                            1.6 总结

                            1.6 Summary

                            几十年来，网络应用软件一直都是从零开始手动开发的。与此过程相关的核心概念和功能需要不断地重新发现和发明，导致网络应用软件的工程和开发成本长期以来居高不下。提高系统化软件重用的质量和数量是解决这一问题的关键。

                            Networked application software has been developed manually from scratch for decades. The continual rediscovery and reinvention of core concepts and capabilities associated with this process has kept the costs of engineering and evolving networked applications too high for too long. Improving the quality and quantity of systematic software reuse is essential to resolve this problem.

                            中间件是一类软件，它尤其擅长为网络应用程序提供系统化的可重用组件。因此，开发和使用中间件是提高重用率的重要途径。然而，中间件的开发和重用面临着诸多技术和非技术挑战。本章阐述了如何应用面向对象框架来克服其中许多挑战。为了帮助用户选择最合适的软件开发技术，我们还介绍了框架与类库、组件、模式以及模型集成计算之间的区别。每种技术都有助于降低软件开发成本和缩短生命周期，并提高软件的质量、功能和性能。

                            Middleware is a class of software that's particularly effective at providing systematically reusable artifacts for networked applications. Developing and using middleware is therefore an important way to increase reuse. There are many technical and nontechnical challenges that make middleware development and reuse hard, however. This chapter described how object-oriented frameworks can be applied to overcome many of these chal-lenges. To make the most appropriate choice of software development technologies, we also described the differences between frameworks and class libraries, components, patterns, and model-integrated computing. Each technology plays a part in reducing software development costs and life cycles and increasing software quality, functionality, and performance.

                            将框架开发原则和模式应用于网络应用领域，催生了 ACE 框架。这些框架能够处理常见的网络编程任务，并可通过 C++ 语言特性进行定制，从而构建完整的网络应用。ACE 框架协同工作，简化了网络应用的创建、组合、配置和移植，且不会造成显著的性能开销。本书的其余部分将阐述 ACE 框架的开发思路和原因，并展示大量示例，说明 ACE 如何利用 C++ 特性来实现其目标。

                            The result of applying framework development principles and patterns to the domain of networked applications has yielded the ACE frameworks. These frameworks handle common network programming tasks and can be customized via C++ language features to produce complete networked applications. When used together, the ACE frameworks simplify the creation, composition, configuration, and porting of networked applications without incurring significant performance overhead. The rest of this book explains how and why the ACE frameworks were developed and shows many examples of how ACE uses C++ features to achieve its goals.

                            ACE 的一个无形但宝贵的优势在于，它将 ACE 框架开发者数十年来积累的知识以专业技术的形式传递给了 ACE 框架用户。这些专业技术体现在经过充分测试的 C++ 类中，这些类实现了久经考验的网络化应用软件开发策略。这些框架的开发、优化和完善耗费了数十个人年的时间。幸运的是，您可以利用这些框架中蕴含的专业知识，而无需独立地重新发现或重新发明支撑它们的模式和类。

                            An intangible, but valuable, benefit of ACE is its transfer of decades of accumulated knowledge from ACE framework developers to ACE framework users in the form of expertise embodied in well-tested C++ classes that implement time-proven networked application software development strategies. These frameworks took scores of person-years to develop, optimize, and mature. Fortunately, you can take advantage of the expertise embodied in these frameworks without having to independently rediscover or reinvent the patterns and classes that underlie them.

                              第二章 服务和配置设计维度

                              Chapter 2. Service and Configuration Design Dimensions

                              C章概要​

                              CHAPTER SYNOPSIS

                              服务是指服务器向客户端提供的一组功能。如今互联网上常见的服务包括：

                              A service is a set of functionality offered to a client by a server. Common services available on the Internet today include

                              • 网络内容检索服务，例如 Apache 和 Google

                              • Web content retrieval services, such as Apache and Google

                              • 软件分发服务，例如 Castanet、Citrix 或 Softricity。

                              • Software distribution services, such as Castanet, Citrix, or Softricity

                              • 电子邮件和网络新闻传输服务

                              • Electronic mail and network news transfer services

                              • 远程计算机上的文件访问

                              • File access on remote machines

                              • 网络时间同步

                              • Network time synchronization

                              • 支付处理服务

                              • Payment processing services

                              • 流媒体音频/视频服务，例如 RealPlayer 和 QuickTime。

                              • Streaming audio/video services, such as RealPlayer and QuickTime

                              可以通过在编译时、静态链接时、安装时或运行时等不同时间点配置其组成服务来创建联网应用程序。

                              Networked applications can be created by configuring their constituent services together at various points of time, such as compile time, static link time, installation time, or run time.

                              C++NPv1 的第 1 章和第 5 章对网络应用程序使用的通信协议和机制以及并发架构进行了领域分析。本章将扩展此范围，分析其他涉及网络应用程序关键属性的设计维度。这些属性包括服务持续时间和结构、网络服务的识别方式以及它们绑定在一起形成完整应用程序的时间。这些设计维度在任何网络应用程序中都至关重要，对于 ACE 服务配置器框架（第 5 章）尤其重要。如果您已经熟悉这些设计维度，则可以跳到第 3 章，该章开始介绍 ACE 框架。

                              Chapters 1 and 5 of C++NPv1 provided a domain analysis of the communication protocols and mechanisms and the concurrency architectures used by networked applications. This chapter expands that coverage to analyze other design dimensions that address key networked application properties. These properties include service duration and structure, how networked services are identified, and the time at which they are bound together to form complete applications. These design dimensions are important in any networked application, and of particular importance to the ACE Service Configurator framework (Chapter 5). If you're already familiar with these design dimensions, however, you may want to skip ahead to Chapter 3, which begins the coverage of the ACE frameworks.

                                2.1 服务和服务器设计维度

                                2.1 Service and Server Design Dimensions

                                在设计网络应用程序时，区分服务（提供给客户端的功能）和服务器（提供服务的机制）至关重要。服务和服务器的设计决策很容易混淆，但应该分开考虑。本节将介绍服务和服务器设计的以下几个方面：

                                When designing networked applications, it's important to recognize the difference between a service, which is a capability offered to clients, and a server, which is the mechanism by which the service is offered. The design decisions regarding services and servers are easily confused, but should be considered separately. This section covers the following service and server design dimensions:

                                • 短期服务与长期服务

                                • Short- versus long-duration services

                                • 内部服务与外部服务

                                • Internal versus external services

                                • 有状态服务与无状态服务

                                • Stateful versus stateless services

                                • 分层/模块化服务与单体服务

                                • Layered/modular versus monolithic services

                                • 单服务服务器与多服务服务器

                                • Single- versus multiservice servers

                                • 一击制胜对阵站立发球

                                • One-shot versus standing servers

                                2.1.1 短期服务与长期服务

                                2.1.1 Short-Duration versus Long-Duration Services

                                网络服务器提供的服务可以分为短时服务和长时服务。这些服务时长反映了服务占用系统资源的时间长短。此设计维度的主要权衡在于：一方面，当系统资源可以更好地用于其他用途时，保留这些资源是必要的；另一方面，当需要重启服务时，则需要承担相应的开销。在网络应用中，此维度与协议选择密切相关，因为不同协议的配置要求可能差异很大。

                                The services offered by network servers can be classified as short duration or long duration. These time durations reflect how long a service holds system resources. The primary tradeoff in this design dimension involves holding system resources when they may be better used elsewhere versus the overhead of restarting a service when it's needed. In a networked application, this dimension is closely related to protocol selection because setup requirements for different protocols can vary significantly.

                                短时服务 执行时间短，通常是固定的，并且一次通常只处理一个请求。短时服务的例子包括计算当前时间、解析 IP 地址的以太网端口号以及从网络文件服务器的缓存中检索磁盘块。为了最大限度地减少建立连接所需的时间，短时服务通常使用无连接协议（例如UDP / IP）来实现[ Ste94 ]。

                                Short-duration services execute in brief, often fixed, amounts of time and usually handle a single request at a time. Examples of short-duration services include computing the current time of day, resolving the Ethernet number of an IP address, and retrieving a disk block from the cache of a network file server. To minimize the amount of time spent setting up a connection, short-duration services are often implemented using connectionless protocols, such as UDP/IP [Ste94].

                                长时间 运行的服务持续时间较长，且持续时间通常可变，在其生命周期内可能会处理大量请求。长时间运行服务的示例包括：通过FTP传输大型软件版本、使用HTTP从 Web 服务器下载 MP3 文件、使用RTSP从服务器流式传输音频和视频、通过TELNET远程访问主机资源以及通过网络执行远程文件系统备份。长时间运行的服务在协议选择方面具有更大的灵活性。例如，为了提高效率和可靠性，这些服务通常使用面向连接的协议（例如TCP / IP [ Ste94 ]）或面向会话的协议（例如RTSP [ SRL98 ] 或SCTP [ SX01 ]）来实现。

                                Long-duration services run for extended, often variable, lengths of time and may handle numerous requests during their lifetime. Examples of long-duration services include transferring large software releases via FTP, downloading MP3files from a Web server using HTTP, streaming audio and video from a server using RTSP, accessing host resources remotely via TELNET, and performing remote file system backups over a network. Services that run for longer durations allow more flexibility in protocol selection. For example, to improve efficiency and reliability, these services are often implemented with connection-oriented protocols, such as TCP/IP [Ste94], or session-oriented protocols, such as RTSP [SRL98] or SCTP [SX01].

                                从单个日志记录的角度来看，我们的服务器日志守护进程 似乎是一个短时服务。每个日志记录的最大长度限制为 4KB，但实际上大多数日志记录远小于此。处理单个日志记录的实际时间也相对较短。然而，由于客户端可能会发送大量日志记录，我们通过设计客户端日志守护进程与对等服务器日志守护进程建立连接来优化性能。然后，我们将这些连接重用于后续的日志请求。为每个日志请求建立和断开套接字连接既浪费资源又耗时，尤其是在频繁发送小型请求的情况下。因此，我们将客户端和服务器日志守护进程建模为长时服务。

                                Logging service From the standpoint of an individual log record, our server logging daemon seems like a short-duration service. Each log record is limited to a maximum length of 4K bytes, though in practice most are much smaller. The actual time spent handling a log record is relatively short. Since a client may transmit many log records, however, we optimize performance by designing client logging daemons to establish connections with their peer server logging daemons. We then reuse these connections for subsequent logging requests. It would be wasteful and time consuming to set up and tear down a socket connection for each logging request, particularly when small requests are sent frequently. We therefore model our client and server logging daemons as long-duration services.

                                2.1.2 内部服务与外部服务

                                2.1.2 Internal versus External Services

                                服务可以分为内部服务或外部服务。这一维度的主要权衡因素包括服务初始化时间、服务间的隔离程度以及简易性。

                                Services can be classified as internal or external. The primary tradeoffs in this dimension are service initialization time, isolation of one service from another, and simplicity.

                                如图 2.1 (1) 所示，内部服务与接收请求的服务器运行在同一地址空间中。如 C++NPv1 第 5 章所述，内部服务可以与其他内部服务进行迭代、并发或响应式交互。内部服务通常具有较低的初始化延迟，并且其上下文切换时间通常比驻留在独立进程中的服务更短。

                                Internal services execute in the same address space as the server that receives the request, as shown in Figure 2.1 (1). As described in Chapter 5 of C++NPv1, an internal service can run iteratively, concurrently, or reactively in relation to other internal services. Internal services usually have low initialization latency and their context switch time is generally shorter than that of services residing in separate processes.

                                图 2.1. 内部服务与外部服务

                                然而，内部服务也可能降低应用程序的健壮性，因为进程内的各个服务彼此之间缺乏保护。因此，一个服务出现故障可能会破坏进程内其他内部服务共享的数据，从而导致错误的结果、进程崩溃或进程无限期挂起。因此，内部服务应该仅用于那些在应用程序地址空间内与其他服务协同运行时能够可靠运行的代码。

                                Internal services may also reduce application robustness, however, since separate services within a process aren't protected from one another. One faulty service can therefore corrupt data shared with other internal services in the process, which may produce incorrect results, crash the process, or cause the process to hang indefinitely. As a result, internal services should be reserved for code that can be trusted to operate correctly when run in the context of other services in an application's address space.

                                外部服务 在不同的进程地址空间中执行。例如，图 2.1 (2) 展示了一个主服务进程，它监控一组网络端口。当客户端发出连接请求时，主服务进程接受连接，然后启动一个新进程来执行外部请求的服务。外部服务可能比内部服务更健壮，因为一个服务的故障不一定会导致其他服务的故障。因此，为了提高健壮性，关键任务应用程序服务通常会被隔离在单独的进程中。然而，这种健壮性的代价可能是由于进程管理和进程间通信 (IPC) 开销而导致的性能下降。

                                External services execute in different process address spaces. For instance, Figure 2.1 (2) illustrates a master service process that monitors a set of network ports. When a connection request arrives from a client, the master accepts the connection and then spawns a new pro-cess to perform the requested service externally. External services may be more robust than internal services since the failure of one need not cause the failure of another. To increase robustness, therefore, mission-critical application services are often isolated in separate processes. The price for this robustness, however, can be a reduction in performance due to process management and IPC overhead.

                                某些服务器框架同时支持内部服务和外部服务。例如，INETD 超级服务器[ Ste98 ] 是一个守护进程，它监听特定端口上的连接请求或消息，并运行程序来执行与这些端口关联的服务。系统管理员可以通过修改inetd.conf配置文件来选择INETD中的内部服务和外部服务，具体操作如下：

                                Some server frameworks support both internal and external services. For example, the INETD superserver [Ste98] is a daemon that listens for connection requests or messages on certain ports and runs programs to perform the services associated with those ports. System administrators can choose between internal and external services in INETD by modifying the inetd.conf configuration file as follows:

                                • INETD可以配置为通过调用INETD程序中静态链接的函数在内部执行短时服务，例如ECHO和DAY TIME。

                                • INETD can be configured to execute short-duration services, such as ECHO and DAYTIME, internally via calls to statically linked functions in the INETD program.

                                • INETD还可以配置为通过生成单独的进程，在外部运行持续时间更长的服务，例如FTP和TELNET。

                                • INETD can also be configured to run longer-duration services, such as FTP and TELNET, externally by spawning separate processes.

                                侧边栏 4（第 31 页）描述了这种以及其他使用内部和外部服务的服务提供机制。

                                Sidebar 4 (page 31) describes this and other service provisioning mechanisms that use both internal and external services.

                                日志服务 本书中所有日志服务器的实现均设计为内部服务。只要日志服务器中只配置了一种类型的服务，我们就无需将其与其他服务的有害副作用隔离。然而，保护不同客户端会话的处理过程彼此独立是有充分理由的，尤其是在使用组件配置器模式 [ POSA2 ] 动态链接服务的情况下。因此，C++NPv1 第 8 章将演示如何使用ACE_Process和ACE_Process_Manager类将日志服务器实现为外部服务。

                                Logging service All logging server implementations in this book are designed as internal services. As long as only one type of service is configured into our logging server, we needn't isolate it from harmful side effects of other services. There are valid reasons to protect the processing of different client sessions from each other, however, particularly if services are linked dynamically using the Component Configurator pattern [POSA2]. Chapter 8 in C++NPv1 therefore illustrates how to implement a logging server as an external service using the ACE_Process and ACE_Process_Manager classes.

                                2.1.3 有状态服务与无状态服务

                                2.1.3 Stateful versus Stateless Services

                                服务可以分为有状态服务和无状态服务。服务在请求之间维护的状态（或上下文）量会影响客户端和服务器的复杂性和资源消耗。有状态服务和无状态服务在效率和可靠性之间进行权衡，正确的选择取决于多种因素，例如主机和网络故障的概率和影响。

                                Services can be classified as stateful or stateless. The amount of state, or context, that a service maintains between requests impacts the complexity and resource consumption of clients and servers. Stateful and stateless services trade off efficiency for reliability, with the right choice depending on a variety of factors, such as the probability and impact of host and network failures.

                                有状态服务 会将某些信息（例如会话状态、身份验证密钥、标识号和 I/O 句柄）缓存到服务器端，以减少通信和计算开销。例如，Web Cookie 使 Web 服务器能够在多个页面请求之间保持状态。

                                Stateful services cache certain information, such as session state, authentication keys, identification numbers, and I/O handles, in a server to reduce communication and computation overhead. For instance, Web cookies enable a Web server to preserve state across multiple page requests.

                                无状态服务 在服务器端不保留任何易失性状态。例如，网络文件系统 (NFS) [ Ste94 ] 提供分布式数据存储和检索服务，这种服务不会在服务器的地址空间中维护任何易失性状态信息。客户端发送的每个请求都完全独立，包含执行该请求所需的所有信息，例如文件句柄、字节数、文件起始偏移量和用户凭据。

                                Stateless services retain no volatile state within a server. For example, the Network File System (NFS) [Ste94] provides distributed data storage and retrieval services that don't maintain volatile state information within a server's address space. Each request sent from a client is completely self-contained with the information needed to carry it out, such as the file handle, byte count, starting file offset, and user credentials.

                                一些常见的网络应用程序，例如FTP和TELNET，不需要在连续的服务调用之间保留持久的应用程序状态信息。这些无状态服务通常配置和重新配置都相当简单可靠。相反，CORBA 命名服务 [ Obj98 ] 是一种常见的中间件服务，它管理着各种绑定，即使包含该服务的服务器崩溃，这些绑定的值也可能需要保留。如果跨故障保持状态对于系统正确性至关重要，则可能需要使用事务监视器 [ GR93 ] 或某种类型的活动复制 [ BvR94 ]。

                                Some common network applications, such as FTP and TELNET, don't require retention of persistent application state information between consecutive service invocations. These stateless services are generally fairly simple to configure and reconfigure reliably. Conversely, the CORBA Naming Service [Obj98] is a common middleware service that manages various bindings whose values may need to be retained even if the server containing the service crashes. If preserving state across failures is paramount to system correctness, you may need to use a transaction monitor [GR93] or some type of active replication [BvR94].

                                日志服务 我们的网络日志服务兼具有状态和无状态的特性。服务器进程维护的状态主要存在于操作系统内核（例如连接块）和文件系统（例如日志记录）中。然而，本书中的客户端和服务器日志守护进程服务都是无状态的，因为它们单独处理每条记录，无需或使用任何来自先前或未来请求的信息，也不对任何先前或未来请求抱有任何预期。由于我们使用TCP / IP 协议，它提供有序可靠的通信字节流，因此无需考虑任何可能的请求顺序。

                                Logging service Our networked logging service exhibits both stateful and stateless characteristics. The state maintained by the server process resides largely in the OS kernel (e.g., connection blocks) and the file system (e.g., the log records). Both client and server logging daemon services in this book are stateless, however, since they process each record individually without requiring or using any information from, or expectation of, any previous or possible future request. The need to handle any possible request ordering is not a factor since we use TCP/IP, which provides an ordered, reliable communication byte stream.

                                2.1.4 分层/模块化服务与单体服务

                                2.1.4 Layered/Modular versus Monolithic Services

                                服务实现可以分为分层/模块化和单体式两种类型。这一维度的主要权衡因素是服务的可重用性、可扩展性和效率。

                                Service implementations can be classified as layered/modular or monolithic. The primary tradeoffs in this dimension are service reusability, extensibility, and efficiency.

                                分层/模块化服务 可以分解为一系列分区且层级相关的任务。例如，应用程序族可以像图 2.2 (1) 所示那样，被指定和实现为分层/模块化服务。每一层都可以处理整个服务中一个独立的部分，例如输入输出、事件分析、事件过滤和服务处理。互连的服务可以通过交换控制消息和数据消息来进行通信。

                                Layered/modular services can be decomposed into a series of partitioned and hierarchically related tasks. For instance, application families can be specified and implemented as layered/modular services, as shown in Figure 2.2 (1). Each layer can handle a self-contained portion of the overall service, such as input and output, event analysis, event filtering, and service processing. Interconnected services can collaborate by exchanging control and data messages for incoming and outgoing communication.

                                图 2.2. 分层/模块化服务与单体服务

                                多年来，涌现出了许多强大的通信框架，用于简化和自动化分层/模块化服务的开发和配置[ SS93 ]。例如，System V STREAMS [ Rit84 ]、x-kernel[ HP91 ]、Conduits+框架[ HJE95 ]和ACE Streams框架（第9章）。这些框架将服务功能与以下服务设计方面解耦：

                                Powerful communication frameworks have emerged over the years to simplify and automate the development and configuration of layered/modular services [SS93]. Examples include System V STREAMS [Rit84], the x-kernel [HP91], the Conduits+ framework [HJE95], and the ACE Streams framework (Chapter 9). These frameworks decouple the service functionality from the following service design aspects:

                                • 组合策略， 例如服务和协议组合在一起的时间和/或顺序（本书第5章和第 9 章对此进行了描述）

                                • Compositional strategies, such as the time and/or order in which services and protocols are composed together (described in Chapters 5 and 9 of this book)

                                • 并发和同步策略， 例如基于任务和消息的架构（在 C++NPv1 第 5 章中描述），这些策略在运行时执行服务。

                                • Concurrency and synchronization strategies, such as task- and message-based architectures (described in Chapter 5 of C++NPv1) that execute services at run time

                                • 通信策略， 例如将服务互连在一起的协议和消息传递机制（在 C++NPv1 的第 1-3 章中描述）[ SS95b ]

                                • Communication strategies, such as the protocols and messaging mechanisms (described in Chapters 1–3of C++NPv1) that interconnect services together [SS95b]

                                单体服务 是由紧密耦合且不按层级组织的功能块组成。它们可能包含一些功能模块，这些模块大致类似于层，但通常通过共享的全局变量紧密耦合，如图2.2 (2)（第 27 页）所示。它们在功能上也常常紧密耦合，控制流图看起来像一团乱麻。因此，单体服务难以理解、维护和扩展。虽然它们有时可能适用于生命周期短的“一次性”原型 [ FY00 ]，但很少适用于需要多个开发人员长期维护和增强的软件。[1]

                                Monolithic services are tightly coupled clumps of functionality that aren't organized hierarchically. They may contain separate modules of functionality that vaguely resemble layers, but are most often tightly coupled via shared, global variables, as shown in Figure 2.2 (2) (page 27). They are also often tightly coupled functionally, with control flow diagrams that look like spaghetti. Monolithic services are therefore hard to understand, maintain, and extend. While they may sometimes be appropriate in short-lived, "throw away" prototypes [FY00], they are rarely suitable for software that must be maintained and enhanced by multiple developers over longer amounts of time.[1]

                                [1]熟练掌握 ACE 工具包后，你会发现构建一个分层原型通常比拼凑一个整体原型要快得多。

                                [1] After you become proficient with the ACE toolkit, you'll find it's usually much faster to build a properly layered prototype than to hack together a monolithic one.

                                开发人员通常可以选择分层或单体服务架构来构建其网络应用程序。第6章和第9章讨论的 ACE Task 和 Streams 框架提供了高效且可扩展的方式来构建模块化服务。设计分层/模块化服务的优势在于：

                                Developers can often select either layered or monolithic service architectures to structure their networked applications. The ACE Task and Streams frameworks, discussed in Chapters 6 and 9, provide efficient and extensible ways to build modular services. The advantages of designing layered/modular services are

                                • 分层增强了重用性，因为多个高层应用程序服务可以共享底层服务。

                                • Layering enhances reuse since multiple higher-layer application services can share lower-layer services.

                                • 通过一系列相互连接的分层服务来实现应用程序，可以透明地、逐步地​​增强其功能。

                                • Implementing applications via an interconnected series of layered services enables transparent, incremental enhancement of their functionality.

                                • 分层/模块化架构允许选择性地省略不必要的服务功能或选择性地配置上下文最佳的服务功能，从而促进宏观层面的性能提升。

                                • A layered/modular architecture facilitates macro-level performance improvements by allowing the selective omission of unnecessary service functionality or selective configuration of contextually optimal service functionality.

                                • 模块化设计通常可以改善网络应用程序和服务的实施、测试和维护。

                                • Modular designs generally improve the implementation, testing, and maintenance of networked applications and services.

                                然而，使用分层/模块化架构开发网络应用程序也存在一些缺点：

                                There can also be some disadvantages, however, with using a layered/modular architecture to develop networked applications:

                                • 分层实现的模块化特性可能会导致过多的开销。例如，如果相邻层之间的缓冲区大小不匹配，则分层可能效率低下，从而导致额外的分段、重组和传输延迟。

                                • The modularity of layered implementations can cause excessive overhead. For example, layering may be inefficient if buffer sizes don't match in adjacent layers, thereby causing additional segmentation, reassembly, and transmission delays.

                                • 层与层之间的通信必须经过合理的设计和实现，这可能会引入另一个错误来源。

                                • Communication between layers must be designed and implemented properly, which can introduce another source of errors.

                                • 在具有严格实时性要求的应用程序中，信息隐藏在层级中可能会使资源的可预测性管理变得困难。

                                • Information hiding within layers can make it hard to manage resources predictably in applications with stringent real-time requirements.

                                日志服务通过仔细分离设计关注点，我们的客户端和服务器日志守护程序采用 图 2.3所示的分层/模块化架构进行设计，如下所述。

                                Logging service By carefully separating design concerns, our client and server logging daemons are designed using the layered/modular architecture depicted in Figure 2.3 and described below.

                                图 2.3. 网络化日志服务架构层

                                1. 事件基础设施层 负责检测和解复用事件，并将其分发给关联的事件处理程序。第3章和第4章介绍了如何应用 Reactor 模式和 ACE Reactor 框架来实现通用的事件基础设施层。同样，第 8 章介绍了如何应用 Proactor 模式和 ACE Proactor 框架来实现类似的目的。

                                2. Event infrastructure layer, which detects and demultiplexes events and dispatches them to their associated event handlers. Chapters 3 and 4 describe how the Reactor pattern and ACE Reactor framework can be applied to implement a generic event infrastructure layer. Likewise, Chapter 8 describes how the Proactor pattern and ACE Proactor framework can be applied for a similar purpose.

                                3. 配置管理层 负责安装、初始化、控制和关闭服务组件。第 5 章介绍了如何应用组件配置器模式和 ACE 服务配置器框架来实现通用配置管理层。

                                4. Configuration management layer, which installs, initializes, controls, and shuts service components down. Chapter 5 describes how the Component Configurator pattern and ACE Service Configurator framework can be applied to implement a generic configuration management layer.

                                5. 连接管理和并发层 执行独立于应用程序功能的连接和初始化服务。第6章和第7章描述了 Acceptor-Connector 和 Half-Sync/Half-Async 模式以及 ACE Acceptor-Connector 和 Task 框架如何实现通用的连接管理层。

                                6. Connection management and concurrency layer, which performs connection and initialization services that are independent of application functionality. Chapters 6 and 7 describe how the Acceptor-Connector and Half-Sync/Half-Async patterns and the ACE Acceptor-Connector and Task frameworks can implement a generic connection management layer.

                                7. 应用层 对其他层提供的应用无关类进行自定义，以创建用于配置应用程序、处理事件、建立连接、交换数据以及执行特定日志处理的具体对象。本书将阐述如何使用 ACE 框架和 ACE 包装外观类来实现这些应用层功能。

                                8. Application layer, which customizes the application-independent classes provided by the other layers to create concrete objects that configure applications, handle events, establish connections, exchange data, and perform logging-specific processing. Throughout this book, we illustrate how to implement these application-level capabilities using the ACE frameworks and the ACE wrapper facade classes.

                                2.1.5 单服务服务器与多服务服务器

                                2.1.5 Single-Service versus Multiservice Servers

                                协议和服务很少独立运行，通常都是在服务器的上下文中由应用程序访问的。服务器可以设计为单服务服务器，也可以设计为多服务服务器。这方面的权衡在于资源消耗与服务器健壮性之间。

                                Protocols and services rarely operate in isolation, but instead are accessed by applications within the context of a server. Servers can be designed either as single service or multiservice. The tradeoff in this dimension is between resource consumption versus robustness.

                                单服务服务器仅提供一种服务。如图 2.4 (1) 所示，服务可以是内部服务或外部服务，但每个进程只能有一个服务。单服务服务器的示例包括：

                                Single-service servers offer only one service. As shown in Figure 2.4 (1), a service can be internal or external, but there's only a single service per process. Examples of single-service servers include

                                图 2.4. 单服务服务器与多服务服务器

                                • RWHO守护进程（RWHOD）负责报告活跃用户的身份和数量，以及主机工作负载和主机可用性。

                                • The RWHO daemon (RWHOD), which reports the identity and number of active users, as well as host workloads and host availability

                                • 早期版本的 UNIX 标准网络服务，如FTP和TELNET，作为独立的单服务守护进程在操作系统启动时启动 [ Ste98 ​​]

                                • Early versions of UNIX standard network services, such as FTP and TELNET, that ran as distinct single-service daemons initiated at OS boot time [Ste98]

                                这些单服务服务器的每个实例都在单独的进程中外部执行。然而，随着系统服务器数量的增加，这种静态配置的、每个进程一个服务的方法出现了以下局限性：

                                Each instance of these single-service servers executed externally in a separate process. As the number of system servers increased, however, this statically configured, single-service-per-process approach incurred the following limitations:

                                • 它消耗了过多的操作系统资源，例如虚拟内存和进程表槽位。

                                • It consumed excessive OS resources, such as virtual memory and process table slots.

                                • 这导致每个服务程序都需要单独编写冗余的初始化和网络代码。

                                • It caused redundant initialization and networking code to be written separately for each service program.

                                • 要安装新的服务实现，需要手动关闭并重新启动正在运行的进程。

                                • It required running processes to be shut down and restarted manually to install new service implementations.

                                • 这导致人们采用临时性和不一致的行政机制来控制不同类型的服务。

                                • It led to ad hoc and inconsistent administrative mechanisms' being used to control different types of services.

                                多服务服务器 通过将多个单服务服务器集成到一个单一的管理单元中，解决了单服务服务器的局限性，如图2.4 (2) 所示。多服务服务器的示例包括INETD（源自 BSD UNIX [MBKQ96, Ste98]）、LISTEN（System V UNIX 网络监听器服务 [ Rag93 ]）以及服务控制管理器 ( SCM )（源自 Windows NT [ SR00 ]）。侧边栏 4对这些多服务服务器进行了比较和对比。

                                Multiservice servers address the limitations with single-service servers by integrating a collection of single-service servers into a single administrative unit, as shown in Figure 2.4 (2). Examples of multiservice servers include INETD (which originated with BSD UNIX [MBKQ96, Ste98]), LISTEN (which is the System V UNIX network listener service [Rag93]), and the Service Control Manager (SCM) (which originated with Windows NT [SR00]). Sidebar 4 compares and contrasts these multiservice servers.

                                侧边栏 4：多服务服务器框架比较

                                Sidebar 4: Comparing Multiservice Server Frameworks

                                此侧边栏比较了各种 UNIX 和 Windows 版本支持的多服务服务器框架。

                                This sidebar compares the multiservice server frameworks supported by various versions of UNIX and Windows.

                                • INETD的内部服务（例如ECHO和DAYTIME）在静态链路建立时是固定的。主INETD守护进程允许动态重新配置其外部服务（例如FTP或TELNET）。例如，当INETD守护进程收到SIGHUP信号时，它会读取inetd.conf文件，并对该文件中列出的所有服务执行socket()/bind()/listen()序列。然而，由于INETD不支持动态重新配置内部服务，因此任何新列出的服务仍然必须通过fork()和exec*()系列系统函数来创建从属守护进程进行处理。

                                • INETD's internal services, such as ECHO and DAYTIME, are fixed at static link time. The master INETD daemon permits dynamic reconfiguration of its external services, such as FTP or TELNET. For instance, when the INETD daemon is sent the SIGHUP signal, it reads its inetd.conf file and performs the socket()/bind()/listen() sequence for all services listed in that file. Since INETD does not support dynamic reconfiguration of internal services, however, any newly listed services must still be processed by spawning slave daemons via fork() and the exec*() family of system functions.

                                • System V UNIX LISTEN端口监控工具与INETD类似，但它仅支持通过TLI和 System V STREAMS访问的面向连接的协议，并且不提供内部服务。然而，与INETD不同的是， LISTEN支持常驻服务器，它通过STREAMS管道将初始化的文件描述符从LISTEN进程传递给先前注册的常驻服务器。

                                • The System V UNIX LISTEN port monitoring facility is similar to INETD, though it only supports connection-oriented protocols accessed via TLI and System V STREAMS, and doesn't provide internal services. Unlike INETD, however, LISTEN supports standing servers by passing initialized file descriptors via STREAMS pipes from the LISTEN process to a previously registered standing server.

                                • 与INETD和LISTEN不同，Windows SCM并非端口监视器，因为它不提供内置的监听 I/O 端口集并在客户端请求到达时按需调度服务器进程的功能。相反，它提供了一个基于 RPC 的接口，允许主SCM进程自动启动和控制（例如，暂停、恢复或终止）管理员安装的服务（例如FTP和TELNET）。这些服务通常作为独立线程在单服务或多服务守护进程中运行。每个已安装的服务都负责配置自身并监视所有通信端点。这些端点可能比TCP或UDP套接字更通用，例如，它们可以是 Windows 命名管道。

                                • Unlike INETD and LISTEN, the Windows SCM is not a port monitor since it doesn't provide built-in support for listening to a set of I/O ports and dispatching server processes on demand when client requests arrive. Instead, it provides an RPC-based interface that allows a master SCM process to automatically initiate and control (i.e., pause, resume, or terminate) administrator-installed services (such as FTP and TELNET) that typically run as separate threads within either a single-service or a multiservice daemon process. Each installed service is individually responsible for configuring the service and monitoring any communication endpoints. These endpoints may be more general than TCP or UDP sockets, for example, they can be Windows named pipes.

                                多服务服务器可以带来以下好处：

                                A multiservice server can yield the following benefits:

                                • 它可以按需生成服务器，从而降低操作系统资源消耗。

                                • It can reduce OS resource consumption by spawning servers on demand.

                                • 它通过自动守护服务器进程（在侧边栏 5中描述）、初始化传输端点、监控端口以及将客户端请求解复用/分派到服务处理程序，简化了服务器开发并重用了通用代码。

                                • It simplifies server development and reuses common code by automatically daemonizing a server process (described in Sidebar 5), initializing transport endpoints, monitoring ports, and demultiplexing/dispatching client requests to service handlers.

                                • 它可以允许在不修改现有源代码或终止正在运行的服务器进程的情况下更新外部服务。

                                • It can allow external services to be updated without modifying existing source code or terminating running server processes.

                                • 它通过一套统一的配置管理工具整合了网络服务管理。例如，INETD超级服务器提供了一个统一的接口，用于协调和启动外部服务（如FTP和TELNET）以及内部服务（如DAYTIME和ECHO）。

                                • It consolidates network service administration via a uniform set of configuration management utilities. For example, the INETD superserver provides a uniform interface for coordinating and initiating external services, such as FTP and TELNET, and internal services, such as DAYTIME and ECHO.

                                日志服务： C++NPv1 中网络日志服务的实现均采用单服务服务器。本书 第 5 章开始，将通过 ACE 服务配置器框架配置网络日志服务中的各种实体，该框架可用于配置类似于INETD的多服务超级服务器。

                                Logging service Implementations of the networked logging service in C++NPv1 all used single-service servers. Starting in Chapter 5 of this book, various entities in the networked logging service will be configured via the ACE Service Configurator framework, which can be used to configure multiservice superservers similar to INETD.

                                侧边栏 5：守护进程和守护进程化

                                Sidebar 5: Daemons and Daemonizing

                                守护进程是一种长时间运行的服务器进程，它在“后台”执行各种服务，代表客户端运行[ Ste98 ]。守护进程不与交互式用户或控制终端关联。因此，确保守护进程设计得足够健壮，能够从错误中恢复并谨慎管理其资源至关重要。

                                A daemon is a long-running server process that executes in the "background" performing various services on behalf of clients [Ste98]. A daemon is not associated with an interactive user or controlling terminal. It's therefore important to ensure a daemon is designed robustly to recover from errors and to manage its resources carefully.

                                将 UNIX 进程守护化涉及生成一个新的服务器进程、关闭所有不必要的 I/O 句柄、将当前文件系统目录更改为与发起用户的目录不同的目录、重置文件访问创建掩码、与控制进程组和控制终端解除关联，以及忽略终端 I/O 相关事件和信号。ACE 服务器可以通过调用静态方法 ` ACE::daemonize()`或将`-b`选项传递给`ACE_Service_Config::open()`（第 141 页）将自身转换为 UNIX 上的守护进程。Windows 服务 [ Ric97 ] 是一种守护进程，可以使用ACE_NT_Service类在 ACE 中进行编程。

                                Daemonizing a UNIX process involves spawning a new server process, closing all unnecessary I/O handles, changing the current filesystem directory away from the initiating user's, resetting the file access creation mask, disassociating from the controlling process group and controlling terminal, and ignoring terminal I/O-related events and signals. An ACE server can convert itself into a daemon on UNIX by invoking the static method ACE::daemonize() or passing the '-b' option to ACE_Service_Config::open() (page 141). A Windows Service [Ric97] is a form of daemon and can be programmed in ACE using the ACE_NT_Service class.

                                2.1.6 一次性发球与站立式发球

                                2.1.6 One-shot versus Standing Servers

                                除了单服务或多服务之外，网络服务器还可以设计为一次性运行或持续运行。这方面的主要权衡在于服务器的运行时间和系统资源的占用情况。在评估这方面的选择时，应考虑服务器所提供服务的预期使用频率，以及对启动速度和配置灵活性的要求。

                                In addition to being single service or multiservice, networked servers can be designed as either one shot or standing. The primary tradeoffs in this dimension involve how long the server runs and uses system resources. When evaluating choices in this dimension, consider anticipated usage frequency for the service(s) offered by the server, as well as requirements for startup speed and configuration flexibility.

                                一次性服务器 按需创建，例如由INETD超级服务器创建。它们在单独的线程或进程中执行服务请求，如图2.5 (1) 所示。一次性服务器在触发其创建的请求或会话完成后终止。UNIX FTP服务器就是一个一次性服务器的例子。当FTP客户端连接到服务器时，会创建一个新进程来处理FTP会话，包括用户身份验证和文件传输。当客户端会话结束时， FTP服务器进程退出。

                                One-shot servers are spawned on demand, for example, by an INETD superserver. They perform service requests in a separate thread or process, as shown in Figure 2.5 (1). A one-shot server terminates after the completion of the request or session that triggered its creation. An example of a one-shot server is a UNIX FTP server. When an FTP client connects to the server, a new process is spawned to handle the FTP session, including user authentication and file transfers. The FTP server process exits when the client session ends.

                                图 2.5. 单次发球与站立发球

                                一次性服务器在空闲时不会驻留在系统内存中。因此，这种设计策略可以消耗更少的系统资源，例如虚拟内存和进程表槽位。对于很少使用的服务，这种优势尤为显著。

                                A one-shot server doesn't remain in system memory when it's idle. Therefore, this design strategy can consume fewer system resources, such as virtual memory and process table slots. This advantage is clearly more pronounced for services that are seldom used.

                                常驻服务器 会在处理完任何特定服务请求或会话后继续运行。常驻服务器通常在启动时或由超级服务器在收到第一个客户端请求后启动。它们可以通过连接到超级服务器的本地进程间通信 (IPC) 通道（例如命名管道或套接字）接收连接和/或服务请求，如图2.5 (2) 所示。或者，常驻服务器可以从原始服务调用中获取或继承一个 IPC 通道。

                                Standing servers continue to run beyond the lifetime of any particular service request or session they process. Standing servers are often initiated at boot time or by a superserver after the first client request. They may receive connection and/or service requests via local IPC channels, such as named pipes or sockets, that are attached to a superserver, as shown in Figure 2.5 (2). Alternatively, a standing server may take ownership of, or inherit, an IPC channel from the original service invocation.

                                Apache Web 服务器 [ HMS98 ] 就是一个典型的常驻服务器。Apache 的初始父进程可以配置为预先生成一组子进程，用于处理客户端的 HTTP 请求。每个子进程在处理一定数量的客户端请求后就会退出。父进程可以根据 Web 服务器的负载情况，按需生成新的子进程。

                                An example of a standing server is the Apache Web server [HMS98]. Apache's initial parent process can be configured to pre-spawn a pool of child processes that service client HTTP requests. Each child process services a tunable number of client requests before it exits. The parent process can spawn new child processes as required to support the load on the Web server.

                                与一次性服务器相比，常驻服务器可以通过分摊服务器进程或线程的启动成本来缩短服务响应时间，从而应对一系列客户端请求。例如，Apache 服务器就具备这种特性，可以进行自适应调优以支持不同类型的负载。此外，常驻服务器能够定期终止并重启服务进程，从而有效防止操作系统或应用程序出现内存泄漏等问题，避免性能随时间推移而下降或演变成安全漏洞。

                                Compared with one-shot servers, standing servers can improve service response time by amortizing the cost of spawning a server process or thread over a series of client requests. As in Apache's case, they can also be tuned adaptively to support differing types of load. The ability of a standing server design to terminate and respawn service processes periodically can also guard against OS or application problems, such as memory leaks, that degrade performance over time or become security holes.

                                日志服务： 为了提升系统整体性能，我们在网络日志服务中将客户端和服务器日志守护进程作为常驻服务器运行。考虑到日志服务使用频繁，我们认为占用进程槽位和系统资源是合理的。如果每次客户端都重启日志服务器，会延迟客户端的请求，从而降低系统整体性能。

                                Logging service We implement the client and server logging daemons in our networked logging service as standing servers to improve performance of the overall system. We justify the tradeoff of occupying process slots and system resources since logging is a service that's used frequently. Thus, restarting a logging server for each client would delay the client making the request and degrade overall system performance.

                                一次性服务器和常驻服务器的选择与第 2.1.1 节中描述的短时服务和长时服务的选择是相互独立的。前者通常反映了操作系统资源管理的限制，而后者则是服务本身的属性。例如，我们可以轻松地将服务更改为短时服务，而无需改变服务器本身的常驻特性。同样，如果日志服务在某些环境中使用频率较低，则可以轻松地将其更改为一次性服务器，而无需重新评估每次服务请求的持续时间。

                                The choice between one-shot or standing servers is orthogonal to the choice between short- or long-duration services described in Section 2.1.1. The former design alternative usually reflects OS resource management constraints, whereas the latter design alternative is a property of a service. For example, we could easily change to a short-duration service without changing the standing nature of the server itself. Likewise, if the logging service is lightly used in some environments, it could easily be changed to a one-shot server, with or without revisiting the duration of each service request.

                                  2.2 配置设计尺寸

                                  2.2 Configuration Design Dimensions

                                  本节涵盖以下配置设计维度：

                                  This section covers the following configuration design dimensions:

                                  • 静态命名与动态命名

                                  • Static versus dynamic naming

                                  • 静态链接与动态链接

                                  • Static versus dynamic linking

                                  • 静态配置与动态配置

                                  • Static versus dynamic configuration

                                  2.2.1 静态命名与动态命名

                                  2.2.1 Static versus Dynamic Naming

                                  应用程序可以根据其服务名称是静态命名还是动态命名进行分类。这一维度的主要权衡在于运行时效率与灵活性之间的平衡。

                                  Applications can be categorized according to whether their services are named statically or dynamically. The primary tradeoff in this dimension involves run-time efficiency versus flexibility.

                                  静态命名服务 将服务名称与编译时和/或静态链接时已存在的对象代码关联起来。例如，INETD的内部服务（如ECHO和DAYTIME）绑定到存储在INETD程序内部的静态命名函数。静态命名服务可以在静态库或动态库中实现。

                                  Statically named services associate the name of a service with object code that exists at compile time and/or static link time. For example, INETD's internal services, such as ECHO and DAYTIME, are bound to statically named functions stored internally in the INETD program. A statically named service can be implemented in either static or dynamic libraries.

                                  动态命名服务 会延迟将服务名称与实现该服务的对象代码关联起来。因此，在应用程序运行时开始执行相应的服务之前，无需识别代码，甚至无需编写、编译和链接代码。INETD对外部服务TELNET的处理就是一个典型的动态命名示例。可以通过修改inetd.conf配置文件并向 INETD 进程发送SIGHUP信号来更新外部服务。当INETD收到此信号时，它会重新读取inetd.conf文件，并将提供的服务动态地重新绑定到新的可执行文件。

                                  Dynamically named services defer the association of a service name with the object code that implements the service. Code therefore needn't be identified—nor even be written, compiled, and linked—until an application begins executing the corresponding service at run time. A common example of dynamic naming is demonstrated by INETD's handling of TELNET, which is an external service. External services can be updated by modifying the inetd.conf configuration file and sending the SIGHUP signal to the INETD process. When INETD receives this signal, it rereads inetd.conf and dynamically rebinds the services it offers to their new executables.

                                  2.2.2 静态链接与动态链接

                                  2.2.2 Static versus Dynamic Linking

                                  应用程序还可以根据其服务是静态链接还是动态链接到进程地址空间进行分类。这一维度的主要权衡因素包括可扩展性、安全性、可靠性和效率。

                                  Applications can also be categorized according to whether their services are linked into a process address space statically or dynamically. The primary tradeoffs in this dimension involve extensibility, security, reliability, and efficiency.

                                  静态链接通过在编译时和/或静态链接时将所有目标文件绑定在一起来创建一个完整的可执行程序，如图2.6 (1) 所示。

                                  Static linking creates a complete executable program by binding together all its object files at compile time and/or static link time, as shown in Figure 2.6 (1).

                                  图 2.6. 静态链接与动态链接

                                  如图 2.6 (2) 所示，动态链接在程序首次调用或运行时更新时，将目标文件加载到进程的地址空间中，并从中卸载目标文件。操作系统运行时链接器会更新目标文件加载到的每个进程的外部符号地址，以反映文件加载到的内存区域。操作系统通常支持两种类型的动态链接：

                                  Dynamic linking loads object files into and unloads object files from the address space of a process when a program is invoked initially or updated at run time, as shown in Figure 2.6 (2). The OS run-time linker updates external symbol addresses for each process that the object file is loaded into to reflect the memory region the file is loaded into. Operating systems generally support two types of dynamic linking:

                                  • 隐式动态链接 在程序执行期间加载引用的目标文件，而无需程序本身显式执行任何操作。许多平台都提供了延迟地址解析和重定位操作的选项，直到方法首次被引用时才执行。这种惰性求值策略最大限度地减少了应用程序初始化期间的链接编辑开销。隐式动态链接用于实现动态链接库(DLL) [ SR00 ]，也称为共享库[ GLDW87 ]。

                                  • Implicit dynamic linking loads referenced object files during program execution without explicit action by the program itself. Many platforms offer the option to defer address resolution and relocation operations until a method is first referenced. This lazy evaluation strategy minimizes link editing overhead during application initialization. Implicit dynamic linking is used to implement dynamically linked libraries (DLLs) [SR00], also known as shared libraries [GLDW87].

                                  • 显式动态链接 允许应用程序获取、使用和移除 DLL 中定义的某些函数或数据相关符号的运行时地址绑定。流行的操作系统支持的显式动态链接机制包括 UNIX 函数（dlopen()、dlsym()和dlclose()）和 Windows 函数（LoadLibrary()、GetProcAddress()和FreeLibrary()）。

                                    动态链接有助于降低内存中进程及其存储在磁盘上的程序映像的内存消耗。理想情况下，无论有多少进程同时执行 DLL 代码，都只会存在一份 DLL 代码副本。

                                    在动态链接和静态链接之间进行选择时，开发人员必须仔细权衡灵活性、安全性和健壮性与时间和空间效率方面的潜在优势。以下是使用动态链接的一些缺点：

                                  • Explicit dynamic linking allows an application to obtain, use, and remove the run-time address bindings of certain function- or data-related symbols defined in DLLs. Explicit dynamic linking mechanisms supported by popular operating systems include UNIX functions (dlopen(), dlsym(), and dlclose()) and Windows functions (LoadLibrary(), GetProcAddress(), and FreeLibrary()).

                                    Dynamic linking can help to reduce the memory consumption of both a process in memory and its program image stored on disk. Ideally, only one copy of DLL code will exist, regardless of the number of processes that execute the DLL code simultaneously.

                                    When choosing between dynamic and static linking, developers must carefully weigh tradeoffs between flexibility, security, and robustness against the potential benefits of time and space efficiency. The following are some downsides to using dynamic linking:

                                  • 安全性和健壮性问题。 动态链接应用程序的安全性和健壮性可能低于静态链接应用程序。安全性较低的原因在于，木马程序可能被植入到 DLL 中。健壮性较低的原因在于，一个有缺陷的 DLL 可能会破坏同一应用程序进程中其他代码或数据的状态。

                                  • Security and robustness problems. A dynamically linked application may be less secure and robust than a statically linked application. It may be less secure because trojan horses can be interposed in DLLs. It may be less robust because a faulty DLL can corrupt the state of other code or data in the same application process.

                                  • 运行时开销。 与静态链接相比，动态链接会产生更多的运行时开销。除了打开和映射多个文件之外，DLL 中的外部符号地址还必须根据文件加载到的内存位置进行调整。虽然延迟链接可以缓解这种影响，但仍然会很明显，尤其是在 DLL 首次加载到内存时。此外，生成位置无关代码的编译器通常会使用额外的间接寻址层来解析方法调用和访问 DLL 中的全局变量 [ GLDW87 ]。

                                  • Run-time overhead. Dynamic linking can incur more run-time overhead compared with static linking. In addition to opening and mapping multiple files, external symbol addresses in DLLs must be adjusted based on the memory locations the files are loaded into. Although lazy linking can ameliorate this effect, it can be noticeable, especially the first time a DLL is loaded into memory. Moreover, compilers that generate position-independent code often use extra levels of indirection to resolve method invocations and access global variables within DLLs [GLDW87].

                                  • 抖动过大。 对时间要求严格的应用程序可能无法容忍将 DLL 链接到进程中以及动态解析方法地址的延迟。

                                  • Excessive jitter. Time-critical applications may be unable to tolerate the latency of linking DLLs into a process and resolving method addresses dynamically.

                                  当然，您应该通过实证研究来评估动态链接的影响，以确定它是否真的会给您的应用程序带来问题。

                                  Naturally, you should empirically evaluate the impact of dynamic linking to determine whether it's really an issue for your applications.

                                  2.2.3 静态配置与动态配置

                                  2.2.3 Static versus Dynamic Configuration

                                  如第 2.1 节所述，网络应用程序通常提供或使用各种服务。结合第2.2.1节和2.2.2节中描述的命名和链接维度，我们可以将网络应用程序服务分为静态配置和动态配置两类。与静态链接和动态链接类似，此维度的主要权衡因素涉及可扩展性、安全性、可靠性和效率。

                                  As described in Section 2.1, networked applications often offer or use a variety of services. By combining the naming and linking dimensions described in Sections 2.2.1 and 2.2.2, we can classify networked application services as being either statically or dynamically configured. As with static versus dynamic linking, the primary tradeoffs in this dimension involve extensibility, security, reliability, and efficiency.

                                  静态配置 是指初始化包含静态命名服务的应用程序（即，将每个服务开发为单独的函数或类），然后在单独的操作系统进程中编译、链接和执行这些服务。在这种情况下，应用程序中的服务无法在运行时进行扩展。对于仅包含可信服务的安全应用程序而言，这种设计可能是必要的。静态配置的应用程序还可以受益于适用于静态链接程序的更强大的编译器优化。

                                  Static configuration refers to the activities associated with initializing an application that contains statically named services (i.e., developing each service as a separate function or class) and then compiling, linking, and executing them in a separate OS process. In this case, the services in the application cannot be extended at run time. This design may be necessary for secure applications that only contain trusted services. Statically configured applications can also benefit from the more aggressive compiler optimizations applicable to statically linked programs.

                                  然而，静态配置网络应用程序和服务存在一些问题：

                                  However, there are several problems with statically configuring networked applications and services:

                                  • 它们可能导致不可扩展的应用程序和软件架构，这些架构将特定服务的实现和配置与应用程序中的其他服务紧密耦合在一起。

                                  • They can yield nonextensible applications and software architectures that tightly couple the implementation and the configuration of a particular service with respect to other services in an application.

                                  • 静态配置限制了系统管理员更改应用程序参数或配置以适应本地运行条件或网络和硬件配置变化的能力。

                                  • Static configuration limits the ability of system administrators to change the parameters or configuration of applications to suit local operating conditions or variations in network and hardware configurations.

                                  • 由于可执行文件体积庞大，大规模静态配置应用程序可能难以交付，加载时间过长，并且如果内存不足，还可能导致系统崩溃，因此可能并不实用。

                                  • Large-scale statically configured applications may be impractical due to their executable size, which can be hard to deliver, take excessive time to load, and can cause thrashing in systems if sufficient memory isn't available.

                                  动态配置 是指与初始化提供动态命名服务的应用程序相关的活动。当与显式动态链接和进程/线程创建机制结合使用时，动态配置的应用程序提供的服务可以在安装或启动时，甚至在运行时进行扩展。这种可扩展性可以带来以下与配置相关的优化：

                                  Dynamic configuration refers to the activities associated with initializing an application that offers dynamically named services. When combined with explicit dynamic linking and process/thread creation mechanisms, the services offered by applications configured dynamically can be extended at installation or boot time, or even during run time. This extensibility can yield the following configuration-related optimizations:

                                  • 动态服务重配置。 高可用性网络应用，例如在线交易处理或电信呼叫处理系统，可能需要灵活的动态重配置管理能力。例如，可能需要在不中断服务器正在运行的其他服务的情况下，将新版本的服务逐步部署到服务器上。基于显式动态链接机制的重配置协议可以增强网络应用的功能和灵活性，因为它们允许在运行时插入、删除或修改服务，而无需先停止并重启底层进程或线程[ SS94 ]。

                                  • Dynamic service reconfiguration. Highly available networked applications, such as online transaction processing or telecom call processing systems, may require flexible dynamic reconfiguration management capabilities. For example, it may be necessary to phase a new version of a service into a server without disrupting other services that it's already executing. Reconfiguration protocols based on explicit dynamic linking mechanisms can enhance the functionality and flexibility of networked applications since they enable services to be inserted, deleted, or modified at run time without first stopping and restarting the underlying process or thread(s) [SS94].

                                  • 功能子集化。 动态配置简化了为在各种操作系统平台上运行的应用程序系列生成功能子集所需的步骤。显式动态链接支持对服务进行细粒度的添加、删除或修改。这使得同一框架既可用于空间高效的嵌入式应用程序，也可用于大型企业分布式应用程序。例如，通过动态配置图像渲染、Java 功能、打印或直接拨号等子集，Web 浏览应用程序可以在 PDA、PC 和/或工作站上运行。

                                  • Functional subsetting. Dynamic configuration simplifies the steps necessary to produce subsets of functionality for application families developed to run on a range of OS platforms. Explicit dynamic linking enables the fine-grain addition, removal, or modification of services. This in turn allows the same framework to be used for space-efficient embedded applications and for large enterprise distributed applications. For example, a Web browsing application may be able to run on PDAs, PCs, and/or workstations by dynamically configuring subsets, such as image rendering, Java capability, printing, or direct phone number dialing.

                                  • 应用程序负载均衡。 由于运行时工作负载可能变化很大，因此通常很难预先确定应用程序服务的处理特性。因此，可能需要使用动态配置来支持负载均衡技术 [ OOS01 ] 和系统分区，将应用程序服务分布在网络中不同的主机上。例如，开发人员可以将某些服务（例如图像处理）部署在客户端/服务器边界的两侧。如果服务器应用程序中配置了过多服务，并且同时有过多活跃客户端访问这些服务，则可能会出现瓶颈。反之，如果客户端运行在配置较低、性能较差的机器上，则将过多服务配置到客户端也可能导致瓶颈。

                                  • Application workload balancing. It's often hard to determine the processing characteristics of application services in advance since workloads can vary considerably at run time. It may therefore be necessary to use dynamic configuration to support load balancing techniques [OOS01] and system partitionings that locate application services on different host machines throughout a network. For example, developers may have the opportunity to collocate or distribute certain services, such as image processing, on either side of a client/server boundary. Bottlenecks may result if many services are configured into a server application and too many active clients access these services simultaneously. Conversely, configuring many services into clients can result in a bottleneck if clients execute on cheaper, less powerful machines.

                                  日志服务：本书第 3章和第 4章中，我们使用 C++NPv1 实现的网络日志服务采用静态配置。第 5 章介绍了ACE_DLL，它是一个可移植的封装外观，封装了动态加载/卸载共享库 (DLL) 以及在其中查找符号的功能。我们还介绍了 ACE 服务配置器框架，它可以动态配置应用程序服务。从第 5 章开始，我们的大多数示例都采用动态配置。

                                  Logging service Our networked logging service implementations in C++NPv1 and in Chapters 3 and 4 of this book are configured statically. In Chapter 5 of this book, we describe ACE_DLL, which is a portable wrapper facade that encapsulates the ability to load/unload shared libraries (DLLs) dynamically and find symbols in them. We also describe the ACE Service Configurator framework, which can configure application services dynamically. From Chapter 5 onward most of our examples are configured dynamically.

                                    2.3 总结

                                    2.3 Summary

                                    本章描述了与网络应用程序的成功开发和部署相关的两类设计维度。服务设计维度影响应用程序服务的结构、开发和实例化方式。服务配置维度影响用户或管理员在交付和部署后更改网络服务运行时位置和配置的能力。

                                    This chapter described two groups of design dimensions related to the successful development and deployment of networked applications. Service design dimensions affect the ways in which application services are structured, developed, and instantiated. Service configuration dimensions affect user or administrator abilities to vary the run-time placement and configuration of networked services after delivery and deployment.

                                    服务设计维度对应用程序如何有效地利用系统和网络资源有着显著的影响。高效的资源利用与应用程序的响应时间以及整体系统性能和可扩展性密切相关。性能是最终用户能够直接感知的重要因素。虽然连贯且模块化的设计对最终用户而言不太明显，但它对产品的长期成功至关重要。

                                    Service design dimensions have a significant impact on how effectively applications use system and network resources. Efficient resource usage is closely linked to application response time, as well as to overall system performance and scalability. Performance is an important factor that's visible to end users. Though a coherent and modular design is less visible to end users, it's critical to a product's long-term success.

                                    优秀的设计能够简化维护，并使应用程序功能能够根据市场变化和竞争压力不断演进，而不会损失质量或性能。幸运的是，性能和模块化并非不可兼得。通过仔细考虑服务设计维度并合理运用 ACE，您将能够创建高效且设计精良的网络应用程序。

                                    Good design simplifies maintenance and allows application functionality to evolve in response to market changes and competitive pressures without losing quality or performance. Fortunately, performance and modularity needn't be an either/or proposition. By carefully considering service design dimensions and applying ACE judiciously, you'll be able to create highly efficient and well-designed networked applications.

                                    即使是精心设计的服务和应用程序也可能需要适应各种部署环境和用户需求。服务配置涉及在识别特定服务集和将这些服务链接到一个或多个应用程序的地址空间相关的设计决策之间进行权衡。为了实现成功的解决方案，必须权衡网络应用程序的灵活性与其安全性、封装性和复杂性等问题。

                                    Even well-designed services and applications may need to adapt to a variety of deployment environments and user demands. Service configuration dimensions involve tradeoffs between design decisions associated with identifying a particular set of services and linking these services into the address space of one or more applications. To produce successful solutions, a networked application's flexibility must be weighed against its security, packaging, and complexity concerns.

                                    在开发网络应用程序时，除了C++NPv1第1章和第5章中描述的维度外，还应考虑本章中介绍的两组设计维度。本书中介绍的ACE框架提供了强大的工具，可以实现灵活且可扩展的设计，并可结合多种权衡和功能。

                                    When developing networked applications, the two sets of design dimensions in this chapter should be considered along with the dimensions described in Chapters 1 and 5 of C++NPv1. The ACE frameworks described in this book offer powerful tools to implement flexible and extensible designs with many combinations of tradeoffs and capabilities.

                                      第三章 ACE反应堆框架

                                      Chapter 3. The ACE Reactor Framework

                                      C章概要​

                                      CHAPTER SYNOPSIS

                                      本章介绍 ACE Reactor 框架的设计和使用。该框架实现了 Reactor 模式 [ POSA2 ]，使事件驱动型应用程序能够响应来自多个不同来源的事件，例如 I/O 句柄、定时器和信号。应用程序重写框架定义的钩子方法，框架随后会将这些方法分派给相应的处理程序来处理事件。我们将展示如何使用 Reactor 实现日志服务器，该 Reactor 能够 (1) 检测并解复用来自各种事件源的不同类型连接和数据事件，以及 (2) 将这些事件分派给应用程序定义的处理程序来处理这些事件。

                                      This chapter describes the design and use of the ACE Reactor framework. This framework implements the Reactor pattern [POSA2], which allows event-driven applications to react to events originating from a number of disparate sources, such as I/O handles, timers, and signals. Applications override framework-defined hook methods, which the framework then dispatch to process events. We show how to implement a logging server using a reactor that (1) detects and demultiplexes different types of connection and data events from various event sources and (2) then dispatches the events to application-defined handlers that process the events.

                                        3.1 概述

                                        3.1 Overview

                                        ACE Reactor 框架简化了事件驱动型程序的开发，这类程序是许多网络应用程序的特征。这些应用程序中常见的事件源包括 I/O 操作的 IPC 流活动、POSIX 信号、Windows 句柄信令以及定时器超时。在此背景下，ACE Reactor 框架负责：

                                        The ACE Reactor framework simplifies the development of event-driven programs, which characterize many networked applications. Common sources of events in these applications include activity on an IPC stream for I/O operations, POSIX signals, Windows handle signaling, and timer expirations. In this context, the ACE Reactor framework is responsible for

                                        • 检测来自各种事件源的事件发生情况

                                        • Detecting the occurrence of events from various event sources

                                        • 将事件解复用到其预先注册的事件处理程序

                                        • Demultiplexing the events to their preregistered event handlers

                                        • 分发到处理程序定义的钩子方法，以应用程序定义的方式处理事件。

                                        • Dispatching to hook methods defined by the handlers to process the events in an application-defined manner

                                        本章介绍以下 ACE Reactor 框架类，网络应用程序可以使用这些类来检测事件的发生，然后将事件解复用并分发给其事件处理程序：

                                        This chapter describes the following ACE Reactor framework classes that networked applications can use to detect the occurrence of events and then demultiplex and dispatch the events to their event handlers:

                                        ACE 级

                                        ACE Class

                                        描述

                                        Description

                                        ACE_Time_Value

                                        ACE_Time_Value

                                        提供了一种可移植的、规范化的时间和持续时间表示方法，利用 C++ 运算符重载来简化与时间相关的算术和关系运算。

                                        Provides a portable, normalized representation of time and duration that uses C++ operator overloading to simplify time-related arithmetic and relational operations.

                                        ACE_Event_Handler

                                        ACE_Event_Handler

                                        一个抽象类，其接口定义了作为ACE_Reactor回调目标的钩子方法。大多数使用 ACE 开发的应用程序事件处理程序都是ACE_Event_Handler的子类。

                                        An abstract class whose interface defines the hook methods that are the target of ACE_Reactor callbacks. Most application event handlers developed with ACE are descendants of ACE_Event_Handler.

                                        ACE_Timer_Queue

                                        ACE 是一个抽象类，定义了定时器队列的功能和接口。它包含各种派生自ACE_Timer_Queue 的类，这些类能够灵活地支持不同的定时需求。

                                        Provides the interface for managing event handler registrations and executing the event loop that drives event detection, demultiplexing, and dispatching in the Reactor framework.

                                        ACE Reactor 框架中各类之间最重要的关系如图 3.1所示。这些类根据 Reactor 模式 [ POSA2 ] 扮演以下角色：

                                        The most important relationships between the classes in the ACE Reactor framework are shown in Figure 3.1. These classes play the following roles in accordance with the Reactor pattern [POSA2]:

                                        图 3.1. ACE Reactor 框架类

                                        • 事件基础架构层类 提供与应用程序无关的策略，用于同步检测事件并将其解复用到事件处理程序，然后分发相关的事件处理程序钩子方法。ACE Reactor 框架中的基础架构层组件包括ACE_Time_Value、ACE_Event_Handler 、ACE 定时器队列类以及ACE_Reactor的各种实现。

                                        • Event infrastructure layer classes provide application-independent strategies for synchronously detecting and demultiplexing events to event handlers and then dispatching the associated event handler hook methods. The infrastructure layer components in the ACE Reactor framework include ACE_Time_Value, ACE_Event_Handler, the ACE timer queue classes, and the various implementations of the ACE_Reactor.

                                        • 应用层类 在其钩子方法中定义事件处理程序，以执行应用程序定义的处理。在 ACE Reactor 框架中，应用层类是ACE_Event_Handler的子类。

                                        • Application layer classes define event handlers to perform application-defined processing in their hook methods. In the ACE Reactor framework, application layer classes are descendants of ACE_Event_Handler.

                                        ACE Reactor 框架的强大之处在于它封装了各种操作系统上可用的事件解复用机制之间的差异，并保持了框架类和应用程序类之间的关注点分离。通过将与应用程序无关的事件解复用和分发机制与与应用程序相关的事件处理策略分离，ACE Reactor 框架提供了以下优势：

                                        The power of the ACE Reactor framework comes from encapsulating the differences between event demultiplexing mechanisms available on various operating systems and maintaining a separation of concerns between framework classes and application classes. By separating application-independent event demultiplexing and dispatching mechanisms from application-dependent event processing policies, the ACE Reactor framework provides the following benefits:

                                        • 广泛的可移植性。 该框架可以配置为使用许多操作系统事件解复用机制，例如select()（在 UNIX、Windows 和许多实时操作系统上可用）、/dev/poll（在某些 UNIX 平台上可用）和WaitForMultipleObjects()（仅在 Windows 上可用）。

                                        • Broad portability. The framework can be configured to use many OS event demultiplexing mechanisms, such as select() (available on UNIX, Windows, and many real-time operating systems), /dev/poll (available on certain UNIX platforms), and WaitForMultipleObjects() (available only on Windows).

                                        • ACE Reactor 框架可自动执行事件检测、解复用和分发。 它无需依赖不可移植的原生操作系统事件解复用 API，即可为应用程序提供统一的面向对象的事件检测、解复用和分发机制。事件处理程序对象可以注册到ACE_Reactor中，以处理各种类型的事件。

                                        • Automates event detection, demultiplexing, and dispatching. By eliminating reliance on nonportable native OS event demultiplexing APIs, the ACE Reactor framework provides applications with a uniform object-oriented event detection, demulti-plexing, and dispatching mechanism. Event handler objects can be registered with the ACE_Reactor to process various types of events.

                                        • 透明的可扩展性。 该框架通过继承和动态绑定采用钩子方法，将底层事件机制（例如检测多个 I/O 句柄上的事件、定时器过期以及解复用和分发相应的事件处理程序来处理这些事件）与高层应用程序事件处理策略（例如连接建立策略、数据编组和解组以及客户端请求处理）解耦。这种设计使得 ACE Reactor 框架能够在不修改现有应用程序代码的情况下透明地进行扩展。

                                        • Transparent extensibility. The framework employs hook methods via inheritance and dynamic binding to decouple lower-level event mechanisms, such as detecting events on multiple I/O handles, expiring timers, and demultiplexing and dispatching methods of the appropriate event handler to process these events, from higher-level application event processing policies, such as connection establishment strategies, data marshaling and demarshaling, and processing of client requests. This design allows the ACE Reactor framework to be extended transparently without modifying existing application code.

                                        • 提高代码复用率并减少错误。 使用原生操作系统事件解复用操作编写程序的开发者必须为每个应用程序重新实现、调试和优化相同的底层代码。相比之下，ACE Reactor 框架的事件检测、解复用和分发机制是通用的，因此可以被许多联网应用程序复用。这种关注点分离使开发者能够专注于应用程序定义的高级事件处理策略，而无需反复处理底层机制。

                                        • Increase reuse and minimize errors. Developers who write programs using native OS event demultiplexing operations must reimplement, debug, and optimize the same low-level code for each application. In contrast, the ACE Reactor framework's event detection, demultiplexing, and dispatching mechanisms are generic and can therefore be reused by many networked applications. This separation of concerns allows developers to focus on high-level application-defined event handler policies, rather than wrestling repeatedly with low-level mechanisms.

                                        • 高效的事件解复用。ACE Reactor 框架能够高效地执行事件解复用和分发逻辑。例如，4.2 节中介绍的ACE_Select_Reactor使用了C++NPv1 第 7 章中描述的ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator包装器外观类。该包装器外观类采用了迭代器模式 [ GoF ] 的优化实现，避免了逐位检查fd_set位掩码。这种优化基于一种复杂的算法，该算法利用 C++ 异或运算符将运行时复杂度从O(总位数)降低到O(使能位数)，从而显著提升大规模应用程序的运行时性能。

                                        • Efficient event demultiplexing. The ACE Reactor framework performs its event demultiplexing and dispatching logic efficiently. For instance, the ACE_Select_Reactor presented in Section 4.2 uses the ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator wrapper facade class described in Chapter 7 of C++NPv1. This wrapper facade uses an optimized implementation of the Iterator pattern [GoF] to avoid examining fd_set bit-masks one bit at a time. This optimization is based on a sophisticated algorithm that uses the C++ exclusive-or operator to reduce run-time complexity from O(number of total bits) to O(number of enabled bits), which can improve the run-time performance of large-scale applications substantially.

                                        本章剩余部分将阐述 ACE Reactor 框架中每个类的功能及其背后的原因。我们将展示如何使用该框架来改进我们网络日志服务器的设计。如果您不熟悉 POSA2 中的 Reactor 模式，我们建议您先阅读相关资料，然后再深入研究本章的详细示例。第 4 章将介绍此处展示的ACE_Reactor接口最常用实现的设计和使用方法。该章还将介绍这些ACE_Reactor实现所支持的各种并发模型。

                                        The remainder of this chapter motivates and describes the capabilities of each class in the ACE Reactor framework. We illustrate how this framework can be used to enhance the design of our networked logging server. If you aren't familiar with the Reactor pattern from POSA2, we recommend that you read about it first before delving into the detailed examples in this chapter. Chapter 4 then describes the design and use of the most common implementations of the ACE_Reactor interface presented here. That chapter also describes the various concurrency models supported by these ACE_Reactor implementations.

                                          3.2 ACE_Time_Value 类

                                          3.2 The ACE_Time_Value Class

                                          动机

                                          Motivation

                                          不同的操作系统提供不同的功能和数据来访问和操作时间和日期。例如，UNIX 平台将timeval结构定义如下：

                                          Different operating systems provide different functions and data to access and manipulate the time and date. For example, UNIX platforms define the timeval structure as follows:

                                          struct timeval { 
  long secs; 
  long usecs; 
};

                                          在其他操作系统平台（例如 POSIX、Windows 和专有实时操作系统）上，日期和时间的表示方式各不相同。时间值在多种情况下都会用到，包括超时说明符。如侧边栏 6（第 45 页）所述，ACE 在某些情况下（例如 C++NPv1 中的并发和同步包装器外观）使用绝对时间指定超时，而在其他情况下（例如ACE_Reactor I/O 超时和定时器设置）则使用相对时间。由于跨平台的广泛应用和不同的表示方式，在每个应用程序中处理这些可移植性差异会变得既繁琐又昂贵，因此 ACE Reactor 框架提供了ACE_Time_Value类。

                                          Different date and time representations are used on other OS platforms, such as POSIX, Windows, and proprietary real-time operating systems. Time values are used in a number of situations, including timeout specifiers. As described in Sidebar 6 (page 45), ACE specifies timeouts in absolute time for some situations, such as the concurrency and synchronization wrapper facades in C++NPv1, and in relative time for other situations, such as the ACE_Reactor I/O timeouts and timer settings. The wide range of uses and different representations across platforms makes addressing these portability differences in each application unnecessarily tedious and costly, which is why the ACE Reactor framework provides the ACE_Time_Value class.

                                          等级能力

                                          Class Capabilities

                                          ACE_Time_Value应用了包装器外观模式 [ POSA2 ] 和 C++ 运算符重载，以简化可移植的时间和持续时间相关操作的使用。此类提供以下功能：

                                          ACE_Time_Value applies the Wrapper Facade pattern [POSA2] and C++ operator overloading to simplify the use of portable time and duration related operations. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                          • 它提供了一种标准化的时间表示方法，可以在不同的操作系统平台上使用。

                                          • It provides a standardized representation of time that's portable across OS platforms.

                                          • 它可以转换不同的平台时间表示形式，例如UNIX 上的timespec_t和timeval ，以及Windows 上的FILETIME和timeval 。

                                          • It can convert between different platform time representations, such as timespec_t and timeval on UNIX, and FILETIME and timeval on Windows.

                                          • 它利用运算符重载来简化基于时间的比较，允许使用标准的 C++ 语法进行基于时间的算术和关系表达式。

                                          • It uses operator overloading to simplify time-based comparisons by permitting standard C++ syntax for time-based arithmetic and relational expressions.

                                          • 它的构造函数和方法通过将timeval结构中的字段转换为规范格式来规范时间量，从而确保ACE_Time_Value实例之间的准确比较。

                                          • Its constructors and methods normalize time quantities by converting the fields in a timeval structure into a canonical format that ensures accurate comparisons between ACE_Time_Value instances.

                                          • 它可以表示持续时间，例如 5 秒 310,000 微秒，也可以表示绝对日期和时间，例如 2001-09-11-08.46.00。请注意，某些方法（例如operator*=()）对于绝对时间没有意义。

                                          • It can represent either a duration, such as 5 seconds and 310,000 microseconds, or an absolute date and time, such as 2001-09-11-08.46.00. Note that some methods, such as operator*=(), are meaningless with absolute times.

                                          ACE_Time_Value的接口如图 3.2 （第 44 页）所示。阅读本书时，请牢记侧边栏 7 （第 46 页）中关于 UML 图和 C++ 代码的要点。ACE_Time_Value的主要方法概述如下表所示：

                                          The interface for ACE_Time_Value is shown in Figure 3.2 (page 44). As you read this book, keep in mind the points noted in Sidebar 7 (page 46) regarding UML diagrams and C++ code. The key methods of ACE_Time_Value are outlined in the following table:

                                          除了上述方法之外，ACE_Time_Value类还定义了算术和关系运算，以下二元运算符是其友元：

                                          In addition to the methods shown above, the following binary operators are friends of the ACE_Time_Value class that define arithmetic and relational operations:

                                          方法

                                          Method

                                          描述

                                          Description

                                          operator+()

                                          操作员-（）

                                          所有ACE_Time_Value构造函数和方法都会对它们操作的时间值进行归一化。归一化会将相当于一秒或更长的微秒值转换为微秒值，方法是将秒值转移到secs成员，并将剩余的微秒值保留在usecs中。例如，对ACE_Time_Value(1,1000000)进行归一化后，其结果将等于归一化的ACE_Time_Value(2)。相比之下，对未归一化的对象进行按位比较将无法检测到它们的相等性。

                                          All ACE_Time_Value constructors and methods normalize the time values they operate on. Normalization reduces microsecond quantities equivalent to one second or more by transferring the seconds value to the secs member, leaving the remaining microseconds value in usecs. For example, normalizing the quantity ACE_Time_Value(1,1000000) will compare equal to the normalized ACE_Time_Value(2) quantity. In contrast, a bitwise comparison of non-normalized objects won't detect their equivalence.
