This value causes the reactor to dispatch the Logging_Event_Handler::handle_close() hook method, which closes both the socket to the client and the log file and then deletes itself, as follows:

                                            侧边栏 12：ACE 内存管理宏

                                            Sidebar 12: The ACE Memory Management Macros

                                            C++NPv1 和本书解决了许多与操作系统 API 差异相关的问题。另一个问题是 C++ 编译器之间的差异。C++ 的 ` operatornew()`动态内存分配器就是一个很好的例子。早期的 C++ 运行时在分配失败时会返回一个空指针，而较新的运行时则会抛出异常。ACE 定义了一些宏，统一了这种行为，无论编译器如何，都会返回空指针。ACE 使用这些宏来确保行为的一致性和可移植性；您的应用程序也可以使用它们。

                                            C++NPv1 and this book solve many problems related to differences between OS APIs. Another problem area is differences between C++ compilers. The C++ operatornew() dynamic memory allocator is a good example. Early C++ runtimes returned a NULL pointer when an allocation failed, whereas newer runtimes throw an exception. ACE defines macros that unify the behavior and return a NULL pointer regardless of the compiler's behavior. ACE uses these macros to ensure consistent, portable behavior; your applications can use them as well.

                                            如果内存分配失败，所有 ACE 内存管理宏都会将指定的指针设置为NULL，并将errno 设置为ENOMEM。ACE_NEW_RETURN宏在失败时从当前方法返回指定的值，而ACE_NEW宏则直接返回，ACE_NEW_NORETURN宏则继续在当前方法中执行。这些宏使得应用程序能够跨 C ++编译器内存分配错误处理策略进行移植。例如，对于在new失败 时抛出std::bad_alloc C ++ 异常的编译器，ACE_NEW_RETURN宏定义如下：

                                            If memory allocation fails, all of the ACE memory management macros set the specified pointer to NULL and set errno to ENOMEM. The ACE_NEW_RETURN macro returns a specified value from the current method on failure, whereas the ACE_NEW macro simply returns and the ACE_NEW_NORETURN macro continues to execute in the current method. These macros enable applications to work portably, regardless of the C++ compiler memory allocation error handling policies. For example, the ACE_NEW_RETURN macro is defined as follows for compilers that throw the std::bad_alloc C++ exception when new fails: 

                                            #define ACE_NEW_RETURN(POINTER,CTOR,RET_VAL) \ 
 do { try { POINTER = new CTOR; } catch (std::bad_alloc) \ 
   { errno = ENOMEM; POINTER = 0; return RET_VAL; } \ 
 } while (0)

                                            相反，对于提供nothrow变体的operator new的编译器配置， ACE _ NEW _ RETURN定义如下：

                                            In contrast, ACE_NEW_RETURN is defined as follows for compiler configurations that offer a nothrow variant of operator new: 

                                            #define ACE_NEW_RETURN(POINTER,CTOR,RET_VAL) \ 
 do { POINTER = new (ACE_nothrow) CTOR; \ 
   if (POINTER == 0) { errno = ENOMEM; return RET_VAL; } \ 
 } while (0) 

                                            int Logging_Event_Handler::handle_close (ACE_HANDLE, 
                                         ACE_Reactor_Mask) { 
  logging_handler_.close (); 
  log_file_.close (); 
  delete this; 
  return 0; 
}

                                            由于Logging_Event_Handler对象是动态分配的，不会被 Reactor 或程序的任何其他部分使用，因此可以安全地删除它。第 3.5 节中的示例在完整的 Reactor 框架的上下文中演示了此方法。

                                            This method can safely delete this since the Logging_Event_Handler object is allocated dynamically and won't be used by the reactor or any other part of the program. The Example in Section 3.5 illustrates this method in the context of the complete Reactor framework.

                                            侧边栏 13：如何应对沉默的同伴

                                            Sidebar 13: Handling Silent Peers

                                            如果客户端断开连接（无论是正常断开还是突然断开），其套接字将变为可读状态。反应器可以检测到此事件，并向与该套接字句柄关联的事件处理程序分发 ` handle_input()`钩子方法。然后，处理程序将确定连接已关闭，这通常通过 ` recv()`或`read()`调用返回 0 或 -1 来表明。但是，如果客户端完全停止通信，则可能有多种原因，包括：

                                            If a client disconnects, either gracefully or abruptly, its socket will become readable. A reactor can detect this event and dispatch the handle_input() hook method on the event handler that's associated with the socket handle. The handler will then determine that the connection has closed, which is usually revealed by a recv() or read() call returning 0 or -1. If the client simply stops communicating altogether, however, there could be a number of causes, including

                                            • 以太网电缆从连接器中被拔出，但可能很快又会被重新插上，连接也会继续。

                                            • An Ethernet cable's being pulled out of its connector, which may be plugged back in shortly and the connection continues or

                                            • 主机崩溃，没有机会关闭任何连接，因此连接的本地端点处于断开状态，永远不会继续。

                                            • The host crashed without the opportunity to close any connections, so the local endpoint of the connection is stranded and will never continue.

                                            在这种情况下，反应堆无法检测到任何事件。

                                            In these cases there are no events for a reactor to detect.

                                            根据应用程序服务的需求以及所使用的应用层协议，有多种方法可以处理静默对等节点。这些方法包括：

                                            Depending on the needs of your application services and the application-level protocol(s) used, there are several ways to handle a silent peer. These include:

                                            • 等待TCP保活机制放弃对端连接并关闭连接，这将在套接字上触发一个事件，该事件的处理方式与客户端关闭连接的方式相同。遗憾的是，这可能需要很长时间——甚至几个小时——如 [ SW95 ] 中所述。

                                            • Wait until the TCP keepalive mechanism abandons the peer and closes the connection, which will trigger an event on the socket that can be handled just as if the client closed the connection. Unfortunately, this may take a long time— maybe hours—as described in [SW95].

                                            • 实施应用层策略或协议，例如“心跳”消息或定期发送“在线吗？”消息。如果对端在应用定义的时间段内未发送心跳消息或响应“在线吗？”消息，则单方面中止连接。应用随后可以尝试在稍后重新建立连接。

                                            • Implement an application-level policy or protocol, such as a "heartbeat" message or periodic "are you there?" message. If the peer fails to send a heartbeat message or answer the "are you there?" message within an application defined period of time, abort the connection unilaterally. The application may then attempt to reopen the connection at a later time.

                                            • 实施一项策略：如果对端在设定的时间内未发送任何数据，则断开连接。Logging_Event_Handler_Ex 类（第 68 页）使用了这种策略。

                                            • Implement a policy that if the peer does not send any data for some determined amount of time, the connection will be abandoned. This type of policy is used by the Logging_Event_Handler_Ex class (page 68).

                                              3.4 ACE 定时器队列类

                                              3.4 The ACE Timer Queue Classes

                                              动机

                                              Motivation

                                              许多联网应用程序会定期执行某些活动，或者需要在指定的时间段过后收到通知。例如，Web 服务器需要监控定时器，以便在客户端连接后不久未发送HTTP GET请求时释放资源。

                                              Many networked applications perform activities periodically or must be notified when specified time periods have elapsed. For example, Web servers require watchdog timers that release resources if clients don't send an HTTP GET request shortly after they connect.

                                              原生操作系统定时器功能各不相同，但许多平台都存在以下问题：

                                              Native OS timer capabilities vary, but many platforms share the following problems:

                                              • 定时器数量有限。 许多平台允许应用程序设置有限数量的定时器。例如，POSIX系统中的alarm()和ualarm()函数每次调用都会重置一个“闹钟”定时器。因此，管理多个定时器周期通常需要开发一个定时器队列机制来跟踪下一个预定的定时器到期时间。如有必要，可以安排一个新的“最早”定时器来（重新）设置闹钟。

                                              • Limited number of timers. Many platforms allow applications to set a limited number of timers. For example, the POSIX alarm() and ualarm() system functions each reset a single "alarm clock" timer on each call. Managing multiple timer periods therefore often involves developing a timer queue mechanism that keeps track of the next scheduled expiration. Scheduling a new "earliest" timer can (re)set the alarm clock if necessary.

                                              • 定时器超时会触发信号。 例如，alarm()系统函数会在定时器超时时触发SIGALRM信号。定时器信号的编程比较困难，因为应用程序在信号上下文中的操作受到限制。在 UNIX 平台上，应用程序可以通过使用sleep()系统函数或sigsuspend()系统函数来最大限度地减少在信号上下文中的处理。然而，这些解决方案不具备可移植性，并且会阻塞调用线程，从而影响并发性并使编程更加复杂。

                                              • Timer expiration raises a signal. For example, the alarm() system function raises the SIGALRM signal when the timer expires. Programming timer signals is hard because application actions are restricted in signal context. Applications can minimize processing in signal context on UNIX platforms by using the sleep() system function or using the sigsuspend() system function. These solutions are nonportable, however, and they block the calling thread, which can impede concurrency and complicate programming.

                                              避免这些问题的一种方法是在事件处理的正常过程中管理计时器，如下所示：

                                              One way to avoid these problems is to manage timers in the normal course of event handling, as follows:

                                              1. 开发一种定时器队列机制，该机制对定时器进行排序，并将每个定时器与定时器到期时要执行的操作关联起来。

                                              2. Develop a timer queue mechanism that orders timers and associates each timer with an action to perform when a timer expires

                                              3. 将定时器队列与应用程序对同步事件解复用器（例如select()或WaitForMultipleObjects()）的使用相结合，以便将定时器过期处理与其他事件处理相结合。

                                              4. Integrate the timer queue with the application's use of a synchronous event demultiplexer, such as select() or WaitForMultipleObjects(), to integrate the handling of timer expirations with other event processing.

                                              然而，由于不同操作系统平台的功能和限制各不相同，这种定时器机制很难跨平台移植。此外，由于定时器队列机制与同步事件解复用机制紧密耦合，许多项目通常需要重新开发这种机制。为了减轻应用程序开发人员临时重写高效、可扩展且可移植的基于时间的调度器的负担， ACE Reactor 框架定义了一系列可重用的定时器队列类。

                                              It's hard to develop this type of timer facility portably across OS platforms, however, due to the wide range of capabilities and restrictions. Moreover, this capability is often redeveloped for many projects due to tight coupling between the timer queue mechanism and the synchronous event demultiplexing mechanism. To alleviate the need for application developers to rewrite efficient, scalable, and portable time-driven dispatchers in an ad hoc manner, the ACE Reactor framework defines a family of reusable timer queue classes.

                                              等级能力

                                              Class Capabilities

                                              ACE 定时器队列类允许应用程序注册派生自ACE_Event_Handler的时间驱动事件处理程序。这些类提供以下功能：

                                              The ACE timer queue classes allow applications to register time-driven event handlers derived from ACE_Event_Handler. These classes provide the following capabilities:

                                              • 它们允许应用程序安排事件处理程序，这些处理程序的handle_timeout()钩子方法将在调用者指定的未来时间高效且可扩展地分发，可以一次，也可以按周期性间隔分发。

                                              • They allow applications to schedule event handlers whose handle_timeout() hook methods will be dispatched efficiently and scalably at caller-specified times in the future, either once or at periodic intervals.

                                              • 它们允许应用程序取消与特定事件处理程序关联的计时器，或取消与事件处理程序关联的所有计时器。

                                              • They allow applications to cancel a timer associated with a particular event handler or all timers associated with an event handler.

                                              • 它们允许应用程序配置定时器队列的时间源，例如ACE_OS::gettimeofday()或ACE_High_Res_Timer::gettimeofday_hr() ，如侧边栏 14 （第 65 页）中所述。

                                              • They allow applications to configure a timer queue's time source, such as ACE_OS::gettimeofday() or ACE_High_Res_Timer::gettimeofday_hr(), described in Sidebar 14 (page 65).

                                              图 3.5 （第 64 页）展示了所有 ACE 定时器队列类的接口和关系。下表概述了这些类中的关键方法：

                                              The interfaces and relationships of all the ACE timer queue classes are shown in Figure 3.5 (page 64). The key methods in these classes are outlined in the following table:

                                              图 3.5. ACE 定时器队列类

                                              方法

                                              Method

                                              描述

                                              Description

                                              日程（）

                                              schedule()

                                              安排一个事件处理程序，该处理程序的handle_timeout()方法将在调用者指定的未来时间分发，并且（可选地）按周期性间隔分发。

                                              Schedule an event handler whose handle_timeout() method will be dispatched at a caller-specified time in the future and, optionally, at periodic intervals.

                                              取消（）

                                              cancel()

                                              取消与特定事件处理程序关联的计时器，或取消与该事件处理程序关联的所有计时器。

                                              Cancel a timer associated with a particular event handler or all timers associated with an event handler.

                                              到期（）

                                              expire()

                                              对所有过期时间小于或等于当前时间（以绝对值表示，例如 2001-09-11-09.37.00）的事件处理程序调用handle_timeout()方法。

                                              Dispatch the handle_timeout() method of all event handlers whose expiration time is less than or equal to the current time of day, which is represented as an absolute value, for example, 2001-09-11-09.37.00.

                                              获取日期时间()

                                              gettimeofday()

                                              一对重载方法，允许应用程序 (1) 设置用于控制计时器队列当前时间值来源的方法，以及 (2) 调用该方法返回当前绝对时间值。

                                              A pair of overloaded methods that allow applications to (1) set the method used to control the timer queue's source of the current time value and (2) call that method to return the current absolute time value.

                                              ACE定时器队列的schedule ()方法必须传递两个参数：

                                              The schedule() method of an ACE timer queue must be passed two parameters:

                                              • 指向事件处理程序的指针，该事件处理程序将成为后续handle_timeout()分发的目标。

                                              • A pointer to an event handler that will be the target of the subsequent handle_timeout() dispatching and

                                              • 引用ACE_Time_Value ，指示在事件处理程序上调用handle_timeout()钩子方法的绝对未来时间。

                                              • A reference to an ACE_Time_Value indicating the absolute future time when the handle_timeout() hook method should be invoked on the event handler.

                                              此方法可以选择性地传递以下参数：

                                              This method can optionally be passed the following parameters:

                                              • 定时器队列内部存储着一个空指针，当 ` handle_timeout()`方法被分派时，该指针会原封不动地返回。根据异步完成令牌模式 [ POSA2 ] ，该指针可用作异步完成令牌( ACT ) 。该模式允许应用程序高效地解复用并处理其在服务上调用的异步操作的响应。通过使用ACT，同一个事件处理程序可以在多个未来的分派时间点注册到定时器队列中。

                                              • A void pointer that's stored internally by the timer queue and passed back unchanged when the handle_timeout() method is dispatched. This pointer can be used as an asynchronous completion token (ACT) in accordance with the Asynchronous Completion Token pattern [POSA2]. This pattern allows an application to efficiently demultiplex and process the responses of asynchronous operations it invokes on services. By using an ACT, the same event handler can be registered with a timer queue at multiple future dispatching times.

                                              • 此参数引用第二个ACE_Time_Value，用于指定事件处理程序应定期执行的间隔。如果省略此参数，则事件处理程序的handle_timeout()方法只会执行一次。指定非常短的定时器值时，请注意实际定时器分辨率将受限于定时器队列时间源时钟的更新频率，而该频率因平台而异。

                                              • A reference to a second ACE_Time_Value that designates the interval at which the event handler should be dispatched periodically. If this parameter is omitted, the event handler's handle_timeout() method is dispatched only once. When specifying very short timer values, keep in mind that the actual timer resolution will be limited to that of the timer queue's time source clock update frequency, which varies by platform.

                                              当定时器队列调度事件处理程序的handle_timeout()方法时，它会将当前时间和最初调度事件处理程序时传递给schedule()方法的void指针ACT作为参数传递。

                                              When a timer queue dispatches an event handler's handle_timeout() method, it passes as parameters the current time and the void pointer ACT passed to the schedule() method when the event handler was scheduled originally.

                                              `schedule()`的返回值唯一标识了定时器队列中每个已调度的定时器事件。应用程序可以将唯一的定时器标识符传递给 ` cancel()`方法，以便在特定事件处理程序过期前将其移除。应用程序还可以将处理程序的地址传递给`cancel()`，以移除与该特定事件处理程序关联的所有定时器。如果将指向`void`指针的非NULL指针传递给`cancel()`，则会将其赋值为应用程序最初调度定时器时传递的ACT ，这使得动态分配ACT而不会造成内存泄漏成为可能。

                                              The return value of schedule() uniquely identifies each timer event that's scheduled with a timer queue. Applications can pass the unique timer identifier to the cancel() method to remove a particular event handler before it expires. Applications can also pass the address of the handler to cancel() to remove all timers associated with a particular event handler. If a non-NULL pointer to a void pointer is passed to cancel(), it's assigned the ACT passed by the application when the timer was scheduled originally, which makes it possible to allocate an ACT dynamically without leaking memory.

                                              ACE 定时器队列类结合了设计模式、钩子方法和模板参数，提供了以下定时器队列实现：

                                              The ACE timer queue classes combine design patterns, hook methods, and template arguments to provide the following timer queue implementations:

                                              • ACE_Timer_Heap是一个用数组实现的偏序近乎完全二叉树 [ Rob99 ]。它在调度、取消和过期事件处理程序方面的平均和最坏情况性能均为O (lg n )，因此它是 ACE Reactor 框架中的默认定时器队列机制。基于堆的定时器队列对于操作系统 [ BL88 ] 和中间件 [ SLM98 ] 非常有用，因为它们的应用程序需要可预测且低延迟的时间驱动调度。侧边栏 15（第 66 页）描述了实时应用程序开发人员在代码中使用 ACE 定时器队列机制时应考虑的一些问题。

                                              • ACE_Timer_Heap, which is a partially ordered, almost complete binary tree implemented in an array [Rob99]. Its average- and worst-case performance for scheduling, canceling, and expiring an event handler is O(lg n), which is why it's the default timer queue mechanism in the ACE Reactor framework. Heap-based timer queues are useful for operating systems [BL88] and middleware [SLM98] whose applications require predictable and low-latency time-driven dispatching. Sidebar 15 (page 66) describes some issues that developers of real-time applications should consider when using the ACE timer queue mechanisms in their code.

                                              • ACE_Timer_Wheel使用一个定时轮[ VL97 ]，其中包含一个循环缓冲区，旨在平均情况下以O (1) 时间调度、取消和分派定时器，但在最坏情况下以O ( n ) 时间调度、取消和分派定时器。

                                              • ACE_Timer_Wheel, which uses a timing wheel [VL97] that contains a circular buffer designed to schedule, cancel, and dispatch timers in O(1) time in the average case, but O(n) in the worst case.

                                              • 侧边栏 14：ACE 时间来源

                                                图 3.5显示，ACE_Timer_Queue::gettimeofday()可以修改为使用任何返回ACE_Time_Value值的静态方法。返回的时间值应为绝对值，但不必是当前日期和时间（通常称为“挂钟”时间）。返回时间的静态方法的主要要求是为定时器调度和到期决策提供准确的依据。ACE 提供了两种符合此要求的机制：

                                                • ACE_OS::gettimeofday()是一个静态方法，它返回一个ACE_Time_Value，其中包含操作系统报告的当前绝对日期和时间。

                                                • `ACE_High_Res_Timer::gettimeofday_hr() ` 是一个静态方法，它返回操作系统特定的高分辨率计时器的值，并转换为`ACE_Time_Value`单位。这些计时器通常基于自启动以来 CPU 时钟周期数，而不是实际的挂钟时间。

                                                这些定时器的粒度可能相差三到四个数量级。然而，当它们用于事件解复用机制的超时时，由于时钟、定时器中断服务和操作系统调度的复杂性，其分辨率通常相似。在 Reactor 的定时器队列中，它们的主要区别在于系统日期和/或时间更改时的行为：ACE_OS::gettimeofday()报告的值会发生变化，而ACE_High_Res_Timer::gettimeofday_hr()报告的值不会受到影响——它们会以恒定的速率持续增加。如果应用程序的定时器行为必须保持不变（即使系统时间发生变化），则应将默认时间源替换为ACE_High_Res_Timer::gettimeofday_hr()，如第 3.4 节的示例部分所示。

                                              • Sidebar 14: ACE Time Sources

                                                Figure 3.5 shows that ACE_Timer_Queue::gettimeofday() can be changed to use any static method that returns an ACE_Time_Value value. The returned time value is expected to be absolute, but it need not be the current date and time (commonly known as "wall clock" time). The primary requirement of the time-returning static method is that it provides an accurate basis for timer scheduling and expiration decisions. ACE provides two mechanisms that fit this requirement:

                                                • ACE_OS::gettimeofday(), which is a static method that returns an ACE_Time_Value containing the current absolute date and time as reported by the operating system.

                                                • ACE_High_Res_Timer::gettimeofday_hr(), which is a static method that returns the value of an OS-specific high-resolution timer, converted to ACE_Time_Value units. These timers are often based on the number of CPU clock ticks since boot time, rather than the actual wall clock time.

                                                The granularity of these timers can differ by three to four orders of magnitude. When they're used to time out event demultiplexing mechanisms, however, the resolution is usually similar due to the intricacies of clocks, timer interrupt servicing, and OS scheduling. In the context of the Reactor's timer queue, they differ mainly in their behavior when the system's date and/or time is changed, where the values reported by ACE_OS::gettimeofday() will change but the values reported by ACE_High_Res_Timer::gettimeofday_hr() won't be affected—they'll keep increasing at a constant rate. If an application's timer behavior must remain constant— even if the wall clock time changes—the default time source should be replaced with ACE_High_Res_Timer::gettimeofday_hr(), as shown in the Example portion of Section 3.4.

                                              • ACE_Timer_Hash使用哈希表来管理队列。与定时轮实现类似，调度、取消和过期定时器的平均时间复杂度为O (1)，最坏情况复杂度为O ( n )。

                                              • ACE_Timer_Hash, which uses a hash table to manage the queue. Like the timing wheel implementation, the average-case time required to schedule, cancel, and expire timers is O(1) and its worst-case is O(n).

                                              • ACE_Timer_List实现为一个按截止时间递增排序的绝对定时器链表。虽然其调度和取消定时器的平均性能和最坏情况下的性能均为O ( n )，但它是 ACE 定时器队列实现中内存占用最少的。

                                              • ACE_Timer_List, which is implemented as a linked list of absolute timers ordered by increasing deadline. Although its average and worst-case performance for scheduling and canceling timers is O(n), it uses the least amount of memory of the ACE timer queue implementations.

                                              ACE Reactor 框架允许开发者使用任何定时器队列实现来满足应用程序所需的功能，而无需采用“一刀切”的通用实现方式。由于ACE_Timer_Queue基类中的方法是虚方法，应用程序还可以集成其他定时器队列机制的自定义实现。

                                              The ACE Reactor framework allows developers to use any of these timer queue implementations to achieve the functionality needed by their applications, without burdening them with a "one size fits all" implementation. Since the methods in the ACE_Timer_Queue base class are virtual, applications can also integrate their own implementations of other timer queue mechanisms.

                                              侧边栏 15：在网络化实时应用程序中使用定时器

                                              Sidebar 15: Using Timers in Networked Real-time Applications

                                              网络化实时应用正变得日益普及和重要[ GSC02 ]。常见的例子包括电信网络（例如无线电话服务）、远程医疗（例如远程手术）、制造过程自动化（例如热轧机）和国防应用（例如航空电子任务计算系统）。这类应用通常有一个共同点：即使答案正确，如果提供得太晚，也会变成错误答案。

                                              Networked real-time applications are becoming increasingly widespread and important [GSC02]. Common examples include telecommunication networks (e.g., wireless phone services), telemedicine (e.g., remote surgery), manufacturing process automation (e.g., hot rolling mills), and defense applications (e.g., avionics mission computing systems). These types of applications typically have one thing in common: the right answer delivered too late becomes the wrong answer.

                                              如果使用同一个反应器来调度 I/O 和定时器队列处理程序，I/O 处理时间的变化会导致定时器队列处理出现“漂移”，从而严重影响网络实时应用程序的调度分析和可预测性。此外，ACE Reactor 框架实现中用于集成 I/O 和定时器调度的事件解复用和同步机制，其开销可能超出某些实时应用程序的承受范围。

                                              If one reactor is used to dispatch both I/O and timer queue handlers, variations in the amount of time spent handling I/O can cause the timer queue processing to "drift," which can wreak havoc on the scheduling analysis and predictability of networked real-time applications. Moreover, the event demultiplexing and synchronization mechanisms used to integrate I/O and timer dispatching in implementations of the ACE Reactor framework can incur more overhead than some real-time applications can afford.

                                              因此，网络实时应用程序的开发者可能需要使用运行在不同线程中的独立 ACE 定时器队列来处理定时器调度。根据定时器与 I/O 操作的相对重要性，可以为不同的线程设置不同的线程优先级。ACE_Thread_Timer_Queue_Adapter 类是一个非常有用的类，可以简化这些网络实时应用程序的设计。

                                              Developers of networked real-time applications may therefore want to use separate ACE timer queues running in different threads to handle timer dispatching. Depending on the relative importance of timers versus I/O, different thread priorities can be used for the different threads. The ACE_Thread_Timer_Queue_Adapter is a useful class that can simplify the design of these networked real-time applications.

                                              例子

                                              Example

                                              尽管第 3.3 节中的Logging_Acceptor和Logging_Event_Handler事件处理程序正确实现了日志服务器的功能，但它们可能会不必要地消耗系统资源。例如，客户端连接到服务器后，可能长时间不发送日志记录。在下面的示例中，我们将演示如何应用 ACE 定时器队列机制来回收那些客户端日志记录频率较低的事件处理程序所占用的资源。我们的设计基于Evictor模式 [ HV99 ]，该模式描述了如何以及何时释放内存和 I/O 句柄等资源，以优化系统资源管理。

                                              Although the Logging_Acceptor and Logging_Event_Handler event handlers in Section 3.3 implement the logging server functionality correctly, they may consume system resources unnecessarily. For example, clients can connect to a server and then not send log records for long periods of time. In the example below, we illustrate how to apply the ACE timer queue mechanisms to reclaim resources from those event handlers whose clients log records infrequently. Our design is based on the Evictor pattern [HV99], which describes how and when to release resources, such as memory and I/O handles, in order to optimize system resource management.

                                              我们结合 ACE Reactor 框架的定时器队列机制，使用 Evictor 模式定期检查每个已注册的事件处理程序何时收到其最后一条客户端日志记录。如果收到最后一条日志记录的时间超过指定的阈值（一小时），则执行以下操作：

                                              We use the Evictor pattern in conjunction with the ACE Reactor framework's timer queue mechanisms to check periodically when each registered event handler has received its last client log record. If the time the last log record was received exceeds a designated threshold (one hour), the following actions occur:

                                              1. 事件处理程序与其客户端断开连接。

                                              2. The event handler is disconnected from its client.

                                              3. 其资源将返回给操作系统。

                                              4. Its resources are returned to the OS.

                                              5. 它从反应堆中取出。

                                              6. It is removed from the reactor.

                                              如第 6.2节和第 7.4节的示例部分所示，客户端必须检测到这些关闭的连接，并在需要发送更多日志记录时重新建立连接。

                                              Clients must detect these closed connections and reestablish them when they need to send more log records, as shown in the Example portions of Sections 6.2 and 7.4.

                                              本示例使用`ACE_Timer_Queue::gettimeofday()`获取所有时间值。此方法允许我们在运行时更改程序的时间源，如侧边栏 14（第 65 页）所述。例如，如果更改系统时间既不应延迟也不应加快客户端驱逐，则可以在执行任何与计时器相关的操作之前，将以下代码添加到`main()`函数中：

                                              This example uses ACE_Timer_Queue::gettimeofday() to obtain all time-of-day values. This method allows us to change the program's time source at run time as described in Sidebar 14 (page 65). For example, if changes to the system's time-of-day clock should neither delay nor hasten client evictions, the following code can be added to main() before any timer-related work is done:

                                              ACE_Reactor *r = ACE_Reactor::instance (); 
ACE_High_Res_Timer::global_scale_factor (); 
r->timer_queue ()-> 
  gettimeofday (&ACE_High_Res_Timer::gettimeofday_hr);

                                              ACE_High_Res_Timer ::global_scale_factor()调用执行程序开始执行实际工作之前所需的任何初始化，以获得准确的计时器值。

                                              The ACE_High_Res_Timer::global_scale_factor() call performs any initialization needed to obtain accurate timer values before the program starts doing real work.

                                              为了实现 Evictor 模式，我们扩展了3.3 节中的Logging_Acceptor和Logging_Event_Handler，创建了Logging_Acceptor_Ex和Logging_Event_Handler_Ex 。然后，我们为每个Logging_Event_Handler_Ex实例注册一个定时器。由于默认的 ACE 定时器队列（ACE_Timer_Heap ）具有高度可扩展性和高效性，即使有成千上万个定时器和Logging_Event_Handler_Ex实例，其调度、取消和分发开销也很低。

                                              To implement the Evictor pattern, we extend Logging_Acceptor and Logging_Event_Handler in Section 3.3 to create Logging_Acceptor_Ex and Logging_Event_Handler_Ex . We then register a timer for every instance of Logging_Event_Handler_Ex . Since the default ACE timer queue (ACE_Timer_Heap) is highly scalable and efficient, its scheduling, cancellation, and dispatching overhead is low, even if there are thousands of timers and instances of Logging_Event_Handler_Ex.

                                              我们首先创建一个名为Logging_Acceptor_Ex.h的新头文件，其中包含新的Logging_Acceptor_Ex类。对此类的修改很小。我们只需重写并修改其handle_input()方法，将其从Logging_Event_Handler类更改为Logging_Event_Handler_Ex类，如下所示：

                                              We start by creating a new header file called Logging_Acceptor_Ex.h that contains the new Logging_Acceptor_Ex class. The changes to this class are minor. We simply override and modify its handle_input() method to create a Logging_Event_Handler_Ex rather than a Logging_Event_Handler, as shown below:

                                              #include "ace/INET_Addr.h" 
#include "ace/Reactor.h" 
#include "Logging_Acceptor.h" 
#include "Logging_Event_Handler_Ex.h" 

class Logging_Acceptor_Ex : public Logging_Acceptor { 
public: 
  typedef ACE_INET_Addr PEER_ADDR; 

  // Simple constructor to pass <ACE_Reactor> to base class. 
  Logging_Acceptor_Ex (ACE_Reactor *r = ACE_Reactor::instance ()) 
    : Logging_Acceptor (r) {} 

  int handle_input (ACE_HANDLE) { 
    Logging_Event_Handler_Ex *peer_handler = 0; 
    ACE_NEW_RETURN (peer_handler, 
                    Logging_Event_Handler_Ex (reactor ()), -1); 
    // ... same as Logging_Acceptor::handle_input() 
  } 
};

                                              在第 7 章中，我们将说明 ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架如何使用 C++ 特性（例如模板、继承和动态绑定）和设计模式（例如模板方法和策略 [ GoF ]）向事件处理程序添加新行为，而无需复制或修改现有代码。

                                              In Chapter 7, we'll illustrate how the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework uses C++ features (such as templates, inheritance, and dynamic binding) and design patterns (such as Template Method and Strategy [GoF]) to add new behavior to an event handler without copying or modifying existing code.

                                              Logging_Event_Handler_Ex类包含更多实质性的新增功能，因此我们创建了Logging_Event_Handler_Ex.h文件和Logging_Event_Handler_Ex.cpp文件。在Logging_Event_Handler_Ex.h中，我们扩展了Logging_Event_Handler 类，创建了以下Logging_Event_Handler_Ex类：

                                              The Logging_Event_Handler_Ex class involves more substantial additions, so we create both a Logging_Event_Handler_Ex.h file and a Logging_Event_Handler_Ex.cpp file. In Logging_Event_Handler_Ex.h we extend Logging_Event_Handler to create the following Logging_Event_Handler_Ex class:

                                              class Logging_Event_Handler_Ex : public Logging_Event_Handler { 
private: 
  // Time when a client last sent a log record. 
  ACE_Time_Value time_of_last_log_record_; 

  // Maximum time to wait for a client log record. 
  const ACE_Time_Value max_client_timeout_;

                                              我们通过添加一个ACE_Time_Value来实现 Evictor 模式，该 ACE_Time_Value 会跟踪客户端上次发送日志记录的时间。Logging_Event_Handler_Ex 公共接口中的方法如下所示：

                                              We implement the Evictor pattern by adding an ACE_Time_Value that keeps track of the time when a client last sent a log record. The methods in the public interface of Logging_Event_Handler_Ex are shown below:

                                              public: 
  typedef Logging_Event_Handler PARENT; 

  // 3600 seconds == one hour. 
  enum { MAX_CLIENT_TIMEOUT = 3600 }; 

  Logging_Event_Handler_Ex 
      (ACE_Reactor *reactor, 
       const ACE_Time_Value &max_client_timeout 
         = ACE_Time_Value (MAX_CLIENT_TIMEOUT)) 
    : Logging_Event_Handler (reactor), 
      time_of_last_log_record (0), 
      max_client_timeout_ (max_client_timeout) {} 

  virtual Logging_Event_Handler_Ex () { /* no-op */ } 
  virtual int open (); // Activate the event handler. 

  // Called by a reactor when logging events arrive. 
  virtual int handle_input (ACE_HANDLE); 

  // Called when a timeout expires to check if the client has 
  // been idle for an excessive amount of time. 
  virtual int handle_timeout (const ACE_Time_Value &tv, 
                              const void *act); 
  // Called when this object is destroyed, e.g., when it's 
  // removed from a reactor. 
  virtual int handle_close (ACE_HANDLE = ACE_INVALID_HANDLE, 
                            ACE_Reactor_Mask = 0); 
};

                                              ` Logging_Event_Handler_Ex::handle_input()`方法会记录从已连接客户端接收到日志记录的时间。我们从定时器队列的时间源获取时间，以确保所有比较结果的一致性。记录时间后，此方法会将日志记录转发给其父类的 ` handle_input()`方法来处理，如下所示：

                                              The Logging_Event_Handler_Ex::handle_input() method notes the time when a log record is received from the connected client. We get the time from the timer queue's time source to ensure that all comparisons are consistent. After recording the time, this method forwards to its parent's handle_input() method to process the log record, as shown below:

                                              int Logging_Event_Handler_Ex::handle_input (ACE_HANDLE h) { 
  time_of_last_log_record_ = 
    reactor ()->timer_queue ()->gettimeofday (); 
  return PARENT::handle_input (h); 
}

                                              接下来展示的是open()方法：

                                              The open() method is shown next:

                                               1 int Logging_Event_Handler_Ex::open () { 
 2   int result = PARENT::open (); 
 3   if (result != -1) { 
 4     ACE_Time_Value reschedule (max_client_timeout_.sec () / 4); 
 5     result = reactor ()->schedule_timer 
 6                (this, 0, 
 7                 max_client_timeout_,  // Initial timeout. 
 8                 reschedule);          // Subsequent timeouts. 
 9   } 
10   return result; 
11 }

                                              第 2行 转发到父级的open()方法（第 59 页）。

                                              Line 2 Forward to the parent's open() method (page 59).

                                              第 4-8 行调用ACE_Reactor::schedule_timer()（第 76 页）来调度此事件处理程序，使其由 Reactor 定期分发，以检查其客户端最近是否发送了日志记录。我们将初始计时器设置为在max_client_timeout_秒后过期（默认为 1 小时），并请求其之后每隔max_client_timeout_ / 4 秒定期过期（即每 15 分钟检查一次）。

                                              Lines 4–8 Call ACE_Reactor::schedule_timer() (page 76) to schedule this event handler to be dispatched by the reactor periodically to check whether its client sent it a log record recently. We schedule the initial timer to expire in max_client_timeout_ seconds (which defaults to one hour) and also request that it then expire periodically every max_client_timeout_ / 4 seconds (i.e., check every 15 minutes).

                                              当定时器超时时，反应器会使用其定时器队列机制自动分发以下handle_timeout()钩子方法：

                                              When a timer expires, the reactor uses its timer queue mechanism to dispatch the following handle_timeout() hook method automatically:

                                              int Logging_Event_Handler_Ex::handle_timeout 
    (const ACE_Time_Value &now, const void *) { 
  if (now - time_of_last_log_record_ >= max_client_timeout_) 
    reactor ()->remove_handler (this, 
                                ACE_Event_Handler::READ_MASK); 
  return 0; 
}

                                              当 ACE 定时器队列调用`handle_timeout()`时，它会将 ` now`参数设置为队列定时器超时时的绝对时间（来自`ACE_Timer_Queue::gettimeofday()` ）。`Logging_Event_Handler_Ex ::handle_timeout()`会检查当前时间与此事件处理程序收到其最后一条日志记录的时间之间的时间间隔是否大于指定的`max_client_timeout_`阈值。如果大于阈值，它会调用`ACE_Reactor::remove_handler()`，这将触发 Reactor 调用以下钩子方法以从 Reactor 中移除该事件处理程序：

                                              When an ACE timer queue dispatches handle_timeout(), it sets the now parameter to the absolute time (from ACE_Timer_Queue::gettimeofday()) when the queue expires the timer. Logging_Event_Handler_Ex::handle_timeout() checks if the time elapsed between now and the time when this event handler received its last log record is greater than the designated max_client_timeout_ threshold. If so, it calls ACE_Reactor::remove_handler(), which triggers the reactor to call the following hook method to remove the event handler from the reactor:

                                              int Logging_Event_Handler_Ex::handle_close (ACE_HANDLE, 
                                            ACE_Reactor_Mask) { 
  reactor ()->cancel_timer (this); 
  return PARENT::handle_close (); 
}

                                              此方法取消处理程序的计时器，并调用其父级的handle_close()方法（第 60 页），该方法关闭日志文件和客户端套接字，然后删除自身。

                                              This method cancels the handler's timer and calls its parent's handle_close() method (page 60), which closes the log file and socket to the client, and then deletes itself.

                                                3.5 ACE_Reactor 类

                                                3.5 The ACE_Reactor Class

                                                动机

                                                Motivation

                                                事件驱动型网络应用程序历来都是使用原生操作系统机制进行编程的，例如 Socket API 和select()同步事件解复用器。然而，以这种方式开发的应用程序不仅不具备可移植性，而且缺乏灵活性，因为它们将底层事件检测、解复用和分发代码与应用程序事件处理代码紧密耦合在一起。因此，开发人员必须为每个新的网络应用程序重写所有这些代码，这既繁琐又耗时，而且容易出错。此外，这样做也是不必要的，因为事件检测、解复用和分发的大部分代码都可以通用化，并在多个网络应用程序中重用。

                                                Event-driven networked applications have historically been programmed using native OS mechanisms, such as the Socket API and the select() synchronous event demultiplexer. Applications developed this way, however, are not only nonportable, they are inflexible because they tightly couple low-level event detection, demultiplexing, and dispatching code together with application event processing code. Developers must therefore rewrite all this code for each new networked application, which is tedious, expensive, and error prone. It's also unnecessary because much of event detection, demultiplexing, and dispatching can be generalized and reused across many networked applications.

                                                解决这些问题的一种方法是将熟练的面向对象设计与网络应用领域经验相结合，从而构建一组框架类，将应用程序事件处理代码与框架中可重用的事件检测、解复用和分发代码分离。第3.2节至3.4节通过描述可重用的时间值类和定时器队列类，以及使用ACE_Event_Handler类定义框架与应用程序事件处理代码之间的接口，为该框架奠定了基础。本节将介绍ACE Reactor 框架核心的ACE_Reactor类如何定义应用程序如何注册和接收来自多个源的事件通知。

                                                One way to address these problems is to combine skilled object-oriented design with networked application domain experience to produce a set of framework classes that separates application event handling code from the reusable event detection, demultiplexing, and dispatching code in the framework. Sections 3.2 through 3.4 laid the groundwork for this framework by describing reusable time value and timer queue classes, and by defining the interface between framework and application event processing code with the ACE_Event_Handler class. This section describes how the ACE_Reactor class at the heart of the ACE Reactor framework defines how applications can register for, and be notified about, events from multiple sources.

                                                等级能力

                                                Class Capabilities

                                                ACE_Reactor实现了外观模式 [ GoF ]，定义了一个应用程序可以用来访问 ACE Reactor 框架各种功能的接口。此类提供以下功能：

                                                ACE_Reactor implements the Facade pattern [GoF] to define an interface that applications can use to access the various ACE Reactor framework features. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                • 它集中处理响应式应用程序中的事件循环。

                                                • It centralizes event loop processing in a reactive application.

                                                • 它通过事件多路复用器（例如select()或WaitForMultipleObjects ()）检测事件，这些解复用器由操作系统提供，并由反应堆实现使用。

                                                • It detects events via an event demultiplexer, such as select() or WaitForMultipleObjects(), provided by the OS and used by the reactor implementation.

                                                • 当事件多路复用器指示指定事件发生时，它将事件多路复用到事件处理程序。

                                                • It demultiplexes events to event handlers when the event demultiplexer indicates the occurrence of the designated events.

                                                • 它会向已注册的事件处理程序分发相应的钩子方法，以执行应用程序定义的处理来响应事件。

                                                • It dispatches the appropriate hook methods on registered event handlers to perform application-defined processing in response to the events.

                                                • 它确保任何线程都可以更改 Reactor 的事件集或将回调排队到事件处理程序，并期望 Reactor 及时响应请求。

                                                • It ensures that any thread can change a Reactor's event set or queue a callback to an event handler and expect the Reactor to act on the request promptly.

                                                ACE_Reactor的接口如图 3.6 （第 72 页）所示。该类具有丰富的接口，导出了 ACE Reactor 框架中的所有功能。因此，我们将其方法描述分为以下六个类别。

                                                The interface for ACE_Reactor is shown in Figure 3.6 (page 72). This class has a rich interface that exports all the features in the ACE Reactor framework. We therefore group its method descriptions into the six categories described below.

                                                ACE_Reactor类将多种解复用机制隔离在本章讨论的稳定接口背后。为了以易于使用和维护的方式划分不同的机制，ACE_Reactor类采用桥接模式 [ GoF ] 将其实现与类接口分离。这种设计允许用户在默认实现不适用时替换特定的反应器实现。

                                                The ACE_Reactor class isolates a variety of demultiplexing mechanisms behind the stable interface discussed in this chapter. To partition the different mechanisms in an easy-to-use and easy-to-maintain way, the ACE_Reactor class uses the Bridge pattern [GoF] to separate its implementations from its class interface. This design allows users to substitute a specific reactor implementation when the default isn't appropriate.

                                                ACE_Reactor构造函数可以选择性地接收一个指向用于检测和解复用事件以及将方法分发到相应事件处理程序的实现的指针。第4.2 节中描述的ACE_Select_Reactor是大多数平台上ACE_Reactor的默认实现。例外情况是 Windows，其默认实现为ACE_WFMO_Reactor，原因详见侧边栏 25（第 105 页）。

                                                The ACE_Reactor constructor can optionally be passed a pointer to the implementation used to detect and demultiplex events and to dispatch the methods on the appropriate event handlers. The ACE_Select_Reactor described in Section 4.2 is the default implementation of the ACE_Reactor on most platforms. The exception is Windows, which defaults to ACE_WFMO_Reactor for the reasons described in Sidebar 25 (page 105).

                                                尽管 ACE 提供了“功能齐全”的类构造函数，但它们最适合用于无错误或原型场景，在这些场景中错误检查并不重要（参见 [ Mey96 ] 中的第 10 项）。在 ACE 中，首选用法是单独调用open()方法（在对象清理的情况下调用 close()方法）。这种偏好源于open()和close()方法的功能。

                                                Although ACE offers "full-featured" class constructors, they're best used in error-free or prototype situations where error checking is not important (see Item 10 in [Mey96]). The preferred usage in ACE is a separate call to open() (and close() in the case of object cleanup) methods. This preference stems from the ability of open() and close()

                                                ACE 会返回错误指示，而其构造函数和析构函数不会抛出原生 C++ 异常。ACE 设计中避免使用原生 C++ 异常的原因在 C++NPv1 的 A.6 节中进行了讨论。本书 7.2 节中讨论的ACE_Svc_Handler类会自动关闭底层套接字句柄。

                                                ACE_Reactor的析构函数和close()方法会释放反应器使用的所有资源。此关闭过程涉及对所有与仍注册到反应器的句柄关联的事件处理程序调用handle_close()钩子方法。所有已安排的定时器都会被删除，且不会发出任何通知；反应器通知机制（第 77 页）中缓冲的所有通知也会在反应器关闭时丢失。

                                                The ACE_Reactor destructor and close() methods release all the resources used by a reactor. This shutdown process involves calling the handle_close() hook method on all event handlers associated with handles that remain registered with a reactor. Any scheduled timers are deleted without notice and any notifications that are buffered in the reactor's notification mechanism (page 77) are lost when a reactor is closed.

                                                ACE_Reactor的注册和移除方法提供了多种重载签名，以便于在各种不同场景中使用。例如，register_handler()方法可以与以下任何签名一起使用：

                                                The ACE_Reactor's registration and removal methods offer multiple overloaded signatures to facilitate their use in many different situations. For example, the register_handler() methods can be used with any of the following signatures:

                                                • (ACE_Event_Handler *, ACE_Reactor_Mask) — 在此版本中，第一个参数标识应用程序的事件处理程序，第二个参数指示处理程序准备处理的事件类型。该方法的实现使用双重分派[ GoF ] 通过处理程序的get_handle()方法获取句柄。这种设计的优点在于应用程序代码无需显式获取或公开 I/O 句柄，从而避免将错误的句柄意外关联到事件处理程序。因此，本书中的大多数示例都使用register_handler()的这种变体。

                                                • (ACE_Event_Handler *, ACE_Reactor_Mask)— In this version, the first parameter identifies the application's event handler and the second indicates the type of event(s) the handler is prepared to process. The method's implementation uses double-dispatching [GoF] to obtain a handle via the handler's get_handle() method. The advantage of this design is that application code need not obtain nor expose an I/O handle explicitly, which prevents accidental association of the wrong handle with an event handler. Most examples in this book therefore use this variant of register_handler().

                                                • (ACE_HANDLE, ACE_Event_Handler *, ACE_Reactor_Mask) — 在此版本中，新增了一个第一个参数，用于显式指定与应用程序事件处理程序关联的 I/O 句柄。与上述双参数版本相比，此设计更容易出错，因为调用者可能会意外传递与事件处理程序不匹配的 I/O 句柄。但是，它允许应用程序为同一个事件处理程序注册多个 I/O 句柄，这对于必须与多个 IPC 对象关联的处理程序来说是必要的。如果单个事件处理程序可以处理来自多个不相关 I/O 流的事件，且这些 I/O 流不需要维护每个句柄的状态，则也可以使用此方法来节省内存。第 6.2 节“示例”部分中的客户端日志守护程序示例演示了register_handler()的三参数变体。

                                                • (ACE_HANDLE, ACE_Event_Handler *, ACE_Reactor_Mask)— In this version, a new first parameter is added to explicitly specify the I/O handle associated with the application's event handler. This design is potentially more error-prone than the two-parameter version above since callers can accidentally pass an I/O handle that doesn't match the event handler. However, it allows an application to register multiple I/O handles for the same event handler, which is necessary for handlers that must be associated with multiple IPC objects. This method can also be used to conserve memory if a single event handler can process events from many unrelated I/O streams that don't require maintenance of per-handle state. The client logging daemon example in the Example portion of Section 6.2 illustrates the three parameter variant of register_handler().

                                                • (const ACE_Sig_Set &sigset, ACE_Event_Handler *new_sh, ACE_Sig_Action *new_disp) — 在此版本中，指定了一个新的事件处理程序 ( new_sh ) 来处理一组 POSIX 信号。当sigset中的任何信号被触发时，反应器将调用关联事件处理程序上的handle_signal()钩子方法。与反应器的其他回调不同， handle_signal()是在信号上下文中调用的。因此，它的操作仅限于可用系统调用的一个子集。建议开发人员查阅其操作系统平台文档以了解详细信息。

                                                • (const ACE_Sig_Set &sigset, ACE_Event_Handler *new_sh, ACE_ Sig_Action *new_disp)— In this version, a new event handler (new_sh)is specified to handle a set of POSIX signals. When any signal in sigset is raised, the reactor will call the handle_signal() hook method on the associated event handler. Unlike other callbacks from the reactor, handle_signal() is called in signal context. Its actions are therefore restricted to a subset of available system calls. Developers are advised to check their OS platform documentation for details.

                                                ACE_Reactor ::remove_handler()方法可用于从反应器中移除事件处理程序，使其不再注册处理一种或多种类型的 I/O 事件或信号。该方法有带显式句柄指定和不带显式句柄指定两种变体（与上述前两个register_handler()方法变体类似）。一种变体接受ACE_Handle_Set参数，用于一次性移除多个句柄；另一种变体接受ACE_Sig_Set参数，用于从反应器处理中移除信号。必须使用ACE_Reactor::cancel_timer()方法（第 76 页）来移除已调度处理定时器事件的事件处理程序。

                                                The ACE_Reactor::remove_handler() methods can be used to remove event handlers from a reactor so that they are no longer registered for one or more types of I/O events or signals. There are variants with and without an explicit handle specification (just like the first two register_handler() method variants described above). One variant accepts an ACE_Handle_Set to remove a number of handles at once; the other accepts an ACE_Sig_Set to remove signals from reactor handling. The ACE_Reactor::cancel_timer() method (page 76) must be used to remove event handlers that are scheduled for timer events.

                                                当应用程序调用 ACE_Reactor ::remove_handler()方法来移除 I/O 事件时，它可以传递一个位掩码，该掩码由第 50 页表格中定义的枚举字面量组成。此位掩码指示哪些 I/O 事件类型不再需要处理。随后，会调用事件处理程序的handle_close()方法来通知它事件已被移除。handle_close ()返回后，如果事件处理程序不再注册处理任何 I/O 事件，ACE_Reactor会从其内部 I/O 事件解复用数据结构中移除该事件处理程序。

                                                When an application calls one of the ACE_Reactor::remove_handler() methods for I/O event removal, it can pass a bit mask consisting of the enumeration literals defined in the table on page 50. This bit mask indicates which I/O event types are no longer of interest. The event handler's handle_close() method is subsequently called to notify it of the removal. After handle_close() returns and the event handler is no longer registered to handle any I/O events, the ACE_Reactor removes the event handler from its internal I/O event demultiplexing data structures.

                                                应用程序可以通过向 ` remove_handler() ` 的掩码参数添加`ACE_Event_Handler::DONT_CALL`标志来阻止`handle_close()`被回调。该标志指示 Reactor 在移除事件处理程序时不要调用 ` handle_close()`方法，如 ` Service_Reporter::fini()`方法（第 135 页）所示。为了确保 Reactor 不会无限递归地调用`handle_close()` ，当从`handle_close()`钩子方法内部调用`remove_handler()`时，应始终将`DONT_CALL`标志传递给它。

                                                An application can prevent handle_close() from being called back by adding the ACE_Event_Handler::DONT_CALL flag to remove_handler()'s mask parameter. This flag instructs a reactor not to dispatch the handle_close() method when removing an event handler, as shown in the Service_Reporter::fini() method (page 135). To ensure a reactor won't invoke handle_close() in an infinite recursion, the DONT_CALL flag should always be passed to remove_handler() when it's called from within the handle_close() hook method itself.

                                                默认情况下，通过`cancel_timer()`方法取消定时器时，不会调用` handle_close()`钩子方法。但是，可以提供一个可选的 `final` 参数来请求调用`handle_close()` 。从信号处理中移除事件处理程序时，也不会调用`handle_close()`方法。

                                                By default, the handle_close() hook method is not called when canceling timers via the cancel_timer() method. However, an optional final argument can be supplied to request that handle_close() be called. The handle_close() method is not called when removing an event handler from signal handling.

                                                ` suspend_handler()`方法可用于暂时从反应器的基于句柄的事件解复用活动中移除一个或多个处理程序。`resume_handler ()`方法会撤销`suspend_handler() ` 的操作，使这些句柄重新加入到反应器事件解复用器等待的句柄集中。由于`suspend_handler()`和`resume_handler()`仅影响基于 I/O 句柄的分发，因此它们不会影响定时器、信号处理或通知。

                                                The suspend_handler() method can be used to remove a handler or set of handlers temporarily from the reactor's handle-based event demultiplexing activity. The resume_handler() method reverts the actions of suspend_handler() so that the handle(s) are included in the set of handles waited upon by the reactor's event demultiplexer. Since suspend_handler() and resume_handler() affect only I/O handle-based dispatching, they have no effect on timers, signal handling, or notifications.

                                                ` mask_ops()`方法执行获取、设置、添加或清除与事件处理程序分发掩码关联的事件类型的操作。`mask_ops ()`方法假定事件处理程序已存在，并且不会尝试注册或移除它。因此，它比使用`register_handler()`和`remove_handler()`更高效。`schedule_wakeup ()`和`cancel_wakeup()`方法只是涉及`mask_ops()`的常见操作的“语法糖” 。它们有助于防止一些不易察觉的错误，例如在预期添加位时替换了掩码。例如，以下`mask_ops() ` 调用启用和禁用 ` ACE_Event_Handler::WRITE_MASK`：

                                                The mask_ops() method performs operations that get, set, add, or clear the event type(s) associated with an event handler's dispatch mask. The mask_ops() method assumes that an event handler is already present and doesn't try to register or remove it. It's therefore more efficient than using register_handler() and remove_handler(). The schedule_wakeup() and cancel_wakeup() methods are simply "syntactic sugar" for common operations involving mask_ops(). They help prevent subtle errors, however, such as replacing a mask when adding bits was intended. For example, the following mask_ops() calls enable and disable the ACE_Event_Handler::WRITE_MASK:

                                                ACE_Reactor::instance ()->mask_ops 
  (handler, ACE_Event_Handler::WRITE_MASK, ACE_Reactor::ADD_MASK); 
// ... 
ACE_Reactor::instance ()->mask_ops 
  (handler, ACE_Event_Handler::WRITE_MASK, ACE_Reactor::CLR_MASK);

                                                这些调用可以用以下更简洁、信息更丰富的方法调用来代替：

                                                These calls can be replaced by the following more concise and informative method calls:

                                                ACE_Reactor::instance ()->schedule_wakeup 
  (handler, ACE_Event_Handler::WRITE_MASK); 
// ... 
ACE_Reactor::instance ()->cancel_wakeup 
  (handler, ACE_Event_Handler::WRITE_MASK);

                                                3. 事件循环管理方法。 控制反转是 ACE Reactor 框架提供的一项关键功能。与其他框架（例如 X Windows Toolkit 或 Microsoft Foundation Classes (MFC)）类似，ACE_Reactor实现了事件循环，用于控制应用程序事件处理程序的分发时间。注册初始事件处理程序后，应用程序可以通过下表中的方法管理其事件循环：

                                                3. Event-loop management methods. Inversion of control is a key capability offered by the ACE Reactor framework. Similar to other frameworks, such as the X Windows Toolkit or Microsoft Foundation Classes (MFC), ACE_Reactor implements the event loop that controls when application event handlers are dispatched. After registering its initial event handlers, an application can manage its event loop via methods in the following table:

                                                方法

                                                Method

                                                描述

                                                Description

                                                处理事件()

                                                handle_events()

                                                等待事件发生，然后分发关联的事件处理程序。超时参数可以限制等待事件发生的时间。

                                                Waits for an event to occur and then dispatches the associated event handler(s). A timeout parameter can limit the time spent waiting for an event.

                                                run_reactor_event_loop()

                                                run_reactor_event_loop()

                                                反复调用handle_events()方法，直到失败、reactor_event_loop_done()返回 1 或发生可选的超时为止。

                                                Calls the handle_events() method repeatedly until it fails, reactor_event_loop_done() returns 1, or an optional timeout occurs.

                                                end_reactor_event_loop()

                                                end_reactor_event_loop()

                                                指示反应堆关闭其事件循环。

                                                Instructs a reactor to shut down its event loop.

                                                reactor_event_loop_done()

                                                reactor_event_loop_done()

                                                当通过调用end_reactor_event_loop()结束反应器的事件循环时，返回 1 。

                                                Returns 1 when the reactor's event loop has been ended via a call to end_reactor_event_loop().

                                                ` handle_events()`方法收集所有已注册事件处理程序的句柄，并将它们传递给反应器的事件解复用器，然后阻塞最多一段由应用程序指定的时间间隔，等待事件发生，例如 I/O 活动或定时器超时。当事件发生时，此方法会调用应用程序定义的`handle_*() ` 钩子方法来分发相应的预注册事件处理程序，以处理该事件。如果发生多个事件，则会在返回之前分发所有事件。返回值指示已处理的事件数，如果在调用者指定的超时时间之前没有发生任何事件，则返回 0；如果发生错误，则返回 -1。

                                                The handle_events() method gathers the handles of all registered event handlers, passes them to the reactor's event demultiplexer, and blocks for up to an application-specified time interval awaiting the occurrence of an event, such as I/O activity or timer expiration. When an event occurs, this method dispatches the appropriate preregistered event handlers by invoking their handle_*() hook method(s) defined by the application to process the event(s). If more than one event occurs, they are all dispatched before returning. The return value indicates the number of events processed, 0 if no events occurred before the caller-specified timeout, or -1 if an error occurred.

                                                ` run_reactor_event_loop ()`方法是对`handle_events()`的简单封装。它会持续运行事件循环，不断调用`handle_events()`，直到满足以下任一条件：

                                                The run_reactor_event_loop() method is a simple wrapper around handle_events(). It runs the event loop continually, calling handle_events() until either

                                                • 发生错误

                                                • An error occurs

                                                • 可选参数ACE_Time_Value中指定的时间已过去

                                                • The time designated in the optional ACE_Time_Value elapses

                                                • 调用end_reactor_event_loop ()方法（可能在某个事件处理回调函数内部）来结束事件循环。

                                                • The end_reactor_event_loop() method is called—possibly from within one of the event handling callbacks—to end the event loop

                                                没有专门事件处理需求的应用程序通常使用run_reactor_event_loop()和end_reactor_event_loop()来处理其事件循环，因为这些方法可以自动检测和处理错误。

                                                Applications without specialized event handling needs often use run_reactor_event_loop() and end_reactor_event_loop() to handle their event loops because these methods detect and handle errors automatically.

                                                许多联网应用程序在单个控制线程中运行反应器的事件循环。第4.3节和4.4节描述了ACE_TP_Reactor和ACE_WFMO_Reactor类如何允许多个线程并发调用其事件循环方法。

                                                Many networked applications run a reactor's event loop in a single thread of control. Sections 4.3 and 4.4 describe how the ACE_TP_Reactor and ACE_WFMO_Reactor classes allow multiple threads to call their event loop methods concurrently.

                                                4. 定时器管理方法。 默认情况下，ACE_Reactor使用3.4 节中描述的ACE_Timer_Heap定时器队列机制，根据事件处理程序的超时截止时间来调度和分发它们。ACE_Reactor 公开的定时器管理方法包括：

                                                4. Timer management methods. By default, ACE_Reactor uses the ACE_Timer_Heap timer queue mechanism described in Section 3.4 to schedule and dispatch event handlers in accordance to their timeout deadlines. The timer management methods exposed by the ACE_Reactor include:

                                                方法

                                                Method

                                                描述

                                                Description

                                                schedule_timer()

                                                schedule_timer()

                                                注册一个事件处理程序，该程序将在用户指定的时间后执行。

                                                Registers an event handler that will be executed after a user-specified amount of time.

                                                取消计时器()

                                                cancel_timer()

                                                取消之前注册的一个或多个计时器。

                                                Cancels one or more timers that were previously registered.

                                                ACE_Reactor规范了在处理包括 I/O 和定时器在内的各种事件类型时，如何正确使用 ACE 定时器队列功能。事实上，大多数用户仅通过 ACE_Reactor 与 ACE 定时器队列进行交互，ACE_Reactor将 ACE 定时器队列功能集成到 Reactor 框架中，具体如下：

                                                The ACE_Reactor codifies the proper usage of the ACE timer queue functionality in the context of handling a range of event types including I/O and timers. In fact, most users interact with the ACE timer queues only via the ACE_Reactor, which integrates the ACE timer queue functionality into the Reactor framework as follows:

                                                • schedule_timer ()方法允许用户使用相对时间指定定时器，这通常比 ACE 定时器队列使用的绝对时间更容易操作。此方法利用定时器队列的gettimeofday()机制，自动将用户指定的时间调整为定时器队列使用的时间方法。

                                                • The schedule_timer() method allows users to specify timers using relative time, which is generally easier to work with than the absolute times the ACE timer queues use. This method uses the timer queue's gettimeofday() mechanism to adjust user-specified times automatically to the time method used by the timer queue.

                                                • handle_events ()方法会查询定时器队列，找到最早定时器的到期时间。然后，它使用该值来限制事件解复用器等待 I/O 事件的时间。

                                                • The handle_events() method queries the timer queue to find the expiration time of the earliest timer. It then uses this value to limit the amount of time the event demultiplexer waits for I/O events.

                                                • handle_events ()方法会在最早的计时器到达时间之后，事件解复用器超时时调用计时器队列方法使计时器过期。

                                                • The handle_events() method will call the timer queue methods to expire timers when the event demultiplexer times out after the time for the earliest timer arrives.

                                                这些措施共同有效地将定时器以易于使用的方式集成到 ACE Reactor 框架中，使应用程序无需直接与定时器队列方法交互即可重用 ACE 定时器队列的功能。侧边栏 16介绍了如何最大限度地减少 ACE 定时器队列中的动态内存分配。

                                                Together, these actions effectively integrate timers into the ACE Reactor framework in an easy-to-use way that allows applications to reuse the ACE timer queue capabilities without interacting with timer queue methods directly. Sidebar 16 describes how to minimize dynamic memory allocations in ACE timer queues.

                                                侧边栏 16：最小化 ACE 定时器队列中的内存分配

                                                Sidebar 16: Minimizing Memory Allocations in ACE Timer Queues

                                                图 3.5 （第 64 页）所示的ACE_Timer_Queue基类没有提供设置定时器队列大小的方法。这种省略是故意的，因为在该类层次结构中，“大小”没有统一的含义。每个定时器队列子类对“大小”的定义都不同，这取决于其底层数据结构。因此，定时器队列子类在其构造函数中提供了与大小相关的参数。这些参数指示定时器队列实现如何设置其初始内部数据结构的大小。虽然定时器队列会自动调整大小以容纳任意数量的定时器，但调整大小涉及动态内存分配，这可能会引入一些应用程序难以承受的开销。

                                                The ACE_Timer_Queue base class depicted in Figure 3.5 (page 64) offers no method to set the size of a timer queue. This omission is deliberate because there's no uniform meaning for "size" at that level of the class hierarchy. Each timer queue subclass has a different meaning for "size" that's related to its underlying data structures. The timer queue subclasses therefore offer size-related parameters in their constructors. These parameters are hints instructing the timer queue implementation how large to make its initial internal data structures. Although the timer queues resize automatically to accomodate arbitrarily large numbers of timers, resizing involves dynamic memory allocation, which can introduce overhead that's prohibitive for some applications.

                                                除了调整队列大小之外，ACE_Timer_Heap和ACE_Timer_Wheel类还提供了预分配定时器队列条目的功能，从而避免队列进行任何后续的动态内存分配。要使ACE_Reactor使用自定义调整的队列来执行定时器操作，只需执行以下操作：

                                                In addition to sizing the queue, the ACE_Timer_Heap and ACE_Timer_Wheel classes offer the ability to preallocate timer queue entries so the queue can avoid any subsequent dynamic memory allocation. To make the ACE_Reactor use a custom-tuned queue for its timer operations you simply need to do the following:

                                                1. 实例化所需的 ACE 定时器队列类，并指定所需的大小和预分配参数（如果适用）。

                                                2. Instantiate the desired ACE timer queue class, specifying the desired size and preallocation argument, if applicable.

                                                3. 实例化一个 ACE 反应器实现对象，并指定步骤 1 中的定时器队列。

                                                4. Instantiate an ACE reactor implementation object, specifying the timer queue from step 1.

                                                5. 实例化一个新的ACE_Reactor对象，并提供步骤 2 中的实现对象。

                                                6. Instantiate a new ACE_Reactor object, supplying the implementation object from step 2.

                                                5. 通知方法。 反应器具有通知机制，应用程序可以使用该机制将事件和事件处理程序插入到反应器的调度引擎中。以下方法管理反应器通知机制的各个方面：

                                                5. Notification methods. A reactor has a notification mechanism that applications can use to insert events and event handlers into a reactor's dispatching engine. The following methods manage various aspects of a reactor's notification mechanism:

                                                方法

                                                Method

                                                描述

                                                Description

                                                通知（）

                                                notify()

                                                将事件（以及可选的事件处理程序）插入到反应器的事件检测器中，这样当反应器下次等待事件时，就会处理该事件。

                                                Inserts an event (and an optional event handler) into the reactor's event detector, which causes it to be processed when the reactor next waits for events.

                                                max_notify_iterations()

                                                max_notify_iterations()

                                                设置反应堆将通过其通知机制派发的处理程序的最大数量。

                                                Sets the maximum number of handlers a reactor will dispatch from its notification mechanism.

                                                清除待处理通知()

                                                purge_pending_notifications()

                                                从反应堆的通知机制中清除指定的事件处理程序或所有事件处理程序。

                                                Purges a specified event handler or all event handlers from the reactor's notification mechanism.

                                                ACE_Reactor ::notify()方法可用于以下几个目的：

                                                The ACE_Reactor::notify() method can be used for several purposes:

                                                • 反应器通知机制允许其他线程唤醒因等待 I/O 事件而阻塞事件解复用器函数的反应器所有者线程。例如，由于`mask_ops()`、`schedule_wakeup()`和`cancel_wakeup()`不会导致反应器重新检查其句柄和处理程序集，因此任何新的掩码只有在下次调用反应器的 ` handle_events()`方法时才会被注意到。如果预计近期没有其他活动，或者需要立即重新检查等待掩码，则可以调用`ACE_Reactor::notify()`来强制反应器重新检查其句柄和处理程序集。

                                                • The reactor notification mechanism enables other threads to wake up a reactor's owner thread whose event demultiplexer function is blocked waiting for I/O events to occur. For example, since mask_ops(), schedule_wakeup(), and cancel_wakeup() don't cause the reactor to reexamine its set of handles and handlers, any new masks will only be noticed the next time a reactor's handle_events() method is called. If no other activity is expected shortly, or if the wait masks should be reexamined immediately, ACE_Reactor::notify() can be called to force a reactor to reexamine its set of handles and handlers.

                                                • notify ()方法可以接收一个事件处理程序指针和一个ACE_Reactor_Mask值，例如READ_MASK、WRITE_MASK或EXCEPT_MASK。这些参数会触发 Reactor 分发相应的事件处理程序钩子方法（详见第 50 页的表格），而无需将处理程序与 I/O 句柄或定时器事件关联。由于传递给 ACE_Reactor ::notify()的处理程序指针无需事先或将来注册到该 Reactor，因此该特性使得 Reactor 可以扩展到无限数量的事件处理程序。

                                                • The notify() method can be passed an event handler pointer and one of the ACE_Reactor_Mask values, such as READ_MASK, WRITE_MASK, or EXCEPT_MASK. These parameters trigger the reactor to dispatch the corresponding event handler hook method (outlined in the table on page 50) without needing to associate the handler with I/O handles or timer events. This feature enables the reactor to scale to an open-ended number of event handlers since there's no requirement that a handler whose pointer is passed to ACE_Reactor::notify() has ever been, or ever will be, registered with that reactor.

                                                默认情况下，反应器在检测到通知事件后会调度其通知机制中的所有事件处理程序。`max_notify_iterations ()`方法可以更改调度的事件处理程序数量。设置较低的值可以提高公平性并防止事件饥饿，但会略微增加调度开销。

                                                By default, a reactor dispatches all event handlers in its notification mechanism after detecting a notification event. The max_notify_iterations() method can change the number of event handlers dispatched. Setting a low value improves fairness and prevents starvation, though it increases dispatching overhead somewhat.

                                                侧边栏 17：避免反应堆通知机制僵局

                                                Sidebar 17: Avoiding Reactor Notification Mechanism Deadlock

                                                默认情况下，反应堆通知机制使用有界缓冲区实现，`notify()`方法通过阻塞式发送调用将通知插入队列。因此，如果缓冲区已满，且事件处理程序的`handle_*()`方法调用了`notify()`方法，则可能发生死锁。有几种方法可以避免此类死锁：

                                                By default, the reactor notification mechanism is implemented with a bounded buffer and notify() uses a blocking send call to insert notifications into the queue. A deadlock can therefore occur if the buffer is full and notify() is called by a handle_*() method of an event handler. There are several ways to avoid such deadlocks:

                                                • 向notify()方法传递一个超时时间。这种解决方案将处理缓冲区溢出的责任转移到调用notify()的线程。

                                                • Pass a timeout to the notify() method. This solution pushes the responsibility for handling buffer overflow to the thread that calls notify().

                                                • 设计应用程序时，应确保其调用 ` notify()`函数的速度不会超过 Reactor 的处理速度。这最终是最佳解决方案，但需要仔细分析程序行为。

                                                • Design the application so that it doesn't generate calls to notify() faster than a reactor can process them. This is ultimately the best solution, though it requires careful analysis of program behavior.

                                                侧边栏 22（第 94 页）描述了一种避免ACE_Select_Reactor死锁的方法。

                                                Sidebar 22 (page 94) describes a way to avoid ACE_Select_Reactor deadlocks.

                                                发送到反应器的通知会在内部排队等待反应器分发（侧边栏 17讨论了如何避免队列死锁）。如果与通知关联的事件处理程序在通知分发之前失效，则当反应器尝试分发无效的事件处理程序指针时，可能会发生灾难性故障。因此，可以使用` purge_pending_notifications()`方法从队列中移除与事件处理程序关联的所有通知。ACE Reactor 框架通过在`ACE_Event_Handler`析构函数中调用`purge_pending_notifications()`来帮助用户。所有应用程序事件处理程序都会继承此行为，因为析构函数被声明为`virtual`。

                                                Notifications to the reactor are queued internally while waiting for the reactor to dispatch them (Sidebar 17 discusses how to avoid deadlock on a queue). If an event handler associated with a notification is invalidated before the notification is dispatched, a catastrophic failure can occur when the reactor tries to dispatch an invalid event handler pointer. The purge_pending_notifications() method can therefore be used to remove any notifications associated with an event handler from the queue. The ACE Reactor framework assists users by calling purge_pending_notifications() from the ACE_Event_Handler destructor. This behavior is inherited by all application event handlers because the destructor is declared virtual.

                                                通知会一直保留在队列中，直到被事件处理程序分发或清除。这确保即使在调用`notify()`时反应器正忙于处理其他事件，通知也能得到处理。但是，如果反应器停止检测和分发事件（例如，在`run_reactor_event_loop()`返回后），所有排队的通知都会保留，除非反应器被指示再次检测和分发事件，否则不会被分发。因此，如果在分发排队的通知之前关闭或删除反应器，则通知将会丢失。应用程序负责决定何时终止事件处理，此后将不会检测、解复用或分发任何来源的事件。

                                                Notifications remain in a queue until they are dispatched or purged by an event handler, which ensures that a notification will be processed even if the reactor is busy processing other events at the time that notify() is called. However, if the reactor ceases to detect and dispatch events (e.g., after run_reactor_event_loop() returns), any queued notifications remain and will not be dispatched unless and until the reactor is directed to detect and dispatch events again. Notifications will therefore be lost if the reactor is closed or deleted before dispatching the queued notifications. Applications are responsible for deciding when to terminate event processing, and no events from any source will be detected, demultiplexed, or dispatched after that time.
