By default, the ACE_Object_Manager (Sidebar 23 on page 218 of C++NPv1) deletes the singleton ACE_Reactor during shutdown. Since we replaced the original singleton with our local reactor object, however, ACE won't delete either the original instance (because we assumed ownership of it on line 18) or our local one (because ACE won't delete a reactor it didn't create, unless specifically directed to).

                                                          本示例与第 96 页示例的主要区别在于执行事件循环的线程数。虽然多个线程可以将事件分派给Logging_Event_Handler和Logging_Acceptor_Ex对象，但ACE_TP_Reactor确保不会从多个线程并发调用同一个处理程序。由于日志服务器中的事件处理类是完全独立的，因此不会出现涉及多线程访问的竞态条件。因此，我们无需对其进行任何更改即可确保线程安全。

                                                          The primary difference between this example and the example on page 96 is the number of threads executing the event loop. Although multiple threads can dispatch events to Logging_Event_Handler and Logging_Acceptor_Ex objects, the ACE_TP_Reactor ensures that the same handler won't be invoked from multiple threads concurrently. Since the event handling classes in the logging server are completely self-contained, there's no chance for race conditions involving access from multiple threads. We therefore needn't make any changes to them to ensure thread safety.

                                                            4.4 ACE_WFMO_Reactor 类

                                                            4.4 The ACE_WFMO_Reactor Class

                                                            动机

                                                            Motivation

                                                            虽然大多数操作系统都提供了select()函数，但它并非在任何给定的操作系统平台上都是最高效或最强大的事件解复用器。特别是， select()函数存在以下局限性：

                                                            Although the select() function is available on most operating systems, it's not always the most efficient or most powerful event demultiplexer on any given OS platform. In particular, select() has the following limitations:

                                                            • 在 UNIX 平台上，它仅支持对 I/O 句柄（例如文件、终端设备、FIFO 和管道）进行解复用。它不支持对同步器、线程或 System V 消息队列进行解复用，且支持移植性较差。

                                                            • On UNIX platforms, it only supports demultiplexing of I/O handles, such as files, terminal devices, FIFOs, and pipes. It does not portably support demultiplexing of synchronizers, threads, or System V Message Queues.

                                                            • 在 Windows 系统中，select() 函数仅支持套接字句柄的解复用。

                                                            • On Windows, select() only supports demultiplexing of socket handles.

                                                            • 对于特定的一组 I/O 句柄，一次只能由一个线程调用它，这可能会降低潜在的并行性。

                                                            • It can only be called by one thread at a time for a particular set of I/O handles, which can degrade potential parallelism.

                                                            Windows 定义了WaitForMultipleObjects()系统函数（详见侧边栏 24，第 104 页），用于缓解这些问题。该函数适用于多种可发出信号的 Windows 句柄类型。虽然它不能直接处理 I/O 句柄，但可以通过两种方式对 I/O 相关事件进行解复用：

                                                            Windows defines the WaitForMultipleObjects() system function, described in Sidebar 24 (page 104), to alleviate these problems. This function works with many Windows handle types that can be signaled. Although it doesn't work directly with I/O handles, it can be used to demultiplex I/O-related events in two ways:

                                                            1. 重叠 I/O 操作中使用的事件句柄

                                                            2. Event handles used in overlapped I/O operations

                                                            3. 通过WSAEventSelect()将事件句柄与套接字句柄关联起来

                                                            4. Event handles associated with socket handles via WSAEventSelect()

                                                            此外，多个线程可以对同一组句柄并发调用WaitForMultipleObjects() ，从而增强潜在的并行性。

                                                            Moreover, multiple threads can call WaitForMultipleObjects() concurrently on the same set of handles, thereby enhancing potential parallelism.

                                                            然而，由于以下原因，正确使用WaitForMultipleObjects()比较棘手 [ SS95a ]：

                                                            WaitForMultipleObjects() is tricky to use correctly, however, for the following reasons [SS95a]:

                                                            • `WaitForMultipleObjects() ` 返回指向第一个包含已发出信号的句柄的句柄数组槽位的索引。但是，它并不指示已发出信号的句柄的数量，也没有简单的方法可以扫描这些句柄并检查哪些句柄已发出信号。因此，必须多次调用`WaitForMultipleObjects()`才能找到所有已发出信号的句柄。相比之下，`select()`返回一组活动的 I/O 句柄以及其中有多少个是活动的。

                                                            • WaitForMultipleObjects() returns an index to the first handle array slot with a signaled handle. It does not, however, indicate the number of handles that are signaled, and there is no simple way to scan the handles and check which are. WaitForMultipleObjects() must therefore be invoked numerous times to find all signaled handles. In contrast, select() returns a set of active I/O handles and a count of how many are active.

                                                            • WaitForMultipleObjects()不能保证通知的公平分配，也就是说，无论数组中更靠后的其他句柄可能有多长时间的待处理事件，它总是返回数组中最低的活动句柄。

                                                            • WaitForMultipleObjects() doesn't guarantee a fair distribution of notifications, that is, the lowest active handle in the array is always returned, regardless of how long other handles further back in the array may have had pending events.

                                                            为了保护程序员免受这些底层细节的影响，保持解复用公平性，并利用Windows 平台上WaitForMultipleObjects()的强大功能，ACE Reactor 框架提供了ACE_WFMO_Reactor类。

                                                            To shield programmers from these low-level details, preserve demultiplexing fairness, and leverage the power of WaitForMultipleObjects() on Windows platforms, the ACE Reactor framework provides the ACE_WFMO_Reactor class.

                                                            侧边栏 24：Windows 的 WaitForMultipleObjects() 函数

                                                            Sidebar 24: The Windows WaitForMultipleObjects() Function

                                                            Windows 的WaitForMultipleObjects()事件解复用函数类似于select()函数。它会阻塞一个最多包含 64 个句柄的数组，直到其中一个或多个句柄变为活动状态（在 Windows 术语中称为“被发出信号”），或者直到其超时参数中指定的时间间隔到期。它可以被编程为在一个或多个句柄变为活动状态或所有句柄都变为活动状态时返回给调用者。无论哪种情况，它都会返回调用者指定的句柄数组中最低的活动句柄的索引。与仅解复用 I/O 句柄的select()函数不同，WaitForMultipleObjects()可以等待多种类型的 Windows 对象，包括线程、进程、同步器（例如事件、信号量或互斥锁）、更改通知、控制台输入和计时器。

                                                            The Windows WaitForMultipleObjects() event demultiplexer function is similar to select(). It blocks on an array of up to 64 handles until one or more of them become active (which is known as being "signaled" in Windows terminology) or until the interval in its timeout parameter elapses. It can be programmed to return to its caller when either any one or more of the handles becomes active or all the handles become active. In either case, it returns the index of the lowest active handle in the caller-specified array of handles. Unlike the select() function, which only demultiplexes I/O handles, WaitForMultipleObjects() can wait for many types of Windows objects, including a thread, process, synchronizer (e.g., event, semaphore, or mutex), change notification, console input, and timer.

                                                            等级能力

                                                            Class Capabilities

                                                            ACE_WFMO_Reactor是ACE_Reactor接口的另一种实现，它使用WaitForMultipleObjects()函数来等待一组事件源上发生的事件。除了支持ACE_Reactor接口的所有功能外，ACE_WFMO_Reactor类还提供以下功能：

                                                            ACE_WFMO_Reactor is yet another implementation of the ACE_Reactor interface, which uses the WaitForMultipleObjects() function to wait for events to occur on a set of event sources. In addition to supporting all the features of the ACE_Reactor interface, the ACE_WFMO_Reactor class provides the following capabilities:

                                                            • 它允许线程池中的多个线程并发调用其 ` handle_events()`方法（因此，` ACE_WFMO_Reactor::owner() ` 方法将不起作用）。此功能比 ` ACE_TP_Reactor`更强大。在`ACE_WFMO_Reactor`中，所有事件处理线程都可以并发分发事件，而无需像 `ACE_TP_Reactor` 那样采用领导者/跟随者模式轮流执行。我们将在第 106 页的“并发性注意事项”部分更详细地讨论`ACE_WFMO_Reactor`的这一特性。

                                                            • It enables a pool of threads to call its handle_events() method concurrently (as a result, the ACE_WFMO_Reactor::owner() method is a no-op). This facility is more powerful than that of ACE_TP_Reactor. In ACE_WFMO_Reactor, all of the event handling threads can dispatch events concurrently instead of taking turns in a leader/followers arrangement. We'll discuss this aspect of ACE_WFMO_Reactor in more detail in the Concurrency considerations section on page 106.

                                                            • 它允许应用程序等待套接字 I/O 事件和计划定时器，类似于基于select()的反应器。ACE_WFMO_Reactor还集成了WaitForMultipleObjects ()支持的所有事件类型的事件解复用和分发功能，如侧边栏 24中所述。

                                                            • It allows applications to wait for socket I/O events and scheduled timers, similar to the select()-based reactors. ACE_WFMO_Reactor also integrates event demultiplexing and dispatching for all event types that WaitForMultipleObjects() supports, as outlined in Sidebar 24.

                                                            • 每次调用`handle_events()`函数都会等待一个句柄变为活动状态。从该句柄开始，它会遍历所有其他活动句柄，然后返回。这种设计可以防止活动句柄导致句柄集数组中更后面的句柄无法被激活。

                                                            • Each call to handle_events() waits for a handle to become active. Starting from that handle, it iterates through all other active handles before returning. This design prevents an active handle from starving handles further down in the handle set array.

                                                            • 使用ACE_Msg_WFMO_Reactor子类，应用程序可以处理上述所有事件以及窗口消息。

                                                            • Using the ACE_Msg_WFMO_Reactor subclass, applications can process all the events above plus window messages.

                                                            ACE_WFMO_Reactor是 Windows 上的默认ACE_Reactor实现，原因见侧边栏 25。请注意，ACE_WFMO_Reactor分发事件的顺序与ACE_Select_Reactor相同（第 92 页）。

                                                            ACE_WFMO_Reactor is the default ACE_Reactor implementation on Windows for the reasons described in Sidebar 25. Note that ACE_WFMO_Reactor dispatches events in the same order as the ACE_Select_Reactor (page 92).

                                                            实现概述。如图 4.1 （第 89 页） 所示，ACE_WFMO_Reactor继承自ACE_Reactor_Impl。因此，它是ACE_Reactor接口的具体实现。正如ACE_Select_Reactor利用了select()函数的功能一样，ACE_WFMO_Reactor利用了WaitForMultipleObjects()函数的功能，如图 4.6 （第 106 页）所示。

                                                            Implementation overview. As shown in Figure 4.1 (page 89), ACE_WFMO_Reactor inherits from ACE_Reactor_Impl. It therefore serves as a concrete implementation of the ACE_Reactor interface. Just as ACE_Select_Reactor leverages the capabilities of the select() function, ACE_WFMO_Reactor leverages the capabilities of WaitForMultipleObjects(), as shown in Figure 4.6 (page 106).

                                                            图 4.6. ACE_WFMO_Reactor框架内部结构

                                                            侧边栏 25：为什么 ACE_WFMO_Reactor 是 Windows 上的默认设置

                                                            Sidebar 25: Why ACE_WFMO_Reactor Is the Default on Windows

                                                            ACE_WFMO_Reactor是 Windows 平台上ACE_Reactor的默认实现，原因如下：

                                                            The ACE_WFMO_Reactor is the default implementation of the ACE_Reactor on Windows platforms for the following reasons:

                                                            • 它更自然地适用于多线程处理，这在 Windows 上很常见（ACE_WFMO_Reactor是在ACE_TP_Reactor之前开发的，并且是第一个支持多线程事件处理的 reactor）。

                                                            • It lends itself more naturally to multithreaded processing, which is common on Windows (ACE_WFMO_Reactor was developed before ACE_TP_Reactor and was the first reactor to support multithreaded event handling).

                                                            • 应用程序经常在 POSIX 上使用信号（例如，子进程退出）的情况​​下使用可发出信号的句柄，并且这些事件可以由ACE_WFMO_Reactor分发。

                                                            • Applications often use signalable handles in situations where a signal may have been used on POSIX (e.g., child process exit) and these events can be dispatched by ACE_WFMO_Reactor.

                                                            • 它能够处理比ACE_Select_Reactor更广泛的事件，ACE_Select_Reactor 只能处理 Windows 上的套接字和定时器事件。

                                                            • It can handle a wider range of events than the ACE_Select_Reactor, which can only handle socket and timer events on Windows.

                                                            • 它很容易与ACE_Proactor事件处理集成，详见侧边栏 58（第 290 页）。

                                                            • It's easily integrated with ACE_Proactor event handling, discussed in Sidebar 58 (page 290).

                                                            ACE_WFMO_Reactor与ACE_Select_Reactor和ACE_TP_Reactor最显著的区别包括以下几点：

                                                            ACE_WFMO_Reactor's most significant differences from ACE_Select_Reactor and ACE_TP_Reactor include the following:

                                                            • 句柄数量有限。与可以配置为解复用数百或数千个句柄的ACE_Select_Reactor和ACE_TP_Reactor 不同， ACE_WFMO_Reactor最多只能处理 62 个句柄。此限制源于 Windows 仅允许WaitForMultipleObjects()函数每个线程等待 64 个句柄。ACE_WFMO_Reactor内部使用其中两个句柄：一个用于其通知机制，另一个用于同步并发处理程序更新。如果需要解复用超过 64 个句柄，可以在多个线程中使用多个ACE_WFMO_Reactor对象，使用ACE_Proactor（参见第 8 章），或者使用ACE_Select_Reactor并通过侧边栏 20 （第 92 页）中描述的机制来增加其大小。

                                                            • Limited number of handles. Unlike ACE_Select_Reactor and ACE_TP_Reactor, which can be configured to demultiplex hundreds or thousands of handles, ACE_WFMO_Reactor can process no more than 62 handles. This limitation stems from the fact that Windows only allows WaitForMultipleObjects() to wait for 64 handles per thread. ACE_WFMO_Reactor uses two of these handles internally: one for its notification mechanism and another for synchronizing concurrent handler updates. If more than 64 handles must be demultiplexed, you can use multiple ACE_WFMO_Reactor objects in multiple threads, use the ACE_Proactor (Chapter 8), or use the ACE_Select_Reactor and increase its size via the mechanisms described in Sidebar 20 (page 92).

                                                            • WRITE_MASK 的语义与 select()不同 。当套接字可以发送更多数据时，select()会检测到WRITE条件。只要套接字保持可写状态（即变为流控制状态），它就会持续检测到此条件。相比之下，Windows 的WSAEventSelect()函数仅在套接字首次连接时（无论是被动连接还是主动连接）以及套接字从流控制状态转换为可写状态时设置WRITE事件。因此，在使用ACE_WFMO_Reactor依赖WRITE事件时，您必须持续写入，直到连接关闭或套接字变为流控制状态且send()失败并返回EWOULDBLOCK错误。如果这种行为不理想，您可以考虑在 Windows 上选择ACE_Select_Reactor作为ACE_Reactor 的实现，因为它与 UNIX 平台上的WRITE_MASK语义相同。

                                                            • WRITE_MASK semantics different from select(). When a socket can send more data, select() detects a WRITE condition. It will continue to detect this condition as long as the socket remains writeable, that is, until it becomes flow controlled. In contrast, the Windows WSAEventSelect() function only sets the WRITE event when the socket is first connected, whether passively or actively, and when the socket transitions from flow-controlled to writeable. When relying on WRITE events using the ACE_WFMO_Reactor, you must therefore continue to write until the connection closes or the socket becomes flow controlled and a send() fails with EWOULDBLOCK. If this behavior is undesirable, you might consider choosing the ACE_Select_Reactor as the ACE_Reactor implementation on Windows since it has the same WRITE_MASK semantics as on UNIX platforms.

                                                            • 不同的通知机制。ACE_Select_Reactor的通知机制采用侧边栏 21 （第 93 页）中描述的ACE_Pipe机制实现。相比之下，ACE_WFMO_Reactor的通知机制采用6.2 节中描述的ACE_Message_Queue的同步版本实现。因此，队列可以配置为用户自定义大小，这有助于避免侧边栏 17 （第 78 页）中讨论的死锁问题。ACE_WFMO_Reactor的默认最大队列通知数为 1024。要更改此值：

                                                              • 创建一个新的ACE_WFMO_Reactor_Notify对象，并在其构造函数中指定所需的最大排队通知数。

                                                              • 创建一个新的ACE_WFMO_Reactor对象，并将指向新的ACE_WFMO_Reactor_Notify对象的指针传递给ACE_WFMO_Reactor构造函数。

                                                            • Different notification mechanism. The ACE_Select_Reactor's notification mechanism is implemented using the ACE_Pipe mechanism described in Sidebar 21 (page 93). In contrast, the ACE_WFMO_Reactor's notification mechanism is implemented using a synchronized version of the ACE_Message_Queue described in Section 6.2. As a result, the queue can be configured to have a user-defined size that can help avoid the deadlock problems discussed in Sidebar 17 (page 78). The default maximum number of queued notifications for ACE_WFMO_Reactor is 1,024. To change this value:

                                                              • Create a new ACE_WFMO_Reactor_Notify object, specifying the desired maximum number of queued notifications to its constructor.

                                                              • Create a new ACE_WFMO_Reactor object, passing a pointer to the new ACE_WFMO_Reactor_Notify object to the ACE_WFMO_Reactor constructor.

                                                            并发性考量。ACE_WFMO_Reactor允许多个线程并发调用其handle_events()方法。然而，这种特性使其设计变得复杂，并引入了一些与基于select() 的Reactor 类似的细微行为差异，如下所述：

                                                            Concurrency considerations. The ACE_WFMO_Reactor allows multiple threads to call its handle_events() method concurrently. This capability complicates its design, however, and introduces some subtle behavioral differences from select()-based reactors, as discussed below:

                                                            • 注册变更的协调。 对已注册句柄集的每次更改都会影响执行事件循环的所有线程。如果这些更改未经同步就发生，则会导致各种错误，从事件丢失到分发错误或无效的处理程序。为了在存在多个线程的情况下正确处理注册变更，ACE_WFMO_Reactor维护了三组处理程序信息对象：

                                                            • Coordination of registration changes. Each change to the set of registered handles will affect all threads executing the event loop. Allowing these changes to occur without synchronization would cause errors ranging from missed events to incorrect or invalid handlers being dispatched. To handle registration changes properly in the presence of multiple threads, ACE_WFMO_Reactor maintains three sets of handler information objects:

                                                            1. 当前处理程序，即用于事件检测和解复用的处理程序。

                                                            2. Current handlers, which are the handlers used for event detection and demultiplexing

                                                            3. 等待添加到当前处理程序集中的新处理程序

                                                            4. New handlers, which are awaiting addition to the set of current handlers

                                                            5. 已挂起的处理程序，是指从当前处理程序集中挂起的处理程序。

                                                            6. Suspended handlers, which are handlers suspended from the current handler set

                                                            当请求注册变更（例如注册、移除、暂停或恢复事件处理程序）时，句柄、事件处理程序和事件类型信息会被记住，并且需要更改相关信息。下一个完成 ` handle_events() ` 调用的线程会注意到需要进行更改，获取反应器的锁，并等待所有其他运行`handle_events()`的线程完成。为了确保它们及时完成，等待的线程会发出一个内部事件信号，该事件是分发句柄集的一部分，从而唤醒所有阻塞在`WaitForMultipleObjects()`中的线程。此时，所有事件处理线程都会阻塞，等待变更发生。当原始线程完成必要的信息和句柄更改后，反应器锁会被释放，所有事件处理线程都会使用更新后的句柄集重新开始它们的事件等待、解复用和分发。

                                                            When registration changes are requested (such as registering, removing, suspending, or resuming an event handler), the handle, event handler, and event type information are remembered and the need for changing the associated information is noted. The next thread that completes its pass through handle_events() will notice the need for a change, obtain the reactor's lock, and wait for all other threads running handle_events() to complete. To ensure that they complete in a timely fashion, the waiting thread signals an internal event that's part of the dispatch handle set, causing all threads blocked in WaitForMultipleObjects() to awake. At this point, all event-handling threads will block waiting for changes to occur. When the original thread completes the necessary information and handle changes, the reactor lock is released, and all event-handling threads restart their event waiting, demultiplexing, and dispatching with the updated handle set.

                                                            • 延迟事件处理程序清理。ACE_WFMO_Reactor 的注册变更延迟与基于select() 的Reactor相比，会带来细微的行为差异。当handle_*()方法返回 -1 或对事件处理程序调用ACE_Reactor::remove_handler()时， ACE_WFMO_Reactor会延迟处理程序的移除和回调到处理程序的handle_close()钩子，直到注册变更如上所述发生。因此，应用程序不能在请求ACE_WFMO_Reactor移除事件处理程序后立即删除它，因为 Reactor 稍后对handle_close()方法的调用会通过无效指针进行分发。

                                                              在实践中，可以通过遵循侧边栏 9 （第 51 页）中所述的惯例来掩盖ACE_WFMO_Reactor与基于select()的 Reactor之间的差异，即在事件处理程序的handle_close()钩子方法中执行所有清理工作。这种惯例可以防止事件处理程序对象被过早删除。如果这种惯例不适用（例如，如果事件处理程序是无法延迟销毁的自动对象），则必须将ACE_Event_Handler::DONT_CALL标志传递给ACE_Reactor::remove_handler()，以防止ACE_WFMO_Reactor稍后调用handle_close()钩子方法。因此，建议动态分配事件处理程序，如侧边栏 11（第 55 页）中所述，这样就无需在ACE_Reactor处理程序管理方案之外管理事件处理程序的生命周期。

                                                            • Deferred event handler cleanup. ACE_WFMO_Reactor's registration change delay introduces a subtle behavioral difference compared to select()-based reactors. When a handle_*() method returns -1orACE_Reactor::remove_handler() is called on an event handler, the ACE_WFMO_Reactor defers the handler removal and callback to the handler's handle_close() hook until the registration changes can take place as described above. An application therefore can't delete an event handler immediately after requesting an ACE_WFMO_Reactor to remove it since the reactor's later call to the handle_close() method will dispatch through an invalid pointer.

                                                              The differences between ACE_WFMO_Reactor and the select()-based reactors can be masked in practice by adhering to the idiom of performing all cleanup in an event handler's handle_close() hook method, as described in Sidebar 9 (page 51). This idiom prevents premature deletion of the event handler object. In cases where this idiom doesn't apply (for example if an event handler is an automatic object whose destruction cannot be deferred), the ACE_Event_Handler::DONT_CALL flag must be passed to ACE_Reactor::remove_handler() to prevent ACE_WFMO_Reactor from invoking the handle_close() hook method later. It's therefore advisable to allocate event handlers dynamically, as advocated in Sidebar 11 (page 55), which avoids the need to manage the lifetime of event handlers outside the ACE_Reactor handler management scheme.

                                                            • 多线程分派至同一处理程序。 与使用基于select() 的Reactor 不同，多线程应用程序可以使用ACE_WFMO_Reactor::handle_events()方法并发地解复​​用和分派事件。 [2]因此，在多线程情况下，不同的线程可能会同时将事件分派至同一事件处理程序。例如，当处理程序调度的定时器在 I/O 处理过程中超时时，就会发生这种情况。以下情况也可能发生：

                                                              [2]虽然多个线程可以并发调用 ACE_TP_Reactor::handle_events()，但一次只有一个线程（领导者）实际运行select()。

                                                            • Multithreaded dispatch to same handler. Unlike those using select()-based reactors, multithreaded applications can demultiplex and dispatch events concurrently using the ACE_WFMO_Reactor::handle_events() method. [2] In the multithreaded case it's therefore possible that different threads will dispatch events simultaneously to the same event handler. This can happen, for example, when a handler-scheduled timer expires while I/O is being processed. It can also occur in the following situation:

                                                              [2] Although multiple threads can call ACE_TP_Reactor::handle_events() concurrently, only one thread at a time (the leader) actually runs select().

                                                            1. 线程1将套接字输入事件分发给处理程序。

                                                            2. Thread1 dispatches a socket input event to a handler.

                                                            3. 线程1调用ACE_SOCK_Stream::recv()读取数据。

                                                            4. Thread1 calls ACE_SOCK_Stream::recv() to read data.

                                                            5. 由于步骤 2 中的接收受限或更多数据的到达，套接字上会有更多数据可用。

                                                            6. More data are available on the socket, due to a limited receive in step 2 or the arrival of more data.

                                                            7. 线程2在同一个句柄上分发输入事件，导致线程1和线程2之间出现竞争条件。

                                                            8. Thread2 dispatches the input event on the same handle, resulting in a race condition between thread1 and thread2.

                                                            因此，当多个线程在同一个ACE_WFMO_Reactor对象上执行` handle_events()`事件循环时，事件处理程序必须显式地防止竞态条件。ACE_TP_Reactor 通过实现一个内部协议来避免这些竞态条件，该协议会在分发事件处理程序之前自动挂起句柄。任何随后成为领导者的跟随线程都不会在受影响的句柄上分发事件，直到回调完成且句柄恢复为止。侧边栏 26解释了为什么这种处理程序挂起协议不能与ACE_WFMO_Reactor一起使用。

                                                            Event handlers must therefore explicitly protect against race conditions when the handle_events() event loop is executed by multiple threads on the same ACE_WFMO_Reactor object. The ACE_TP_Reactor avoids these race conditions by implementing an internal protocol that automatically suspends a handle before dispatching its event handler. Any follower thread that subsequently becomes the leader doesn't dispatch events on the affected handle until the callback is complete and the handle is resumed. Sidebar 26 explains why this handler suspension protocol can't be used with the ACE_WFMO_Reactor.

                                                            例子

                                                            Example

                                                            本示例演示了如何将可信号句柄与ACE_WFMO_Reactor结合使用。它还演示了一种在运行ACE_WFMO_Reactor事件循环的线程池中正确串行化 I/O 处理的技术。图 4.7（第 110 页）展示了此服务器的架构。它与图 4.4（第 96 页）中的架构类似，区别在于调用ACE_Reactor::handle_events()的线程池。由于本示例显式指定了ACE_WFMO_Reactor的实例，因此它仅适用于 Windows 系统。

                                                            This example illustrates how to use a signalable handle with the ACE_WFMO_Reactor.It also illustrates one technique for properly serializing I/O handling in a thread pool running the ACE_WFMO_Reactor event loop. Figure 4.7 (page 110) illustrates the architecture of this server. It's similar to the one in Figure 4.4 (page 96), with the difference being the pool of threads that call ACE_Reactor::handle_events(). Since this example explicitly specifies an instance of ACE_WFMO_Reactor, it works only on Windows.

                                                            图 4.7. ACE_WFMO_Reactor日志服务器

                                                            此示例位于WFMO_Reactor_Logging_Server.cpp文件中。我们首先定义一个Quit_Handler类：

                                                            This example is in the WFMO_Reactor_Logging_Server.cpp file. We start by defining a Quit_Handler class:

                                                            class Quit_Handler : public ACE_Event_Handler { 
private: 
  ACE_Manual_Event quit_seen_; // Keep track of when to shutdown. 
public:

                                                            虽然此类继承自ACE_Event_Handler ，但它的用法与第 98 页定义的Quit_Handler截然不同。Quit_Handler构造函数如下所示，说明了其中的一些区别：

                                                            Although this class inherits from ACE_Event_Handler, it's used quite differently from the Quit_Handler defined on page 98. The Quit_Handler constructor illustrates some of the differences below:

                                                             1 Quit_Handler (ACE_Reactor *r): ACE_Event_Handler (r) { 
 2   SetConsoleMode (ACE_STDIN, ENABLE_LINE_INPUT 
 3                              | ENABLE_ECHO_INPUT 
 4                              | ENABLE_PROCESSED_INPUT); 
 5   if (reactor ()->register_handler 
 6       (this, quit_seen_.handle ()) == -1 
 7       || ACE_Event_Handler::register_stdin_handler 
 8           (this, r, ACE_Thread_Manager::instance ()) == -1) 
 9     r->end_reactor_event_loop (); 
10 }

                                                            侧边栏 26：为什么 ACE_WFMO_Reactor 不暂停句柄

                                                            Sidebar 26: Why ACE_WFMO_Reactor Doesn't Suspend Handles

                                                            ACE_WFMO_Reactor内部未实现处理程序挂起协议，以尽量减少对应用程序类施加的策略量。特别是，当处理事件不需要事件间序列化时（例如接收 UDP 数据报时），多线程应用程序可以更高效地处理事件。由于以下操作系统事件解复用机制的功能存在语义差异，ACE_TP_Reactor无法实现这种行为：

                                                            The ACE_WFMO_Reactor doesn't implement a handler suspension protocol internally to minimize the amount of policy imposed on application classes. In particular, multithreaded applications can process events more efficiently when doing so doesn't require interevent serialization, as is the case when receiving UDP datagrams. This behavior isn't possible in the ACE_TP_Reactor because of the semantic differences in the functionality of the following OS event demultiplexing mechanisms:

                                                            • WaitForMultipleObjects()。当对套接字句柄的 I/O 事件进行解复用时，一个ACE_WFMO_Reactor线程会从WSAEnumNetworkEvents()获取 I/O 事件掩码，操作系统会原子地清除该套接字的内部事件掩码。即使多个线程同时对套接字句柄进行解复用，也只有一个线程会获取 I/O 事件掩码并分发处理程序。被分发的处理程序必须执行一些操作来重新启用该句柄的解复用，然后另一个线程才能再次分发它。

                                                            • WaitForMultipleObjects(). When demultiplexing a socket handle's I/O event, one ACE_WFMO_Reactor thread will obtain the I/O event mask from WSAEnumNetworkEvents(), and the OS atomically clears that socket's internal event mask. Even if multiple threads demultiplex the socket handle simultaneously, only one obtains the I/O event mask and will dispatch the handler. The dispatched handler must take some action that reenables demultiplexing for that handle before another thread will dispatch it.

                                                            • select()函数没有自动操作系统序列化功能。如果允许多个线程查看处于就绪状态的套接字句柄，它们都会分发该句柄，从而导致ACE_Event_Handler层出现不可预测的行为，并且由于多个线程都在操作同一个句柄而降低性能。

                                                            • select(). There's no automatic OS serialization for select(). If multiple threads were allowed to see a ready-state socket handle, they would all dispatch it, yielding unpredictable behavior at the ACE_Event_Handler layer and reduced performance due to multiple threads all working on the same handle.

                                                            需要注意的是，当与 ACE_WFMO_Reactor 结合使用时，应用程序事件处理程序类中无法实现处理程序挂起协议。这是因为如第 107 页所述，挂起请求会被排队，不会立即执行。因此，在处理程序被ACE_WFMO_Reactor实际挂起之前，它可能会收到来自多个线程的向上调用。Logging_Event_Handler_WFMO类（第 111 页）演示了如何使用互斥来避免向上调用中的竞争条件。

                                                            It's important to note that the handler suspension protocol can't be implemented in the application event handler class when it's used in conjunction with the ACE_WFMO_Reactor. This is because suspension requests are queued and aren't acted on immediately, as described on page 107. A handler could therefore receive upcalls from multiple threads until the handler was actually suspended by the ACE_WFMO_Reactor. The Logging_Event_Handler_WFMO class (page 111) illustrates how to use mutual exclusion to avoid race conditions in upcalls.

                                                            第 2-4 行简化了输入处理，将控制台设置为一次性读取整行文本（而不是一次读取一小段），不包括控制字符，例如 Ctl-C。

                                                            Lines 2–4 Simplify input handling by setting the console to read a whole line of text (not small pieces at a time) without including control characters, such as Ctl-C.

                                                            第 5-6 行：我们演示如何向反应堆注册事件句柄。当输入退出命令时，我们将发出此事件信号。侧边栏 27 （第 111 页）概述了ACE_Manual_Event类的功能。

                                                            Lines 5–6 We illustrate how to register an event handle with the reactor. We will signal this event when the quit command is entered. Sidebar 27 (page 111) outlines the capabilities of the ACE_Manual_Event class.

                                                            第 7-8 行使用ACE_Event_Handler::register_stdin_handler()建立输入机制，这将导致Quit_Handler::handle_input()钩子方法被反复调用，直到它返回 -1。在 Windows 上，所有这些调用都将从事件循环线程之外的线程发出，这消除了输入处理方法对其处理进行序列化的要求。

                                                            Lines 7–8 Use ACE_Event_Handler::register_stdin_handler() to establish the input mechanism, which causes the Quit_Handler::handle_input() hook method to be called repeatedly until it returns-1. On Windows, all these calls will be made from a thread other than the event loop thread(s), which removes the requirement for the input-handling method to serialize its processing.

                                                            第 9 行如果任一注册失败，我们将立即把反应堆事件循环标记为已结束，这将在主程序启动时强制循环立即结束。

                                                            Line 9 If either registration fails, we immediately mark the reactor event loop as ended, which forces an immediate end to the loop when the main program starts it.

                                                            Quit_Handler ::handle_input()方法如下所示：

                                                            The Quit_Handler::handle_input() method is shown below:

                                                            virtual int handle_input (ACE_HANDLE h) { 
  CHAR user_input[BUFSIZ]; 
  DWORD count; 
  if (!ReadFile (h, user_input, BUFSIZ, &count, 0)) return -1; 
  user_input[count] = '\0'; 
  if (ACE_OS_String::strncmp (user_input, "quit", 4) == 0) 
    return -1; 
  return 0; 
}

                                                            当收到“quit”命令时， handle_input()返回 -1，这将触发ACE_WFMO_Reactor调用Quit_Handler::handle_close()：

                                                            When the "quit" command is seen, handle_input() returns -1, which triggers ACE_WFMO_Reactor to dispatch Quit_Handler::handle_close():

                                                            virtual int handle_close (ACE_HANDLE, ACE_Reactor_Mask) 
{ quit_seen_.signal (); return 0; }

                                                            来自quit_seen_ 的手动事件句柄已在Quit_Handler构造函数中注册到反应器（第 108 页）。当在handle_close()方法中发出事件信号时，ACE_WFMO_Reactor将解复用该事件并调用下面所示的Quit_Handler::handle_signal()方法。

                                                            The manual event handle from quit_seen_ was registered with the reactor in the Quit_Handler constructor (page 108). When the event is signaled in the handle_close() method, the ACE_WFMO_Reactor will then demultiplex the event and call the Quit_Handler::handle_signal() method shown below.

                                                            virtual int handle_signal (int, siginfo_t *, ucontext_t *) 
{ reactor ()->end_reactor_event_loop (); return 0; }

                                                            这个钩子方法会调用反应器的 ` end_reactor_event_loop()`方法，这会导致所有事件处理线程停止。可以直接从`handle_close()`调用`end_reactor_event_loop()`。我们将其调用移至`handle_signal()`，是为了演示如何将可发出信号的句柄与ACE_WFMO_Reactor一起使用。

                                                            This hook method calls the reactor's end_reactor_event_loop() method, which causes all of the event-handling threads to stop. It's possible to call end_reactor_event_loop() directly from handle_close(). We moved the call to handle_signal() to illustrate how to use a signalable handle with ACE_WFMO_Reactor.

                                                            当Quit_Handler对象被销毁时，其析构函数的行为如下：

                                                            When the Quit_Handler object is destroyed, its destructor behaves as follows:

                                                            1 Quit_Handler () { 
2   ACE_Event_Handler::remove_stdin_handler 
3     (reactor (), ACE_Thread_Manager::instance ()); 
4   reactor ()->remove_handler (quit_seen_.handle (), 
5                               ACE_Event_Handler::DONT_CALL); 
6 }

                                                            第 2-3 行取消先前register_stdin_handler()调用的效果。

                                                            Lines 2–3 Cancel the effects of the previous register_stdin_handler() call.

                                                            第 4-5 行：从反应器中注销事件句柄。DONT_CALL标志阻止反应器回调handle_close()，因此清理工作到此完成，我们无需担心后续通过无效对象指针进行的回调。

                                                            Lines 4–5 Unregister the event handle from the reactor. The DONT_CALL flag prevents the reactor from calling back to handle_close(), so the cleanup is complete at this point and we needn't worry about a later callback through an invalid object pointer.

                                                            侧边栏 27：ACE_Manual_Event 和 ACE_Auto_Event 类

                                                            Sidebar 27: The ACE_Manual_Event and ACE_Auto_Event Classes

                                                            ACE 提供了两个同步包装器外观类，Windows 程序员应该比较熟悉：ACE_Manual_Event和ACE_Auto_Event。这些类允许进程中的线程以线程安全的方式等待事件发生，或通知其他线程特定事件的发生。在 Windows 上，这些类是对原生事件对象的包装，而在其他平台上，ACE 则模拟 Windows 事件对象机制。

                                                            ACE provides two synchronization wrapper facade classes that should be familiar to Windows programmers: ACE_Manual_Event and ACE_Auto_Event. These classes allow threads in a process to wait on an event or inform other threads about the occurrence of a specific event in a thread-safe manner. On Windows these classes are wrapper facades around native event objects, whereas on other platforms ACE emulates the Windows event object facility.

                                                            事件与条件变量类似，线程可以使用它们来发出应用程序定义事件发生的信号，或者等待该事件发生。然而，与无状态条件变量不同的是，已发出信号的事件会一直保持设置状态，直到发生特定于类的操作。例如，ACE_Manual_Event会一直保持设置状态，直到被显式重置；ACE_Auto_Event会一直保持设置状态，直到有线程等待它。这两个类允许用户控制由信号操作唤醒的线程数，并且允许事件指示状态转换，即使在发出事件信号时没有线程在等待。

                                                            Events are similar to condition variables in the sense that a thread can use them to either signal the occurrence of an application-defined event or wait for that event to occur. Unlike stateless condition variables, however, a signaled event remains set until a class-specific action occurs. For example, an ACE_Manual_Event remains set until it is explicitly reset and an ACE_Auto_Event remains set until a single thread waits on it. These two classes allow users to control the number of threads awakened by signaling operations, and allows an event to indicate a state transition, even if no threads are waiting at the time the event is signaled.

                                                            事件比互斥锁开销更大，但能更好地控制线程调度。事件提供的同步机制比条件变量更简单。然而，条件变量更适合复杂的同步操作，因为它们允许线程等待任意条件表达式。

                                                            Events are more expensive than mutexes, but provide better control over thread scheduling. Events provide a simpler synchronization mechanism than condition variables. Condition variables are more useful for complex synchronization activities, however, since they enable threads to wait for arbitrary condition expressions.

                                                            由于ACE_WFMO_Reactor与基于select()的反应器（如4.2节和4.3节所示）在并发性方面存在差异，我们还派生了一个新的Logging_Event_Handler_WFMO类，以防止竞态条件。我们只需要重写Logging_Event_Handler_Ex的handle_input()钩子方法（第 68 页），并添加一个互斥锁，以显式地序列化线程池中线程对客户端日志守护进程连接的访问​​，如下所示：

                                                            Due to concurrency differences between ACE_WFMO_Reactor and the select()based reactors (shown in Sections 4.2 and 4.3), we also derive a new Logging_Event_Handler_WFMO class to add protection against race conditions. We need only override the handle_input() hook method of Logging_Event_Handler_Ex (page 68) and add a mutex to explicitly serialize access of threads in the thread pool to a client logging daemon connection, as follows:

                                                            class Logging_Event_Handler_WFMO 
    : public Logging_Event_Handler_Ex { 
public: 
  Logging_Event_Handler_WFMO (ACE_Reactor *r) 
    : Logging_Event_Handler_Ex (r) {} 

protected: 
  int handle_input (ACE_HANDLE h) { 
    ACE_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_SYNCH_MUTEX, monitor, lock_, -1); 
    return logging_handler_.log_record (); 
  } 

  ACE_Thread_Mutex lock_; // Serialize threads in thread pool. 
};

                                                            由于Logging_Acceptor_Ex（第 67 页）会为每个新的客户端连接实例化一个新的Logging_Event_Handler_Ex对象，因此我们使用不同的事件处理程序类也需要一个新的 acceptor 类。以下Logging_Acceptor_Ex的子类会在新的客户端连接到达时实例化正确类型的事件处理程序：

                                                            Since Logging_Acceptor_Ex (page 67) instantiates a new Logging_Event_Handler_Ex object for each new client connection, our use of a different event handler class also mandates a new acceptor class. The following subclass of Logging_Acceptor_Ex instantiates the correct type of event handler when a new client connection arrives:

                                                            class Logging_Acceptor_WFMO : public Logging_Acceptor_Ex { 
public: 
  Logging_Acceptor_WFMO 
    (ACE_Reactor *r = ACE_Reactor::instance ()) 
    : Logging_Acceptor_Ex (r) {} 

protected: 
  virtual int handle_input (ACE_HANDLE) { 
    Logging_Event_Handler_WFMO *peer_handler = 0; 
    ACE_NEW_RETURN (peer_handler, 
                    Logging_Event_Handler_WFMO (reactor ()), -1); 
    if (acceptor_.accept (peer_handler->peer ()) == -1) 
    { delete peer_handler; return -1; } 
    else if (peer_handler->open () == -1) 
    { peer_handler->handle_close (); return -1; } 
    return 0; 
  } 
};

                                                            由于` handle_input()`方法仅操作方法内部的对象，因此无需防止竞态条件。实际上，除了为每个新连接实例化的事件处理程序类型不同之外，`Logging_Acceptor_WFMO`与`Logging_Acceptor_Ex`完全相同（第 67 页）。第 7 章中的 ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架展示了如何将事件处理程序类型提取到可重用的 acceptor 类中。

                                                            The handle_input() method doesn't require protection against race conditions since it only operates on objects local to the method. In fact, except for the type of event handler that's instantiated for each new connection, Logging_Acceptor_WFMO is identical to Logging_Acceptor_Ex (page 67). The ACE Acceptor-Connector framework in Chapter 7 shows how to factor out the event handler type into a reusable acceptor class.

                                                            下面显示的是我们ACE_WFMO_Reactor日志服务器的main()函数：

                                                            Our ACE_WFMO_Reactor logging server's main() function is shown below:

                                                            #include "ace/Reactor.h" 
#include "ace/Synch.h" 
#include "ace/WFMO_Reactor.h" 
#include "ace/Thread_Manager.h" 
#include "Reactor_Logging_Server.h" 

ACE_THR_FUNC_RETURN event_loop (void *); // Forward declaration. 

typedef Reactor_Logging_Server<Logging_Acceptor_WFMO> 
        Server_Logging_Daemon; 

int main (int argc, char *argv[]) { 
  const size_t N_THREADS = 4; 
  ACE_WFMO_Reactor wfmo_reactor; 
  ACE_Reactor reactor (&wfmo_reactor); 

  Server_Logging_Daemon *server = 0; 
  ACE_NEW_RETURN 
    (server, Server_Logging_Daemon (argc, argv, &reactor), 1); 
  Quit_Handler quit_handler (&reactor); 
  ACE_Thread_Manager::instance ()->spawn_n 
    (N_THREADS, event_loop, &reactor); 
  return ACE_Thread_Manager::instance ()->wait (); 
}

                                                            此main()函数与第 101 页所示的 main() 函数的主要区别在于：

                                                            The main differences between this main() and the one shown on page 101 are

                                                            • Reactor_Logging_Server使用Logging_Acceptor_WFMO而不是Logging_Acceptor_Ex进行实例化。

                                                            • Reactor_Logging_Server is instantiated with Logging_Acceptor_WFMO rather than Logging_Acceptor_Ex.

                                                            • 使用ACE_WFMO_Reactor代替ACE_TP_Reactor 。

                                                            • The ACE_WFMO_Reactor is used instead of ACE_TP_Reactor.

                                                            • 专用于关机处理的控制器线程被上面描述的Quit_Handler实例所取代。

                                                            • The controller thread dedicated to shutdown processing is replaced by an instance of Quit_Handler, described above.

                                                            • 对WaitForMultipleObjects()事件解复用器的调用实际上可以在不同的线程中并发运行，而不是像ACE_TP_Reactor那样使用 Leader/Followers 模式对select()调用进行序列化。

                                                            • The calls to the WaitForMultipleObjects() event demultiplexer can actually run concurrently in different threads, rather than having calls to select() be serialized using the Leader/Followers pattern, as is the case with the ACE_TP_Reactor.

                                                            • 该程序只能在 Windows 平台上运行，而不能在所有 ACE 平台上运行。

                                                            • The program will only run on Windows platforms, instead of all ACE platforms.

                                                            • 我们不使用单例 Reactor API，而是再次使用本地 Reactor 实例。

                                                            • We don't use the singleton reactor API, but instead use a local reactor instance again.

                                                              4.5 总结

                                                              4.5 Summary

                                                              本章介绍了最常见的ACE_Reactor实现的设计方式，并阐述了它们不同功能的一些细微差别。除了给出何时使用每种实现的指导原则外，我们的讨论还强调了两点：

                                                              This chapter described how the most common ACE_Reactor implementations are designed and illustrated some subtle nuances of their different capabilities. In addition to giving some guidelines on when to use each, our discussions emphasized two points:

                                                              1. 操作系统事件解复用机制的不同实现方式既可能带来重大挑战，也可能带来重要机遇。

                                                              2. Different implementations of OS event demultiplexing mechanisms can present significant challenges, as well as important opportunities.

                                                              3. 一个设计良好的框架可以扩展以有效地利用操作系统功能，同时将复杂的设计问题隔离在框架中，而不是应用程序代码中。

                                                              4. A well-designed framework can be extended to use OS capabilities effectively while isolating complex design issues in the framework, rather than in application code.

                                                              精心设计的框架能够显著提升应用程序及其自身的可移植性和可扩展性。ACE Reactor 框架的实现便是很好的例子，它展示了如何运用诸如 Wrapper Facade、Facade 和 Bridge 等模式，以及继承和动态绑定等 C++ 特性，来构建一个具备这些难得特性的高质量、高可重用框架。本章介绍的 ACE Reactor 框架实现封装了许多复杂的功能，使网络应用程序开发人员能够专注于应用程序本身的具体问题。

                                                              An intelligently designed framework can significantly improve the portability and extensibility of both applications and the framework itself. The ACE Reactor framework implementations are good examples of how applying patterns, such as Wrapper Facade, Facade, and Bridge, and C++ features, such as inheritance and dynamic binding, can yield a high-quality, highly reusable framework with these elusive qualities. The ACE Reactor framework implementations described in this chapter encapsulate many complex capabilities, allowing networked application developers to focus on application-specific concerns.

                                                              ACE Reactor框架设计最强大的特性之一是它能够在以下几个方面增强可扩展性：

                                                              One of the most powerful properties of the ACE Reactor framework design is its ability to enhance extensibility at the following variation points:

                                                              • 自定义事件处理程序。 通过继承ACE_Event_Handler类或其预定义的 ACE 子类（例如ACE_Service_Object、ACE_Task或ACE_Svc_Handler），并选择性地实现必要的虚方法，可以轻松扩展应用程序功能。例如，第 7 章演示了如何透明地自定义客户端和服务器日志守护程序中的事件处理程序以支持身份验证。

                                                              • Customized event handlers. It's straightforward to extend application functionality by inheriting from the ACE_Event_Handler class or one of its pre-defined ACE subclasses (such as ACE_Service_Object, ACE_Task,orACE_Svc_Handler) and selectively implementing the necessary virtual method(s). For example, Chapter 7 illustrates how event handlers in our client and server logging daemons can be customized transparently to support authentication.

                                                              • 自定义ACE_Reactor实现。修改ACE_Reactor 的底层事件解复用机制非常简单，不会影响现有应用程序代码。例如，将响应式日志服务器从 UNIX 平台移植到 Windows 平台无需对应用程序代码进行任何可见的更改。相比之下，将服务器的 C 实现从select()移植到WaitForMultipleObjects()则既繁琐又容易出错。

                                                              • Customized ACE_Reactor implementations. It's straightforward to modify the underlying event demultiplexing mechanism of an ACE_Reactor without affecting existing application code. For example, porting a reactive logging server from a UNIX platform to a Windows platform requires no visible changes to application code. In contrast, porting a C implementation of the server from select() to WaitForMultipleObjects() is tedious and error-prone.

                                                              过去十年间，ACE 在新环境中的应用催生了对事件驱动型应用支持的新需求。例如，由于新的 GUI 工具包和事件循环的要求，GUI 集成成为一个重要领域。得益于 ACE Reactor 框架的模块化设计，以下新的 Reactor 实现变得更加便捷：

                                                              Over the previous decade, ACE's use in new environments has yielded new requirements for event-driven application support. For example, GUI integration is an important area due to new GUI toolkits and event loop requirements. The following new Reactor implementations were made easier due to the ACE Reactor framework's modular design:

                                                                第五章 ACE 服务配置器框架

                                                                Chapter 5. The ACE Service Configurator Framework

                                                                C章概要​

                                                                CHAPTER SYNOPSIS

                                                                本章介绍 ACE 服务配置器框架的设计和使用，它是组件配置器模式 [ POSA2 ] 的一种实现。该模式通过将服务的行为与服务实现配置到应用程序进程的时间点解耦，从而提高应用程序的可扩展性和灵活性。本章最后阐述了 ACE 服务配置器框架如何帮助我们提升网络日志服务器的可扩展性。

                                                                This chapter describes the design and use of the ACE Service Configurator framework, which is an implementation of the Component Configurator pattern [POSA2]. This pattern helps increase application extensibility and flexibility by decoupling the behavior of services from the point of time when implementations of these services are configured into application processes. The chapter concludes by illustrating how the ACE Service Configurator framework can help to improve the extensibility of our networked logging server.

                                                                  5.1 概述

                                                                  5.1 Overview

                                                                  第 2.2 节描述了开发人员在配置网络应用程序时需要考虑的命名和链接设计维度。一种解决这些设计维度的可扩展策略是应用组件配置器设计模式 [ POSA2 ]。该模式允许应用程序在运行时重新配置其服务，而无需修改、重新编译或重新链接程序本身，也无需关闭并重新启动应用程序。

                                                                  Section 2.2 described the naming and linking design dimensions that developers need to consider when configuring networked applications. An extensible strategy for addressing these design dimensions is to apply the Component Configurator design pattern [POSA2]. This pattern allows an application to reconfigure its services at run time without having to modify, recompile, or relink the program itself, or shut down and restart the application.

                                                                  ACE 服务配置器框架是组件配置器模式的可移植实现，它允许应用程序将服务的配置和实现决策推迟到设计周期的后期——甚至可以推迟到安装时或运行时。ACE 服务配置器框架支持在运行时选择性地激活服务，无论这些服务是否处于待配置状态。

                                                                  The ACE Service Configurator framework is a portable implementation of the Component Configurator pattern that allows applications to defer configuration and implementation decisions about their services until late in the design cycle—as late as installation time or even at run time. The ACE Service Configurator framework supports the ability to activate services selectively at run time regardless of whether they are

                                                                  • 静态服务， 即静态链接到应用程序中的服务

                                                                  • Static services, which are linked statically into an application program

                                                                  • 动态服务， 由一个或多个共享库（DLL）链接而成。

                                                                  • Dynamic services, which are linked from one or more shared libraries (DLLs)

                                                                  每个服务还可以接收argc / argv风格的参数，以便在运行时设置某些信息。由于 ACE 的集成框架设计，使用 ACE 服务配置器框架的服务也可以由 ACE Reactor 框架进行调度。

                                                                  Each service can also be passed argc/argv-style arguments to set certain information at run time. Due to ACE's integrated framework design, services using the ACE Service Configurator framework can also be dispatched by the ACE Reactor framework.

                                                                  本章将探讨以下 ACE 服务配置器框架类：

                                                                  This chapter examines the following ACE Service Configurator framework classes:

                                                                  ACE 级

                                                                  ACE Class

                                                                  描述

                                                                  Description

                                                                  ACE_Service_Object

                                                                  ACE_Service_Object

                                                                  定义了ACE服务配置器框架用于配置和控制服务实现的统一接口。控制操作包括初始化、暂停、恢复和终止服务。

                                                                  Defines a uniform interface that the ACE Service Configurator framework uses to configure and control a service implementation. Control operations include initializing, suspending, resuming, and terminating a service.

                                                                  ACE_服务存储库

                                                                  ACE_Service_Repository

                                                                  这是一个集中式存储库，用于存储所有使用 ACE 服务配置器框架管理的服务。它提供了用于查找、报告和控制应用程序所有已配置服务的方法。

                                                                  A central repository for all services managed using the ACE Service Configurator framework. It provides methods for locating, reporting on, and controlling all of an application's configured services.

                                                                  ACE_Service_Repository_Iterator

                                                                  ACE_Service_Repository_Iterator

                                                                  一种可移植的机制，用于遍历存储库中的所有服务。

                                                                  A portable mechanism for iterating through all the services in a repository.

                                                                  ACE_Service_Config

                                                                  ACE_Service_Config

                                                                  提供一个解释器，用于解析和执行脚本，指定要将哪些服务（重新）配置到应用程序中（例如，通过链接和取消链接 DLL），以及要暂停和恢复哪些服务。

                                                                  Provides an interpreter that parses and executes scripts specifying which services to (re)configure into an application (e.g., by linking and unlinking DLLs) and which services to suspend and resume.

                                                                  ACE 服务配置器框架中各类之间最重要的关系如图 5.1所示。这些类根据组件配置器模式 [ POSA2 ] 扮演以下角色：

                                                                  The most important relationships between the classes in the ACE Service Configurator framework are shown in Figure 5.1. These classes play the following roles in accordance with the Component Configurator pattern [POSA2]:

                                                                  图 5.1. ACE 服务配置器框架类

                                                                  • 配置管理层类 执行与应用程序无关的策略来安装、初始化、控制和关闭服务对象。ACE 服务配置器框架中的配置管理层类包括ACE_Service_Config、ACE_Service_Repository和ACE_Service_Repository_Iterator。

                                                                  • Configuration management layer classes perform application-independent strategies to install, initialize, control, and shut down service objects. The classes in the configuration management layer in the ACE Service Configurator framework include ACE_Service_Config, ACE_Service_Repository, and ACE_Service_Repository_Iterator.

                                                                  • 应用层类 实现具体服务来执行应用程序的处理。在 ACE 服务配置器框架中，应用层类是ACE_Service_Object的子类，而 ACE_Service_Object 又继承自ACE_Event_Handler（第 3 章），从而使服务对象能够动态地链接和取消链接，并参与到 ACE Reactor 框架中。

                                                                  • Application layer classes implement concrete services to perform an application's processing. In the ACE Service Configurator framework, application layer classes are descendants of ACE_Service_Object, which in turn inherits from ACE_Event_Handler (Chapter 3), thereby enabling service objects to be linked and unlinked dynamically, and to participate in the ACE Reactor framework.

                                                                  ACE 服务配置器框架具有以下优势：

                                                                  The ACE Service Configurator framework provides the following benefits:

                                                                  • 灵活性。 该框架允许开发者提供多种服务，以及多种不同的服务实现方式，这些服务可以在运行时进行组装。开发者可以在任何时间点（从应用程序构建到服务实际启动运行）选择在哪些网络节点上执行哪些服务，并且可以随时更改这些选择。开发者还可以根据需要限制选择范围（例如，不提供动态链接服务）。

                                                                  • Flexibility. The framework allows developers to offer multiple services, and a choice of different implementations of services, that can be assembled at run time. The choices concerning which services to execute on which network node(s) can be made (and changed) at any point, ranging from application build time to the actual point when services start running. Developers can also limit choices (e.g., by not offering dynamically linkable services) where desired.

                                                                  • 可配置性。 开发人员可以针对服务的几乎所有方面以及每次部署自定义和配置应用程序数据。服务可以开发为读取传统的配置数据，例如端口号、网络地址和文件系统位置。此外，服务允许将调优和性能决策推迟到获得正确的信息后再进行。例如，根据运行时平台可用的多线程功能和可用 CPU，在单独的线程或单独的进程中运行多个服务可能效率更高或更低。ACE 服务配置器框架允许熟悉站点的管理员配置应用程序，或者他们可以在运行时灵活地选择和调整这些行为，前提是有足够的信息来帮助将客户端需求与可用的系统处理资源相匹配。

                                                                  • Configurability. Developers can customize and configure application data for nearly any aspect of a service and for each deployment. Services can be developed to read traditional configuration data, such as port numbers, network addresses, and file system locations. Moreover, services can allow tuning and performance decisions to be deferred until the right information is available to guide them. For example, depending on the run-time platform's available multithreading facilities and available CPUs, it may be either more or less efficient to run multiple services in separate threads or separate processes. The ACE Service Configurator framework enables applications to be configured by site-knowledgable administrators, or they can select and tune these behaviors flexibly at run time, when there's enough information to help match client demands with available system processing resources.

                                                                  • 可管理性。 所有配置信息都可以存储在名为svc.conf 的配置脚本文件中。框架使用这些脚本来加载和配置服务。应用程序的安装过程可以将设置记录到svc.conf文件中。管理员还可以根据需要编辑和调整这些信息，而无需重新构建应用程序本身。应用程序可以创建自己的配置指令，并将其直接传递给 ACE 服务配置器框架。该框架将应用程序的服务分组到一个管理单元中，并使应用程序能够报告其服务及其状态。

                                                                  • Managability. All configuration information can be stored in a configuration script file, known as svc.conf. The framework uses these scripts to load and configure services. An application's installation procedure can record settings in an svc.conf file. Administrators can also edit and tune this information as needed, without rebuilding the application itself. Applications can form their own configuration directives and pass them directly to the ACE Service Configurator framework. The framework groups an application's services into one administrative unit and enables an application to report on its services and their states.

                                                                  • 一致性。 该框架为服务的初始化、暂停、恢复和终止设定了统一的接口。这种统一性为框架用户提供了一致性，并允许将服务视为可灵活组合以形成完整应用程序的构建模块。

                                                                  • Consistency. The framework imposes a uniform interface for initializing, suspending, resuming, and terminating a service. This uniformity provides consistency to framework users and allows services to be treated as building blocks that can be assembled flexibly to form complete applications.

                                                                  • 可维护性。 该框架将服务实现与网络应用程序的配置解耦，使得服务实现能够随时间演进，而无需考虑它们被包含在哪些网络应用程序中。每个服务都可以独立开发和测试，从而简化后续的服务组合并提高重用性。

                                                                  • Maintainability. The framework's decoupling of service implementation from configuration into networked applications allows service implementations to evolve over time, independently of which networked applications they're included in. Each service can be developed and tested independently, which simplifies subsequent service composition and increases reuse.

                                                                  • 增强的动态性和控制力。 该框架支持动态重新配置服务，无需修改、重新编译或静态重新链接现有代码。每个服务都可以在不影响其他服务或停止并重启服务器进程的情况下进行重新配置。这些重新配置功能对于高可用性应用至关重要，例如执行在线交易处理或电信呼叫处理的关键任务系统。

                                                                  • Enhanced dynamism and control. The framework enables a service to be reconfigured dynamically without modifying, recompiling, or statically relinking existing code. Each service can also be reconfigured without affecting other services or stopping and restarting the server process itself. These reconfiguration capabilities are often required for high-availability applications, such as mission-critical systems that perform online transaction processing or telecom call processing.

                                                                  本章剩余部分将阐述 ACE 服务配置器框架中每个类的功能及其背后的原因。我们还将展示如何使用该框架来增强网络日志服务器的可扩展性。如果您不熟悉 POSA2 中的组件配置器模式，我们建议您在深入研究本章的详细示例之前先阅读相关资料。

                                                                  The remainder of this chapter motivates and describes the capabilities of each class in the ACE Service Configurator framework. We also illustrate how this framework can be used to enhance the extensibility of our networked logging server. If you aren't familiar with the Component Configurator pattern from POSA2 we recommend that you read about it first before delving into the detailed examples in this chapter.

                                                                    5.2 ACE_Service_Object 类

                                                                    5.2 The ACE_Service_Object Class

                                                                    动机

                                                                    Motivation

                                                                    服务配置和生命周期管理涉及以下几个方面，我们上面已经简要提及：

                                                                    Service configuration and life cycle management involves the following aspects that we've alluded to briefly above:

                                                                    • 初始化。 服务必须进行初始化，这可能涉及创建一个或多个对象或调用工厂方法。此时会将配置参数传递给服务。

                                                                    • Initialization. A service must be initialized, which may involve creating one or more objects or invoking a factory method. Configuration parameters are passed to the service at this time.

                                                                    • 执行控制。 某些应用程序需要具备暂停和恢复服务的能力。因此，要提供这种能力，就需要一种机制，使管理应用程序能够找到所需的服务，然后联系这些服务以请求或强制执行暂停/恢复操作。

                                                                    • Execution control. Certain applications require the ability to suspend and resume services. Offering this capability therefore requires a mechanism by which a management application can locate the desired services and then contact the services to request or force the suspend/resume operation.

                                                                    • 报告。 关键任务服务通常需要能够以统一的方式响应有关其状态和可用性的信息请求。

                                                                    • Reporting. Mission-critical services often require the ability to respond to requests for information concerning their status and availability in a uniform way.

                                                                    • 终止。 有序的关闭流程对于确保服务资源得到正确释放、所有必要的状态信息得到更新以及服务关闭顺序正确至关重要，以避免不当的服务交互。

                                                                    • Termination. Orderly shutdown processes are required to ensure that a service's resources are released properly, any necessary status information is updated, and that service shutdown is ordered properly to avoid improper service interactions.

                                                                    以临时方式设计和实现这些功能通常会产生紧密耦合的数据结构和类，这难以在未来的项目中进行演进和重用。

                                                                    Designing and implementing these capabilities in an ad hoc manner often produces tightly coupled data structures and classes, which are hard to evolve and reuse in future projects.

                                                                    此外，如果多个项目或开发组进行类似的努力，服务配置的主要优势将会丧失，因为多个设计在服务或管理层面上互操作的可能性极低。

                                                                    Moreover, if multiple projects or development groups undertake similar efforts, the primary benefits of service configuration will be lost because it's highly unlikely that multiple designs will interoperate at either the service or management level.

                                                                    由于服务配置和管理在很大程度上与应用程序无关，因此它们非常适合集成到框架中。在所有联网服务中强制执行统一的接口，可以更轻松地对其进行一致的配置和管理。反过来，这种一致性通过缓解创建可重用管理配置工具时固有的关键挑战，简化了应用程序的开发和部署。为了在 ACE 服务配置器框架和应用程序定义的服务之间提供统一的接口，每个服务都必须是名为ACE_Service_Object的公共基类的子类。

                                                                    Since service configuration and management are largely application-independent they are good candidates to incorporate into a framework. Enforcing a uniform interface across all networked services makes it easier to configure and manage them consistently. In turn, this consistency simplifies application development and deployment by mitigating key challenges inherent in creating reusable administrative configuration tools. To provide a uniform interface between the ACE Service Configurator framework and the application-defined services, each service must be a descendant of a common base class called ACE_Service_Object.

                                                                    等级能力

                                                                    Class Capabilities

                                                                    ACE_Service_Object提供了一个统一的接口，允许 ACE 服务配置器框架配置和管理服务实现。此类提供以下功能：

                                                                    ACE_Service_Object provides a uniform interface that allows service implementations to be configured and managed by the ACE Service Configurator framework. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                    • 它提供了初始化服务（例如，分配其资源）和关闭服务（例如，清理其资源）的钩子方法。

                                                                    • It provides hook methods that initialize a service (e.g., allocating its resources) and shut a service down (e.g., cleaning up its resources).

                                                                    • 它提供钩子方法来暂时暂停服务执行，以及恢复已暂停服务的执行。

                                                                    • It provides hook methods to suspend service execution temporarily and to resume execution of a suspended service.

                                                                    • 它提供了一个钩子方法，用于报告关键服务信息，例如其用途、当前状态以及监听客户端连接的端口号。

                                                                    • It provides a hook method that reports key service information, such as its purpose, current status, and the port number where it listens for client connections.

                                                                    这些方法通常是在 ACE 服务配置器框架解释第 141 页所述的配置指令时作为回调调用的。

                                                                    These methods are generally invoked as callbacks from the ACE Service Configurator framework when it interprets the configuration directives described on page 141.

                                                                    ACE_Service_Object的接口如图 5.2 （第 120 页）所示。通过继承ACE_Event_Handler和ACE_Shared_Object，ACE_Service_Object的子类可以由 ACE Reactor 框架进行调度，并分别可以动态地与 DLL 链接和取消链接。ACE_Service_Object 的关键配置相关钩子方法概述如下表所示：

                                                                    The interface for ACE_Service_Object is shown in Figure 5.2 (page 120). By inheriting from ACE_Event_Handler and ACE_Shared_Object, subclasses of ACE_Service_Object can be dispatched by the ACE Reactor framework and can be linked and unlinked from a DLL dynamically, respectively. The key configuration-related hook methods of ACE_Service_Object are outlined in the following table:

                                                                    图 5.2. ACE_Service_Object类

                                                                    方法

                                                                    Method

                                                                    描述

                                                                    Description

                                                                    初始化()

                                                                    init()

                                                                    框架使用此方法来指示服务初始化自身。“ argc / argv ”风格的参数可以传递给init()来控制服务初始化。

                                                                    Used by the framework to instruct a service to initialize itself. "argc/argv"-style arguments can be passed to init() to control service initialization.

                                                                    最终()

                                                                    fini()

                                                                    框架使用此方法指示服务自行关闭。此方法通常执行终止操作，释放服务的资源，例如内存、同步锁或 I/O 句柄。

                                                                    Used by the framework to instruct a service to shut itself down. This method typically performs termination operations that release a service's resources, such as memory, synchronization locks, or I/O handles.

                                                                    暂停（）

                                                                    suspend()

                                                                    恢复（）

                                                                    resume()

                                                                    信息（）

                                                                    用于查询服务自身的特定信息，例如服务名称、用途和网络地址。客户端可以查询服务器以检索这些信息，并使用这些信息来联系服务器上运行的特定服务。

                                                                    Used to query a service for certain information about itself, such as its name, purpose, and network address. Clients can query a server to retrieve this information and use it to contact a particular service running in a server.

                                                                    这些钩子方法共同在 ACE 服务配置器框架和它管理的应用程序定义的服务之间建立了一个统一的接口。

                                                                    These hook methods collectively impose a uniform interface between the ACE Service Configurator framework and the application-defined services that it manages.

                                                                    继承自ACE_Service_Object的应用程序服务可以选择性地重写其钩子方法，ACE 服务配置器框架会在特定事件发生时适当地调用这些钩子方法。例如，当服务配置器框架执行激活服务的指令时（动态指令和静态指令都会激活服务，如第 141 页所示），将调用服务对象的init()钩子方法。如果初始化成功， init()钩子方法必须返回 0；如果初始化失败，则返回 -1。只有当init()成功时，当 ACE 服务配置器框架执行服务的移除指令或关闭所有服务时，才会调用服务对象上相应的fini()方法。

                                                                    Application services that inherit from ACE_Service_Object can selectively override its hook methods, which are called back at the appropriate time by the ACE Service Configurator framework in response to specific events. For example, a service object's init() hook method is called when the Service Configurator framework executes a directive to activate the service (both the dynamic and static directives activate a service, as shown on page 141). The init() hook method must return 0 if initialization succeeds and -1 if it fails. If (and only if) init() succeeds, the corresponding fini() method will be called on the service object when the ACE Service Configurator framework executes the remove directive for the service, or shuts down all services.

                                                                    服务配置器是我们研究过的第一个与管理员或应用程序进行大量交互的 ACE 框架。这些交互引入了使用本地字符集的需求。图 5.2显示了ACE_TCHAR类型，它有助于 ACE 以可移植的方式处理非 ASCII 字符集。ACE 处理宽字符和 Unicode 字符的功能在侧边栏 28中进行了描述。本书的其余部分将使用此功能来处理字符串。

                                                                    The Service Configurator is the first ACE framework we've studied that has extensive interaction with administrators or applications. These interactions introduce the need to operate with local character sets. Figure 5.2 shows the ACE_TCHAR type, which helps ACE deal with non-ASCII character sets portably. ACE's facilities for handling wide-character and Unicode characters are described in Sidebar 28. We'll use this facility to handle character strings in the remainder of this book.

                                                                    Example
