                                                                        下面我们将描述每个指令中标记的语法和语义。

                                                                        We describe the syntax and semantics for the tokens in each of these directives below.

                                                                        • 动态链接并初始化服务： dynamic svc-name svc-type DLL-name:factory_func() [ "argc/argv 选项" ]

                                                                          动态指令指示 ACE 服务配置器框架动态链接并初始化服务对象。`svc -name`是分配给服务的名称。`svc -type`指定服务的类型，可以是 ` Service_Object*`、` Module*`或`Stream* ` 。`DLL -name`是包含 ` factory_func()`符号的动态链接库的名称。此符号是外部 C函数的入口点， ACE_Service_Config解释器调用该函数来创建服务实例。如果`svc-type`为`Service_Object*` ，则`factory_func()`必须返回指向派生自`ACE_Service_Object`的对象的指针。`factory_func () ` 符号应以一个前导下划线字符开头，因为链接器会将该字符添加到外部可见的符号中。

                                                                          DLL 名称可以是完整路径名，也可以是不带后缀的文件名。如果是完整路径名，则使用侧边栏 33中描述的ACE_DLL::open()方法将指定文件动态链接到应用程序进程中。如果是文件名，则ACE_DLL::open()使用ACE::ldfind() （同样在侧边栏 33中描述）来定位 DLL，并通过ACE_DLL::open()将其动态链接到进程的地址空间中。由于 ACE 封装了这些平台细节，因此动态指令可以在不同操作系统之间移植使用。

                                                                          argc /argv 选项是一个可选参数列表，可通过其init()钩子方法提供给服务对象以进行初始化。ACE 服务配置器框架使用侧边栏 35 （第 148 页）中描述的ACE_ARGV类将字符串拆分为参数，并替换字符串中包含的环境变量的值。

                                                                        • Dynamically link and initialize a service: dynamic svc-name svc-type DLL-name:factory_func() [ "argc/argv options"]

                                                                          The dynamic directive instructs the ACE Service Configurator framework to dynamically link and initialize a service object. The svc-name is the name assigned to the service. The svc-type designates the type of the service, which can be a Service_Object *, Module *, or Stream *. DLL-name is the name of the dynamic link library that contains the factory_func() symbol. This symbol is the entry point for an extern "C" function that the ACE_Service_Config interpreter invokes to create an instance of a service. If the svc-type is Service_Object * then factory_func() must return a pointer to an object derived from ACE_Service_Object. The factory_func() symbol should have a leading underscore character since linkers add that character to externally visible symbols.

                                                                          DLL-name can be either a full pathname or a filename without a suffix. If it's a full pathname, the ACE_DLL::open() method described in Sidebar 33 is used to dynamically link the designated file into the application process. If it's a filename, however, ACE_DLL::open() uses ACE::ldfind() (also described in Sidebar 33) to locate the DLL and dynamically link it into the address space of the process via ACE_DLL::open(). The dynamic directive can be used portably across operating systems since ACE encapsulates these platform details.

                                                                          The argc/argv options are an optional list of parameters that can be supplied to initialize a service object via its init() hook method. The ACE Service Configurator framework uses the ACE_ARGV class described in Sidebar 35 (page 148) to separate the string into arguments and substitute the values of environment variables that are included in the string.

                                                                        • 初始化静态链接服务： static svc-name [ "argc/argv 选项" ]

                                                                          尽管ACE_Service_Config通常用于动态配置服务，但它也可以通过static指令静态配置服务。svc -name和可选的argc/argv 选项与动态指令中的相同。然而，语法更简洁，因为服务对象必须已经静态链接到可执行程序映像中。因此，无需查找和链接 DLL，也无需调用工厂函数来创建服务对象。静态配置牺牲了灵活性，换取了更高的安全性，这对于某些必须仅包含受信任的、静态链接服务的服务器类型非常有用。回顾侧边栏 31（第 132 页），静态服务加载默认处于禁用状态。因此，必须显式启用静态服务加载才能使用它们，否则static指令将不起作用。

                                                                        • Initialize a statically linked service: static svc-name ["argc/argv options"]

                                                                          Although ACE_Service_Config is commonly used to configure services dynamically, it can also be used to configure services statically via the static directive. The svc-name and optional argc/argv options are the same as those in the dynamic directive. The syntax is simpler, however, since the service object must already be linked into the executable program image statically. Thus, there's no need to either locate and link a DLL or call a factory function to create a service object. Static configuration trades flexibility for increased security, which may be useful for certain types of servers that must contain only trusted, statically linked services. Recall from Sidebar 31 (page 132) that static service loading is disabled by default. Static service loading must therefore be enabled explicitly to use them, or else the static directive will have no effect.

                                                                        • 侧边栏 33：ACE_DLL 类

                                                                          显式链接和取消链接 DLL 的应用程序可能会遇到以下问题：

                                                                          -一种非统一的编程接口，其可移植性甚至比 C++NPv1 第 3 章中描述的 Socket API 还要差。



                                                                          -由于原生操作系统 DLL API 返回弱类型句柄，而这些句柄会被传递给 DLL 函数（例如用于查找符号和取消链接 DLL 的函数），因此不安全的类型容易导致错误和误用。



                                                                          -可能存在资源泄漏风险，因为有可能忘记释放 DLL 句柄。



                                                                          为了解决这些问题，ACE 定义了ACE_DLL包装器外观类来封装显式链接/取消链接功能。该类消除了应用程序使用容易出错的弱类型句柄的需要，并确保其析构函数能够正确释放资源。此外，它还使用ACE::ldfind()方法通过以下算法查找 DLL：

                                                                          • DLL 文件名扩展——ACE ::ldfind()通过添加适当的前缀和后缀来确定 DLL 的名称。例如，对于 Solaris 系统，它会添加lib前缀和.so后缀；对于 Windows 系统，它会添加.dll后缀。

                                                                          • DLL 搜索路径— ACE::ldfind()还会使用平台的 DLL 搜索路径环境变量来搜索指定的 DLL。例如，在许多 UNIX 系统上，它使用LD_LIBRARY_PATH来搜索 DLL ，而在 Windows 系统上，它使用PATH来搜索 DLL 。

                                                                          ACE_DLL类中的关键方法如下表所示。

                                                                          打开并动态链接指定的 DLL 文件

                                                                          象征（）

                                                                        • Sidebar 33: The ACE_DLL Class

                                                                          Applications that link and unlink DLLs explicitly can encounter the following problems:

                                                                          - A nonuniform programming interface that's even less portable than the Socket API described in Chapter 3 of C++NPv1



                                                                          - Unsafe types that invite errors and misuse because the native OS DLL APIs return weakly typed handles that are passed to DLL functions, such as those used to locate symbols and unlink the DLL



                                                                          - Potential resource leaks, since it's possible to forget to release DLL handles



                                                                          To address these problems, ACE defines the ACE_DLL wrapper facade class to encapsulate explicit linking/unlinking functionality. This class eliminates the need for applications to use error-prone, weakly typed handles and also ensures that resources are released properly by its destructor. In addition, it uses the ACE::ldfind() method to locate DLLs via the following algorithms:

                                                                          • DLL filename expansion— ACE::ldfind() determines the name of the DLL by adding the appropriate prefix and suffix. For example, it adds the lib prefix and .so suffix for Solaris and the .dll suffix for Windows.

                                                                          • DLL search path— ACE::ldfind() will also search for the designated DLL using the platform's DLL search path environment variable. For example, it searches for DLLs using LD_LIBRARY_PATH on many UNIX systems and PATH on Windows.

                                                                          The key methods in the ACE_DLL class are outlined in the following table.

                                                                          ACE Class

                                                                          Description

                                                                          ACE_DLL() open()

                                                                          Opens and dynamically links a designated DLL

                                                                          ACE_DLL() close()

                                                                          Closes and optionally unlinks the DLL

                                                                          symbol()

                                                                          Returns a pointer to a function or object in the DLL

                                                                          error()

                                                                          Returns a string explaining which failure occurred

                                                                          The interface of ACE_DLL is shown in the figure below. 

                                                                                             ACE_DLL
- handle_ : ACE_SHLIB_HANDLE 
+ open (name : const ACE_TCHAR *, 
        mode : int = ACE_DEFAULT_SHLIB_MODE, 
        close_on_destruct : int = 1) : int 
+ close () : int 
+ symbol (name : const ACE_TCHAR *) : void * 
+ error (void) : ACE_TCHAR *

                                                                        • 彻底移除服务： remove svc-name

                                                                          remove指令会使ACE_Service_Config解释器向ACE_Service_Repository查询指定的服务。如果找到该服务，解释器会调用其fini ()钩子方法，该方法会在服务关闭时执行清理资源所需的操作。如果服务对象关联了服务销毁函数指针，则会调用该指针来销毁服务对象本身（ACE_FACTORY_DEFINE宏会自动定义此函数）。最后，如果该服务是从 DLL 动态链接的，则会通过ACE_DLL::close()方法将其取消链接。由于一个 DLL 在一个进程中可能被多次链接，ACE_DLL::close()确保 DLL 仅在不再使用时才被取消链接。

                                                                        • Remove a service completely: remove svc-name

                                                                          The remove directive causes the ACE_Service_Config interpreter to query the ACE_Service_Repository for the named service. If this service is located, the interpreter invokes its fini() hook method, which performs the activities needed to clean up resources when the service shuts down. If a service destruction function pointer is associated with the service object, it's called to destroy the service object itself (the ACE_FACTORY_DEFINE macro defines this function automatically). Finally, if the service was linked dynamically from a DLL, it's unlinked via the ACE_DLL::close() method. Since a DLL can be linked multiple times in a process, ACE_DLL::close() ensures that the DLL is only unlinked when it's no longer in use.

                                                                        • 暂停服务而不将其移除： suspend svc-name

                                                                          suspend指令会使ACE_Service_Config解释器向ACE_Service_Repository查询指定的svc-name服务。如果找到该服务，则会调用其suspend()钩子方法。服务可以重写此方法以实现暂停其处理所需的相应操作。

                                                                        • Suspend a service without removing it: suspend svc-name

                                                                          The suspend directive causes the ACE_Service_Config interpreter to query the ACE_Service_Repository for the designated svc-name service. If this service is located, its suspend() hook method is invoked. A service can override this method to implement the appropriate actions needed to suspend its processing.

                                                                        • 恢复之前暂停的服务： 恢复 服务名称

                                                                          resume指令会使ACE_Service_Config解释器向ACE_Service_Repository查询指定的svc-name服务。如果找到该服务，则会调用其resume()钩子方法。服务可以重写此方法以实现恢复其处理所需的相应操作，这些操作通常会逆转suspend()方法的效果。

                                                                        • Resume a previously suspended service: resume svc-name

                                                                          The resume directive causes the ACE_Service_Config interpreter to query the ACE_Service_Repository for the designated svc-name service. If this service is located, its resume() hook method is invoked. A service can override this method to implement the appropriate actions needed to resume its processing, which typically reverse the effects of the suspend() method.

                                                                        • 初始化一个按层级关系排列的模块有序列表： stream svc-name '{' module-list '}'

                                                                          stream指令使ACE_Service_Config解释器初始化一个按层级排列的有序模块列表。每个模块包含一对相互连接的服务，这些服务通过传递 ACE_Message_Block 对象进行通信。stream指令的实现使用了第 9 章中描述的 ACE Streams 框架。

                                                                        • Initialize an ordered list of hierarchically related modules: stream svc-name '{' module-list '}'

                                                                          The stream directive causes the ACE_Service_Config interpreter to initialize an ordered list of hierarchically related modules. Each module consists of a pair of services that are interconnected and communicate by passing ACE_Message_Block objects. The implementation of the stream directive uses the ACE Streams framework described in Chapter 9.

                                                                        图 5.7显示了ACE_Service_Config解析的svc.conf文件的完整Backus/Naur 格式(BNF) 语法。侧边栏 34（第 146 页）描述了如何使用可选的 XML 语法指定svc.conf文件。

                                                                        The complete Backus/Naur Format (BNF) syntax for svc.conf files parsed by the ACE_Service_Config is shown in Figure 5.7. Sidebar 34 (page 146) describes how to specify svc.conf files using the optional XML syntax.

<svc-conf-entries> ::= <svc-conf-entries> <svc-conf-entry> | NULL 
<svc-conf-entry>   ::= <dynamic> | <static> | <suspend> | 
                        <resume> | <remove> | <stream> 
<dynamic> ::= dynamic <svc-location> <parameters-opt> 
<static> ::= static <svc-name> <parameters-opt> 
<suspend> ::= suspend <svc-name> 
<resume> ::= resume <svc-name> 
<remove> ::= remove <svc-name> 
<stream> ::= stream <streamdef> '{' <module-list> '}' 
<streamdef> ::= <svc-name> | dynamic | static 
<module-list> ::= <module-list> <module> | NULL 
<module> ::= <dynamic> | <static> | <suspend> | 
             <resume> | <remove> 
<svc-location> ::= <svc-name> <svc-type> <svc-factory> <status> 
<svc-type> ::= Service_Object '*' | Module '*' | Stream '*' | NULL 
<svc-factory> ::= PATHNAME ':' FUNCTION '(' ')' 
<svc-name> ::= STRING 
<status> ::= active | inactive | NULL 
<parameters-opt> ::= '"' STRING '"' | NULL

                                                                        ` reconfigure()`方法可用于强制ACE_Service_Config解释器重新处理服务配置文件。如果您的应用程序监视服务配置文件的更改，则此功能非常有用。检测到更改后，可以使用 ` reconfigure()`方法进行处理。由于 Windows 上没有像 UNIX 那样向进程发送信号（例如SIGHUP）的等效方法，因此建议使用此方法在 Windows 上进行运行时更改。

                                                                        The reconfigure() method can be used to force the ACE_Service_Config interpreter to reprocess the service configuration files. This capability is useful if your application monitors the service configuration files for changes. When changes are noticed, they can be processed using the reconfigure() method. This method is the recommended way to make run-time changes on Windows since there's no equivalent to the common UNIX practice of sending a signal, such as SIGHUP, to a process.

                                                                        如果知道服务名称， suspend ()和resume()方法可以暂停和恢复服务。这是对ACE_Service_Repository单例中定义的方法的快捷方式。

                                                                        The suspend() and resume() methods enable the suspension and resumption of a service if its name is known. It's a shortcut to the methods defined in the ACE_Service_Repository singleton.

                                                                        侧边栏 34：使用 XML 配置服务

                                                                        Sidebar 34: Using XML to Configure Services

                                                                        ACE_Service_Config类可以配置为解释基于 XML 的脚本语言。该语言的文档类型定义 (DTD) 如下所示：

                                                                        The ACE_Service_Config class can be configured to interpret an XML-based scripting language. The Document Type Definition (DTD) for this language is shown below: 

                                                                        <!ELEMENT ACE_Svc_Conf (dynamic|static|suspend|resume 
                        |remove|stream|streamdef)*> 
<!ELEMENT streamdef ((dynamic|static),module)> 
<!ATTLIST streamdef id IDREF #REQUIRED> 
<!ELEMENT module (dynamic|static|suspend|resume|remove)+> 
<!ELEMENT stream (module)> 
<!ATTLIST stream id IDREF #REQUIRED> 
<!ELEMENT dynamic (initializer)> 
<!ATTLIST dynamic id ID #REQUIRED 
                  status (active|inactive) "active" 
                  type (module|service_object|stream) 
                  #REQUIRED> 
<!ELEMENT initializer EMPTY> 
<!ATTLIST initializer init CDATA #REQUIRED 
                      path CDATA #IMPLIED 
                      params CDATA #IMPLIED> 
<!ELEMENT static EMPTY> 
<!ATTLIST static id ID #REQUIRED 
                 params CDATA #IMPLIED> 
<!ELEMENT suspend EMPTY> 
<!ATTLIST suspend id IDREF #REQUIRED> 
<!ELEMENT resume EMPTY> 
<!ATTLIST resume id IDREF #REQUIRED> 
<!ELEMENT remove EMPTY> 
<!ATTLIST remove id IDREF #REQUIRED>

                                                                        这种基于 XML 的配置语言的语法与图 5.5中的语法不同，但语义相同。虽然编写起来更繁琐，但 ACE 基于 XML 的配置文件格式更加灵活。例如，用户可以插入自定义的 XML 事件处理程序来扩展 ACE 服务配置器框架的行为，而无需修改底层 ACE 实现。

                                                                        The syntax of this XML-based configuration language is different from the one in Figure 5.5, but its semantics are the same. Although it's more verbose to compose, the ACE XML-based configuration file format is more flexible. For example, users can plug in customized XML event handlers to extend the behavior of the ACE Service Configurator framework without modifying the underlying ACE implementation.

                                                                        XML 配置文件格式相对较新（在 ACE 5.3 中引入），因此目前 ACE 服务配置器框架尚未将其设为默认格式。用户可以通过启用 ACE_HAS_XML_SVC_CONF 宏来编译 ACE，从而选择基于 XML 的服务配置器。ACE提供了一个名为svcconf-convert.pl的Perl脚本，用于将原始格式的文件转换为新的 XML 格式。该脚本位于$ ACE_ROOT /bin/目录下。

                                                                        The XML configuration file format is relatively new (it was introduced in ACE 5.3). It's therefore not yet the default used by the ACE Service Configurator framework. Users can choose the XML-based Service Configurator by compiling ACE with the ACE_HAS_XML_SVC_CONF macro enabled. ACE provides the svcconf-convert.pl perl script to translate original format files into the new XML format. The script is located in the $ACE_ROOT/bin/ directory.

                                                                        初始服务器配置。首先，我们在Configurable_Logging_Server.cpp中 编写以下通用main()程序。该程序将Service_Reporter和Reactor_Logging_Server_Adapter服务配置到应用程序进程中，然后运行 ​​Reactor 的事件循环。

                                                                        Initial server configuration. We start by writing the following generic main() program in Configurable_Logging_Server.cpp. This program configures the Service_Reporter and Reactor_Logging_Server_Adapter services into an application process and then runs the reactor's event loop.

                                                                         1 #include "ace/OS.h" 
 2 #include "ace/Service_Config.h" 
 3 #include "ace/Reactor.h" 
 4 
 5 int ACE_TMAIN (int argc, ACE_TCHAR *argv[]) { 
 6   ACE_STATIC_SVC_REGISTER (Reporter); 
 7 
 8   ACE_Service_Config::open 
 9     (argc, argv, ACE_DEFAULT_LOGGER_KEY, 0); 
10 
11   ACE_Reactor::instance ()->run_reactor_event_loop (); 
12   return 0; 
13 }

                                                                        第 1-3 行：main()程序中没有特定于服务的头文件（或代码）。因此，它是完全通用的，可以被许多使用 ACE 服务配置器和 Reactor 框架配置的程序重复使用。

                                                                        Lines 1–3 There are no service-specific header files (or code) in the main() program. It's therefore completely generic, and can be reused for many programs that are configured using the ACE Service Configurator and Reactor frameworks.

                                                                        第 5 行：将main()入口点名称替换为ACE_TMAIN宏。此宏在 Windows 系统启用 Unicode 时使用备用入口点wmain() ，在所有其他情况下使用常规的main()入口点。

                                                                        Line 5 Replace the main() entry point name with the ACE_TMAIN macro. This macro uses the alternate wmain() entry point on Windows when Unicode is enabled, and the usual main() in all other situations.

                                                                        第 6 行：向 ACE 服务配置器框架注册静态 Reporter 服务。虽然框架现在知道该服务，但除非服务配置指令激活它，否则它不会被激活。

                                                                        Line 6 Register the static Reporter service with the ACE Service Configurator framework. Although the framework now knows of the service, it is not activated unless a service configuration directive causes it to be.

                                                                        第 8-9行调用ACE_Service_Config::open()来配置应用程序。所有关于要加载哪些服务以及所有服务参数的决策都位于服务配置文件中，该文件位于二进制应用程序外部。然后，我们运行反应器的事件循环来处理来自客户端的 I/O 事件。

                                                                        Lines 8–9 Call ACE_Service_Config::open() to configure the application. All decisions about which service(s) to load, and all of the service parameters, are located in the service configuration file, which is external to the binary application program. We then run the reactor's event loop to handle I/O events from clients.

                                                                        由于我们知道程序会激活静态的Service_Reporter服务，因此我们在ACE_Service_Config::open() 函数中添加了第四个参数（以及必要的第三个参数），以显式启用静态服务加载。如果我们决定将此决定权留给用户或管理员，则不会提供该参数，用户可以通过在命令行中使用-y选项来启用或禁用静态服务。

                                                                        Since we know that our program will activate the static Service_Reporter service, we added the fourth argument (and by necessity, the third) to ACE_Service_Config::open() to explicitly enable static service loading. If we instead decided to leave this decision to the user or administrator, that argument would not be supplied, and the user would choose to enable or disable static services by supplying the -y option on the command line.

                                                                        当调用ACE_Service_Config::open()时，它会使用ACE_Service_Config::process_directives()方法来解释下面的svc.conf文件：

                                                                        When ACE_Service_Config::open() is called, it uses the ACE_Service_Config::process_directives() method to interpret the svc.conf file below:

                                                                        1 static Service_Reporter "-p $SERVICE_REPORTER_PORT" 
2 
3 dynamic Server_Logging_Daemon Service_Object * 
4 SLD:_make_Server_Logging_Daemon() 
5   "$SERVER_LOGGING_DAEMON_PORT"

                                                                        第 1 行：Service_Reporter代码、注册信息和工厂函数都静态链接到可执行程序中。因此，此指令仅使 Service Configurator 框架通过调用Service_Reporter::init()（第 132 页）来激活服务。传递给init() 的argc / argv参数是字符串“-p”和SERVICE_REPORTER_PORT环境变量的展开式。Service Configurator 框架使用侧边栏 35中描述的 ACE_ARGV 类自动展开此环境变量。ACE_ARGV通过前导$字符识别SERVICE_REPORTER_PORT为环境变量，并替换其关联的值。Service_Reporter.cpp （第135 页）中使用的 ACE_STATIC_SVC_REQUIRE 宏确保在调用ACE_Service_Config ::open()方法之前，Service_Reporter已注册到ACE_Service_Repository 。

                                                                        Line 1 The Service_Reporter code, registration information, and factory function were all statically linked into the executable program. This directive therefore simply causes the Service Configurator framework to activate the service by calling Service_Reporter::init() (page 132). The argc/argv arguments passed to init() are the string "-p" and an expansion of the SERVICE_REPORTER_PORT environment variable. The Service Configurator framework expands this environment variable automatically using the ACE_ARGV class described in Sidebar 35. ACE_ARGV recognizes SERVICE_REPORTER_PORT as an environment variable by its leading $ character and substitutes its associated value. The ACE_STATIC_SVC_REQUIRE macro used in Service_Reporter.cpp (page 135) ensures the Service_Reporter is registered with ACE_Service_Repository before the ACE_Service_Config::open() method is called.

                                                                        侧边栏 35：ACE_ARGV 类

                                                                        Sidebar 35: The ACE_ARGV Class

                                                                        ACE_ARGV类是一个有用的实用程序类，它可以

                                                                        The ACE_ARGV class is a useful utility class that can

                                                                        1. 将字符串转换为argc / argv风格的字符串向量

                                                                        2. Transform a string into an argc/argv-style vector of strings

                                                                        3. 将一组字符串逐步组装成argc / argv向量

                                                                        4. Incrementally assemble a set of strings into an argc/argv vector

                                                                        5. 将argc / argv风格的向量转换为字符串

                                                                        6. Transform an argc/argv-style vector into a string

                                                                        在转换过程中，该类可以为每个遇到的以$分隔的环境变量名称替换相应的环境变量值。ACE_ARGV提供了一种简单高效的机制来创建任意命令行参数。当需要进行命令行处理时，尤其是在需要替换环境变量时，建议考虑使用它。ACE 广泛使用了ACE_ARGV，尤其是在其服务配置器框架中。

                                                                        During the transformation, the class can substitute environment variable values for each $-delimited environment variable name encountered. ACE_ARGV provides an easy and efficient mechanism to create arbitrary command-line arguments. Consider its use whenever command-line processing is required, especially when environment variable substitution is desirable. ACE uses ACE_ARGV extensively, particularly in its Service Configurator framework.

                                                                        第 3-5 行：此代码通过以下步骤配置服务器日志守护程序：

                                                                        1. 将SLD DLL动态链接到进程的地址空间中。

                                                                        2. Dynamically link the SLD DLL into the address space of the process.

                                                                        3. 使用侧边栏 33 （第 143 页）中描述的ACE_DLL类，从SLD DLL 符号表中提取_make_Server_Logging_Daemon()工厂函数。

                                                                        4. Use the ACE_DLL class described in Sidebar 33 (page 143) to extract the _make_Server_Logging_Daemon() factory function from the SLD DLL symbol table.

                                                                        侧边栏 36展示了上面所示的svc.conf文件的 XML 版本。

                                                                        Sidebar 36 illustrates an XML version of the svc.conf file shown above.

                                                                        侧边栏 36：XML svc.conf 文件示例

                                                                        Sidebar 36: An XML svc.conf File Example

                                                                        下面显示的是第 147 页所示的 svc.conf文件的 XML 表示形式：

                                                                        The XML representation of the svc.conf file shown on page 147 is shown below: 

                                                                         1 <ACE_Svc_Conf> 
 2   <static id='Service_Reporter' 
 3           params='-p $SERVICE_REPORTER_PORT'/> 
 4 
 5   <dynamic id='Server_Logging_Daemon' 
 6            type='service_object'> 
 7     <initializer path='SLD' 
 8                  init='_make_Server_Logging_Daemon' 
 9                  params='$SERVER_LOGGING_DAEMON_PORT'/> 
10   </dynamic> 
11 </ACE_Svc_Conf>

                                                                        XML 格式的svc.conf文件比原始格式更冗长，因为它明确指定了字段名称。然而，XML 格式允许svc.conf文件表达更强大的功能，因为可以添加新的节和字段而不会影响现有语法。此外，也不会像在原始格式中添加字段或更改字段顺序那样，对向后兼容性构成威胁。

                                                                        The XML svc.conf file is more verbose than the original format since it specifies field names explicitly. However, the XML format allows svc.conf files to express expanded capabilities, since new sections and fields can be added without affecting existing syntax. There's also no threat to backwards compatibility, as might occur if fields were added to the original format or the field order changed.

                                                                        SLD_DLL由以下 SLD.cpp文件生成：

                                                                        The SLD_DLL is generated from the following SLD.cpp file:

                                                                        #include "Reactor_Logging_Server_Adapter.h" 
#include "Logging_Acceptor.h" 
#include "SLD_export.h" 

typedef Reactor_Logging_Server_Adapter<Logging_Acceptor> 
        Server_Logging_Daemon; 

ACE_FACTORY_DEFINE (SLD, Server_Logging_Daemon)

                                                                        SLD.cpp文件包含Server_Logging_Daemon类型定义，该类型定义使用 Logging_Acceptor 类实例化Reactor_Logging_Server_Adapter模板（第54页）。ACE_FACTORY_DEFINE宏在包含服务代码的 DLL中生成_make_Server_Logging_Daemon()工厂函数。如果服务 DLL 外部的代码需要引用该工厂函数，则可以使用ACE_FACTORY_DECLARE宏来声明带有正确导入声明的_make_Server_Logging_Daemon()工厂函数。

                                                                        The SLD.cpp file contains the Server_Logging_Daemon type definition that instantiates the Reactor_Logging_Server_Adapter template with the Logging_Acceptor class (page 54). The ACE_FACTORY_DEFINE macro generates the _make_Server_Logging_Daemon() factory function in the DLL containing the service code. If code outside the service DLL needs to refer to the factory function, it can use the ACE_FACTORY_DECLARE macro to declare the _make_Server_Logging_Daemon() factory function with the proper import declaration.

                                                                        ACE 的导入/导出辅助宏在侧边栏 37（第 150 页）中有详细说明。这些宏有助于确保 DLL 中外部可见的符号在所有受支持的平台上都能正确导出，并允许 DLL 用户正确导入这些符号。在 ACE 服务宏中应用导出宏，可以让 ACE 服务配置器框架在激活服务时查找工厂函数的入口点符号。

                                                                        ACE's import/export helper macros are described in Sidebar 37 (page 150). These macros help to ensure that a DLL's externally visible symbols are exported properly from the DLL on all supported platforms, as well as allowing the DLL's users to import them properly. Applying the export macros within the ACE service macros allow the ACE Service Configurator framework to look up the factory function's entry point symbol when activating a service.

                                                                        侧边栏 37：ACE DLL 导入/导出宏

                                                                        Sidebar 37: The ACE DLL Import/Export Macros

                                                                        Windows 对 DLL 中符号的显式导入和导出有特定的规则。具有 UNIX 背景的开发人员可能以前没有接触过这些规则，但它们对于管理 Windows 上 DLL 中的符号使用至关重要。ACE 提供了一个脚本，可以生成必要的导入/导出声明以及一套成功使用它们的指南，从而简化了遵循这些规则的过程。为了方便移植，以下步骤适用于 ACE 运行的所有平台：

                                                                        Windows has specific rules for explicitly importing and exporting symbols in DLLs. Developers with a UNIX background may not have encountered these rules in the past, but they are important for managing symbol usage in DLLs on Windows. ACE makes it easy to conform to these rules by supplying a script that generates the necessary import/export declarations and a set of guidelines for using them successfully. To ease porting, the following procedure can be used on all platforms that ACE runs on:

                                                                        1. 为要构建的每个 DLL 选择一个简洁的助记符。

                                                                        2. Select a concise mnemonic for each DLL to be built.

                                                                        3. 运行`$ACE_ROOT/bin/generate_export_file.pl` Perl 脚本，并在命令行中指定 DLL 的助记符。该脚本将生成一个平台无关的头文件并将其写入标准输出。将输出重定向到名为`<助记符>_export.h`的文件。

                                                                        4. Run the $ACE_ROOT/bin/generate_export_file.pl Perl script, specifying the DLL's mnemonic on the command line. The script will generate a platform-independent header file and write it to the standard output. Redirect the output to a file named <mnemonic>_export.h

                                                                        5. #将生成的文件包含到声明全局可见类或符号的每个 DLL 源文件中。

                                                                        6. #include the generated file in each DLL source file that declares a globally visible class or symbol.

                                                                        7. 要在类声明中使用，请在类名和类名之间插入关键字<助记符>_Export 。

                                                                        8. To use in a class declaration, insert the keyword <mnemonic>_Export between class and the class name.

                                                                        9. 编译 DLL 的源代码时，定义宏<助记符>_BUILD_DLL。

                                                                        10. When compiling the source code for the DLL, define the macro <mnemonic>_BUILD_DLL.

                                                                        按照此步骤操作后，在 Windows 系统上会出现以下情况：

                                                                        Following this procedure results in the following behavior on Windows:

                                                                        • 使用上述准则修饰的符号在构建到其 DLL 时将使用`__declspec(dllexport)`声明。

                                                                        • Symbols decorated using the above guidelines will be declared using __declspec(dllexport) when built in their DLL

                                                                        • 当从 DLL 外部的组件引用时，符号将被声明为__declspec(dllimport)。

                                                                        • When referenced from components outside the DLL, the symbols will be declared __declspec(dllimport).

                                                                        如果为每个 DLL 选择单独的助记符并始终如一地使用它们，那么在所有操作系统平台上构建和使用 DLL 将变得非常简单。

                                                                        If you choose a separate mnemonic for each DLL and use them consistently, it will be straightforward to build and use DLLs across all OS platforms.

                                                                        重新配置服务器。ACE 服务配置器框架可以在运行时响应外部事件（例如信号或命令）重新配置服务器。此时，框架会重新读取其svc.conf文件并执行指定的指令，例如向服务器插入或删除服务对象，以及暂停或恢复现有服务对象。接下来，我们将演示如何使用这些功能动态地重新配置服务器日志守护程序。

                                                                        Reconfiguring the server. The ACE Service Configurator framework can reconfigure a server at run time in response to external events, such as signals or commands. At this point, the framework rereads its svc.conf file(s) and performs the designated directives, such as inserting or removing service objects into or from a server, and suspending or resuming existing service objects. We now illustrate how to use these features to reconfigure our server logging daemon dynamically.

                                                                        日志服务器的初始配置存在以下限制：

                                                                        • It uses the Logging_Acceptor implementation from Section 3.3 (page 54), which doesn't time out logging handlers that remain idle for long periods of time.

                                                                        • 无法关闭在ACE_Reactor单例上调用的run_reactor_event_loop()方法。

                                                                        • There is no way to shut down the run_reactor_event_loop() method called on the ACE_Reactor singleton.

                                                                        我们可以通过定义一个新的svc.conf文件并指示服务器通过向其发送信号（例如SIGHUP或SIGINT ）来重新配置自身，从而在不影响现有代码或Service_Reporter服务的情况下添加这些功能。

                                                                        We can add these capabilities without affecting existing code or the Service_Reporter service in the process by defining a new svc.conf file and instructing the server to reconfigure itself by sending it a signal, such as SIGHUP or SIGINT.

                                                                        ACE 服务配置器框架中的动态重配置机制使开发人员无需进行大量重新开发和重新安装工作即可修改服务器功能或微调性能。例如，调试日志服务的错误实现只需动态重配置一个功能等效的服务，该服务包含额外的检测功能，有助于识别错误行为。此重配置过程无需修改、重新编译、重新链接或重启当前正在运行的服务器日志守护程序。尤其值得一提的是，此重配置不会影响静态配置的Service_Reporter 。

                                                                        The dynamic reconfiguration mechanism in the ACE Service Configurator framework enables developers to modify server functionality or fine-tune performance without extensive redevelopment and reinstallation effort. For example, debugging a faulty implementation of the logging service simply involves the dynamic reconfiguration of a functionally equivalent service that contains additional instrumentation to help identify the erroneous behavior. This reconfiguration process may be performed without modifying, recompiling, relinking, or restarting the currently executing server logging daemon. In particular, this reconfiguration doesn't affect the Service_Reporter that was configured statically.

                                                                          5.5 总结

                                                                          5.5 Summary

                                                                          传统的软件开发技术通过静态链接和配置网络应用程序的各项服务，存在诸多局限性。例如，每次新增或修改服务都需要重新构建整个程序，这会大幅增加开发和维护成本。此外，现场进行这些更改效率低下且容易出错，会导致支持成本飙升，客户满意度骤降。

                                                                          Traditional software development techniques that statically link and configure a networked application's services together can be limiting. For example, the effort and time needed to rebuild an entire program for each new or modified service increases development and maintenance costs substantially. Moreover, making these changes in the field is inefficient and error prone, and can cause support costs to soar and customer satisfaction to plummet.

                                                                          本章介绍了 ACE 服务配置器框架，该框架实现了组件配置器模式 [ POSA2 ]，提供了一种可移植的方式来静态和/或动态链接服务，并在运行时动态地启动、挂起、恢复和关闭这些服务。该框架允许应用程序将特定服务实现的选择推迟到软件生命周期的后期——甚至安装时或运行时——从而有助于提高网络软件的可扩展性。这种灵活性带来了以下重要优势：

                                                                          This chapter described the ACE Service Configurator framework, which implements the Component Configurator pattern [POSA2] to provide a portable way to statically and/or dynamically link services and then initiate, suspend, resume, and shut them down dynamically at run time. This framework helps to improve the extensibility of networked software by allowing applications to defer the selection of a particular service implementation until late in the software life cycle—as late as installation time or even run time. This flexibility yields the following important advantages:

                                                                          • 应用程序可以在运行时使用可自由组合的、独立开发的服务进行（重新）配置。

                                                                          • Applications can be composed and (re)configured at run time using mix-and-match, independently developed services.

                                                                          • 开发人员可以专注于服务的功能和其他关键设计维度，而无需过早地确定特定的服务配置。

                                                                          • Developers can concentrate on a service's functionality and other key design dimensions without committing prematurely to a particular service configuration.

                                                                          • 应用程序由多个独立开发的服务组成，因此它们不需要彼此具备高级全局知识，但仍然可以协作。

                                                                          • Applications are composed of multiple services that are developed independently, so they don't require advanced global knowledge of each other, yet can still collaborate.

                                                                          本章解释了 ACE 服务配置器框架中每个类和辅助宏的来源和用途。我们还利用这些功能将上一章日志服务器的各个部分拆分为可独立链接和配置的服务。最终形成了一个可以以多种方式配置和部署的网络日志服务。ACE 服务配置器框架提供的可扩展性允许运维人员和管理员根据特定情况选择最合适的功能和替代实现策略，并就如何最佳地初始化和演进这些功能做出本地化的决策。

                                                                          This chapter explained the origin and usage of each of the ACE Service Configurator framework's classes and helper macros. We also used these capabilities to separate parts of the previous chapter's logging servers into independently linkable and configurable services. The result was a networked logging service that can be configured and deployed in various ways. The extensibility afforded by the ACE Service Configurator framework allows operators and administrators to select the features and alternative implementation strategies that make the most sense in a particular context, as well as make localized decisions on how best to initialize and evolve them.

                                                                            第六章 ACE任务框架

                                                                            Chapter 6. The ACE Task Framework

                                                                            C章概要​

                                                                            CHAPTER SYNOPSIS

                                                                            本章介绍 ACE Task 框架的设计和使用。该框架有助于增强并发面向对象网络应用程序的模块化和可扩展性。ACE Task 框架是常见并发模式（例如 Active Object 和 Half-Sync/Half-Async [ POSA2 ]）的基础。在讨论了框架类的动机和用法之后，我们将 ACE Task 框架应用于增强我们网络日志服务的并发性和可扩展性。

                                                                            This chapter describes the design and use of the ACE Task framework. This framework helps to enhance the modularity and extensibility of concurrent object-oriented networked applications. The ACE Task framework forms the basis of common concurrency patterns, such as Active Object and Half-Sync/Half-Async [POSA2]. After discussing the motivation and usage of the framework's classes, we apply the ACE Task framework to enhance the concurrency and scalability of our networked logging service.

                                                                              6.1 概述

                                                                              6.1 Overview

                                                                              ACE Task 框架提供强大且可扩展的面向对象并发功能，它既可以在对象上下文中创建线程，也可以在不同线程中执行的对象之间传输和排队消息。该框架可用于实现关键的并发模式 [ POSA2 ]，例如：

                                                                              The ACE Task framework provides powerful and extensible object-oriented concurrency capabilities that can spawn threads in the context of an object, as well as transfer and queue messages between objects executing in separate threads. This framework can be applied to implement key concurrency patterns [POSA2], such as:

                                                                              • 活动对象模式将调用方法的线程与执行方法的线程解耦。这种模式增强了并发性，并简化了对在一个或多个线程上下文中执行的对象的同步访问。

                                                                              • The Active Object pattern, which decouples the thread that invokes a method from the thread that executes the method. This pattern enhances concurrency and simplifies synchronized access to objects executing in the context of one or more threads.

                                                                              • 半同步/半异步模式将并发系统中的异步和同步处理解耦，从而简化编程，同时又不会过度降低性能。该模式引入了三层：一层用于异步（或响应式）处理，一层用于同步服务处理，以及一个用于协调异步/响应式层和同步层之间通信的队列层。

                                                                              • The Half-Sync/Half-Async pattern, which decouples asynchronous and synchronous processing in concurrent systems to simplify programming without unduly reducing performance. This pattern introduces three layers: one for asynchronous (or reactive) processing, one for synchronous service processing, and a queueing layer that mediates communication between the asynchronous/reactive and synchronous layers.

                                                                              本章展示了如何应用这些模式以及实现这些模式的 ACE Task 框架，以比现有 C 操作系统 API 和 C++ 封装外观更高的抽象层次开发并发面向对象应用程序。ACE Task 框架包含以下类，联网应用程序可以使用这些类来生成和管理线程，并在进程内的一个或多个线程之间传递消息：

                                                                              This chapter shows how these patterns, and the ACE Task framework that reifies them, can be applied to develop concurrent object-oriented applications at a higher level of abstraction than existing C operating system APIs and C++ wrapper facades. The ACE Task framework consists of the following classes that networked applications can use to spawn and manage threads and pass messages between one or more threads within a process:

                                                                              ACE 级

                                                                              ACE Class

                                                                              描述

                                                                              Description

                                                                              ACE_Message_Block

                                                                              ACE_Message_Block

                                                                              实现了复合模式 [ GoF ]，以便高效地处理固定大小和可变大小的消息。

                                                                              Implements the Composite pattern [GoF] to enable efficient manipulation of fixed- and variable-sized messages

                                                                              ACE_消息队列

                                                                              ACE_Message_Queue

                                                                              提供一个进程内消息队列，使应用程序能够在进程内的线程之间传递和缓冲消息。

                                                                              Provides an intraprocess message queue that enables applications to pass and buffer messages between threads in a process

                                                                              ACE_Thread_Manager

                                                                              ACE_Thread_Manager

                                                                              允许应用程序以可移植的方式创建和管理一个或多个线程的生命周期、同步和属性。

                                                                              Allows applications to portably create and manage the lifetime, synchronization, and properties of one or more threads

                                                                              ACE_Task

                                                                              ACE_Task

                                                                              允许应用程序创建被动或主动对象，以解耦不同的处理单元；使用消息来传递请求、响应、数据和控制信息；并且可以按顺序或并发对消息进行排队和处理。

                                                                              Allows applications to create passive or active objects that decouple different units of processing; use messages to communicate requests, responses, data, and control information; and can queue and process messages sequentially or concurrently

                                                                              ACE任务框架中各类之间最重要的关系如图6.1所示。该框架具有以下优点：

                                                                              The most important relationships between the classes in the ACE Task framework are shown in Figure 6.1. This framework provides the following benefits:

                                                                              图 6.1. ACE 任务框架类

                                                                              • 通过允许开发人员在其并发网络应用程序中使用 C++ 和面向对象技术，提高了编程风格的一致性。例如， ACE_Task类提供了一个面向对象的编程抽象，将操作系统级线程与 C++ 对象关联起来。

                                                                              • Improves the consistency of programming style by enabling developers to use C++ and object-oriented techniques throughout their concurrent networked applications. For example, the ACE_Task class provides an object-oriented programming abstraction that associates OS-level threads with C++ objects.

                                                                              • 将一组线程作为一个整体进行管理。 多线程网络应用程序通常需要多个线程作为一个整体启动和结束。因此，ACE_Task类提供了线程组功能，允许其他线程等待整个线程组退出后再继续执行。

                                                                              • Manages a group of threads as a cohesive collection. Multithreaded networked applications often require multiple threads to start and end as a group. The ACE_Task class therefore provides a thread group capability that allows other threads to wait for an entire group of threads to exit before continuing their processing.

                                                                              • 将并发运行的生产者和消费者线程解耦 ，并通过同步消息队列传递消息进行协作。

                                                                              • Decouples producer and consumer threads that run concurrently and collaborate by passing messages via a synchronized message queue.

                                                                              • 将并发处理（ 例如半同步/半异步模式的同步层）与第 3 章讨论的 ACE Reactor 框架或第 8 章讨论的 ACE Proactor 框架集成在一起。

                                                                              • Integrates concurrent processing, such as the Half-Sync/Half-Async pattern's synchronous layer, with the ACE Reactor framework discussed in Chapter 3 or the ACE Proactor framework discussed in Chapter 8.

                                                                              • 通过与第 5 章讨论的 ACE 服务配置器框架集成，可以实现任务 的动态配置。因此，开发人员无需在设计时甚至运行时过早地确定并发决策。相反，可以根据部署站点资源和动态条件的变化来设计任务，使其按照可能发生变化的配置运行。

                                                                              • Facilitates dynamic configuration of tasks via integration with the ACE Service Configurator framework discussed in Chapter 5. Developers therefore need not commit prematurely to concurrency decisions at design time or even at run time. Tasks can instead be designed to run according to configurations that may change as deployment site resources and dynamic conditions dictate.

                                                                              ACE_Message_Block和ACE_Thread_Manager类分别在 C++NPv1 的第 4 章和第 9 章中进行了描述。因此，本章主要侧重于介绍ACE_Message_Queue和ACE_Task类提供的功能。不过，我们也会演示如何使用 ACE Task 框架中的所有类来增强客户端和服务器日志守护进程的并发性。如果您不熟悉 POSA2 中的 Active Object 和 Half-Sync/Half-Async 模式，我们建议您在深入研究本章的详细示例之前先阅读相关内容。

                                                                              The ACE_Message_Block and ACE_Thread_Manager classes were described in Chapters 4 and 9 of C++NPv1, respectively. This chapter therefore focuses largely on describing the capabilities provided by the ACE_Message_Queue and ACE_Task classes. However, we illustrate how all the classes in the ACE Task framework can be used to enhance the concurrency of our client and server logging daemons. If you aren't familiar with the Active Object and Half-Sync/Half-Async patterns from POSA2 we recommend that you read about them first before delving into the detailed examples in this chapter.

                                                                                6.2 ACE_Message_Queue 类

                                                                                6.2 The ACE_Message_Queue Class

                                                                                动机

                                                                                Motivation

                                                                                如第 27 页2.1.4 节所述，服务采用分层/模块化架构的网络应用程序通常由流程内的一组协作任务组成。为了简化接口和设计、最大限度地降低维护成本并最大限度地提高重用性，这些任务应具备以下属性：

                                                                                As discussed in Section 2.1.4 on page 27, networked applications whose services are layered/modular are often composed of a set of collaborating tasks within a process. To simplify interfaces and design, minimize maintenance costs, and maximize reuse, these tasks should have the following properties:

                                                                                • 任务间耦合度低， 也就是说，各个任务对象之间对彼此的数据和方法的依赖性应该最小。

                                                                                • Low intertask coupling, that is, separate task objects should have minimal dependencies on each other's data and methods.

                                                                                • 任务内部一致性高， 也就是说，任务中的方法和数据应该集中于一组相关的功能。

                                                                                • High intratask cohesion, that is, the methods and data in a task should focus on a related set of functionality.

                                                                                为了实现这些特性，任务之间通常通过通用方法（例如`push()`或`put()`）传递消息进行通信，而不是直接调用特定的静态类型方法。消息可以表示工作请求、工作结果或其他类型的待处理数据。它们还可以表示控制请求，指示任务更改其处理方式，例如，关闭或重新配置自身。

                                                                                To achieve these properties, tasks often communicate by passing messages via a generic method, such as push() or put(), rather than calling specific statically typed methods directly. Messages can represent work requests, work results, or other types of data to process. They can also represent control requests that direct tasks to alter their processing, for example, to shut down or reconfigure themselves.

                                                                                当生产者和消费者任务位于同一进程中时，任务之间通常通过进程内消息队列交换消息。在这种设计中，生产者任务将消息插入一个同步消息队列，消费者任务负责移除并处理这些消息。如果队列已满，生产者可以选择阻塞或等待一段有限的时间后再插入消息。同样地，如果队列为空，消费者也可以选择阻塞或等待一段有限的时间后再移除消息。

                                                                                When producer and consumer tasks are collocated in the same process, tasks often exchange messages via an intraprocess message queue. In this design, producer task(s) insert messages into a synchronized message queue serviced by consumer task(s) that remove and process the messages. If the queue is full, producers can either block or wait a bounded amount of time to insert their messages. Likewise, if the queue is empty, consumers can either block or wait a bounded amount of time to remove messages.

                                                                                尽管某些操作系统原生支持进程内消息队列，但并非所有平台都具备此功能。此外，即使提供了此功能，也往往要么高度依赖特定平台（例如 VxWorks 消息队列），要么效率低下、繁琐且容易出错（例如 System V IPC 消息队列 [ Ste99 ]）。C++NPv1 中提供了如何创建包装外观类来解决这些问题的示例。包装外观类可以将各种可用的进程内消息队列机制封装在一个通用接口之后，并在需要时模拟缺失的功能。然而，ACE 出于以下原因采用了不同的方法：

                                                                                Although some operating systems supply intraprocess message queues natively, this capability isn't available on all platforms. Moreover, when it is offered, it's often either highly platform specific, such as VxWorks message queues, and/or inefficient, tedious, and error prone to use, such as System V IPC message queues [Ste99]. Examples of how to create wrapper facade classes to handle these problems appear in C++NPv1. Wrapper facades could encapsulate the spectrum of available intraprocess message queue mechanisms behind a common interface, emulating missing capabilities where needed. ACE takes a different approach, however, for the following reasons:

                                                                                • 为了避免不必要的复杂性， 原生消息队列机制（如果存在）由于使用底层 C API，因此难以正确编程。它们还会对系统管理造成限制，从而影响产品的运行流程，增加产品支持成本。例如，如果未正确清理，System V IPC 消息队列在程序执行完毕后仍会存在。这些残留信息可能导致应用程序无法重启，或造成资源泄漏，通常需要系统管理员手动修复系统。同样，System V IPC 消息队列提供的进程间队列比许多网络应用程序的目标用例——进程内队列——开销更大。

                                                                                • To avoid unnecessary complexity. Native message queueing mechanisms, where they exist, can be hard to program correctly since they use low-level C APIs. They can also impose constraints on system administration that reflect poorly on a product's operational procedures, which can increase product support costs. For example, System V IPC message queues can persist after a program finishes execution if not cleaned up properly. These remnants may prevent an application from restarting, or contribute to resource leaks and often require a system administrator's intervention to repair the system manually. Likewise, System V IPC message queues offer interprocess queueing that incurs more overhead than the intraprocess queueing that's the target use case for many networked applications.

                                                                                • 为了避免矩阵复杂度不断增加， 每个原生消息队列机制都有其自身的消息格式。因此，要用包装器外观正确地封装消息队列，就需要对消息进行相应的封装。协调两个包装器所需的功能集与消息队列和类型的矩阵，会使包装器的设计和开发工作量成倍增加。随着 ACE 移植到新平台，这个问题只会更加严重。

                                                                                • To avoid a matrix of increasing complexity. Each native message queueing mechanism has its own message format. Properly encapsulating message queues with wrapper facades therefore requires a corresponding encapsulation of messages. Reconciling two wrappers' desired feature sets with the matrix of message queues and types complicates the design and development effort for the wrappers many times over. This problem would only get worse as ACE is ported to new platforms.

                                                                                • ACE 已经拥有一个功能强大的消息类。ACE_Message_Block是一个便捷、高效且功能强大的消息类，在 C++NPv1 的第 4 章中有 详细介绍。它比许多特定于平台的消息格式功能更强大，并且可以跨所有 ACE 平台移植。

                                                                                • ACE already has a powerful message class. ACE_Message_Block is a convenient, efficient, and powerful message class described in Chapter 4 of C++NPv1. It offers more capability than many platform-specific message formats, and also works portably across all ACE platforms.

                                                                                由于这些因素，ACE 定义了ACE_Message_Queue类，这是一个可移植且高效的进程内消息排队机制，它利用了ACE_Message_Block的高级功能。

                                                                                Due to these factors, ACE defines the ACE_Message_Queue class, which is a portable and efficient intraprocess message queueing mechanism that leverages the advanced capabilities of ACE_Message_Block.

                                                                                等级能力

                                                                                Class Capabilities

                                                                                ACE_Message_Queue是一种可移植、轻量级的进程内消息队列机制，提供以下功能：

                                                                                ACE_Message_Queue is a portable, lightweight intraprocess message queueing mechanism that provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                • 它允许将消息（即ACE_Message_Block的实例）入队到队列的前端、后端，或者根据消息的优先级按优先级顺序入队。消息可以从队列的前端或后端出队。

                                                                                • It allows messages (which are instances of ACE_Message_Block) to be enqueued at the front of the queue, the rear of the queue, or in priority order based on the message's priority. Messages can be dequeued from the front or back of the queue.

                                                                                • 它使用ACE_Message_Block提供高效的消息缓冲机制，最大限度地减少动态内存分配和数据复制。

                                                                                • It uses ACE_Message_Block to provide an efficient message buffering mechanism that minimizes dynamic memory allocation and data copying.

                                                                                • 它可以针对多线程或单线程配置进行实例化，允许程序员在不需要并发访问队列时，以较低的开销换取严格的同步。

                                                                                • It can be instantiated for either multithreaded or single-threaded configurations, allowing programmers to trade off strict synchronization for lower overhead when concurrent access to a queue isn't required.

                                                                                • 在多线程配置中，它支持可配置的流控制，防止快速的消息生产者线程占用较慢的消息消费者线程的处理和内存资源。

                                                                                • In multithreaded configurations, it supports configurable flow control, which prevents fast message producer thread(s) from swamping the processing and memory resources of slower message consumer thread(s).

                                                                                • 它允许对入队和出队操作指定超时时间，以避免无限期阻塞。

                                                                                • It allows timeouts to be specified on both enqueue and dequeue operations to avoid indefinite blocking.

                                                                                • 它可以与 ACE Reactor 框架的事件处理机制集成。

                                                                                • It can be integrated with the ACE Reactor framework's event handling mechanism.

                                                                                • 它提供了可以进行策略性分配的分配器，以便可以从各种来源获取消息使用的内存，例如共享内存、堆内存、静态内存或线程特定内存。

                                                                                • It provides allocators that can be strategized so the memory used by messages can be obtained from various sources, such as shared memory, heap memory, static memory, or thread-specific memory.

                                                                                图 6.2 （第 160 页）展示了ACE_Message_Queue的接口。由于此类具有广泛的功能，我们将其描述分为以下四个类别。

                                                                                Figure 6.2 (page 160) shows the interface for ACE_Message_Queue. Since this class has a wide range of features, we divide its description into the four categories below.

                                                                                图 6.2. ACE_Message_Queue类

                                                                                1. 初始化和流量控制方法。 以下方法可用于初始化和管理ACE_Message_Queue中的流量控制：

                                                                                1. Initialization and flow control methods. The following methods can be used to initialize and manage flow control in an ACE_Message_Queue:

                                                                                高水位线()

                                                                                低水位线()

                                                                                low_water_mark()

                                                                                设置/获取决定流量控制何时开始和停止的高水位线和低水位线。

                                                                                ACE_Message_Queue包含一对水位线，用于实现流量控制，防止快速发送方过度消耗较慢接收方的缓冲和计算资源。为了反映队列中消息的总资源使用情况，水位线以字节为单位进行计量。每个ACE_Message_Queue都会维护一个计数，记录每个已入队的ACE_Message_Block中的有效载荷字节数，以跟踪队列中的字节数。如果新消息入队前的队列总字节数小于或等于高水位线，则可以将新消息入队。否则， ACE_Message_Queue 的流量控制机制如下：

                                                                                An ACE_Message_Queue contains a pair of watermarks that implement flow control to prevent a fast sender from overrunning the buffering and computing resources of a slower receiver. To reflect the total resource usage of messages in the queue, the watermarks are measured in bytes. Each ACE_Message_Queue maintains a count of the payload bytes in each queued ACE_Message_Block to keep track of the number of bytes in the queue. A new message can be enqueued if the total number of bytes in the queue before queueing the new message is less than or equal to the high watermark. Otherwise, ACE_Message_Queue flow control works as follows:

                                                                                • 如果队列是“同步的”，则调用线程将阻塞，直到队列中的字节总数低于低水位线或发生超时为止。

                                                                                • If the queue is "synchronized," the calling thread will block until the total number of bytes in the queue falls below the low watermark or until a timeout occurs.

                                                                                • 如果队列“不同步”，则调用将返回 -1，并将errno设置为EWOULD BLOCK。

                                                                                • If the queue is "unsynchronized," the call will return -1 with errno set to EWOULDBLOCK.

                                                                                ACE_MT_SYNCH或ACE_NULL_SYNCH特性类（第 163 页）分别用于指定队列是否同步。当ACE_Message_Block对象从消息队列中移除时，队列字节数会相应递减。低水位线表示先前受流控制的ACE_Message_Queue不再认为自身已满时的队列字节数。

                                                                                The ACE_MT_SYNCH or ACE_NULL_SYNCH traits classes (page 163) can be used to designate whether a queue is synchronized or not, respectively. As ACE_Message_Block objects are removed from a message queue, the count of queued bytes is decremented accordingly. The low watermark indicates the number of queued bytes at which a previously flow-controlled ACE_Message_Queue no longer considers itself full.

                                                                                默认的高水位线和低水位线均为 16K。默认水位线值会导致ACE_Message_Queue在队列中数据超过 16K 时进行流控制，并在队列字节数降至 16K 以下时停止流控制。这些默认值适用于平均ACE_Message_Block大小远小于 1K的应用。

                                                                                The default high and low watermarks are both 16K. The default watermark values cause an ACE_Message_Queue to flow control when more than 16K are queued and to cease flow control when the number of queued bytes drops below 16K. These defaults are appropriate for applications in which the average ACE_Message_Block size is considerably less than 1K.

                                                                                根据负载和设计约束，应用程序可能需要对水位线或其中之一或两者都进行不同的设置。默认水位线值可以在ACE_Message_Queue的构造函数或open()方法中重置，也可以通过其high_water_mark()和low_water_mark()修改器方法进行重置。一种方法是使用第 5 章中描述的 ACE 服务配置器框架来指定水位线，默认值根据开发和测试期间测量的应用程序基准来确定。第6.3节和第 7.4节的示例部分演示了如何设置和使用消息队列的高水位线，以便在多线程网络应用程序中实现流量控制。

                                                                                Depending on load and design constraints, applications may require different settings for either or both of the watermarks. The default watermark values can be reset in the ACE_Message_Queue's constructor or open() method, as well as by its high_water_mark() and low_water_mark() mutator methods. One approach is to specify watermarks using the ACE Service Configurator framework described in Chapter 5, with defaults determined from application benchmarks measured during development and testing. The Example portions of Sections6.3 and 7.4 illustrate how to set and use a message queue's high watermark to exert flow control within multithreaded networked applications.

                                                                                2. 入队/出队方法和消息缓冲。以下方法执行ACE_Message_Queue 中的大部分工作：
