                                                                                ACE_Message_Queue类的设计基于 System V STREAMS [ Rag93 ] 中的消息缓冲和排队机制。传递到消息队列的消息是ACE_Message_Block的实例，可以分为简单消息和复合消息。简单消息包含单个ACE_Message_Block。复合消息包含多个ACE_Message_Block对象，这些对象根据复合模式 [ GoF ] 链接在一起，该模式为构建递归聚合提供了一种结构。复合消息通常包含以下消息类型：

                                                                                The design of the ACE_Message_Queue class is based on the message buffering and queueing facilities in System V STREAMS [Rag93]. Messages passed to a message queue are instances of ACE_Message_Block and can be classified as either simple or composite messages. Simple messages contain a single ACE_Message_Block. Composite messages contain multiple ACE_Message_Block objects that are linked together in accordance with the Composite pattern [GoF], which provides a structure for building recursive aggregations. A composite message often contains the following message types:

                                                                                • 包含记账信息（例如目标地址和长度字段）的控制消息，后跟

                                                                                • A control message that contains bookkeeping information, such as destination addresses and length fields, followed by

                                                                                • 一个或多个数据消息，其中包含复合消息的实际内容

                                                                                • One or more data messages that contain the actual contents of a composite message

                                                                                队列中的消息通过一对指针进行双向链接，这两个指针可以通过 ` next()`和`prev()`访问器方法获取。这种设计优化了队列头部和尾部的入队和出队操作。基于优先级的队列机制（使用 ` ACE_Message_Queue::enqueue_prio()`方法）利用 ` ACE_Message_Block::msg_priority() ` 访问器方法，将优先级更高的消息块排在所有优先级更低的消息块之前。相同优先级的消息块则按照先进先出 (FIFO) 的顺序入队。

                                                                                Messages in a queue are linked bidirectionally via a pair of pointers that can be obtained using their next() and prev() accessor methods. This design optimizes enqueueing and dequeueing at the head and tail of a queue. Priority-based queueing with the ACE_Message_Queue::enqueue_prio() method uses the ACE_Message_Block::msg_priority() accessor method to enqueue a message block ahead of all lower-priority message blocks already in the queue. Message blocks at the same priority are enqueued in first-in, first-out (FIFO) order.

                                                                                复合消息中的每个消息块都通过延续指针单向链接在一起，该延续指针可以通过`cont()`访问器方法获取。图 6.3（第 162 页）展示了如何将三个消息链接在一起形成一个 ` ACE_Message_Queue`。队列的头部和尾部消息是简单消息，而中间的消息是一个复合消息，其中一个消息块通过其延续指针链接在一起。

                                                                                Each message block in a composite message is chained together unidirectionally via a continuation pointer, which can be obtained via the cont() accessor method. Figure 6.3 (page 162) illustrates how three messages can be linked together to form an ACE_Message_Queue. The head and tail messages in the queue are simple messages, whereas the middle one is a composite message with one message block chained via its continuation pointer.

                                                                                图 6.3. ACE_Message_Queue的结构

                                                                                侧边栏 39（第 164 页）描述了ACE_Message_Queue_Ex，它是ACE_Message_Queue的一个变体，用于交换强类型消息。

                                                                                Sidebar 39 (page 164) describes ACE_Message_Queue_Ex, which is a variant of ACE_Message_Queue that exchanges strongly typed messages.

                                                                                3. 参数化同步策略。仔细 查看图 6.2（第 160 页），你会发现ACE_Message_Queue模板由SYNCH_STRATEGY特性类参数化。这种设计基于策略锁定模式 [ POSA2 ]，该模式参数化了类用于保护其临界区免受并发访问的同步机制。在内部，ACE_Message_Queue类使用了其SYNCH_STRATEGY特性类模板参数中的以下特性：

                                                                                3. Parameterized synchronization strategies. If you examine Figure 6.2 (page 160) carefully you'll see the ACE_Message_Queue template is parameterized by a SYNCH_STRATEGY traits class. This design is based on the Strategized Locking pattern [POSA2], which parameterizes the synchronization mechanisms that a class uses to protect its critical sections from concurrent access. Internally, the ACE_Message_Queue class uses the following traits from its SYNCH_STRATEGY traits class template parameter:

                                                                                template <class SYNCH_STRATEGY> 
class ACE_Message_Queue { 
  // ... 
protected: 
  // C++ traits that coordinate concurrent access. 
  ACE_TYPENAME SYNCH_STRATEGY::MUTEX lock_; 
  ACE_TYPENAME SYNCH_STRATEGY::CONDITION notempty_; 
  ACE_TYPENAME SYNCH_STRATEGY::CONDITION notfull_; 
};

                                                                                侧边栏 40（第 165 页）介绍了 C++ 特性和特性类惯用法。这些惯用法使应用程序开发人员能够自定义ACE_Message_Queue的同步策略，以满足其特定需求。上面的ACE_Message_Queue类片段展示了如何使用其特性类模板参数中的以下特性：

                                                                                Sidebar 40 (page 165) describes the C++ traits and traits class idioms. These idioms enable application developers to customize an ACE_Message_Queue's synchronization strategy to suit their particular needs. The ACE_Message_Queue class fragment above shows how the following traits in its traits class template parameter are used:

                                                                                侧边栏 38：将 ACE_Message_Queue 与 ACE_Reactor 集成

                                                                                Sidebar 38: Integrating an ACE_Message_Queue with an ACE_Reactor

                                                                                某些平台提供了将原生消息队列事件与同步事件解复用集成的方法。例如，AIX 的select()函数可以对 System V 消息队列生成的事件进行解复用。虽然这种select()的使用方式不具备可移植性，但将消息队列与 Reactor 集成的能力在以下应用中非常有用：单个线程必须同时响应 I/O 事件和已入队到消息队列中的项。因此， ACE_Message_Queue类提供了一种可移植的方法，可以将事件队列与第 3 章中介绍的 ACE Reactor 框架集成。

                                                                                Some platforms offer a way to integrate native message queue events with synchronous event demultiplexing. For example, AIX's version of select() can demultiplex events generated by System V message queues. Although this use of select() is nonportable, the ability to integrate a message queue with a reactor is useful in applications in which one thread must respond to both I/O events and items enqueued to a message queue. The ACE_Message_Queue class therefore offers a portable way to integrate event queueing with the ACE Reactor framework presented in Chapter 3.

                                                                                ACE_Message_Queue类的构造函数及其open()和notification_strategy()方法可用于为ACE_Message_Queue设置通知策略。此设计是策略模式 [ GoF ] 的一个示例，它允许在不更改客户端（在本例中为ACE_Message_Queue类）的情况下替换各种算法。通知策略必须派生自ACE_Notification_Strategy，这样可以灵活地插入应用程序所需的任何策略。ACE_Reactor_Notification_Strategy 就是这样一个子类策略，其构造函数将其与ACE_Reactor、ACE_Event_Handler和事件掩码关联起来。策略对象与 ACE_Message_Queue 关联后，每个排队的消息都会触发以下操作序列：

                                                                                The constructor of the ACE_Message_Queue class, as well as its open() and notification_strategy() methods, can be used to set a notification strategy for the ACE_Message_Queue. This design is an example of the Strategy pattern [GoF], which allows various algorithms to be substituted without changing the client (which is the ACE_Message_Queue class in this case). The notification strategy must be derived from ACE_Notification_Strategy, which allows the flexibility to insert any strategy necessary for your application. One such subclass strategy is ACE_Reactor_Notification_Strategy, whose constructor associates it with an ACE_Reactor, an ACE_Event_Handler, and an event mask. After the strategy object is associated with an ACE_Message_Queue, each queued message triggers the following sequence of actions:

                                                                                1. ACE_Message_Queue调用策略的notify()方法。

                                                                                2. ACE_Message_Queue calls the strategy's notify() method.

                                                                                3. ACE_Reactor_Notification_Strategy ::notify()方法使用反应器通知机制（第 77 页）通知关联的反应器。

                                                                                4. The ACE_Reactor_Notification_Strategy::notify() method notifies the associated reactor using the reactor notification mechanism (page 77).

                                                                                5. 反应堆使用指定的掩码将通知分发给指定的事件处理程序。

                                                                                6. The reactor dispatches the notification to the specified event handler using the designated mask.

                                                                                • lock_成员对队列状态的访问进行序列化，

                                                                                • The lock_ member serializes access to the queue's state and

                                                                                • notempty_和notfull_是条件变量，分别使调用者能够有效地等待消息到达或插入消息。

                                                                                • notempty_ and notfull_ are condition variables that enable callers to wait efficiently for a message to arrive or to insert a message, respectively.

                                                                                SYNCH_STRATEGY特性类用于参数化ACE_Message_Queue，允许这些成员在编译时适应同步或非同步队列。

                                                                                The SYNCH_STRATEGY traits class used to parameterized ACE_Message_Queue allows these members to adapt to a synchronized or unsynchronized queue at compile time.

                                                                                ACE 的同步包装器外观集可以组合成特性类，用于定义自定义同步策略。ACE 提供了以下两个特性类，它们预封装了最常用的同步特性：

                                                                                Sets of ACE's synchronization wrapper facades can be combined to form traits classes that define customized synchronization strategies. ACE provides the following two traits classes that prepackage the most common synchronization traits:

                                                                                • ACE_NULL_SYNCH — 此类中的特性是根据“空”锁定机制实现的，如下所示。

                                                                                  class ACE_NULL_SYNCH { 
public: 
  typedef ACE_Null_Mutex MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_Null_Mutex NULL_MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_Null_Mutex PROCESS_MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_Null_Mutex RECURSIVE_MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_Null_Mutex RW_MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_Null_Condition CONDITION; 
  typedef ACE_Null_Semaphore SEMAPHORE; 
  typedef ACE_Null_Semaphore NULL_SEMAPHORE; 
};

                                                                                • ACE_NULL_SYNCH— The traits in this class are implemented in terms of "null" locking mechanisms, as shown below.

                                                                                  class ACE_NULL_SYNCH { 
public: 
  typedef ACE_Null_Mutex MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_Null_Mutex NULL_MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_Null_Mutex PROCESS_MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_Null_Mutex RECURSIVE_MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_Null_Mutex RW_MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_Null_Condition CONDITION; 
  typedef ACE_Null_Semaphore SEMAPHORE; 
  typedef ACE_Null_Semaphore NULL_SEMAPHORE; 
};

                                                                                侧边栏 39：ACE_Message_Queue_Ex 类

                                                                                Sidebar 39: The ACE_Message_Queue_Ex Class

                                                                                ACE_Message_Queue类用于将ACE_Message_Block对象入队和出队，ACE_Message_Block 对象提供了一种动态可扩展的方式来表示消息。对于需要强类型消息传递的程序，ACE 提供了ACE_Message_Queue_Ex类，该类用于将消息入队和出队，这些消息是MESSAGE_TYPE模板参数的实例，而不是ACE_Message_Block的实例。

                                                                                The ACE_Message_Queue class enqueues and dequeues ACE_Message_Block objects, which provide a dynamically extensible way to represent messages. For programs requiring strongly typed messaging, ACE provides the ACE_Message_Queue_Ex class, which enqueues and dequeues messages that are instances of a MESSAGE_TYPE template parameter, rather than an ACE_Message_Block.

                                                                                ACE_Message_Queue_Ex提供与ACE_Message_Queue相同的功能。它的主要优势在于，应用程序定义的数据类型可以直接入队，而无需在入队和出队时进行类型转换，也无需将对象复制到ACE_Message_Block的数据部分。然而，由于ACE_Message_Queue_Ex并非派生自ACE_Message_Queue，因此它不能与6.3 节中描述的ACE_Task类一起使用。

                                                                                ACE_Message_Queue_Ex offers the same capabilities as ACE_Message_Queue. Its primary advantage is that application-defined data types can be queued without the need to type cast on enqueue and dequeue or copy objects into the data portion of an ACE_Message_Block. Since ACE_Message_Queue_Ex is not derived from ACE_Message_Queue, however, it can't be used with the ACE_Task class described in Section 6.3.

                                                                                ACE_NULL_SYNCH类是空对象模式 [ Woo97 ] 的一个示例，它通过定义一个“空操作”占位符来简化应用程序，该占位符可以移除类实现中的条件语句。ACE_NULL_SYNCH通常用于单线程应用程序，或者用于那些通过精心设计消除了线程间同步需求，或通过其他机制实现线程间同步的应用程序。第 7.4 节（第 238 页）中的客户端日志守护程序示例说明了ACE_NULL_SYNCH特性类的用法。

                                                                                The ACE_NULL_SYNCH class is an example of the Null Object pattern [Woo97], which simplifies applications by defining a "no-op" placeholder that removes conditional statements in a class implementation. ACE_NULL_SYNCH is often used in single-threaded applications or in applications in which the need for interthread synchronization has either been eliminated via careful design or implemented via some other mechanism. The client logging daemon examples in Section 7.4 (page 238) illustrate the use of the ACE_NULL_SYNCH traits class.

                                                                                • ACE_MT_SYNCH — 此预定义类中的特性是通过实际的锁定机制实现的，如下所示： 

                                                                                  class ACE_MT_SYNCH { 
public: 
  typedef ACE_Thread_Mutex MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_Null_Mutex NULL_MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_Process_Mutex PROCESS_MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_Recursive_Thread_Mutex RECURSIVE_MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_RW_Thread_Mutex RW_MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex CONDITION; 
  typedef ACE_Thread_Semaphore SEMAPHORE; 
  typedef ACE_Null_Semaphore NULL_SEMAPHORE; 
};

                                                                                • ACE_MT_SYNCH— The traits in this predefined class are implemented in terms of actual locking mechanisms, as shown below: 

                                                                                  class ACE_MT_SYNCH { 
public: 
  typedef ACE_Thread_Mutex MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_Null_Mutex NULL_MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_Process_Mutex PROCESS_MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_Recursive_Thread_Mutex RECURSIVE_MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_RW_Thread_Mutex RW_MUTEX; 
  typedef ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex CONDITION; 
  typedef ACE_Thread_Semaphore SEMAPHORE; 
  typedef ACE_Null_Semaphore NULL_SEMAPHORE; 
};

                                                                                ACE_MT_SYNCH特性类定义了一种策略，其中包含适用于多线程应用程序的可移植、高效的同步器。第 6.2 节（第 180 页）和第 7.4 节（第 243 页）中的客户端日志守护程序示例说明了ACE_MT_SYNCH特性类的用法。

                                                                                The ACE_MT_SYNCH traits class defines a strategy containing portable, efficient synchronizers suitable for multithreaded applications. The client logging daemon examples in Section 6.2 (page 180) and Section 7.4 (page 243) illustrate the use of the ACE_MT_SYNCH traits class.

                                                                                侧边栏 40：C++ 特性和特性类惯用法

                                                                                Sidebar 40: The C++ Traits and Traits Class Idioms

                                                                                特性（trait）是一种类型，它传递的信息供其他类或算法在编译时确定策略。特性类 [ Jos99 ] 是一种收集特性集合的有效方法，这些特性应在特定情况下应用，以适当地改变其他类的行为。特性和特性类是 C++基于策略的类设计惯用法 [ Ale01 ]，在 C++ 标准库 [ Aus99 ] 中被广泛使用。

                                                                                A trait is a type that conveys information used by another class or algorithm to determine policies at compile time. A traits class [Jos99] is a useful way to collect a set of traits that should be applied in a given situation to alter another class's behavior appropriately. Traits and traits classes are C++ policy-based class design idioms [Ale01] that are widely used throughout the C++ standard library [Aus99].

                                                                                例如，`char_traits`类定义了字符类型的特性，例如其数据类型以及用于比较、查找和赋值该类型字符的函数。C++ 标准库提供了`char_traits<>`的`char`和`wchar_t`特化版本。这些字符特性会修改诸如`basic_iostream<>`和`basic_string<>`等常用类的行为。`iostream`和`string`类是通过使用`char_traits<char>`特化类模板来定义的。类似地，`wiostream`和` wstring`类是通过使用`char_traits<wchar_t>`特化模板来定义的。

                                                                                For example, the char_traits class defines the traits of a character type, such as its data type and functions to compare, search for, and assign characters of that type. The C++ standard library provides specializations of char_traits<> for char and wchar_t. These character traits then modify the behavior of common classes, such as basic_iostream<> and basic_string<>. The iostream and string classes are defined by specializing the class templates with char_traits<char>. Similarly, the wiostream and wstring classes are defined by specializing the templates with char_traits<wchar_t>.

                                                                                这些 C++ 惯用法在精神上与策略模式 [ GoF ]类似，它允许在不修改类本身的情况下替换类的行为特征。策略模式涉及一个已定义的接口，该接口通常在运行时使用虚方法动态绑定。相比之下，trait 和 traits 类惯用法涉及一组类成员和/或方法的替换，这些成员和/或方法可以使用 C++ 参数化类型在编译时静态绑定。

                                                                                These C++ idioms are similar in spirit to the Strategy pattern [GoF], which allows substitution of class behavioral characteristics without requiring a change to the class itself. The Strategy pattern involves a defined interface that's commonly bound dynamically at run time using virtual methods. In contrast, the traits and traits class idioms involve substitution of a set of class members and/or methods that can be bound statically at compile time using C++ parameterized types.

                                                                                使用 traits 类对ACE_Message_Queue模板进行参数化可以提供以下好处。

                                                                                Parameterizing the ACE_Message_Queue template with a traits class provides the following benefits.

                                                                                • 它允许ACE_Message_Queue在单线程和多线程配置中工作，而无需更改类实现。

                                                                                • It allows ACE_Message_Queue to work in both single-threaded and multithreaded configurations without requiring changes to the class implementation.

                                                                                • 它允许通过策略锁定模式对ACE_Message_Queue实例的同步方面进行整体更改。

                                                                                • It allows the synchronization aspects of an instantiation of ACE_Message_Queue to be changed wholesale via the Strategized Locking pattern.

                                                                                例如，如果使用ACE_NULL_SYNCH特性类，则ACE_Message_Queue的MUTEX和CONDITION特性将解析为ACE_Null_Mutex和ACE_Null_Condition 。在这种情况下，生成的消息队列类不会产生同步开销。相反，如果使用ACE_MT_SYNCH特性类对ACE_Message_Queue进行参数化，则其MUTEX和CONDITION特性将解析为ACE_Thread_Mutex和ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex。在这种情况下，生成的消息队列类的行为符合监视对象设计模式 [ POSA2 ]。

                                                                                For example, the ACE_Message_Queue's MUTEX and CONDITION traits resolve to ACE_Null_Mutex and ACE_Null_Condition if the ACE_NULL_SYNCH traits class is used. In this case, the resulting message queue class incurs no synchronization overhead. In contrast, if an ACE_Message_Queue is parameterized with the ACE_MT_SYNCH traits class, its MUTEX and CONDITION traits resolve to ACE_Thread_Mutex and ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex. In this case, the resulting message queue class behaves in accordance with the Monitor Object design pattern [POSA2], which

                                                                                • 同步并发方法的执行，以确保对象中一次只有一个方法在运行。

                                                                                • Synchronizes concurrent method execution to ensure that only one method at a time runs within an object

                                                                                • 允许对象的各个方法协作安排它们的执行顺序。

                                                                                • Allows an object's methods to schedule their execution sequences cooperatively

                                                                                侧边栏 49（第 214 页）解释了 ACE 如何使用宏来实现ACE_NULL_SYNCH和ACE_MT_SYNCH，以用于不支持模板中 traits 类的 C++ 编译器。

                                                                                Sidebar 49 (page 214) explains how ACE uses macros to implement ACE_NULL_SYNCH and ACE_MT_SYNCH for C++ compilers that lack support for traits classes in templates.

                                                                                当ACE_Message_Queue被参数化为ACE_NULL_SYNCH时，其入队和出队方法在达到队列边界条件时不会阻塞调用线程，而是返回 -1，并将errno设置为EWOULDBLOCK。相反，当ACE_Message_Queue被实例化为ACE_MT_SYNCH时，其入队和出队方法支持阻塞、非阻塞和定时操作。例如，当同步队列为空时，其出队方法默认会阻塞，直到有消息入队且队列不再为空。同样，当同步队列已满时，其入队方法默认会阻塞，直到有足够多的消息出队，使队列中的字节数低于其低水位线且队列不再为满。可以通过向这些方法传递以下类型的ACE_Time_Value值来修改此默认阻塞行为：

                                                                                When ACE_Message_Queue is parameterized with ACE_NULL_SYNCH, calls to its enqueue and dequeue methods never block the calling thread when they reach the queue's boundary conditions. They instead return -1 with errno set to EWOULDBLOCK. Conversely, when an ACE_Message_Queue is instantiated with ACE_MT_SYNCH, its enqueue and dequeue methods support blocking, nonblocking, and timed operations. For example, when a synchronized queue is empty, calls to its dequeue methods will block by default until a message is enqueued and the queue is no longer empty. Likewise, when a synchronized queue is full, calls to its enqueue methods block by default until sufficient messages are dequeued to decrease the number of bytes in the queue below its low watermark and the queue is no longer full. This default blocking behavior can be modified by passing the following types of ACE_Time_Value values to these methods:

                                                                                价值

                                                                                Value

                                                                                行为

                                                                                Behavior

                                                                                空 ACE_Time_Value指针

                                                                                NULL ACE_Time_Value pointer

                                                                                表示入队或出队方法应该无限期地等待，也就是说，它将阻塞直到方法完成、队列关闭或信号中断调用。

                                                                                Indicates that the enqueue or dequeue method should wait indefinitely, that is, it will block until the method completes, the queue is closed, or a signal interrupts the call.

                                                                                指向非空 ACE_Time_Value 的指针，其sec()和usec()方法均返回 0。

                                                                                Non-NULL ACE_Time_Value pointer whose sec() and usec() methods return 0

                                                                                表示入队和出队方法应该执行非阻塞操作，也就是说，如果方法没有立即成功，则返回 -1 并将errno设置为EWOULDBLOCK。

                                                                                Indicates that enqueue and dequeue methods should perform a nonblocking operation, that is, if the method doesn't succeed immediately return -1 and set errno to EWOULDBLOCK.

                                                                                指向非空 ACE_Time_Value 的指针，其sec()或usec()方法返回值大于 0。

                                                                                Non-NULL ACE_Time_Value pointer whose sec() or usec() method returns > 0

                                                                                指示入队或出队方法应等待至指定时间，如果在此时间之前方法未完成，则返回 -1 并将errno设置为EWOULDBLOCK。如果队列已关闭或调用被信号中断，则调用也会提前返回。

                                                                                Indicates that enqueue or dequeue method should wait until the absolute time of day, returning -1 with errno set to EWOULDBLOCK if the method does not complete by this time. The call will also return earlier if the queue is closed or a signal interrupts the call.

                                                                                侧边栏 6（第 45 页）描述了 ACE 中各种类使用的超时值的不同解释。

                                                                                Sidebar 6 (page 45) describes the different interpretations of timeout values used by various classes in ACE.

                                                                                1. 4. 关闭和消息释放方法。 可以使用以下方法关闭、停用和/或释放ACE_Message_Queue中的消息：

                                                                                2. 4. Shutdown and message release methods. The following methods can be used to shut down, deactivate, and/or release the messages in an ACE_Message_Queue:

                                                                                方法

                                                                                将队列状态更改为PULSED，并唤醒所有等待入队或出队操作的线程。此方法不会释放任何已排队的消息。

                                                                                ACE_Message_Queue内部始终处于以下三种状态之一：

                                                                                An ACE_Message_Queue is always in one of three states internally:

                                                                                • 已激活，其中所有操作均正常运行（队列始终以已激活状态开始）。

                                                                                • ACTIVATED, in which all operations work normally (a queue always starts in the ACTIVATED state).

                                                                                • DEACTIVATED，其中所有入队和出队操作立即返回 -1，并将errno设置为ESHUTDOWN ，直到队列再次激活。

                                                                                • DEACTIVATED, in which all enqueue and dequeue operations immediately return -1 and set errno to ESHUTDOWN until the queue is activated again.

                                                                                • PULSED 状态的转换会导致等待的入队和出队操作立即返回，就像队列被停用一样；但是，在PULSED状态下启动的所有操作的行为都与ACTIVATED状态下的行为相同。

                                                                                • PULSED, the transition to which causes waiting enqueue and dequeue operations to return immediately as if the queue were deactivated; however, all operations initiated while in the PULSED state behave as in ACTIVATED state.

                                                                                DEACTIVATED和PULSED状态在需要通知所有生产者和消费者线程发生重要事件的情况下非常有用。转换到任一状态都会唤醒所有等待的生产者和消费者线程。它们的区别在于转换后队列的入队/出队行为。在DEACTIVATED状态下，所有入队和出队操作都会失败，直到队列状态变为ACTIVATED。而PULSED状态的行为与ACTIVATED状态相同，也就是说，所有入队/出队操作都会正常进行。PULSED状态主要用于通知——被唤醒的生产者/消费者可以通过检查state()方法的返回值来决定是否尝试进一步的队列操作。第 7.4 节（第 246 页）的示例部分演示了如何使用pulse()方法触发连接重建。

                                                                                The DEACTIVATED and PULSED states are useful in situations in which it's necessary to notify all producer and consumer threads that some significant event has occurred. Transitioning to either state causes all waiting producer and consumer threads to wake up. The difference between them is the queue's enqueue/dequeue behavior after the transition. In the DEACTIVATED state, all enqueue and dequeue operations fail until the queue's state is changed to ACTIVATED. The PULSED state, however, is behaviorally equivalent to the ACTIVATED state, that is, all enqueue/dequeue operations proceed normally. The PULSED state is mainly informational—an awakened producer/consumer can decide whether to attempt further queue operations by examining the return value from the state() method. The Example portion of Section 7.4 (page 246) illustrates the use of the pulse() method to trigger connection reestablishment.

                                                                                在任何状态转换中，队列中的消息都不会被移除。队列中的消息可以通过`ACE_Message_Queue` 的析构函数、`close()`或`flush()`方法释放。这些方法会释放消息队列中剩余的所有消息块。但是， `flush()`方法不会停用队列，而其他两个方法会停用队列。侧边栏 41介绍了几种可以优雅地关闭`ACE_Message_Queue`的协议。

                                                                                No messages are removed from the queue on any state transition. The messages in a queue can be released by the ACE_Message_Queue destructor, close(), or flush() methods. These methods release all the message blocks remaining in the message queue. The flush() method doesn't deactivate the queue, however, whereas the other two methods do. Sidebar 41 describes several protocols that shut ACE_Message_Queues down gracefully.

                                                                                侧边栏 41：ACE_Message——uscoreQueue 优雅关闭协议

                                                                                Sidebar 41: ACE_Message—uscoreQueue Graceful Shutdown Protocols

                                                                                为避免在需要关闭ACE_Message_Queue时意外丢失已排队的消息，生产者和消费者线程可以实现以下协议：

                                                                                To avoid losing queued messages unexpectedly when an ACE_Message_Queue needs to be closed, producer and consumer threads can implement the following protocol:

                                                                                1. 生产者线程可以向队列中放入一个特殊消息，例如有效负载大小为 0 和/或类型为MB_STOP 的消息块，以表明它希望关闭队列。

                                                                                2. A producer thread can enqueue a special message, such as a message block whose payload is size 0 and/or whose type is MB_STOP, to indicate that it wants the queue closed.

                                                                                3. 消费者线程在处理完队列中其他所有消息后，收到此关闭消息时即可关闭队列。

                                                                                4. The consumer thread can close the queue when it receives this shutdown message, after processing any other messages ahead of it in the queue.

                                                                                该协议的一个变体可以使用ACE_Message_Queue::enqueue_prio()方法来提高关闭消息的优先级，使其优先于队列中可能已经存在的低优先级消息。

                                                                                A variant of this protocol can use the ACE_Message_Queue::enqueue_prio() method to boost the priority of the shutdown message so it takes precedence over lower-priority messages that may already reside in the queue.

                                                                                例子

                                                                                Example

                                                                                本示例展示了如何使用ACE_Message_Queue来实现客户端日志守护进程。如图 1.10（第 21 页）所示，客户端日志守护进程在参与网络日志服务的每个主机上运行，​​并执行以下任务：

                                                                                This example shows how ACE_Message_Queue can be used to implement a client logging daemon. As shown in Figure 1.10 (page 21), a client logging daemon runs on every host participating in the networked logging service and performs the following tasks:

                                                                                • 它使用本地 IPC 机制（例如共享内存、管道或回环套接字）从客户端日志守护程序主机上的客户端应用程序接收日志记录。

                                                                                • It uses a local IPC mechanism, such as shared memory, pipes, or loopback sockets, to receive log records from client applications on the client logging daemon's host.

                                                                                • 它使用远程 IPC 机制（例如TCP / IP）将日志记录转发到在指定主机上运行的服务器日志守护程序。

                                                                                • It uses a remote IPC mechanism, such as TCP/IP, to forward log records to a server logging daemon running on a designated host.

                                                                                我们的示例使用两个线程来实现基于同步ACE_Message_Queue 的有界缓冲区并发模型 [ BA90 ]，该模型使用ACE_MT_SYNCH特性类（第 164 页）。

                                                                                Our example uses two threads to implement a bounded buffer concurrency model [BA90] based on a synchronized ACE_Message_Queue using the ACE_MT_SYNCH traits class (page 164).

                                                                                在我们的客户端日志守护进程中，主线程使用事件处理程序和 ACE Reactor 框架，通过网络回环设备从连接到客户端应用程序的套接字读取日志记录。事件处理程序将每条日志记录放入同步的ACE_Message_Queue队列中。一个独立的转发线程并发运行，持续执行以下步骤：

                                                                                In our client logging daemon, the main thread uses an event handler and the ACE Reactor framework to read log records from sockets connected to client applications via the network loopback device. The event handler queues each log record in the synchronized ACE_Message_Queue. A separate forwarder thread runs concurrently, performing the following steps continuously:

                                                                                1. 从消息队列中取出消息

                                                                                2. Dequeueing messages from the message queue

                                                                                3. 将消息缓冲成更大的块

                                                                                4. Buffering the messages into larger chunks

                                                                                5. 通过TCP连接将数据块转发到服务器日志守护进程。

                                                                                6. Forwarding the chunks to the server logging daemon over a TCP connection

                                                                                通过使用同步消息队列，只要消息队列未满，主线程就可以持续从客户端应用程序读取日志记录。因此，即使转发线程在通过流量控制连接向日志服务器发送日志记录时偶尔发生阻塞，也能提高服务器的整体并发性。

                                                                                By using a synchronized message queue, the main thread can continue to read log records from client applications as long as the message queue isn't full. Overall server concurrency can therefore be enhanced, even if the forwarder thread blocks occasionally when sending log records to the logging server over a flow controlled connection.

                                                                                客户端日志守护进程扮演多种角色，包括接受来自客户端应用程序的连接、接收日志记录、建立与日志服务器的连接以及转发日志记录。因此，我们不能通过重用3.5 节示例部分中的Reactor_Logging_Server类来实现它。相反，我们定义了一组新的类，如图 6.4所示。每个类的作用概述如下：

                                                                                The client logging daemon plays multiple roles, including accepting connections from client applications, receiving log records, establishing connections to the logging server, and forwarding log records. We therefore can't implement it by reusing our Reactor_Logging_Server class from the Example portion of Section 3.5. Instead, we define a new group of classes shown in Figure 6.4. The role of each class is outlined below:

                                                                                图 6.4. 客户端日志守护进程类

                                                                                班级

                                                                                Class

                                                                                描述

                                                                                Description

                                                                                CLD_Handler

                                                                                CLD_Handler

                                                                                ACE_Reactor回调的目标。接收来自客户端的日志记录，将其转换为ACE_Message_Block，并将其插入到由单独线程处理并转发到日志服务器的同步消息队列中。

                                                                                Target of callbacks from the ACE_Reactor. Receives log records from clients, converts them into ACE_Message_Blocks, and inserts them into the synchronized message queue that's processed by a separate thread and forwarded to the logging server.

                                                                                CLD_Acceptor

                                                                                CLD_Acceptor

                                                                                一个工厂，它被动地接受来自客户端的连接，并将它们注册到ACE_Reactor中，以便由CLD_Handler进行处理。

                                                                                如图 6.4所示，此客户端日志守护进程实现中的类是按照 Acceptor-Connector 模式设计的。CLD_Acceptor扮演Acceptor 角色，CLD_Connector扮演 Connector 角色，CLD_Handler扮演 ServiceHandler 角色。主线程、转发线程、图 6.4中的类以及连接它们的同步ACE_Message_Queue之间的关系如图 6.5（第 170 页）所示。

                                                                                As shown in Figure 6.4, the classes in this client logging daemon implementation are designed in accordance with the Acceptor-Connector pattern. CLD_Acceptor plays the acceptor role, CLD_Connector plays the connector role, and CLD_Handler plays the service handler role. The relationships between the main thread, the forwarder thread, the classes in Figure 6.4, and the synchronized ACE_Message_Queue that joins them are shown in Figure 6.5 (page 170).

                                                                                图 6.5. 客户端日志守护进程中对象之间的交互

                                                                                我们首先通过包含必要的 ACE 头文件来进行实现。

                                                                                图 6.4中的每个类都在Client_Logging_Daemon.cpp文件中定义，具体描述如下。

                                                                                Each class in Figure 6.4 is defined in the Client_Logging_Daemon.cpp file and described below.

                                                                                CLD 处理程序。 此类提供以下功能：

                                                                                CLD Handler. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                • 它接收来自客户端的日志记录。

                                                                                • It receives log records from clients.

                                                                                • 它将日志记录转换为ACE_Message_Block。

                                                                                • It converts the log records into ACE_Message_Blocks.

                                                                                • 它将消息块放入同步消息队列中。

                                                                                • It enqueues the message blocks in a synchronized message queue.

                                                                                • 它运行一个单独的线程，将消息块从队列中取出，并以大块的形式转发到日志服务器。

                                                                                • It runs a separate thread that dequeues the message blocks and forwards them to the logging server in large chunks.

                                                                                CLD_Handler类如下所示：

                                                                                The CLD_Handler class is shown below:

                                                                                #if !defined (FLUSH_TIMEOUT) 
#define FLUSH_TIMEOUT 120 /* 120 seconds == 2 minutes. */ 
#endif /* FLUSH_TIMEOUT */ 

class CLD_Handler : public ACE_Event_Handler { 
public: 
  enum { QUEUE_MAX = sizeof (ACE_Log_Record) * ACE_IOV_MAX }; 

  // Initialization hook method. 
  virtual int open (CLD_Connector *); 
  // Shut down hook method. 
  virtual int close (); 

  // Accessor to the connection to the logging server. 
  virtual ACE_SOCK_Stream &peer () { return peer_; } 

  // Reactor hook methods. 
  virtual int handle_input (ACE_HANDLE handle); 
  virtual int handle_close (ACE_HANDLE = ACE_INVALID_HANDLE, 
                            ACE_Reactor_Mask = 0); 

protected: 
  // Forward log records to the server logging daemon. 
  virtual ACE_THR_FUNC_RETURN forward (); 

  // Send buffered log records using a gather-write operation. 
  virtual int send (ACE_Message_Block *chunk[], size_t count); 

  // Entry point into forwarder thread of control. 
  static ACE_THR_FUNC_RETURN run_svc (void *arg); 

  // A synchronized <ACE_Message_Queue> that queues messages. 
  ACE_Message_Queue<ACE_MT_SYNCH> msg_queue_; 
  
  // Manage the forwarder thread. 
  ACE_Thread_Manager thr_mgr_; 

  // Pointer to our <CLD_Connector>. 
  CLD_Connector *connector_; 

  // Connection to the logging server. 
  ACE_SOCK_Stream peer_; 
};

                                                                                CLD_Handler不需要构造函数或析构函数，因为它的open()和close()钩子会在CLD_Acceptor工厂类调用时执行初始化和销毁​​操作（第 176 页）。CLD_Handler承担两种角色——输入和输出——具体说明如下。

                                                                                There's no need for a constructor or destructor in CLD_Handler since its open() and close() hooks perform initialization and destruction activities when called by the CLD_Acceptor factory class (page 176). CLD_Handler performs two roles—input and output—which are explained below.

                                                                                • 输入角色。 由于CLD_Handler继承自ACE_Event_Handler，它可以使用 ACE Reactor 框架来等待通过回环TCP套接字连接到客户端日志守护进程的客户端应用程序发送的日志记录。当日志记录到达客户端日志守护进程时，单例ACE_Reactor会分派以下CLD_Handler::handle_input()钩子方法：

                                                                                   1 int CLD_Handler::handle_input (ACE_HANDLE handle) { 
 2   ACE_Message_Block *mblk = 0; 
 3   Logging_Handler logging_handler (handle); 
 4 
 5   if (logging_handler.recv_log_record (mblk) != -1) 
 6     if (msg_queue_.enqueue_tail (mblk->cont ()) != -1) { 
 7       mblk->cont (0); 
 8       mblk->release (); 
 9       return 0; // Success return. 
10     } else mblk->release (); 
11   return -1; // Error return. 
12 }

                                                                                • Input role. Since CLD_Handler inherits from ACE_Event_Handler, it can use the ACE Reactor framework to wait for log records to arrive from client applications connected to the client logging daemon via loopback TCP sockets. When a log record arrives at the client logging daemon, the singleton ACE_Reactor dispatches the following CLD_Handler::handle_input() hook method:

                                                                                   1 int CLD_Handler::handle_input (ACE_HANDLE handle) { 
 2   ACE_Message_Block *mblk = 0; 
 3   Logging_Handler logging_handler (handle); 
 4 
 5   if (logging_handler.recv_log_record (mblk) != -1) 
 6     if (msg_queue_.enqueue_tail (mblk->cont ()) != -1) { 
 7       mblk->cont (0); 
 8       mblk->release (); 
 9       return 0; // Success return. 
10     } else mblk->release (); 
11   return -1; // Error return. 
12 }

                                                                                第 3-5 行使用C++NPv1 第 4 章中的Logging_Handler从套接字句柄参数中读取日志记录，并将该记录存储在ACE_Message_Block中。

                                                                                Lines 3–5 Use the Logging_Handler from Chapter 4 of C++NPv1 to read a log record out of the socket handle parameter and store the record in an ACE_Message_Block.

                                                                                第 6-8 行将消息插入由转发线程处理的同步队列。服务器日志守护进程期望接收的是序列化的日志记录，而不是主机名字符串，因此我们只入队日志记录数据（由`mblk->cont()`引用），而不入队主机名（由`mblk`引用）。当服务器日志守护进程接收到日志记录时，它会在记录前添加客户端日志主机名，就像客户端日志守护进程记录日志客户端的名称一样。如果 ` enqueue_tail() ` 调用成功，则将 `continuation` 字段设置为`NULL`，以确保`mblk->release()`只回收存储主机名的消息块。

                                                                                Lines 6–8 Insert the message into the synchronized queue serviced by the forwarder thread. The server logging daemon expects to receive a marshaled log record, but not a hostname string, so we enqueue only the log record data (which is referenced by mblk->cont()) and not the hostname (which is referenced by mblk). When the server logging daemon receives the log record, it prepends the name of the client logging host, just as this client logging daemon recorded the name of the logging client. If the enqueue_tail() call succeeds, the continuation field is set to NULL to ensure that mblk->release() only reclaims the message block that stores the hostname.

                                                                                第 10-11 行：如果客户端应用程序断开 TCP 连接或发生错误，` handle_input()`钩子方法将返回 -1（第 61 页的侧边栏 41讨论了处理停止通信的对等方的策略）。此值会触发 Reactor 调用以下`handle_close()`钩子方法来关闭套接字：

                                                                                Lines 10–11 If a client application disconnects the TCP connection or an error occurs, the handle_input() hook method returns -1 (Sidebar 41 on page 61 discusses strategies for handling peers that simply stop communicating). This value triggers the reactor to call the following handle_close() hook method that closes the socket:

                                                                                int CLD_Handler::handle_close (ACE_HANDLE handle, 
                               ACE_Reactor_Mask) 
{ return ACE_OS::closesocket (handle); }

                                                                                请注意，我们不需要使用handle_close()删除此对象，因为内存由Client_Logging_Daemon类管理（第 180 页）。

                                                                                Note that we needn't delete this object in handle_close() since the memory is managed by the Client_Logging_Daemon class (page 180).

                                                                                • 输出角色。CLD_Handler 对象在 CLD_Connector的connect ()方法（第 179 页）调用以下open()钩子方法 时初始化：

                                                                                  1 int CLD_Handler::open (CLD_Connector *connector) { 
2   connector_ = connector; 
3   int bufsiz = ACE_DEFAULT_MAX_SOCKET_BUFSIZ; 
4   peer ().set_option (SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDBUF, 
5                       &bufsiz, sizeof bufsiz); 
6   msg_queue_.high_water_mark (CLD_Handler::QUEUE_MAX); 
7   return thr_mgr_.spawn (&CLD_Handler::run_svc, 
8                          this, THR_SCOPE_SYSTEM); 
9 }

                                                                                • Output role. The CLD_Handler object is initialized when CLD_Connector's connect() method (page 179) calls the following open() hook method: 

                                                                                  1 int CLD_Handler::open (CLD_Connector *connector) { 
2   connector_ = connector; 
3   int bufsiz = ACE_DEFAULT_MAX_SOCKET_BUFSIZ; 
4   peer ().set_option (SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDBUF, 
5                       &bufsiz, sizeof bufsiz); 
6   msg_queue_.high_water_mark (CLD_Handler::QUEUE_MAX); 
7   return thr_mgr_.spawn (&CLD_Handler::run_svc, 
8                          this, THR_SCOPE_SYSTEM); 
9 }

                                                                                第 2-5 行存储指向CLD_Connector 的指针，并将peer()套接字发送缓冲区增加到最大大小，以最大限度地提高长延迟和/或高速网络的吞吐量。

                                                                                Lines 2–5 Store a pointer to the CLD_Connector and increase the peer() socket send buffer to its largest size to maximize throughput over long-delay and/or high-speed networks.

                                                                                第 6行将msg_queue_的高水位线设置为sizeof(ACE_Log_Record) x ACE_IOV_MAX 。由于日志记录在发送到服务器日志守护进程之前会以 ACE_IOV_MAX 为一组进行缓冲，因此队列的高水位线设置为至少可以容纳ACE_IOV_MAX条日志记录。尽管排队的日志记录将被 CDR 序列化，但使用最大大小的反序列化日志记录 ( ACE_Log_Record )是一个合理的近似值。

                                                                                Line 6 Set the msg_queue_'s high watermark to sizeof(ACE_Log_Record) x ACE_IOV_MAX. Since log records are buffered in groups of up to ACE_IOV_MAX before being sent to the server logging daemon, the queue's high watermark is set to accomodate at least ACE_IOV_MAX log records. Although the queued log records will be CDR-marshaled, using the maximum sized demarshaled log record (ACE_Log_Record) is a fair approximation.

                                                                                第 7-8 行使用C++NPv1 第 9 章中的ACE_Thread_Manager创建一个系统作用域线程，该线程与主线程并发执行CLD_Handler::run_svc()静态方法。 [1] run_svc ()静态方法将其void指针参数强制转换为CLD_Handler指针，然后将其处理委托给forward ()方法，如下所示：

                                                                                Lines 7–8 Use the ACE_Thread_Manager from Chapter 9 of C++NPv1 to spawn a system-scoped thread that executes the CLD_Handler::run_svc() static method concurrently with respect to the main thread.[1] The run_svc() static method casts its void pointer argument to a CLD_Handler pointer and then delegates its processing to the forward() method, as shown below:

                                                                                [1]由于CLD_Handler::close()方法（第 176 页）会等待此线程退出，因此我们不需要将 THR_DETACHED 标志传递给spawn ( )。

                                                                                [1] Since the CLD_Handler::close() method (page 176) waits for this thread to exit, we needn't pass the THR_DETACHED flag to spawn(). 

                                                                                ACE_THR_FUNC_RETURN CLD_Handler::run_svc (void *arg) { 
  CLD_Handler *handler = ACE_static_cast (CLD_Handler *, arg); 
  return handler->forward (); 
}

                                                                                现在我们来介绍CLD_Handler::forward()方法，该方法运行在独立的线程中，并将日志记录转发到服务器日志守护进程。如下所示，该方法通过缓冲日志记录来优化网络吞吐量，直到达到最大日志数量或经过最大时间。

                                                                                We now show the CLD_Handler::forward() method, which runs in its own thread and forwards log records to the server logging daemon. As shown below, this method optimizes network throughput by buffering log records until a maximum number have arrived or a maximum time elapses.

                                                                                 1 ACE_THR_FUNC_RETURN CLD_Handler::forward () { 
 2   ACE_Message_Block *chunk[ACE_IOV_MAX]; 
 3   size_t message_index = 0; 
 4   ACE_Time_Value time_of_last_send (ACE_OS::gettimeofday ()); 
 5   ACE_Time_Value timeout; 
 6   ACE_Sig_Action no_sigpipe ((ACE_SignalHandler) SIG_IGN); 
 7   ACE_Sig_Action original_action; 
 8   no_sigpipe.register_action (SIGPIPE, &original_action); 
 9 
10   for (;;) { 
11     if (message_index == 0) { 
12       timeout = ACE_OS::gettimeofday (); 
13       timeout += FLUSH_TIMEOUT; 
14     } 
15     ACE_Message_Block *mblk = 0; 
16     if (msg_queue_.dequeue_head (mblk, &timeout) == -1) { 
17       if (errno != EWOULDBLOCK) break; 
18       else if (message_index == 0) continue; 
19     } else { 
20       if (mblk->size () == 0 
21           && mblk->msg_type () == ACE_Message_Block::MB_STOP) 
22         { mblk->release (); break; } 
23       chunk[message_index] = mblk; 
24       ++message_index; 
25     } 
26     if (message_index >= ACE_IOV_MAX 
27         || (ACE_OS::gettimeofday () - time_of_last_send 
28             >= FLUSH_TIMEOUT)) { 
29       if (send (chunk, message_index) == -1) break; 
30       time_of_last_send = ACE_OS::gettimeofday (); 
31     } 
32   } 
33 
34   if (message_index > 0) send (chunk, message_index); 
35   msg_queue_.close (); 
36   no_sigpipe.restore_action (SIGPIPE, original_action); 
37   return 0; 
38 }

                                                                                第 2-5 行：我们将缓存尽可能多的数据块，以支持单次收集写入操作。因此，我们声明一个ACE_Message_Block指针数组，用于保存指向待出队的数据块的指针。我们还定义了一个索引来跟踪已缓存的记录数，以及ACE_Time_Value对象来记录上次发送日志记录的时间和下次刷新超时时间。这些ACE_Time_Value对象用于限制日志记录在发送到日志服务器之前缓存的时间。

                                                                                Lines 2–5 We will buffer as many blocks as can be sent in a single gather-write operation. We therefore declare an array of ACE_Message_Block pointers to hold pointers to the blocks that will be dequeued. We also define an index to keep track of the number of buffered records and ACE_Time_Value objects to record the last time a log record was sent and the next flush timeout. These ACE_Time_Value objects are used to bound the amount of time log records are buffered before they're transmitted to the logging server.

                                                                                第 6-8 行：如果由于对端关闭连接而导致send()函数失败，UNIX 系统会发出SIGPIPE信号。SIGPIPE信号的默认行为是中止进程。在本方法中，我们使用ACE_Sig_Action类来忽略SIGPIPE信号，这样我们就可以在正常的（非信号）执行路径中处理任何send() 函数的失败。

                                                                                Lines 6–8 UNIX systems will raise the SIGPIPE signal if send() fails due to the peer closing the connection. The default behavior for SIGPIPE is to abort the process. We use the ACE_Sig_Action class to ignore the SIGPIPE signal in this method, which will allow us to handle any send() failures in the normal (nonsignal) execution path.

                                                                                第 10 行此循环将一直运行，直到消息队列被停用。

                                                                                Line 10 This loop will run until the message queue is deactivated.

                                                                                第 11-14 行：在第一次迭代、超时后以及消息块转发后重置刷新超时。

                                                                                Lines 11–14 Reset the flush timeout on the first iteration, after a timeout, and after message blocks are forwarded.

                                                                                第 15-16 行等待到下一个刷新超时，从msg_queue_中出队指向下一个ACE_Message_Block 的指针。

                                                                                Lines 15–16 Wait up to the next flush timeout to dequeue a pointer to the next ACE_Message_Block from the msg_queue_.

                                                                                第 17-18 行：如果出队操作失败，且并非由于超时，则跳出循环。如果是超时，但没有缓冲的日志记录，则继续循环，等待出队消息块。

                                                                                Lines 17–18 If the dequeue operation failed, and it wasn't because of a timeout, break out of the loop. If it was a timeout, but there are no buffered log records, just continue the loop waiting to dequeue a message block.

                                                                                第 19-22 行：成功从队列中取出消息块后，我们首先检查其大小是否为 0 且类型是否为MB_STOP。按照惯例，此应用程序使用此类消息块来请求线程关闭。收到关闭消息后，我们释放消息块并跳出循环。

                                                                                Lines 19–22 After successfully dequeueing a message block, we first check to see if its size() is 0 and its type is MB_STOP. By convention, this application uses this type of message block to request the thread to shut down. When we receive the shutdown message, we release the message block and break out of the loop.

                                                                                第 23-24 行我们将日志记录块存储在块数组的下一个可用槽位中，并增加已保存消息块的计数。

                                                                                Lines 23–24 We store the log record block in the next available slot in the chunk array and increment the count of saved message blocks.

                                                                                第 26-30 行：当缓冲区已满或FLUSH_TIMEOUT超时时，调用CLD_Handler::send()方法（见下文）以一次性写入操作刷新缓冲区中的日志记录。send ()方法会释放所有已保存的消息块，并将message_index重置为已无有效块的状态。如果记录已成功发送，则记录发送时间。

                                                                                Lines 26–30 Whenever the buffer fills up or the FLUSH_TIMEOUT elapses, call the CLD_Handler::send() method (see below) to flush the buffered log records in one gather-write operation. The send() method releases all the saved message blocks and resets message_index to reflect the fact that there are no valid blocks remaining. If the records were sent successfully, we record the time when the records were sent.

                                                                                第 34 行如果dequeue_head()失败或收到关闭消息，则通过调用CLD_Handler::send()来刷新任何剩余的缓冲日志记录。

                                                                                第 35 行关闭消息队列以释放其资源。

                                                                                Line 35 Close the message queue to release its resources.

                                                                                第 36 行将 SIGPIPE 信号的处置方式恢复到调用forward()方法之前的原始操作。

                                                                                CLD_Handler ::send()方法将缓冲的日志记录发送到日志服务器。如果连接关闭，它还负责重新连接到服务器。

                                                                                The CLD_Handler::send() method sends the buffered log records to the logging server. It's also responsible for reconnecting to the server if the connection is closed.

                                                                                 1 int CLD_Handler::send (ACE_Message_Block *chunk[], 
 2                        size_t &count) { 
 3   iovec iov[ACE_IOV_MAX]; 
 4   size_t iov_size; 
 5   int result = 0; 
 6 
 7   for (iov_size = 0; iov_size < count; ++iov_size) { 
 8     iov[iov_size].iov_base = chunk[iov_size]->rd_ptr (); 
 9     iov[iov_size].iov_len = chunk[iov_size]->length (); 
10   } 
11 
12   while (peer ().sendv_n (iov, iov_size) == -1) 
13     if (connector_->reconnect () == -1) { 
14       result = -1; 
15       break; 
16     } 
17 
18   while (iov_size > 0) { 
19     chunk[--iov_size]->release (); chunk[iov_size] = 0; 
20   } 
21   count = iov_size; 
22   return result; 
23 }

                                                                                第 3-9 行为了设置收集写入操作，我们将提供的消息块中的数据指针和长度收集到iovec数组中。

                                                                                Lines 3–9 To set up the gather-write operation, we gather the data pointers and lengths from the supplied message blocks into an iovec array.

                                                                                第 12-16 行ACE_SOCK_Stream ::sendv_n()方法通过一次收集-写入操作刷新缓冲的日志记录。如果sendv_n()由于连接断开而失败，我们会尝试使用CLD_Connector::reconnect()方法重新建立连接。如果reconnect()成功，则会再次调用sendv_n() 。如第179 页所示，CLD_Connector::reconnect()最多会尝试MAX_RETRIES次来重新建立连接。

                                                                                Lines 12–16 The ACE_SOCK_Stream::sendv_n() method flushes the buffered log records in one gather-write operation. If sendv_n() fails due to a broken connection, we attempt to reestablish the connection using the CLD_Connector::reconnect() method. If reconnect() succeeds, sendv_n() is reinvoked. As shown on page 179, CLD_Connector::reconnect() tries upto MAX_RETRIES times to reestablish connections.

                                                                                在while循环的每次迭代中，所有数据都会被发送。由于没有应用层事务监控，因此无法进行端到端的确认，确认已发送的日志记录已被接收和记录。`sendv_n ()`函数可以将成功发送到TCP层进行传输的字节数返回，但无法保证对端主机已接收到任何字节，也无法保证服务器日志守护进程已读取任何字节。由于没有可靠的方法来判断已接收和记录的日志记录数量，并且多次记录同一条记录并无害处，因此如果需要重新建立连接，则会重新发送所有日志记录。

                                                                                All the data is sent on each iteration of the while loop. Since there's no application-level transaction monitoring, there's no end-to-end acknowledgment that the transmitted log records were received and recorded. The sendv_n() can pass back the number of bytes successfully sent to the TCP layer for transmission, but offers no guarantee that any of the bytes were received at the peer host or read by the server logging daemon. Since there's no reliable way to tell how many log records were received and recorded, and logging a record multiple times does no harm, they are all re-sent if the connection must be reestablished.

                                                                                第 18-21行 方法中的最后一个循环释放所有日志记录数据，并将所有ACE_Message_Block指针设置为 0。为了反映chunk中没有剩余的有效日志记录，我们将count重置为 0。

                                                                                Lines 18–21 The final loop in the method releases all the log record data and sets all the ACE_Message_Block pointers to 0. To reflect the fact that there are no valid log records remaining in chunk, we reset count to 0.

                                                                                CLD_Handler::close()是一个公共方法，由CLD_Acceptor::handle_close()方法（第 178 页）或Client_Logging_Daemon::fini()方法（第 181 页）调用，用于关闭处理程序。它会将一条大小为 0 的消息（类型为MB_STOP）插入到消息队列中，如下所示：

                                                                                CLD_Handler::close() is a public method called by the CLD_Acceptor::handle_close() method (page 178) or the Client_Logging_Daemon::fini() method (page 181) to shut the handler down. It inserts a 0-sized message of type MB_STOP into the message queue as follows:

                                                                                int CLD_Handler::close () { 
  ACE_Message_Block *shutdown_message = 0; 
  ACE_NEW_RETURN 
    (shutdown_message, 
    ACE_Message_Block (0, ACE_Message_Block::MB_STOP), -1); 
  msg_queue_.enqueue_tail (shutdown_message); 
  return thr_mgr_.wait (); 
}

                                                                                当转发线程收到shutdown_message消息时，它会将剩余的日志记录刷新到日志服务器，关闭消息队列，然后退出线程。我们使用 ACE_Thread_Manager ::wait()方法阻塞，直到转发线程退出后才返回。此方法还会回收转发线程的退出状态，以防止内存泄漏。

                                                                                When the forwarder thread receives the shutdown_message, it flushes its remaining log records to the logging server, closes the message queue, and exits the thread. We use the ACE_Thread_Manager::wait() method to block until the forwarder thread exits before returning. This method also reaps the exit status of the forwarder thread to prevent memory leaks.

                                                                                CLD_Acceptor。 此类提供以下功能：

                                                                                CLD_Acceptor. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                • 这是一个被动接受客户连接的工厂。

                                                                                • It's a factory that passively accepts connections from clients.

                                                                                • 然后，它将连接注册到 ACE_Reactor 。客户端通过这些连接发送的日志记录随后由上面所示的CLD_Handler实例进行处理。

                                                                                • It then registers the connections with the ACE_Reactor. Log records sent from clients over the connections are then processed by an instance of the CLD_Handler shown above.

                                                                                CLD_Acceptor类的定义如下所示：

                                                                                The CLD_Acceptor class definition is shown below:

                                                                                class CLD_Acceptor : public ACE_Event_Handler { 
public: 
  // Initialization hook method. 
  virtual int open (CLD_Handler *, const ACE_INET_Addr &, 
                    ACE_Reactor * = ACE_Reactor::instance ()); 
  // Reactor hook methods. 
  virtual int handle_input (ACE_HANDLE handle); 
  virtual int handle_close (ACE_HANDLE = ACE_INVALID_HANDLE, 
                            ACE_Reactor_Mask = 0); 
  virtual ACE_HANDLE get_handle () const; 

protected: 
  // Factory that passively connects <ACE_SOCK_Stream>s. 
  ACE_SOCK_Acceptor acceptor_; 

  // Pointer to the handler of log records. 
  CLD_Handler *handler_; 
};

                                                                                由于CLD_Acceptor继承自ACE_Event_Handler，它可以向 ACE Reactor 框架注册自身以接受连接，如下所示：

                                                                                Since CLD_Acceptor inherits from ACE_Event_Handler, it can register itself with the ACE Reactor framework to accept connections, as shown below:

                                                                                int CLD_Acceptor::open (CLD_Handler *handler, 
                        const ACE_INET_Addr &local_addr, 
                        ACE_Reactor *r) { 
  reactor (r); // Store the reactor pointer. 
  handler_ = handler; 
  if (acceptor_.open (local_addr) == -1 
      || reactor ()->register_handler 
           (this, ACE_Event_Handler::ACCEPT_MASK) == -1) 
    return -1; 
  return 0; 
}

                                                                                此方法指示acceptor_开始监听连接请求，然后将此对象注册到单例 reactor 中以接受新连接。reactor 会向以下CLD_Acceptor::get_handle()方法进行双重分派，以获取acceptor_的套接字句柄：

                                                                                This method instructs the acceptor_ to start listening for connection requests and then registers this object with the singleton reactor to accept new connections. The reactor double-dispatches to the following CLD_Acceptor::get_handle() method to obtain the acceptor_'s socket handle:

                                                                                ACE_HANDLE CLD_Acceptor::get_handle () const 
{ return acceptor_.get_handle (); }

                                                                                当客户端日志守护进程收到连接请求时，单例反应器会分发以下CLD_Acceptor::handle_input() hook 方法：

                                                                                When a connection request arrives at the client logging daemon, the singleton reactor dispatches the following CLD_Acceptor::handle_input() hook method:

                                                                                 1 int CLD_Acceptor::handle_input (ACE_HANDLE) { 
 2   ACE_SOCK_Stream peer_stream; 
 3   if (acceptor_.accept (peer_stream) == -1) return -1; 
 4   else if (reactor ()->register_handler 
 5              (peer_stream.get_handle (), 
 6               handler_, 
 7               ACE_Event_Handler::READ_MASK) == -1) 
 8     return -1; 
 9   else return 0; 
10 }

                                                                                第 2-3行将连接传递给peer_stream，它仅接受连接并初始化已在 reactor 中注册的新套接字句柄。因此，在handle_input()返回后，该句柄可能不再存在。ACE_SOCK_Stream 的析构函数不会自动关闭句柄，原因详见 C++NPv1 第 3 章。

                                                                                Lines 2–3 Accept the connection into peer_stream, which just accepts the connection and initializes the new socket handle registered with the reactor. It therefore needn't exist after handle_input() returns. The destructor of ACE_SOCK_Stream doesn't shut down the handle automatically for the reasons described in Chapter 3 of C++NPv1.

                                                                                第 4-7 行：使用`register_handler()`的三参数变体（第 73 页）向 Reactor注册指向CLD_Handler 的指针，用于接收 READ 事件。此`register_handler()`方法使客户端日志守护程序能够为其所有日志处理程序重用单个 C++ 对象。当日志记录到达时，Reactor 将调用 ` CLD_Handler::handle_input()`方法（第 171 页）。

                                                                                Lines 4–7 Use the three-parameter variant of register_handler() (page 73) to register a pointer to the CLD_Handler with the reactor for READ events. This register_handler() method enables the client logging daemon to reuse a single C++ object for all of its logging handlers. When log records arrive, the reactor will dispatch the CLD_Handler::handle_input() method (page 171).

                                                                                如果在接受连接或注册句柄和事件处理程序时发生故障，反应器会自动调用以下handle_close()方法：

                                                                                The following handle_close() method is invoked automatically by the reactor if a failure occurs while accepting a connection or registering a handle and event handler:

                                                                                int CLD_Acceptor::handle_close (ACE_HANDLE, ACE_Reactor_Mask) { 
  acceptor_.close (); 
  handler_->close (); 
  return 0; 
}

                                                                                此方法会同时关闭 acceptor 工厂和CLD_Handler。CLD_Handler :: close()（第 176 页）会触发消息队列和转发器线程的关闭。

                                                                                This method closes both the acceptor factory and the CLD_Handler. CLD_Handler::close() (page 176) triggers a shutdown of the message queue and forwarder thread.

                                                                                CLD_Connector。 此类提供以下功能：

                                                                                CLD_Connector. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                • 这是一个工厂，它主动建立从客户端日志守护进程到服务器日志守护进程的连接。

                                                                                • It's a factory that actively establishes a connection from the client logging daemon to the server logging daemon.

                                                                                • 它激活CLD_Handler实例，将日志记录并发转发到日志服务器。

                                                                                • It activates the instance of CLD_Handler to forward log records concurrently to the logging server.

                                                                                CLD_Connector类的定义如下所示：

                                                                                The CLD_Connector class definition is shown below:

                                                                                class CLD_Connector { 
public: 
  // Establish a connection to the logging server 
  // at the <remote_addr>. 
  int connect (CLD_Handler *handler, 
               const ACE_INET_Addr &remote_addr); 

  // Re-establish a connection to the logging server. 
  int reconnect (); 

private: 
  // Pointer to the <CLD_Handler> that we're connecting. 
  CLD_Handler *handler_; 

  // Address at which the logging server is listening 
  // for connections. 
  ACE_INET_Addr remote_addr_; 
}

                                                                                connect ()方法如下所示：

                                                                                The connect() method is shown below:

                                                                                 1 int CLD_Connector::connect 
 2     (CLD_Handler *handler, 
 3      const ACE_INET_Addr &remote_addr) { 
 4   ACE_SOCK_Connector connector; 
 5 
 6   if (connector.connect (handler->peer (), remote_addr) == -1) 
 7     return -1; 
 8   else if (handler->open (this) == -1) 
 9   { handler->handle_close (); return -1; } 
10   handler_ = handler; 
11   remote_addr_ = remote_addr; 
12   return 0; 
13 }

                                                                                第 4-6 行使用 C++NPv1 第 4 章中的 ACE Socket wrapper facades 与服务器日志守护程序建立 TCP 连接。

                                                                                Lines 4–6 Use the ACE Socket wrapper facades from Chapter 4 of C++NPv1 to establish a TCP connection with the server logging daemon.

                                                                                第 8-9 行通过调用CLD_Handler的open()钩子方法（第 172 页）来激活它。如果成功，此方法会生成一个线程，运行CLD_Handler::forward()方法将日志记录转发到日志服务器。但是，如果open()失败，我们会调用处理程序的handle_close()方法来关闭套接字。

                                                                                Lines 8–9 Activate the CLD_Handler by invoking its open() hook method (page 172). If successful, this method spawns a thread that runs the CLD_Handler::forward() method to forward log records to the logging server. If open() fails, however, we call the handle_close() method on the handler to close the socket.

                                                                                第 10-11 行存储处理程序和远程地址，以简化CLD_Connector::reconnect()方法的实现。该方法用于在日志服务器因崩溃或 Evictor 模式（第 66 页）关闭客户端连接时重新连接到日志服务器。如下所示，reconnect()方法使用指数退避算法来避免日志服务器被过多的连接请求淹没：

                                                                                Lines 10–11 Store the handler and the remote address to simplify the implementation of the CLD_Connector::reconnect() method, which is used to reconnect to the logging server when it closes client connections, either due to a crash or due to the Evictor pattern (page 66). As shown below, the reconnect() method uses an exponential backoff algorithm to avoid swamping a logging server with connection requests:

                                                                                int CLD_Connector::reconnect () { 
  // Maximum number of times to retry connect. 
  const size_t MAX_RETRIES = 5; 

  ACE_SOCK_Connector connector; 
  ACE_Time_Value timeout (1); // Start with 1 second timeout. 
  size_t i; 
  for (i = 0; i < MAX_RETRIES; ++i) { 
    if (i > 0) ACE_OS::sleep (timeout); 
    if (connector.connect (handler_->peer (), remote_addr_, 
                           &timeout) == -1) 
      timeout *= 2; // Exponential backoff. 
    else { 
      int bufsiz = ACE_DEFAULT_MAX_SOCKET_BUFSIZ; 
      handler_->peer ().set_option (SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDBUF, 
                                    &bufsiz, sizeof bufsiz); 
      break; 
    } 
  } 
  return i == MAX_RETRIES ? -1 : 0; 
}

                                                                                与之前一样，我们将peer()套接字发送缓冲区增加到最大大小，以最大限度地提高长延迟和/或高速网络的吞吐量。

                                                                                As earlier, we increase the peer() socket send buffer to its largest size to maximize throughput over long-delay and/or high-speed networks.

                                                                                Client_Logging_Daemon 类是一个外观类，它集成了上述三个类来实现客户端日志守护进程。其定义如下所示。

                                                                                Client_Logging_Daemon. This class is a facade that integrates the three classes described above to implement the client logging daemon. Its definition is shown below.

                                                                                class Client_Logging_Daemon : public ACE_Service_Object { 
public: 
  // Service Configurator hook methods. 
  virtual int init (int argc, ACE_TCHAR *argv[]); 
  virtual int fini (); 
  virtual int info (ACE_TCHAR **bufferp, size_t length = 0) const; 
  virtual int suspend (); 
  virtual int resume (); 

protected: 
  // Receives, processes, and forwards log records. 
  CLD_Handler handler_; 

  // Factory that passively connects the <CLD_Handler>. 
  CLD_Acceptor acceptor_; 

  // Factory that actively connects the <CLD_Handler>. 
  CLD_Connector connector_; 
};

                                                                                Client_Logging_Daemon继承自ACE_Service_Object 。因此，它可以通过svc.conf文件进行动态配置，该文件由第 5 章中描述的 ACE 服务配置器框架处理。当动态链接Client_Logging_Daemon实例时，ACE 服务配置器框架会调用Client_Logging_Daemon::init()，如下所示：

                                                                                Client_Logging_Daemon inherits from ACE_Service_Object. It can therefore be configured dynamically via a svc.conf file processed by the ACE Service Configurator framework described in Chapter 5. When an instance of Client_Logging_Daemon is linked dynamically, the ACE Service Configurator framework calls Client_Logging_Daemon::init(), which is shown below:

                                                                                 1 int Client_Logging_Daemon::init (int argc, ACE_TCHAR *argv[]) { 
 2   u_short cld_port = ACE_DEFAULT_SERVICE_PORT; 
 3   u_short sld_port = ACE_DEFAULT_LOGGING_SERVER_PORT; 
 4   ACE_TCHAR sld_host[MAXHOSTNAMELEN]; 
 5   ACE_OS_String::strcpy (sld_host, ACE_LOCALHOST); 
 6 
 7   ACE_Get_Opt get_opt (argc, argv, ACE_TEXT ("p:r:s:"), 0); 
 8   get_opt.long_option (ACE_TEXT ("client_port"), 'p', 
 9                        ACE_Get_Opt::ARG_REQUIRED); 
10   get_opt.long_option (ACE_TEXT ("server_port"), 'r', 
11                        ACE_Get_Opt::ARG_REQUIRED); 
12   get_opt.long_option (ACE_TEXT ("server_name"), 's', 
13                        ACE_Get_Opt::ARG_REQUIRED); 
14 
15   for (int c; (c = get_opt ()) != -1;) 
16     switch (c) { 
17     case 'p': // Client logging daemon acceptor port number. 
18       cld_port = ACE_static_cast 
19         (u_short, ACE_OS::atoi (get_opt.opt_arg ())); 
20       break; 
21     case 'r': // Server logging daemon acceptor port number. 
22       sld_port = ACE_static_cast 
23         (u_short, ACE_OS::atoi (get_opt.opt_arg ())); 
24       break; 
25     case 's': // Server logging daemon hostname. 
26       ACE_OS_String::strsncpy 
27         (sld_host, get_opt.opt_arg (), MAXHOSTNAMELEN); 
28       break; 
29     } 
30 
31   ACE_INET_Addr cld_addr (cld_port); 
32   ACE_INET_Addr sld_addr (sld_port, sld_host); 
33 
34   if (acceptor_.open (&handler_, cld_addr) == -1) 
35     return -1; 
36   else if (connector_.connect (&handler_, sld_addr) == -1) 
37   { acceptor_.handle_close (); return -1; } 
38   return 0; 
39 }

These network addresses can be changed by arguments passed into this method. In particular, the server logging daemon hostname will often need to be set using the -s option.
