                                                                                  • 它创建TP_Logging_Handler，用于接收来自已连接客户端的日志记录。

                                                                                  • It creates TP_Logging_Handlers that receive log records from connected clients.

                                                                                  TP_Logging_Acceptor类如下所示：

                                                                                  The TP_Logging_Acceptor class is shown below:

                                                                                  侧边栏 45：ACE_Singleton 模板适配器

                                                                                  Sidebar 45: The ACE_Singleton Template Adapters

                                                                                  虽然可以显式地将TP_Logging_Task编写为单例，但这种方法繁琐且容易出错。因此，ACE 定义了以下ACE_Singleton模板适配器，应用程序可以使用它来管理单例生命周期：

                                                                                  Although it's possible to code the TP_Logging_Task explicitly to be a singleton, this approach is tedious and error-prone. ACE therefore defines the following ACE_Singleton template adapter that applications can use to manage singleton life cycles: 

                                                                                  template <class TYPE, class LOCK> 
class ACE_Singleton : public ACE_Cleanup { 
public: 
  static TYPE *instance (void) { 
    ACE_Singleton<TYPE, LOCK> *&s = singleton_; 
    if (s == 0) { 
      LOCK *lock = 0; 
      ACE_GUARD_RETURN (LOCK, guard, 
            ACE_Object_Manager::get_singleton_lock (lock), 0); 
      if (s == 0) { 
        ACE_NEW_RETURN (s, (ACE_Singleton<TYPE, LOCK>), 0); 
        ACE_Object_Manager::at_exit (s); 
      } 
    } 
    return &s->instance_; 
  } 
protected: 
  ACE_Singleton (void); // Default constructor. 
  TYPE instance_; // Contained instance. 
  // Single instance of the <ACE_Singleton> adapter. 
  static ACE_Singleton<TYPE, LOCK> *singleton_; 
};

                                                                                  静态方法` ACE_Singleton::instance()`使用双重检查锁定优化模式 [ POSA2 ] 来构造和访问特定类型的`ACE_Singleton`实例。然后，它会将该实例注册到 ` ACE_Object_Manager`，以便在程序终止时进行清理。如 C++NPv1 的侧边栏 23（第 218 页）所述，`ACE_ObjectManager`负责销毁 ` ACE_Singleton`实例以及相应的`TYPE`实例。

                                                                                  The ACE_Singleton::instance() static method uses the Double-Checked Locking Optimization pattern [POSA2] to construct and access an instance of the type-specific ACE_Singleton. It then registers the instance with the ACE_Object_Manager for cleanup at program termination. As described in Sidebar 23 of C++NPv1 (page 218), the ACE_ObjectManager assumes responsibility for destroying the ACE_Singleton instance, as well as the adapted TYPE instance.

                                                                                  如果实现TYPE 接口的对象代码在ACE_Object_Manager清理单例之前被取消链接，程序可能会在单例清理期间崩溃。这种情况在动态链接服务中的单例中很常见。因此，我们建议在动态链接和取消链接的 DLL 中定义单例时使用ACE_Unmanaged_Singleton。此类提供相同的双重检查锁定优化来创建单例。但是，要销毁单例，需要显式调用ACE_Unmanaged_Singleton::close()方法。动态服务的fini()方法是调用此close()方法的理想位置，如TP_Logging_Server::fini()方法（第 201 页）所示。

                                                                                  A program can crash during singleton cleanup if the object code implementing TYPE is unlinked before the ACE_Object_Manager cleans up singletons, which is often the case for singletons located in dynamically linked services. We therefore recommend using ACE_Unmanaged_Singleton when defining singletons in DLLs that will be linked and unlinked dynamically. This class offers the same double-checked locking optimization to create the singleton. To destroy the singleton, however, requires an explicit call to ACE_Unmanaged_Singleton::close(). A dynamic service's fini() method is a good place to call this close() method, as shown in the TP_Logging_Server::fini() method (page 201).

                                                                                  class TP_Logging_Acceptor : public Logging_Acceptor { 
public: 
  TP_Logging_Acceptor (ACE_Reactor *r = ACE_Reactor::instance ()) 
    : Logging_Acceptor (r) {} 

  virtual int handle_input (ACE_HANDLE) { 
    TP_Logging_Handler *peer_handler = 0; 
    ACE_NEW_RETURN (peer_handler, 
                    TP_Logging_Handler (reactor ()), -1); 
    if (acceptor_.accept (peer_handler->peer ()) == -1) { 
      delete peer_handler; 
      return -1; 
    } else if (peer_handler->open () == -1) 
      peer_handler->handle_close (ACE_INVALID_HANDLE, 0); 
    return 0; 
  } 
};

                                                                                  由于TP_Logging_Acceptor继承自Logging_Acceptor（第 54 页），因此它可以重写handle_input()来创建TP_Logging_Handler的实例。

                                                                                  Since TP_Logging_Acceptor inherits from the Logging_Acceptor (page 54) it can override handle_input() to create instances of TP_Logging_Handler.

                                                                                  TP_Logging_Handler 类提供以下功能：

                                                                                  TP_Logging_Handler. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                  • 它接收来自已连接客户端的日志记录。

                                                                                  • It receives log records from a connected client.

                                                                                  • 它将日志记录排入TP_LOGGING_TASK单例的同步消息队列中。

                                                                                  • It enqueues the log records into the TP_LOGGING_TASK singleton's synchronized message queue.

                                                                                  TP_Logging_Handler类如下所示：

                                                                                  The TP_Logging_Handler class is shown below:

                                                                                  class TP_Logging_Handler : public Logging_Event_Handler { 
  friend class TP_Logging_Acceptor;

                                                                                  由于此类继承自Logging_Event_Handler（第 3.3 节第 59 页），因此当由反应器分派时，它可以接收日志记录。

                                                                                  Since this class derives from Logging_Event_Handler (page 59 in Section 3.3), it can receive log records when dispatched by a reactor.

                                                                                  为了确保动态分配，析构函数被定义为受保护的。然而，由于 ` TP_Logging_Acceptor::handle_input()`方法会删除此类对象，因此`TP_Logging_Acceptor`必须是此类的友元类。在这种情况下，声明友元类是合适的，因为这些类具有高度内聚性，并且保持对 ` TP_Logging_Handler`动态分配的限制至关重要。三个数据成员用于实现并发关闭`TP_Logging_Handler`对象的协议，如侧边栏 46 （第 196 页）所述。

                                                                                  The destructor is defined as protected to ensure dynamic allocation. However, since the TP_Logging_Acceptor::handle_input() method deletes objects of this type, TP_Logging_Acceptor must be a friend of this class. Declaring a friend class is appropriate in this case because these classes exhibit a high degree of cohesion, and it's important to maintain the restriction on dynamic allocation of TP_Logging_Handler. The three data members are used to implement the protocol for closing TP_Logging_Handler objects concurrently, as described in Sidebar 46 (page 196).

                                                                                  protected: 
  virtual TP_Logging_Handler () {} // No-op destructor. 

  // Number of pointers to this class instance that currently 
  // reside in the <TP_LOGGING_TASK> singleton's message queue. 
  int queued_count_; 

  // Indicates whether <Logging_Event_Handler::handle_close()> 
  // must be called to cleanup and delete this object. 
  int deferred_close_; 

  // Serialize access to <queued_count_> and <deferred_close_>. 
  ACE_Thread_Mutex lock_;

                                                                                  侧边栏 46：同时关闭 TP_Logging_Handlers

                                                                                  Sidebar 46: Closing TP_Logging_Handlers Concurrently

                                                                                  线程池服务器面临的一个挑战是如何关闭可被多个线程并发访问的对象。在我们的线程池日志服务器中，TP_Logging_Handler指针被TP_LOGGING_TASK线程使用。这些服务线程与运行 Reactor 事件循环（该循环会向TP_Logging_Handler发送回调）的线程是相互独立的。因此，我们必须确保在TP_LOGGING_TASK线程仍在使用指向TP_Logging_Handler 的指针时，该对象不会被销毁。

                                                                                  A challenge with thread pool servers is closing objects that can be accessed concurrently by multiple threads. In our thread pool logging server, TP_Logging_Handler pointers are used by TP_LOGGING_TASK threads. These service threads are separate from the thread running the reactor event loop that's driving callbacks to TP_Logging_Handler. We must therefore ensure that a TP_Logging_Handler object isn't destroyed while there are still pointers to it in use by TP_LOGGING_TASK.

                                                                                  当日志客户端关闭连接时，`TP_Logging_Handler::handle_input()`（第 197 页）返回 -1。然后，反应器调用处理程序的 ` handle_close()`方法，该方法通常会清理资源并删除处理程序。然而，如果一个或多个指向该处理程序的指针仍在队列中或被`TP_LOGGING_TASK`线程池中的线程使用，则此操作会造成严重问题。因此，我们使用引用计数协议来确保在指向处理程序的指针仍在被使用时，处理程序不会被销毁。下面的 UML 活动图说明了此协议强制执行的行为：

                                                                                  When a logging client closes a connection, TP_Logging_Handler::handle_input() (page 197) returns -1. The reactor then calls the handler's handle_close() method, which ordinarily cleans up resources and deletes the handler. Unfortunately, that would wreak havoc if one or more pointers to that handler were still enqueued or being used by threads in the TP_LOGGING_TASK pool. We therefore use a reference counting protocol to ensure the handler isn't destroyed while a pointer to it is still in use. The UML activity diagram below illustrates the behavior this protocol enforces:

                                                                                  该协议会统计处理程序在TP_LOGGING_TASK单例消息队列中停留的次数。如果日志客户端套接字关闭时计数大于 0，则TP_Logging_Handler::handle_close()暂时无法销毁该处理程序。之后，随着TP_LOGGING_TASK处理每条日志记录，处理程序的引用计数会递减。当计数达到 0 时，处理程序才能完成之前被延迟的关闭请求的处理。

                                                                                  The protocol counts how many times a handler resides in the TP_LOGGING_TASK singleton's message queue. If the count is greater than 0 when the logging client socket is closed, TP_Logging_Handler::handle_close() can't yet destroy the handler. Later, as the TP_LOGGING_TASK processes each log record, the handler's reference count is decremented. When the count reaches 0, the handler can finish processing the close request that was deferred earlier.

                                                                                  该类的公共部分定义了构造函数和当某些事件发生时由反应器分派的一对方法。

                                                                                  The public part of the class defines the constructor and a pair of methods dispatched by the reactor when certain events occur.

                                                                                  public: 
  TP_Logging_Handler (ACE_Reactor *reactor) 
    : Logging_Event_Handler (reactor), 
      queued_count_ (0), 
      deferred_close_ (0) {} 

  // Called when input events occur, e.g., connection or data. 
  virtual int handle_input (ACE_HANDLE); 

  // Called when this object is destroyed, e.g., when it's 
  // removed from a reactor. 
  virtual int handle_close (ACE_HANDLE, ACE_Reactor_Mask); 
}; 

ACE_FACTORY_DECLARE (TPLS, TP_Logging_Handler)

                                                                                  在半同步/半异步模式中， `TP_Logging_Handler::handle_input()`扮演着响应式的角色。它与 ` Logging_Event_Handler::handle_input()`方法（第 59 页）的不同之处在于，它不会在接收到日志记录后立即进行处理。相反，它会将每条日志记录插入到 ` TP_LOGGING_TASK`单例的消息队列中，以便进行并发处理。然而，在处理日志记录时，` TP_LOGGING_TASK`需要访问此处理程序的日志文件（继承自`Logging_Event_Handler`）。为了实现这一点，`handle_input()`将日志记录与包含处理程序指针的消息块合并，并将生成的复合消息插入到`TP_LOGGING_TASK`单例消息队列的末尾，如下所示：

                                                                                  TP_Logging_Handler::handle_input() plays the reactive role in the HalfSync/Half-Async pattern. It differs from the Logging_Event_Handler::handle_input() method (page 59) since it doesn't process a log record immediately after receiving it. Instead, it inserts each log record into the TP_LOGGING_TASK singleton's message queue, where it will be processed concurrently. However, while processing the log record, the TP_LOGGING_TASK needs to access this handler's log file (inherited from Logging_Event_Handler). To facilitate this, handle_input() combines the log record with a message block containing the handler's pointer and inserts the resulting composite message at the end of the TP_LOGGING_TASK singleton's message queue, as shown below:

                                                                                   1 int TP_Logging_Handler::handle_input (ACE_HANDLE) { 
 2   ACE_Message_Block *mblk = 0; 
 3   if (logging_handler_.recv_log_record (mblk) != -1) { 
 4     ACE_Message_Block *log_blk = 0; 
 5     ACE_NEW_RETURN 
 6       (log_blk, ACE_Message_Block 
 7                   (ACE_reinterpret_cast (char *, this)), -1); 
 8     log_blk->cont (mblk); 
 9     ACE_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_Thread_Mutex, guard, lock_, -1); 
10     if (TP_LOGGING_TASK::instance ()->put (log_blk) == -1) 
11     { log_blk->release (); return -1; } 
12     ++queued_count_; 
13     return 0; 
14   } else return -1; 
15 }

                                                                                  第 2-3 行从连接的套接字读取日志记录到动态分配的ACE_Message_Block中。

                                                                                  Lines 2–3 Read a log record from a connected socket into a dynamically allocated ACE_Message_Block.

                                                                                  第 4-8 行创建一个名为log_blk的ACE_Message_Block，其中包含指向此处理程序的指针。ACE_Message_Block构造函数简单地“借用”此指针，并在内部设置ACE_Message_Block::DONT_DELETE标志，以确保在TP_Logging_Task::svc()中释放消息块时，处理程序本身不会被销毁（第 199 页）。mblk附加到log_blk的延续链以形成复合消息。

                                                                                  Lines 4–8 Create an ACE_Message_Block called log_blk that contains a pointer to this handler. The ACE_Message_Block constructor simply "borrows" the this pointer and sets the ACE_Message_Block::DONT_DELETE flag internally to ensure that the handler itself isn't destroyed when the message block is released in TP_Logging_Task::svc() (page 199). The mblk is attached to log_blk's continuation chain to form a composite message.

                                                                                  第 9-10 行使用ACE_Guard获取锁，该锁用于序列化对queued_count_的访问。为了避免服务线程在queued_count_递增之前处理记录的竞争条件，在调用put()将复合消息块插入TP_LOGGING_TASK单例的消息队列之前获取该锁。

                                                                                  Lines 9–10 Use an ACE_Guard to acquire the lock_ that serializes access to queued_count_. To avoid a race condition in which a service thread processes the record before queued_count_ can be incremented, the lock is acquired before calling put() to insert the composite message block into the TP_LOGGING_TASK singleton's message queue.

                                                                                  第 11-13 行：释放log_blk资源，如果put()失败则返回 -1 。如果成功，则增加处理程序在TP_LOGGING_TASK队列中的次数。无论哪种情况，return语句都会导致守卫释放lock_。

                                                                                  Lines 11–13 Release the log_blk resources and return -1 if put() fails. If it succeeds, increment the count of the number of times the handler's in the TP_LOGGING_TASK's queue. In either case, the return statement causes the guard to release lock_.

                                                                                  第 14 行：如果客户端关闭连接或发生严重错误，`handle_input()`返回 -1。此值会导致 Reactor 调用`TP_Logging_Handler::handle_close()` ，该函数实现了并发关闭 ` TP_Logging_Handler`协议的关键部分，如侧边栏 46（第 196 页）所述。`handle_close ()`方法如下所示：

                                                                                  Line 14 If the client closes the connection, or a serious error occurs, handle_input() returns -1. This value causes the reactor to call TP_Logging_Handler::handle_close(), which implements a key portion of the protocol for closing TP_Logging_Handlers concurrently, as described in Sidebar 46 (page 196). The handle_close() method is shown below:

                                                                                   1 int TP_Logging_Handler::handle_close (ACE_HANDLE handle, 
 2                                       ACE_Reactor_Mask) { 
 3   int close_now = 0; 
 4   if (handle != ACE_INVALID_HANDLE) { 
 5     ACE_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_Thread_Mutex, guard, lock_, -1); 
 6     if (queued_count_ == 0) close_now = 1; 
 7     else deferred_close_ = 1; 
 8   } else { 
 9     ACE_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_Thread_Mutex, guard, lock_, -1); 
10     queued_count_--; 
11     if (queued_count_ == 0) close_now = deferred_close_; 
12   } 
13 
14   if (close_now) return Logging_Event_Handler::handle_close (); 
15   return 0; 
16 }

                                                                                  第 3 行close_now变量记录是否应该在第 14 行调用Logging_Event_Handler::handle_close()方法。此决定取决于该方法其余部分中做出的引用计数决定。

                                                                                  Line 3 The close_now variable records whether the Logging_Event_Handler::handle_close() method should be called on line 14. This decision depends on the reference count decisions made in the rest of this method.

                                                                                  第 4-7 行：当 handle_input ()返回 -1时，调用handle_close()会执行此代码。第 6-7 行在一个受ACE_Guard保护的临界区内执行，该 ACE_Guard 会在if子句的作用域内自动获取和释放lock_。如果queue_count_等于 0，则TP_LOGGING_TASK中不再有任何对该对象的引用，因此我们将局部变量close_now设置为 1。否则，我们将deferred_close_数据成员设置为：一旦引用计数达到 0，就应该销毁此处理程序，因为客户端已经关闭了其套接字端点。在处理日志记录时，TP_Logging_Task::svc()方法（第 199 页）会再次调用handle_close()，并执行以下代码行。

                                                                                  Lines 4–7 This code runs when handle_close() is called when handle_input() returns -1. Lines 6–7 are performed within a critical section protected by an ACE_Guard that acquires and releases the lock_ automatically within the scope of the if clause. If queue_count_ equals 0, there are no references to this object remaining in the TP_LOGGING_TASK, so we set the close_now local variable to 1. Otherwise, we set the deferred_close_ data member to note that as soon as the reference count reaches 0 this handler should be destroyed since the client has already closed its socket endpoint. As log records are processed, the TP_Logging_Task::svc() method (page 199) calls handle_close() again, and will execute the lines described below.

                                                                                  第 8-12 行：当处理程序从任务的消息队列中移除后，在 TP_Logging_Task::svc() 中调用 handle_close() 时（第 199 页），句柄等于 ACE_INVALID_HANDLE。因此，我们减去queue_count_ 。如果计数现在为0 ，则记录是否需要完成处理之前被延迟的关闭请求。与第 5-7 行一样，我们使用ACE_Guard在else子句的作用域内自动获取和释放lock_。

                                                                                  Lines 8–12 The handle equals ACE_INVALID_HANDLE when handle_close() is called in TP_Logging_Task::svc() (page 199) after the handler has been removed from the task's message queue. We therefore decrement the queue_count_. If the count is now 0, we record whether we need to finish processing a close request that was deferred earlier. As in lines 5–7, we use an ACE_Guard to acquire and release the lock_ automatically within the scope of the else clause.

                                                                                  第 14 行如果局部变量close_now为真，则调用Logging_Event_Handler::handle_close() （第 60 页）以关闭套接字和日志文件，然后删除自身。

                                                                                  Line 14 Call Logging_Event_Handler::handle_close() (page 60) if the local variable close_now is true to close the socket and log file, and then delete itself.

                                                                                  现在我们已经展示了TP_Logging_Handler类，接下来可以展示TP_Logging_Task::svc()方法。该方法在每个工作线程中并发运行，并在半同步/半异步模式中实现了同步角色。此方法运行一个独立的事件循环，该循环会阻塞在同步消息队列上。消息被TP_Logging_Handler::handle_input()（第 197 页）入队后，将由可用的工作线程出队，并写入与客户端对应的日志文件，如下所示。

                                                                                  Now that we've shown the TP_Logging_Handler class, we can show the TP_Logging_Task::svc() method, which runs concurrently in each of the worker threads and implements the synchronous role in the Half-Sync/Half-Asynch pattern. This method runs its own event loop that blocks on the synchronized message queue. After a message is enqueued by TP_Logging_Handler::handle_input() (page 197), it will be dequeued by an available worker thread and written to the appropriate log file corresponding to the client, as shown below.

                                                                                   1 int TP_Logging_Task::svc () { 
 2   for (ACE_Message_Block *log_blk; getq (log_blk) != -1; ) { 
 3     TP_Logging_Handler *tp_handler = ACE_reinterpret_cast 
 4       (TP_Logging_Handler *, log_blk->rd_ptr ()); 
 5     Logging_Handler logging_handler (tp_handler->log_file ()); 
 6     logging_handler.write_log_record (log_blk->cont ()); 
 7     log_blk->release (); 
 8     tp_handler->handle_close (ACE_INVALID_HANDLE, 0); 
 9   } 
10   return 0; 
11 }

                                                                                  第 2-4 行调用getq()方法，该方法会阻塞，直到有消息块可用。如图 6.11所示，每个消息块都是一个复合消息，包含三个通过延续指针按以下顺序链接在一起的消息块：

                                                                                  Lines 2–4 Call the getq() method, which blocks until a message block is available. As shown in Figure 6.11, each message block is a composite message containing three message blocks chained together via their continuation pointers in the following order:

                                                                                  图 6.11. 日志记录信息的消息区块链

                                                                                  1. 指向TP_Logging_Handler 的指针，该指针指向包含日志文件的地址，日志记录将写入该文件。

                                                                                  2. A pointer to the TP_Logging_Handler that contains the log file where the log record will be written

                                                                                  3. 已连接客户端的主机名

                                                                                  4. The hostname of the connected client

                                                                                  5. 整理后的日志记录内容

                                                                                  6. The marshaled log record contents

                                                                                  第 5-6 行使用log_file初始化logging_handler，然后调用Logging_Handler::write_log_record()，将日志记录写入日志文件。write_log_record ()方法负责释放其消息块链，如 C++NPv1 第 4 章所示。

                                                                                  Lines 5–6 Initialize logging_handler with the log_file and then call Logging_Handler::write_log_record(), which writes the log record to the log file. The write_log_record() method is responsible for releasing its message block chain, as shown in Chapter 4 of C++NPv1.

                                                                                  第 7-8 行调用`log_blk->release()`来回收已分配的资源。然而，由于 ` TP_Logging_Handler`指针是借用的而不是动态分配的，因此我们必须显式地对`tp_handler`调用`TP_Logging_Handler::handle_close()`（第 198 页）。此方法会减少 ` TP_Logging_Handler` 的引用计数，并使用侧边栏 46（第 196 页）中描述的协议正确地清理对象。

                                                                                  Lines 7–8 Call log_blk->release() to reclaim allocated resources. Since the TP_Logging_Handler pointer is borrowed rather than allocated dynamically, however, we must explicitly call TP_Logging_Handler::handle_close() (page 198) on tp_handler. This method decreases the TP_Logging_Handler reference count and cleans up the object properly, using the protocol described in Sidebar 46 (page 196).

                                                                                  TP_Logging_Server。 此外观类继承自ACE_Service_Object，包含Reactor_Logging_Server，并使用TP_LOGGING_TASK单例，如下所示。

                                                                                  TP_Logging_Server. This facade class inherits from ACE_Service_Object, contains a Reactor_Logging_Server, and uses the TP_LOGGING_TASK singleton, as shown below.

                                                                                  class TP_Logging_Server : public ACE_Service_Object { 
protected: 
  // Contains the reactor, acceptor, and handlers. 
  typedef Reactor_Logging_Server<TP_Logging_Acceptor> 
          LOGGING_DISPATCHER; 
  LOGGING_DISPATCHER *logging_dispatcher_; 

public: 
  TP_Logging_Server (): logging_dispatcher_ (0) {} 

  // Other methods defined below... 
};

                                                                                  TP_Logging_Server ::init() hook 方法对第 3 章中的响应式日志服务器实现进行了如下增强：

                                                                                  The TP_Logging_Server::init() hook method enhances the reactive logging server implementation from Chapter 3 as follows:

                                                                                  virtual int init (int argc, ACE_TCHAR *argv[]) { 
  int i; 
  char **array = 0; 
  ACE_NEW_RETURN (array, char*[argc], -1); 
  ACE_Auto_Array_Ptr<char *> char_argv (array); 

   for (i = 0; i < argc; ++i) 
     char_argv[i] = ACE::strnew (ACE_TEXT_ALWAYS_CHAR (argv[i])); 
   ACE_NEW_NORETURN 
     (logging_dispatcher_, 
      TP_Logging_Server::LOGGING_DISPATCHER 
        (i, char_argv.get (), ACE_Reactor::instance ())); 
   for (i = 0; i < argc; ++i) ACE::strdelete (char_argv[i]); 
   if (logging_dispatcher_ == 0) return -1; 
   else return TP_LOGGING_TASK::instance ()->open (); 
}

                                                                                  这个init()方法与第 122 页的方法类似。它分配一个TP_Logging_Server::LOGGING_DISPATCHER实例，并将其指针存储在logging_dispatcher_成员中。它还会调用TP_Logging_Task::open()来预先生成一个工作线程池，用于并发处理日志记录。

                                                                                  This init() method is similar to the one on page 122. It allocates an instance of TP_Logging_Server::LOGGING_DISPATCHER and stores its pointer in the logging_dispatcher_ member. It also calls TP_Logging_Task::open() to prespawn a pool of worker threads that process log records concurrently.

                                                                                  接下来展示的是TP_Logging_Server ::fini()方法：

                                                                                  The TP_Logging_Server::fini() method is shown next:

                                                                                  1 virtual int fini () { 
2   TP_LOGGING_TASK::instance ()->flush (); 
3   TP_LOGGING_TASK::instance ()->wait (); 
4   TP_LOGGING_TASK::close (); 
5   delete logging_dispatcher_; 
6   return 0; 
7 }

                                                                                  第 2 行调用TP_LOGGING_TASK单例的flush()方法，从而关闭与该任务关联的消息队列，这将删除所有排队的消息并向池中的线程发出退出信号。

                                                                                  Line 2 Call the flush() method of the TP_LOGGING_TASK singleton, thereby closing the message queue associated with the task, which deletes all the queued messages and signals the threads in the pool to exit.

                                                                                  第 3-4 行使用ACE_Thread_Manager的屏障同步功能，等待TP_Logging_Task::open()生成的线程池退出，然后显式关闭单例，因为此 DLL 即将被取消链接。

                                                                                  Lines 3–4 Use the ACE_Thread_Manager's barrier synchronization feature to wait for the pool of threads spawned by TP_Logging_Task::open() to exit and then explicitly close the singleton because this DLL is about to be unlinked.

                                                                                  第 5-6 行删除init()中分配的logging_dispatcher_并返回。为简洁起见，我们省略了suspend()、resume()和info()这几个钩子方法，它们与前面示例中展示的方法类似。

                                                                                  Lines 5–6 Delete the logging_dispatcher_ allocated in init() and return. For brevity, we omit the suspend(), resume(), and info() hook methods, which are similar to those shown in earlier examples.

                                                                                  最后，我们将ACE _ FACTORY _ DEFINE放入TP_Logging_Server.cpp中。

                                                                                  Finally, we place ACE_FACTORY_DEFINE into TP_Logging_Server.cpp.

                                                                                  ACE_FACTORY_DEFINE (TPLS, TP_Logging_Server)

                                                                                  此宏会自动定义_make_TP_Logging_Server()工厂函数，该函数在以下svc.conf文件中使用：

                                                                                  This macro automatically defines the _make_TP_Logging_Server() factory function that's used in the following svc.conf file:

                                                                                  dynamic TP_Logging_Server Service_Object * 
TPLS:_make_TP_Logging_Server() "$TP_LOGGING_SERVER_PORT"

                                                                                  该文件指示 ACE 服务配置器框架通过以下步骤配置线程池日志服务器：

                                                                                  This file directs the ACE Service Configurator framework to configure the thread pool logging server via the following steps:

                                                                                  1. 将TPLS DLL动态链接到进程的地址空间中。

                                                                                  2. Dynamically link the TPLS DLL into the address space of the process.

                                                                                  3. 使用ACE_DLL类从TPLS DLL 符号表中提取_make_TP_Logging_Server()工厂函数。

                                                                                  4. Use the ACE_DLL class to extract the _make_TP_Logging_Server() factory function from the TPLS DLL symbol table.

                                                                                  5. 调用此函数以获取指向动态分配的TP_Logging_Server 的指针。

                                                                                  6. This function is called to obtain a pointer to a dynamically allocated TP_Logging_Server.

                                                                                  7. 服务配置器框架通过此指针调用TP_Logging_Server::init()钩子方法，并将TP_LOGGING_SERVER_PORT环境变量的值作为其唯一参数传递。此字符串指定日志服务器监听客户端连接请求的端口号。

                                                                                  8. The Service Configurator framework calls the TP_Logging_Server::init() hook method through this pointer, passing the value of the TP_LOGGING_SERVER_PORT environment variable as its single argument. This string designates the port number where the logging server listens for client connection requests.

                                                                                  9. 如果init()成功，TP_Logging_Server指针将以名称“TP_Logging_Server”存储在ACE_Service_Repository中。

                                                                                  10. If init() succeeds, the TP_Logging_Server pointer is stored in the ACE_Service_Repository under the name "TP_Logging_Server".

                                                                                  ACE 服务配置器框架再次使我们能够重用Configurable_Logging_Server.cpp（第 147 页）中的main()程序。

                                                                                  Once again, the ACE Service Configurator framework enables us to reuse the main() program from Configurable_Logging_Server.cpp (page 147).

                                                                                    6.4 总结

                                                                                    6.4 Summary

                                                                                    ACE Task 框架允许开发人员使用强大且可扩展的面向对象设计来创建和配置并发网络应用程序。该框架提供了ACE_Task类，该类集成了多线程、面向对象编程和队列机制。ACE_Task 中的队列机制使用ACE_Message_Queue类在任务之间高效地传递消息。由于ACE_Task派生自5.2 节中的ACE_Service_Object，因此可以轻松设计可动态配置为活动对象并由 ACE Reactor 框架调度的服务。

                                                                                    The ACE Task framework allows developers to create and configure concurrent networked applications using powerful and extensible object-oriented designs. This framework provides the ACE_Task class that integrates multithreading with object-oriented programming and queueing. The queueing mechanism in ACE_Task uses the ACE_Message_Queue class to transfer messages between tasks efficiently. Since ACE_Task derives from the ACE_Service_Object in Section 5.2, it's easy to design services that can be configured dynamically to run as active objects and be dispatched by the ACE Reactor framework.

                                                                                    本章阐述了如何将 ACE Reactor 框架与 ACE Task 框架结合使用，以实现半同步/半异步模式的各种变体 [ POSA2 ]。ACE Task 框架的类还可以与ACE_Future、ACE_Method_Request和ACE_Activation_List类结合使用，以实现活动对象模式 [ POSA2 ]。ACE_Message_Queue实现的一个子集在 C++NPv1 的第 10 章中介绍。

                                                                                    This chapter illustrated how the ACE Reactor framework can be combined with the ACE Task framework to implement variants of the Half-Sync/Half-Async pattern [POSA2]. The ACE Task framework classes can also be combined with the ACE_Future, ACE_Method_Request, and ACE_Activation_List classes to implement the Active Object pattern [POSA2]. A subset of the ACE_Message_Queue implementation is presented in Chapter 10 of C++NPv1.

                                                                                      第七章 ACE 接收器-连接器框架

                                                                                      Chapter 7. The ACE Acceptor-Connector Framework

                                                                                      C章概要​

                                                                                      CHAPTER SYNOPSIS

                                                                                      本章介绍 ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架的设计和使用。该框架实现了 Acceptor-Connector 模式 [ POSA2 ]，该模式将网络应用中协作对等服务的连接和初始化与它们连接和初始化后执行的处理过程解耦。Acceptor-Connector 框架允许应用程序独立于其提供的服务来配置其连接拓扑的关键属性。我们将展示如何将此框架与 ACE Reactor 和 Task 框架结合使用，以增强我们网络日志服务的可重用性、可扩展性、安全性和可伸缩性。

                                                                                      This chapter describes the design and use of the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework. This framework implements the Acceptor-Connector pattern [POSA2], which decouples the connection and initialization of cooperating peer services in a networked application from the processing they perform after being connected and initialized. The Acceptor-Connector framework allows applications to configure key properties of their connection topologies independently from the services they provide. We illustrate how this framework can be combined with the ACE Reactor and Task frameworks and applied to enhance the reusability, extensibility, security, and scalability of our networked logging service.

                                                                                        7.1 概述

                                                                                        7.1 Overview

                                                                                        许多网络应用程序，例如电子邮件、远程文件备份和 Web 服务，都使用面向连接的服务，其中包含扮演以下角色的类：

                                                                                        Many networked applications, such as e-mail, remote file backups, and Web services, use connection-oriented services containing classes that play the following roles:

                                                                                        • 连接角色决定了应用程序如何建立连接。

                                                                                        • The connection role determines how an application establishes connections.

                                                                                        • 通信角色决定了应用程序在对等配置中扮演客户端、服务器还是同时扮演客户端和服务器的角色。

                                                                                        • The communication role determines whether an application plays the role of a client, a server, or both client and server in a peer-to-peer configuration.

                                                                                        通过面向连接的协议（例如 TCP/IP）进行通信的网络应用程序，其客户端和服务器之间的连接角色通常具有以下不对称性：

                                                                                        Networked applications that communicate via connection-oriented protocols (e.g., TCP/IP) are typified by the following asymmetric connection roles between clients and servers:

                                                                                        • 服务器通常会被动地等待接受连接，方法是监听指定的 TCP 端口。

                                                                                        • Servers often wait passively to accept connections by listening on a designated TCP port.

                                                                                        • 客户端通常通过连接到服务器的监听端口来主动发起连接。

                                                                                        • Clients often initiate connections actively by connecting to a server's listening port.

                                                                                        即使在点对点应用中，应用同时扮演客户端和服务器的角色，连接也必须由一方主动发起，另一方被动接受。为了增强重用性和可扩展性，网络应用的设计应便于切换连接和通信角色，以支持不同的需求和环境。

                                                                                        Even in peer-to-peer applications, where applications play both client and server roles, connections must be initiated actively by one peer and accepted passively by the other. To enhance reuse and extensibility, networked applications should be designed to easily change connection and communication roles to support different requirements and environments.

                                                                                        ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架实现了 Acceptor-Connector 设计模式 [ POSA2 ]，该模式通过将网络应用程序中连接和初始化协作对等服务所需的活动与连接和初始化后执行的处理活动解耦，从而增强了软件的重用性和可扩展性。本章将介绍网络应用程序可用于建立连接和初始化对等服务的以下 ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架类：

                                                                                        The ACE Acceptor-Connector framework implements the Acceptor-Connector design pattern [POSA2], which enhances software reuse and extensibility by decoupling the activities required to connect and initialize cooperating peer services in a networked application from the processing they perform once they're connected and initialized. This chapter describes the following ACE Acceptor-Connector framework classes that networked applications can use to establish connections and initialize peer services:

                                                                                        ACE 级

                                                                                        ACE Class

                                                                                        描述

                                                                                        Description

                                                                                        ACE_Svc_Handler

                                                                                        ACE_Svc_Handler

                                                                                        表示连接服务的本地端，包含用于与连接的对等方通信的 IPC 端点。

                                                                                        Represents the local end of a connected service and contains an IPC endpoint used to communicate with a connected peer.

                                                                                        ACE受体

                                                                                        ACE_Acceptor

                                                                                        该工厂被动地等待接受连接，然后响应来自对等方的主动连接请求而初始化ACE_Svc_Handler 。

                                                                                        This factory waits passively to accept a connection and then initializes an ACE_Svc_Handler in response to an active connection request from a peer.

                                                                                        ACE连接器

                                                                                        ACE_Connector

                                                                                        该工厂主动连接到对等接收器，然后初始化ACE_Svc_Handler以与其连接的对等方通信。

                                                                                        This factory actively connects to a peer acceptor and then initializes an ACE_Svc_Handler to communicate with its connected peer.

                                                                                        图 7.1展示了 ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架中各类之间最重要的关系。这些类根据 Acceptor-Connector 模式 [ POSA2 ] 扮演以下角色：

                                                                                        The most important relationships between the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework's classes are shown in Figure 7.1. These classes play the following roles in accordance with the Acceptor-Connector pattern [POSA2]:

                                                                                        图 7.1. ACE 接收器-连接器框架类

                                                                                        • 事件基础设施层类 执行通用的、与应用程序无关的事件分发策略。第 3 章中描述的 ACE Reactor 框架通常用作事件基础设施层。

                                                                                        • Event infrastructure layer classes perform generic, application-independent strategies for dispatching events. The ACE Reactor framework described in Chapter 3 is commonly used as the event infrastructure layer.

                                                                                        • 连接管理层类 执行与应用程序无关的连接和初始化服务。这些类包括ACE_Svc_Handler、ACE_Acceptor和ACE_Connector。

                                                                                        • Connection management layer classes perform application-independent connection and initialization services. These classes include the ACE_Svc_Handler, ACE_ Acceptor, and ACE_Connector.

                                                                                        • 应用层类 通过子类化和/或模板实例化来定制其他两层执行的通用策略，从而创建用于建立连接、交换数据和执行特定服务处理的对象。在 ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架中，应用层类是上述连接管理层类的子类和模板实例化。

                                                                                        • Application layer classes customize the generic strategies performed by the other two layers via subclassing and/or template instantiation to create objects that establish connections, exchange data, and perform service-specific processing. In the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework, application layer classes are descendants and template instantiations of the connection management layer classes outlined above.

                                                                                        作为ACE_Event_Handler的子类，这些类都提供了与第 3 章中的 ACE Reactor 框架的集成。第 8 章描述了基于 ACE Proactor 框架的 Acceptor-Connector 框架的变体，适用于异步 I/O 更合适或更有益的应用程序。

                                                                                        By being descendants of ACE_Event_Handler, these classes all offer integration with the ACE Reactor framework from Chapter 3. Chapter 8 describes a variant of the Acceptor-Connector framework based on the ACE Proactor framework for applications in which asynchronous I/O is more appropriate or beneficial.

                                                                                        ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架具有以下优点：

                                                                                        The ACE Acceptor-Connector framework provides the following benefits:

                                                                                        • 可重用性和可扩展性。 面向连接的网络应用程序通常包含大量用于建立连接和初始化服务的底层代码。这些代码与连接的服务处理程序对其交换的数据执行的处理基本无关。ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架将这些底层代码重构为可重用的、与应用程序无关的 Acceptor 和 Connector 类，这些类知道如何建立连接并在连接建立后初始化其关联的服务处理程序。因此，服务处理程序可以专注于其应用程序定义的处理。这种关注点分离使得添加新的应用程序服务类型、服务实现、身份验证协议和通信协议变得更加容易，而不会影响现有的连接建立和服务初始化配置代码。

                                                                                        • Reusability and extensibility. Connection-oriented networked applications often contain a significant amount of low-level code that establishes connections and initializes services. This code is largely independent of the processing that connected service handlers perform on the data they exchange. The ACE Acceptor-Connector framework refactors this low-level code into reusable, application-independent acceptor and connector classes that know how to establish a connection and initialize its associated service handler after the connection is established. As a result, service handlers can focus solely on their application-defined processing. This separation of concerns makes it easier to add new types of application services, service implementations, authentication protocols, and communication protocols without affecting existing connection establishment and service initialization configuration code.

                                                                                        • 可移植性。 框架中的所有类模板都根据建立连接和传输数据所需的 IPC 机制类型进行参数化。这种基于模板的可扩展性所提供的灵活性，在开发必须在多个操作系统平台上高效且可移植地运行的应用程序时非常有用。Acceptor-Connector 模板的 IPC 类参数可以是任何符合模板预期接口的网络编程类。例如，根据底层操作系统平台的某些属性（例如它是 BSD 还是 UNIX 的 System V 版本），服务器可以实例化框架类以使用 ACE Socket 包装器外观或 ACE TLI 包装器外观。对于非TCP / IP应用程序，可以使用 ACE 的许多 IPC 包装器外观或任何导出必要接口的私有开发类来实例化模板。

                                                                                        • Portability. The class templates in the framework are all parameterized by the type of IPC mechanism needed to establish connections and to transfer data. The flexibility offered by this template-based extensibility is useful when developing applications that must run portably and efficiently across multiple OS platforms. The IPC class parameters for the Acceptor-Connector templates can be any network programming classes that conform to the interface expected by the templates. For example, depending on certain properties of the underlying OS platform, such as whether it's a BSD or System V variant of UNIX, a server can instantiate the framework classes to use the ACE Socket wrapper facades or the ACE TLI wrapper facades. For non-TCP/IP applications, the templates can be instantiated with many of ACE's IPC wrapper facades, or any privately developed classes that export the necessary interface.

                                                                                        • 健壮性。 通过将服务处理程序与其接收者强耦合，该框架可以确保被动模式传输端点不会被意外用于读取或写入数据。这种增强的类型安全性消除了一类在使用弱类型网络编程接口（例如 C 语言中定义的 Socket 或 TLI API）进行编程时可能出现的隐蔽而有害的错误。

                                                                                        • Robustness. By strongly decoupling a service handler from its acceptor, the framework can ensure that passive-mode transport endpoints aren't accidentally used to read or write data. This added type safety eliminates a subtle and pernicious class of errors that can arise when programming with weakly typed network programming interfaces, such as the Socket or TLI APIs defined in C.

                                                                                        • 效率。Acceptor -Connector 模式能够在长延迟广域网上异步高效地主动与大量对等节点建立连接。异步性在这些情况下至关重要，因为大规模网络应用可能需要连接成百上千个对等节点。

                                                                                        • Efficiency. The Acceptor-Connector pattern can actively establish connections with a large number of peers asynchronously and efficiently over long-latency wide area networks. Asynchrony is important in these situations because large-scale networked applications may have hundreds or thousands of peers to connect.

                                                                                        本章剩余部分将阐述 ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架类的功能及其背后的原因。它将展示服务处理程序的初始化和销毁​​方式，并阐述框架设计中的关键选择。此外，它还将展示如何将此框架构建在 ACE Reactor 和 ACE Task 框架之上，以处理客户端和服务器日志守护程序之间的连接请求和数据交换。如果您不熟悉 POSA2 中的 Acceptor-Connector 模式，我们建议您在深入研究本章的详细示例之前先阅读相关内容。我们还建议您分别阅读第3章和第6章中关于 ACE Reactor 和 Task 框架的内容。

                                                                                        The remainder of this chapter motivates and describes the capabilities of the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework classes. It shows how service handlers are initialized and destroyed, and motivates key framework design choices. It also shows how this framework can be layered on top of the ACE Reactor and ACE Task frameworks to handle connection requests and data exchanged between client and server logging daemons. If you're not familiar with the Acceptor-Connector pattern from POSA2 we recommend you read about it first before delving into the detailed examples in this chapter. We also recommend you read about the ACE Reactor and Task frameworks in Chapters 3 and 6, respectively.

                                                                                          7.2 ACE_Svc_Handler 类

                                                                                          7.2 The ACE_Svc_Handler Class

                                                                                          动机

                                                                                          Motivation

                                                                                          第二章将服务定义为服务器向客户端提供的一组功能。服务处理程序是网络应用程序中实现或访问（或在对等网络中同时实现两者）服务的部分。面向连接的网络应用程序至少需要两个通信的服务处理程序——每个连接的两端各一个。此外，使用多播或广播通信的应用程序可能拥有多个服务处理程序。尽管这些无连接通信协议并不完全符合 Acceptor-Connector 模型，但ACE_Svc_Handler类通常是实现服务处理程序的良好选择，值得考虑。

                                                                                          Chapter 2 defined a service as a set of functionality offered to a client by a server. A service handler is the portion of a networked application that either implements or accesses (or both, in the case of a peer-to-peer arrangement) a service. Connection-oriented networked applications require at least two communicating service handlers—one for each end of every connection. Incidentally, applications using multicast or broadcast communication may have multiple service handlers. Although these connectionless communication protocols don't cleanly fit the Acceptor-Connector model, the ACE_Svc_Handler class is often a good choice for implementing a service handler and should be considered.

                                                                                          在设计服务中涉及的服务处理程序时，开发人员还应考虑 C++NPv1 第 1 章中讨论的通信设计维度。一般来说，服务处理程序定义的应用程序功能可以与以下设计方面解耦：

                                                                                          When designing the service handlers involved in a service, developers should also take into account the communication design dimensions discussed in Chapter 1 of C++NPv1. In general, the application functionality defined by a service handler can be decoupled from the following design aspects:

                                                                                          • 服务处理程序是如何连接（主动或被动）和初始化的

                                                                                          • How the service handler was connected (actively or passively) and initialized

                                                                                          • 用于在两个服务处理程序之间连接、验证和交换消息的协议

                                                                                          • The protocols used to connect, authenticate, and exchange messages between two service handlers

                                                                                          • 用于访问操作系统进程间通信机制的网络编程API

                                                                                          • The network programming API used to access the OS IPC mechanisms

                                                                                          一般来说，连接/认证协议和服务初始化策略的变更频率低于应用程序实现的服务处理程序功能。为了将这些职责分离，使开发人员能够专注于服务处理程序的功能，ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架定义了ACE_Svc_Handler类。

                                                                                          In general, connection/authentication protocols and service initialization strategies change less frequently than the service handler functionality implemented by an application. To separate these concerns and allow developers to focus on the functionality of their service handlers, the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework defines the ACE_Svc_Handler class.

                                                                                          等级能力

                                                                                          Class Capabilities

                                                                                          ACE_Svc_Handler是 ACE 同步和响应式数据传输及服务处理机制的基础。此类提供以下功能：

                                                                                          ACE_Svc_Handler is the basis of ACE's synchronous and reactive data transfer and service processing mechanisms. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                          • 它为在同步和/或响应式网络应用程序中初始化和实现服务提供了基础，充当ACE_Connector和ACE_Acceptor连接工厂的目标。

                                                                                          • It provides the basis for initializing and implementing a service in a synchronous and/or reactive networked application, acting as the target of the ACE_Connector and ACE_Acceptor connection factories.

                                                                                          • 它提供了一个进程间通信 (IPC) 端点，供服务处理程序与其对等服务处理程序通信。此 IPC 端点的类型可以通过 ACE 的许多 IPC 包装器外观类进行参数化，从而将底层通信机制与应用层服务处理策略分离。

                                                                                          • It provides an IPC endpoint used by a service handler to communicate with its peer service handler(s). The type of this IPC endpoint can be parameterized with many of ACE's IPC wrapper facade classes, thereby separating lower-level communication mechanisms from application-level service processing policies.

                                                                                          • 由于ACE_Svc_Handler派生自ACE_Task（而ACE_Task 又派生自ACE_Event_Handler ），因此它继承了第3章至第 6章中描述的并发、同步、动态配置和事件处理功能。

                                                                                          • Since ACE_Svc_Handler derives from ACE_Task (and ACE_Task from ACE_ Event_Handler), it inherits the concurrency, synchronization, dynamic configuration, and event handling capabilities described in Chapters 3 through 6.

                                                                                          • 它规范了反应式网络服务最常见的实践，例如在服务打开时向反应器注册，以及在从反应器取消注册服务时关闭 IPC 端点。

                                                                                          • It codifies the most common practices of reactive network services, such as registering with a reactor when a service is opened and closing the IPC endpoint when unregistering a service from a reactor.

                                                                                          ACE_Svc_Handler的接口如图 7.2 （第 208 页）所示。如图所示，该类模板的参数化方式如下：

                                                                                          The interface for ACE_Svc_Handler is shown in Figure 7.2 (page 208). As shown in the figure, this class template is parameterized by:

                                                                                          图 7.2. ACE_Svc_Handler类

                                                                                          • PEER_STREAM特性类能够在已连接的对等服务处理程序之间传输数据。它还定义了一个关联的PEER_STREAM::PEER_ADDR特性，该特性表示用于标识服务对等节点的地址类。PEER_STREAM参数通常由 ACE IPC 包装器外观实例化，例如C++NPv1 第 3 章中描述的ACE_SOCK_Stream 。

                                                                                          • A PEER_STREAM traits class, which is able to transfer data between connected peer service handlers. It also defines an associated PEER_STREAM::PEER_ADDR trait that represents the address class for identifying the peers to the service. The PEER_ STREAM parameter is often instantiated by one of the ACE IPC wrapper facades, such as the ACE_SOCK_Stream described in Chapter 3 of C++NPv1.

                                                                                          • SYNCH_STRATEGY特性类应用了策略锁定模式 [ POSA2 ]，用于参数化父ACE_Task类中ACE_Message_Queue的同步特性。此参数通常由ACE_NULL_SYNCH或ACE_MT_SYNCH特性类实例化（第 163 页）。

                                                                                          • A SYNCH_STRATEGY traits class, which applies the Strategized Locking pattern [POSA2] to parameterize the synchronization traits of an ACE_Message_Queue in the parent ACE_Task class. This parameter is often instantiated by either the ACE_NULL_SYNCH or ACE_MT_SYNCH traits classes (page 163).

                                                                                          侧边栏 40（第 165 页）描述了 C++ 特性和特性类惯用法。

                                                                                          Sidebar 40 (page 165) describes the C++ traits and traits class idioms.

                                                                                          由于ACE_Svc_Handler是ACE_Event_Handler的子类，因此可以将其实例注册到 ACE Reactor 框架中，用于处理各种类型的事件。例如，它可以注册为处理READ和WRITE事件。当 Reactor 的数据模式套接字句柄准备好接收或发送数据时，其handle_input()和handle_output()钩子方法将分别由 Reactor 自动调用。

                                                                                          Since ACE_Svc_Handler is a descendant of ACE_Event_Handler, an instance of it can be registered with the ACE Reactor framework for various types of events. For example, it can be registered to handle READ and WRITE events. Its handle_input() and handle_output() hook methods will then be dispatched automatically by a reactor when its data-mode socket handle is ready to receive or send data, respectively.

                                                                                          ACE_Svc_Handler类具有丰富的接口，它既导出自身的功能，也导出其父类的功能。因此，我们将它的方法描述分为以下三个类别。

                                                                                          The ACE_Svc_Handler class has a rich interface that exports both its capabilities and the capabilities of its parent classes. We therefore group the description of its methods into the three categories described below.

                                                                                          1. 服务创建和激活方法。ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架可以在编译时和运行时修改各种服务处理程序的创建和初始化方式。默认情况下，ACE_Svc_Handler子类由 Acceptor 或 Connector 工厂动态分配，它们使用以下方法创建和激活该子类：

                                                                                          1. Service creation and activation methods. The ACE Acceptor-Connector framework can modify various service handler creation and initialization aspects at compile time and at run time. By default, an ACE_Svc_Handler subclass is allocated dynamically by an acceptor or connector factory, which use the following methods to create and activate it:
