                                                                                          open()

                                                                                          由接收器或连接器自动调用的钩子方法，用于初始化服务处理程序

                                                                                          Hook method called automatically by an acceptor or connector to initialize a service handler

                                                                                          侧边栏 47解释了为什么 ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架将服务处理程序创建与激活解耦。

                                                                                          Sidebar 47 explains why the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework decouples service handler creation from activation.

                                                                                          可以将指向ACE_Thread_Manager、ACE_Message_Queue和ACE_Reactor对象的指针传递给ACE_Svc_Handler构造函数，以覆盖其默认值。open ()钩子方法可以执行初始化服务处理程序的操作，例如：

                                                                                          Pointers to ACE_Thread_Manager, ACE_Message_Queue, and ACE_Reactor objects can be passed to the ACE_Svc_Handler constructor to override its defaults. The open() hook method can perform activities that initialize a service handler, such as:

                                                                                          • 通过svc()钩子方法生成一个线程（或线程池）来执行服务处理。

                                                                                          • Spawning a thread (or pool of threads) that will perform service processing via the svc() hook method

                                                                                          • 向反应器注册一个或多个事件源，例如输入事件或超时。

                                                                                          • Registering one or more event sources, such as input events or timeouts, with a reactor

                                                                                          • 侧边栏 47：将服务处理程序创建与激活解耦

                                                                                            ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架中将服务激活与服务创建解耦的动机包括：

                                                                                            • 为了使服务处理程序的创建更加灵活， ACE 允许应用程序以高度灵活的方式创建（或重用）服务处理程序。许多应用程序会根据需要动态创建新的处理程序，但有些应用程序可能会重用处理程序，或者对所有连接使用单个处理程序，如侧边栏 53（第 240 页）中所述。

                                                                                            • 为了简化错误处理， ACE 不依赖于 C++NPv1 附录 A.6 中描述的原因的原生 C++ 异常。因此，用于创建服务处理程序的构造函数不应执行任何可能失败的操作。相反，任何此类操作都应放在open()钩子方法中，该方法在激活失败时必须返回 -1。

                                                                                            • 为了确保线程安全， 如果在构造函数中创建线程，则无法保证对象在线程开始运行之前已完全初始化。为了避免这种潜在的竞争条件，ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架将服务处理程序的创建与激活解耦。

                                                                                          • Sidebar 47: Decoupling Service Handler Creation from Activation

                                                                                            The motivations for decoupling service activation from service creation in the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework include:

                                                                                            • To make service handler creation flexible. ACE allows for wide flexibility in the way an application creates (or reuses) service handlers. Many applications create new handlers dynamically as needed, but some may recycle handlers or use a single handler for all connections, as discussed in Sidebar 53 (page 240).

                                                                                            • To simplify error handling. ACE doesn't rely on native C++ exceptions for the reasons described in Appendix A.6 of C++NPv1. The constructor used to create a service handler therefore shouldn't perform any operations that can fail. Instead, any such operations should be placed in the open() hook method, which must return -1 if activation fails.

                                                                                            • To ensure thread safety. If a thread is spawned in a constructor it's not possible to ensure that the object has been initialized completely before the thread begins to run. To avoid this potential race condition, the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework decouples service handler creation from activation.

                                                                                          • 打开日志文件并初始化使用统计信息

                                                                                          • Opening log files and initializing usage statistics

                                                                                          • 初始化锁或其他资源

                                                                                          • Initializing locks or other resources

                                                                                          如果这些初始化活动成功完成，`open()`返回 0。但是，如果发生故障，服务无法或不应继续运行，`open()`必须通过返回 -1 将此事件报告给调用者。由于服务处理程序无法控制其实例化方式，因此必须将`open()`中的故障报告给调用者，以便执行清理活动。默认情况下，如果`open()`返回 -1，则服务处理程序会自动删除，如接收器和连接器工厂的各种`activate_svc_handler()`方法所示（第 221 页）。

                                                                                          If these initialization activities complete successfully, open() returns 0. If a failure occurs and the service cannot or should not continue, however, open() must report this event to its caller by returning -1. Since the service handler doesn't control how it was instantiated, a failure in open() must be reported back to the caller so that cleanup activities can be performed. By default, the service handler is deleted automatically if open() returns -1, as shown in the various activate_svc_handler() methods of the acceptor and connector factories (page 221).

                                                                                          ACE_Svc_Handler定义了open()的默认实现，该实现执行下面所示的一组常见操作：

                                                                                          The ACE_Svc_Handler defines a default implementation of open() that performs the common set of operations shown below:

                                                                                          template <class PEER_STREAM, class SYNCH_STRATEGY> int 
ACE_Svc_Handler<PEER_STREAM, SYNCH_STRATEGY>::open 
    (void *factory) { 
  if (reactor () && reactor ()->register_handler 
      (this, ACE_Event_Handler::READ_MASK) == -1) return -1; 
  else return 0; 
}

                                                                                          ` open() ` 方法的`void *`参数是指向创建服务处理程序的接收器或连接器工厂的指针。默认情况下，服务处理程序会向 Reactor 注册自身，并以响应式的方式处理传入事件。本节的示例部分（第 214 页）展示了一个服务处理程序，该处理程序在其`open()`方法中激活自身，成为一个活动对象并并发处理传入事件。由于服务处理程序在成功激活后负责其生命周期管理，因此它很少与创建并激活它的接收器交互。但是，如第 7.4 节的示例部分所示，如果发生故障，服务处理程序通常会使用连接器来重新建立连接。

                                                                                          The void * parameter to open() is a pointer to the acceptor or connector factory that created the service handler. By default, a service handler registers itself with a reactor and processes incoming events reactively. The Example part of this section (page 214) illustrates a service handler that activates itself in its open() method to become an active object and process incoming events concurrently. Since a service handler is responsible for its life cycle management after being activated successfully, it rarely interacts with the acceptor that created and activated it. As shown in the Example part of Section 7.4, however, a service handler often uses a connector to reestablish connections if failures occur.

                                                                                          2. 服务处理方法。 如上所述，服务处理器可以通过多种方式执行处理。例如，它可以使用 Reactor 以响应式的方式处理事件，也可以通过一个或多个进程或线程并发地处理事件。以下继承自ACE_Svc_Handler祖先类的方法可以被其子类重写，并用于执行服务处理器处理：

                                                                                          2. Service processing methods. As outlined above, a service handler can perform its processing in several ways. For example, it can process events reactively using a reactor or it can process them concurrently via one or more processes or threads. The following methods inherited from ACE_Svc_Handler's ancestors can be overridden by its subclasses and used to perform service handler processing:

                                                                                          方法

                                                                                          Method

                                                                                          描述

                                                                                          Description

                                                                                          svc()

                                                                                          svc()

                                                                                          ACE_Svc_Handler继承了6.3 节中描述的ACE_Task类的svc()钩子方法。在调用服务处理程序的activate()方法之后，其后续的大部分处理都可以在其svc()钩子方法中并发执行。

                                                                                          ACE_Svc_Handler inherits the svc() hook method from the ACE_Task class described in Section 6.3. After a service handler's activate() method is invoked, much of its subsequent processing can be performed concurrently within its svc() hook method.

                                                                                          处理_*（）

                                                                                          handle_*()

                                                                                          ACE_Svc_Handler继承了3.3 节中描述的ACE_Event_Handler类的handle_*()方法。因此，服务处理程序可以向反应器注册自身，以便在发生各种感兴趣的事件时接收回调，例如handle_input() ，如第 3 章所述。

                                                                                          ACE_Svc_Handler inherits the handle_*() methods from the ACE_ Event_Handler class described in Section 3.3. A service handler can therefore register itself with a reactor to receive callbacks, such as handle_ input() , when various events of interest occur, as described in Chapter 3.

                                                                                          peer()

                                                                                          peer()

                                                                                          返回对底层PEER_STREAM 的引用。当服务处理程序的open()钩子方法被调用时，其PEER_STREAM即可使用。任何服务处理方法都可以使用此访问器来获取对已连接的 IPC 机制的引用。

                                                                                          Returns a reference to the underlying PEER_STREAM. A service handler's PEER_STREAM is ready for use when its open() hook method is called. Any of the service processing methods can use this accessor to obtain a reference to the connected IPC mechanism.

                                                                                          尽管ACE_Svc_Handler 的 SYNCH_STRATEGY模板参数对继承自ACE_Task 的ACE_Message_Queue进行了参数化，但它对PEER_STREAM IPC 端点没有影响。ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架单方面地对 IPC 端点的使用进行序列化是不合适的，因为它通常不会被并发访问。例如，服务处理程序可能作为单线程的活动对象运行，或者完全由单线程配置中的 Reactor 的回调驱动。

                                                                                          Although the ACE_Svc_Handler SYNCH_STRATEGY template argument parameterizes the ACE_Message_Queue inherited from ACE_Task, it has no effect on the PEER_STREAM IPC endpoint. It's inappropriate for the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework to unilaterally serialize use of the IPC endpoint since it's often not accessed concurrently. For example, a service handler may run as an active object with a single thread or be driven entirely by callbacks from a reactor in a single-threaded configuration.

                                                                                          然而，服务处理程序的open()钩子方法可能会生成多个线程，这些线程会并发访问其 IPC 端点。在这种情况下，服务处理程序中的应用程序代码必须执行必要的同步操作。《C++NPv1》第 10 章介绍了应用程序可以使用的 ACE 同步机制。例如，如果多个线程写入同一个套接字句柄，最好使用ACE_Thread_Mutex对其进行序列化，以避免将来自不同send()调用的数据交错写入同一个 TCP 字节流中。

                                                                                          It is possible, however, for a service handler's open() hook method to spawn multiple threads that access its IPC endpoint concurrently. In such cases, the application code in the service handler must perform any necessary synchronization. Chapter 10 of C++NPv1 describes ACE synchronization mechanisms that applications can use. For example, if more than one thread writes to the same socket handle, it's a good idea to serialize it with an ACE_Thread_Mutex to avoid interleaving data from different send() calls into the same TCP bytestream.

                                                                                          3. 服务关闭方法。 服务处理程序可以以多种方式使用。例如，它可以由 Reactor 分发，在自己的线程或进程中运行，或者作为线程池的一部分。因此， ACE_Svc_Handler类提供了以下方法来关闭服务处理程序：

                                                                                          3. Service shutdown methods. A service handler can be used in many ways. For example, it can be dispatched by a reactor, run in its own thread or process, or form part of a thread pool. The ACE_Svc_Handler class therefore provides the following methods to shut a service handler down:

                                                                                          方法

                                                                                          Method

                                                                                          描述

                                                                                          Description

                                                                                          破坏（）

                                                                                          destroy()

                                                                                          可以直接调用以关闭服务处理程序。

                                                                                          Can be called to shut a service handler down directly

                                                                                          handle_close()

                                                                                          handle_close()

                                                                                          通过反应器的回调函数调用destroy()函数

                                                                                          Calls destroy() via a callback from a reactor

                                                                                          关闭（）

                                                                                          close()

                                                                                          从服务线程退出时调用handle_close()

                                                                                          Calls handle_close() on exit from a service thread

                                                                                          服务处理程序通常会根据应用程序定义的协议关闭，例如当对等服务处理程序关闭连接或发生严重通信错误时。然而，无论具体情况如何，服务处理程序的关闭处理通常都会撤销其open()钩子方法执行的操作，并在需要时删除该服务处理程序。上表列出的关闭方法可以分为以下三类：

                                                                                          Service handlers are often closed in accordance with an application-defined protocol, such as when a peer service handler closes a connection or when a serious communication error occurs. Regardless of the particular circumstance, however, a service handler's shutdown processing usually undoes the actions performed by the service handler's open() hook method, and deletes the service handler when needed. The shutdown methods listed in the table above can be divided into the following three categories:

                                                                                          • 直接关闭。 应用程序可以直接调用destroy()方法来关闭服务处理程序。此方法执行以下步骤：

                                                                                          • Direct shutdown. An application can invoke the destroy() method directly to shut a service handler down. This method performs the following steps:

                                                                                          1. 从反应器中移除处理程序。

                                                                                          2. Remove the handler from the reactor.

                                                                                          3. 取消与处理程序关联的所有计时器。

                                                                                          4. Cancel any timers associated with the handler.

                                                                                          5. 关闭对等流对象以避免句柄泄漏。

                                                                                          6. Close the peer stream object to avoid handle leaks.

                                                                                          7. 如果对象是动态分配的，请将其删除以避免内存泄漏。

                                                                                          8. If the object was allocated dynamically, delete it to avoid memory leaks.

                                                                                          C++NPv1 的第三章解释了为什么销毁一个派生自ACE_SOCK的对象不会关闭封装的套接字。然而， ACE_Svc_Handler处于更高的抽象层次，并且由于它是框架的一部分，因此它规范了常见的用法模式。由于关闭套接字是关闭服务处理程序的一个常见步骤，ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架会自动执行此任务。

                                                                                          Chapter 3 of C++NPv1 explained why the destruction of an ACE_SOCK-derived object doesn't close the encapsulated socket. ACE_Svc_Handler is at a higher level of abstraction, however, and, because it's part of a framework, it codifies common usage patterns. Since closing the socket is such a common part of shutting down a service handler, the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework performs this task automatically.

                                                                                          ACE_Svc_Handler使用侧边栏 48 （第 212 页）中描述的 C++ 存储类跟踪器惯用法来检查它是动态分配的还是静态分配的。因此，它的destroy()方法可以判断服务处理程序是否是动态分配的，如果是，则将其删除。如果服务处理程序不是动态分配的，则 destroy()方法不会将其删除。

                                                                                          ACE_Svc_Handler uses the Storage Class Tracker C++ idiom described in Sidebar 48 (page 212) to check if it was allocated dynamically or statically. Its destroy() method can therefore tell if a service handler was allocated dynamically and, if so, delete it. If the service handler was not allocated dynamically, destroy() doesn't delete it.

                                                                                          如果服务处理程序已注册到 Reactor，最好不要从未运行 Reactor 事件循环的线程中调用`destroy()` 。这样做可能会从正在向其分发事件的 Reactor 中删除服务处理程序对象，导致未定义（且不希望）的行为（这类似于第 196 页侧边栏 46中讨论的问题）。因此，与其直接调用`destroy()` ，不如使用`ACE_Reactor::notify()`方法（第 77 页）将控制权转移到正在分发 Reactor 事件的线程，这样可以更安全地使用`destroy()`。然而，更好的方法是修改设计，使用接下来将要描述的响应式关闭技术。

                                                                                          If a service handler is registered with a reactor, it's best to not call destroy() from a thread that's not running the reactor event loop. Doing so could delete the service handler object out from under a reactor that's dispatching events to it, causing undefined (and undesired) behavior (this is similar to the issue discussed in Sidebar 46 on page 196). Rather than calling destroy() directly, therefore, use the ACE_Reactor::notify() method (page 77) to transfer control to a thread dispatching reactor events, where destroy() is safer to use. An even better approach, however, is to alter the design to use the reactive shutdown technique described next.

                                                                                          • 响应式关闭。 当ACE_Svc_Handler注册到 ACE Reactor 框架时，它通常会检测到对等应用程序已关闭连接，并在本地启动关闭操作。当被指示从其内部表中移除服务处理程序时， Reactor 会调用该处理程序的handle_close()方法，通常是在对等应用程序关闭连接后，服务处理程序的handle_input()方法返回 -1 时。响应式处理程序应将所有关闭操作整合到handle_close()方法中，如侧边栏 9 （第 51 页）所述。如图 7.3所示，默认的handle_close()方法会调用destroy()方法（第 211 页）。如果默认行为不符合预期，可以在子类中重写handle_close()方法。

                                                                                            图 7.3. ACE_Svc_Handler的反应式关闭

                                                                                          • Reactive shutdown. When an ACE_Svc_Handler is registered with the ACE Reactor framework, it often detects that the peer application has closed the connection and initiates shutdown locally. A reactor invokes a service handler's handle_close() method when instructed to remove the handler from its internal tables, usually when the service handler's handle_input() method returns -1 after a peer closes a connection. Reactive handlers should consolidate shutdown activities in the handle_close() method, as discussed in Sidebar 9 (page 51). As shown in Figure 7.3, the default handle_ close() method calls the destroy() method (page 211). The handle_close() method can be overridden in subclasses if its default behavior is undesirable.

                                                                                            Figure 7.3. Reactive Shutdown of ACE_Svc_Handler

                                                                                          • 侧边栏 48：确定服务处理程序的存储类

                                                                                            在 ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架中，ACE_Svc_Handler对象通常由ACE_Acceptor和ACE_Connector工厂动态分配。然而，在某些情况下，服务处理程序的分配方式可能不同，例如静态分配或栈分配。为了正确回收处理程序的内存，同时避免将其与可能实例化的类和工厂紧密耦合， ACE_Svc_Handler类使用了 C++存储类跟踪器 (Storage Class Tracker )惯用法 [ vR96 ]。该惯用法执行以下步骤，以自动确定服务处理程序是静态分配还是动态分配，并据此采取相应的操作：

                                                                                            1. ACE_Svc_Handler重载了new 运算符，该运算符动态分配内存，并在线程特定的存储中设置一个标志来记录这一事实。

                                                                                            2. ACE_Svc_Handler构造函数检查线程特定的存储，以查看对象是否是动态分配的，并将结果记录在数据成员中。

                                                                                            3. 当最终调用destroy()方法时，它会检查“动态分配”标志。如果对象是动态分配的，则destroy()会将其删除；否则，它会直接让ACE_Svc_Handler析构函数在对象超出作用域时进行清理。

                                                                                          • Sidebar 48: Determining a Service Handler's Storage Class

                                                                                            ACE_Svc_Handler objects are often allocated dynamically by the ACE_Acceptor and ACE_Connector factories in the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework. There are situations, however, when service handlers are allocated differently, such as statically or on the stack. To reclaim a handler's memory correctly, without tightly coupling it with the classes and factories that may instantiate it, the ACE_Svc_Handler class uses the C++ Storage Class Tracker idiom [vR96]. This idiom performs the following steps to determine automatically whether a service handler was allocated statically or dynamically and act accordingly:

                                                                                            1. ACE_Svc_Handler overloads operator new, which allocates memory dynamically and sets a flag in thread-specific storage that notes this fact.

                                                                                            2. The ACE_Svc_Handler constructor inspects thread-specific storage to see if the object was allocated dynamically, recording the result in a data member.

                                                                                            3. When the destroy() method is eventually called, it checks the "dynamically allocated" flag. If the object was allocated dynamically, destroy() deletes it; if not, it will simply let the ACE_Svc_Handler destructor clean up the object when it goes out of scope.

                                                                                          • 线程关闭。 如第 188 页所述，当服务处理程序的`svc()`方法返回时，任务的每个线程都会调用该服务处理程序的`close()`钩子方法。响应式服务使用 Reactor 关闭机制来启动关闭活动，而正在处理对等连接的活动线程可以在对等连接关闭时直接返回。由于单线程执行服务是一种常见用例，因此默认的`ACE_Svc_Handler::close() ` 钩子方法实现会调用上述的 ` handle_close()`方法。如果默认行为不理想，可以在子类中重写此方法以执行特定于应用程序的清理代码。

                                                                                          • Thread shutdown. As described on page 188, a service handler's close() hook method is called in each of a task's threads when its svc() method returns. Whereas a reactive service uses the reactor shutdown mechanism to initiate shutdown activity, an active thread that's handling a peer connection can simply return when the peer closes the connection. Since a single thread executing the service is a common use case, the default ACE_Svc_Handler::close() hook method implementation calls the handle_ close() method described above. This method can be overridden in subclasses to perform application-specific cleanup code if its default behavior is undesirable.

                                                                                          例子

                                                                                          Example

                                                                                          本示例演示如何使用ACE_Svc_Handler类实现基于 C++NPv1 第 5 章所述线程/连接并发模型的日志服务器。示例代码位于TPC_Logging_Server.cpp和TPC_Logging_Server.h文件中。头文件声明了示例类，并首先包含了必要的头文件。

                                                                                          This example illustrates how to use the ACE_Svc_Handler class to implement a logging server based on the thread-per-connection concurrency model described in Chapter 5 of C++NPv1. The example code is in the TPC_Logging_Server.cpp and TPC_ Logging_Server.h files. The header file declares the example classes, and starts by including the necessary header files.

                                                                                          #include "ace/Acceptor.h" 
#include "ace/INET_Addr.h" 
#include "ace/Reactor.h" 
#include "ace/Svc_Handler.h" 
#include "ace/FILE_IO.h" 
#include "Logging_Handler.h"

                                                                                          下面显示的 TPC_Logging_Handler继承自ACE_Svc_Handler。

                                                                                          The TPC_Logging_Handler shown below inherits from ACE_Svc_Handler.

                                                                                          class TPC_Logging_Handler 
  : public ACE_Svc_Handler<ACE_SOCK_Stream, ACE_NULL_SYNCH> {

                                                                                          我们使用ACE_SOCK_Stream数据传输类和ACE_NULL_SYNCH特性类来参数化ACE_Svc_Handler模板，其中 ACE_NULL_SYNCH 特性类指定了一种空操作同步策略。侧边栏 49（第 214 页）解释了 ACE 如何处理不支持模板中特性类的 C++ 编译器。

                                                                                          We parameterize the ACE_Svc_Handler template with an ACE_SOCK_Stream data transfer class and the ACE_NULL_SYNCH traits class, which designates a no-op synchronization strategy. Sidebar 49 (page 214) explains how ACE handles C++ compilers that don't support traits classes in templates.

                                                                                          TPC_Logging_Handler定义了以下两个数据成员，它们在其构造函数中初始化。

                                                                                          TPC_Logging_Handler defines the following two data members that are initialized in its constructor.

                                                                                          protected: 
  ACE_FILE_IO log_file_; // File of log records. 

  // Connection to peer service handler. 
  Logging_Handler logging_handler_; 

public: 
  TPC_Logging_Handler (): logging_handler_ (log_file_) {}

                                                                                          和往常一样，我们重用C++NPv1 第 4 章中的Logging_Handler，从套接字句柄参数中读取日志记录并将其存储到ACE_Message_Block中。

                                                                                          As usual, we reuse the Logging_Handler from Chapter 4 of C++NPv1 to read a log record out of the socket handle parameter and store it into an ACE_Message_Block.

                                                                                          侧边栏 49：缺少特性职业支持的变通方法

                                                                                          Sidebar 49: Workarounds for Lack of Traits Class Support

                                                                                          仔细查看 ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架的源代码，你会发现ACE_Acceptor、ACE_Connector和ACE_Svc_Handler的 IPC 类模板参数是一个宏，而不是类型参数。同样， ACE_Svc_Handler的同步策略参数也是一个宏，而不是类型参数。ACE 使用这些宏来规避某些 C++ 编译器对 traits 类和模板的支持不足的问题。为了在这些平台上实现可移植性，ACE 类类型（例如ACE_INET_Addr或ACE_Thread_Mutex）必须作为显式模板参数传递，而不能像ACE_SOCK_Addr::PEER_ADDR或ACE_MT_SYNCH::MUTEX那样作为 traits 类的 traits 来访问。

                                                                                          If you examine the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework source code closely, you'll notice that the IPC class template argument to ACE_Acceptor, ACE_Connector, and ACE_Svc_Handler is a macro rather than a type parameter. Likewise, the synchronization strategy parameter to the ACE_Svc_Handler is a macro rather than a type parameter. ACE uses these macros to work around the lack of support for traits classes and templates in some C++ compilers. To work portably on those platforms, ACE class types, such as ACE_INET_Addr or ACE_Thread_Mutex, must be passed as explicit template parameters, rather than accessed as traits of traits classes, such as ACE_SOCK_Addr::PEER_ADDR or ACE_MT_SYNCH::MUTEX.

                                                                                          为了简化应用程序开发人员的工作，ACE 定义了一组宏，这些宏可以根据条件展开为相应的类型。例如，下表描述了ACE_SOCK*宏：

                                                                                          To simplify the efforts of application developers, ACE defines a set of macros that conditionally expand to the appropriate types. For example, the following table describes the ACE_SOCK* macros:

                                                                                          ACE 级

                                                                                          ACE Class

                                                                                          描述

                                                                                          Description

                                                                                          ACE_SOCK_ACCEPTOR

                                                                                          ACE_SOCK_ACCEPTOR

                                                                                          展开为ACE_SOCK_Acceptor或ACE_SOCK_Acceptor和ACE_INET_Addr

                                                                                          Expands to either ACE_SOCK_Acceptor or ACE_ SOCK_Acceptor and ACE_INET_Addr

                                                                                          ACE_SOCK_CONNECTOR

                                                                                          ACE_SOCK_CONNECTOR

                                                                                          展开为ACE_SOCK_Connector或ACE_SOCK_Connector和ACE_INET_Addr

                                                                                          Expands to either ACE_SOCK_Connector or to ACE_ SOCK_Connector and ACE_INET_Addr

                                                                                          ACE_SOCK_STREAM

                                                                                          ACE_SOCK_STREAM

                                                                                          展开为ACE_SOCK_Stream或ACE_SOCK_Stream和ACE_INET_Addr

                                                                                          Expands to either ACE_SOCK_Stream or to ACE_ SOCK_Stream and ACE_INET_Addr

                                                                                          这些宏提供寻址类，可与 ACE 支持的所有 C++ 编译器正常工作。例如，如果支持模板特性，它们会展开为一个类；如果不支持，则会展开为两个类。

                                                                                          These macros supply addressing classes that work properly with all C++ compilers supported by ACE. For example, they expand to a single class if template traits are supported and two classes if not.

                                                                                          ACE 内部使用` ACE_SOCK_STREAM`宏作为 ` ACE_Svc_Handler`模板宏的 IPC 类参数，而不是 ` ACE_SOCK_Stream`类，以避免将代码移植到旧版 C++ 编译器时出现问题。大多数现代 C++ 编译器已不再存在这些问题，因此除非移植到旧版编译器至关重要，否则您无需在应用程序代码中使用这些宏。为简单起见，本书中的代码假设您的 C++ 编译器完全支持模板特性和特性类，因此未使用 ACE 宏。但是，ACE 附带的 C++NPv2 示例代码确实使用了这些宏，以确保可移植到所有 ACE 平台。

                                                                                          ACE uses the ACE_SOCK_STREAM macro internally as the IPC class parameter to the ACE_Svc_Handler template macro rather than the ACE_SOCK_Stream class to avoid problems when porting code to older C++ compilers. Most modern C++ compilers no longer have these problems, so you needn't use these macros in your application code unless portability to legacy compilers is essential. For simplicity, the code in this book assumes that your C++ compiler fully supports template traits and traits classes, and therefore doesn't use the ACE macros. The C++NPv2 example code included with ACE, however, does use the macros to ensure portability to all ACE platforms.

                                                                                          每个TPC_Logging_Handler实例都由TPC_Logging_Acceptor（第 222 页）在收到来自对等连接器的连接请求时动态分配。TPC_Logging_Handler重写了ACE_Svc_Handler::open()钩子方法来初始化处理程序，如下所示：

                                                                                          Each instance of TPC_Logging_Handler is allocated dynamically by the TPC_ Logging_Acceptor (page 222) when a connection request arrives from a peer connector. TPC_Logging_Handler overrides the ACE_Svc_Handler::open() hook method to initialize the handler, as shown below:

                                                                                          Lines 2–17 Initialize a log file using the same logic described in the Logging_Event_ Handler::open() method (page 59).

                                                                                          第 19 行从服务处理程序借用套接字句柄并将其分配给logging_handler_，然后使用该句柄接收和处理客户端日志记录。

                                                                                          Line 19 Borrow the socket handle from the service handler and assign it to logging_ handler_, which is then used to receive and process client log records.

                                                                                          第 21 行将TPC_Logging_Handler转换为活动对象。新生成的独立线程运行以下TPC_Logging_Handler::svc()钩子方法：

                                                                                          Line 21 Convert TPC_Logging_Handler into an active object. The newly spawned detached thread runs the following TPC_Logging_Handler::svc() hook method:

                                                                                            virtual int svc () { 
    for (;;) 
      switch (logging_handler_.log_record ()) { 
      case -1: return -1; // Error. 
      case 0: return 0; // Client closed connection. 
      default: continue; // Default case. 
      } 
      /* NOTREACHED */ 
        return 0; 
  } 
};

                                                                                          此方法仅专注于读取和处理客户端日志记录。当`log_record()`方法检测到其对等服务处理程序已关闭连接或发生错误时，我们会跳出for循环并从方法返回。方法返回会导致线程退出，进而触发`ACE_Task::svc_run()`调用对象上继承的`ACE_Svc_Handler::close()`方法。默认情况下，此方法会关闭对等流并删除服务处理程序（如果它是动态分配的，如第 210 页表格中所述）。由于线程是使用`THR_DETACHED`标志创建的，因此无需等待其退出。

                                                                                          This method focuses solely on reading and processing client log records. We break out of the for loop and return from the method when the log_record() method detects that its peer service handler has closed the connection or when an error occurs. Returning from the method causes the thread to exit, which in turn triggers ACE_Task::svc_run() to call the inherited ACE_Svc_Handler::close() method on the object. By default, this method closes the peer stream and deletes the service handler if it was allocated dynamically, as described in the table on page 210. Since the thread was spawned using the THR_DETACHED flag, there's no need to wait for it to exit.

                                                                                          您可能会注意到，如果服务器在对端关闭套接字之前被要求关闭， TPC_Logging_Handler::svc()无法停止线程的处理。添加此功能留给读者作为练习。侧边栏 50中介绍了一些实现此功能的常用技术。

                                                                                          You may notice that TPC_Logging_Handler::svc() provides no way to stop the thread's processing if the server is somehow asked to shut down before the peer closes the socket. Adding this capability is left as an exercise for the reader. Some common techniques for providing this feature are described in Sidebar 50.

                                                                                          侧边栏 50：关闭阻塞服务线程的技术

                                                                                          Sidebar 50: Techniques for Shutting Down Blocked Service Threads

                                                                                          服务线程通常执行阻塞式 I/O 操作，如TPC_Logging_Handler::svc()函数（第 215 页）中每个连接一个线程的并发模型所示。然而，如果必须在服务线程正常完成之前将其停止，则这种模型的简单性可能会导致问题。强制服务线程关闭的一些技术及其潜在缺点包括：

                                                                                          Service threads often perform blocking I/O operations, as shown by the thread-per-connection concurrency model in TPC_Logging_Handler::svc() (page 215). If the service thread must be stopped before its normal completion, however, the simplicity of this model can cause problems. Some techniques for forcing service threads to shut down, along with their potential drawbacks, include:

                                                                                          • 退出服务器进程，让操作系统突然终止与对等方的连接，以及任何其他打开的资源，例如文件（在本章示例中为日志文件）。这种方法可能导致数据丢失和资源泄漏。例如，System V IPC 对象在这种方法下就很容易受到攻击。

                                                                                          • Exit the server process, letting the OS abruptly terminate the peer connection, as well as any other open resources, such as files (a log file, in the case of this chapter's examples). This approach can result in lost data and leaked resources. For example, System V IPC objects are vulnerable in this approach.

                                                                                          • 启用异步线程取消功能并取消服务线程。这种设计不具备可移植性，如果编程不当，还可能浪费资源。

                                                                                          • Enable asynchronous thread cancellation and cancel the service thread. This design isn't portable and can also abandon resources if not programmed correctly.

                                                                                          • 关闭套接字，希望阻塞的 I/O 调用能够中止并终止服务线程。这种方法有时有效，但并非在所有平台上都适用。

                                                                                          • Close the socket, hoping that the blocked I/O call will abort and end the service thread. This solution can be effective, but doesn't work on all platforms.

                                                                                          • 与其阻塞 I/O，不如使用定时 I/O 并检查关闭标志，或者使用ACE_Thread_Manager 的协作式取消机制，以便在 I/O 尝试之间干净地关闭线程。这种方法也有效，但可能会延迟关闭，延迟时间最长可达指定的超时时间。

                                                                                          • Rather than blocking I/O, use timed I/O and check a shutdown flag, or use the ACE_Thread_Manager cooperative cancellation mechanism, to cleanly shut down between I/O attempts. This approach is also effective, but may delay the shutdown by up to the specified timeout.

                                                                                            7.3 ACE_Acceptor 类

                                                                                            7.3 The ACE_Acceptor Class

                                                                                            动机

                                                                                            Motivation

                                                                                            许多面向连接的服务器应用程序将连接建立和服务初始化代码紧密耦合，导致现有代码难以重用。例如，如果您查看Logging_Acceptor（第 58 页）、Logging_Acceptor_Ex（第 67 页）、Logging_Acceptor_WFMO（第 112 页）、CLD_Acceptor（第 176 页）和TP_Logging_Acceptor（第 193 页）类，您会发现每个日志处理程序都重写了handle_input()方法，即使代码的结构和行为几乎相同。ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架定义了ACE_Acceptor类，因此应用程序开发人员无需重复编写此代码。

                                                                                            Many connection-oriented server applications tightly couple their connection establishment and service initialization code in ways that make it hard to reuse existing code. For example, if you examine the Logging_Acceptor (page 58), Logging_Acceptor_Ex (page 67), Logging_Acceptor_WFMO (page 112), CLD_Acceptor (page 176), and TP_Logging_Acceptor (page 193) classes, you'll see that the handle_input() method was rewritten for each logging handler, even though the structure and behavior of the code was nearly identical. The ACE Acceptor-Connector framework defines the ACE_Acceptor class so that application developers needn't rewrite this code repeatedly.

                                                                                            等级能力

                                                                                            Class Capabilities

                                                                                            ACE_Acceptor是一个工厂类，它实现了 Acceptor-Connector 模式中的 Acceptor 角色 [ POSA2 ]。此类提供以下功能：

                                                                                            ACE_Acceptor is a factory that implements the Acceptor role in the Acceptor-Connector pattern [POSA2]. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                            • 它将被动连接建立和服务初始化逻辑与服务处理程序在连接和初始化后执行的处理逻辑解耦。

                                                                                            • It decouples the passive connection establishment and service initialization logic from the processing performed by a service handler after it's connected and initialized.

                                                                                            • 它提供了一个被动模式的进程间通信 (IPC) 端点，用于监听和接受来自对等节点的连接。该 IPC 端点的类型可以通过 ACE 的许多 IPC 包装器外观类进行参数化，从而将底层连接机制与应用层服务初始化策略分离。

                                                                                            • It provides a passive-mode IPC endpoint used to listen for and accept connections from peers. The type of this IPC endpoint can be parameterized with many of ACE's IPC wrapper facade classes, thereby separating lower-level connection mechanisms from application-level service initialization policies.

                                                                                            • 它自动执行被动连接 IPC 端点并创建/激活其关联的服务处理程序所需的步骤。

                                                                                            • It automates the steps necessary to connect the IPC endpoint passively and create/activate its associated service handler.

                                                                                            • 由于ACE_Acceptor派生自ACE_Service_Object ，因此它继承了第3章和第5章中描述的事件处理和配置功能。

                                                                                            • Since ACE_Acceptor is derived from ACE_Service_Object, it inherits the event-handling and configuration capabilities described in Chapters 3 and 5.

                                                                                            ACE_Acceptor的接口如图 7.4所示。如图所示，该类模板的参数化方式如下：

                                                                                            The interface for ACE_Acceptor is shown in Figure 7.4. As shown in the figure, this class template is parameterized by:

                                                                                            图 7.4. ACE_Acceptor类

                                                                                            • SVC_HANDLER类提供了一个接口，用于处理对等服务中由客户端、服务器或客户端和服务器角色共同定义的服务。此参数由第7.2 节中描述的 ACE_Svc_Handler 类的子类实例化。

                                                                                            • An SVC_HANDLER class, which provides an interface for processing services defined by clients, servers, or both client and server roles in peer-to-peer services. This parameter is instantiated by a subclass of the ACE_Svc_Handler class described in Section 7.2.

                                                                                            • PEER_ACCEPTOR类能够被动地接受客户端连接。此参数通常指定为 ACE IPC 包装器外观之一，例如C++NPv1 第 3 章中描述的ACE_SOCK_Acceptor 。

                                                                                            • A PEER_ACCEPTOR class, which is able to accept client connections passively. This parameter is often specified as one of the ACE IPC wrapper facades, such as the ACE_SOCK_Acceptor described in Chapter 3 of C++NPv1.

                                                                                            由于ACE_Acceptor是ACE_Event_Handler的子类，因此可以将其实例注册到 ACE Reactor 框架中以处理ACCEPT事件。当客户端收到新的连接请求时，其handle_input()方法将由 Reactor 自动调用。

                                                                                            Since ACE_Acceptor is a descendant of ACE_Event_Handler, an instance of it can be registered with the ACE Reactor framework to process ACCEPT events. Its handle_input() method will be dispatched automatically by a reactor when a new connection request arrives from a client.

                                                                                            ACE_Acceptor类具有灵活的接口，应用程序开发人员可以对其进行广泛的自定义。因此，我们将它的方法描述分为以下两类。

                                                                                            The ACE_Acceptor class has a flexible interface that can be customized extensively by application developers. We therefore group the description of its methods into the two categories described below.

                                                                                            1. Acceptor 的初始化、销毁和访问器方法。 以下方法用于初始化和销毁​​ ACE_Acceptor：

                                                                                            2. 连接建立和服务处理程序初始化方法。 以下ACE_Acceptor方法可用于被动建立连接并初始化其关联的服务处理程序：

                                                                                            2. Connection establishment and service handler initialization methods. The following ACE_Acceptor methods can be used to establish connections passively and initialize their associated service handlers:

                                                                                            Description

                                                                                            处理输入()

                                                                                            handle_input()

                                                                                            当对等连接器收到连接请求时，反应器会调用此模板方法。它可以使用以下三种方法来自动执行被动连接 IPC 端点以及创建和激活其关联的服务处理程序所需的步骤。

                                                                                            This template method is called by a reactor when a connection request arrives from a peer connector. It can use the three methods outlined below to automate the steps necessary to connect an IPC endpoint passively, and to create and activate its associated service handler.

                                                                                            make_svc_handler()

                                                                                            make_svc_handler()

                                                                                            该工厂方法创建一个服务处理程序，用于处理通过其连接的 IPC 端点从其对等服务处理程序发出的数据请求。

                                                                                            This factory method creates a service handler to process data requests emanating from its peer service handler via its connected IPC endpoint.

                                                                                            accept_svc_handler()

                                                                                            accept_svc_handler()

                                                                                            此钩子方法使用接收者的被动模式 IPC 端点来创建连接的 IPC 端点，并将端点封装为与服务处理程序关联的 I/O 句柄。

                                                                                            This hook method uses the acceptor's passive-mode IPC endpoint to create a connected IPC endpoint and encapsulate the endpoint with an I/O handle that's associated with the service handler.

                                                                                            activate_svc_handler()

                                                                                            activate_svc_handler()

                                                                                            此钩子方法调用服务处理程序的open()钩子方法，从而允许服务处理程序完成自身的初始化。

                                                                                            This hook method invokes the service handler's open() hook method, which allows the service handler to finish initializing itself.

                                                                                            图 7.5 （第 220 页）显示了ACE_Acceptor在其handle_input()模板方法中执行的默认步骤：

                                                                                            Figure 7.5 (page 220) shows the default steps that an ACE_Acceptor performs in its handle_input() template method:

                                                                                            图 7.5. ACE_Acceptor连接接受步骤

                                                                                            1. 它调用make_svc_handler()工厂方法来动态创建服务处理程序。

                                                                                            2. It calls the make_svc_handler() factory method to create a service handler dynamically.

                                                                                            3. 它调用accept_svc_handler() hook 方法来接受连接并将其存储在服务处理程序中。

                                                                                            4. It calls the accept_svc_handler() hook method to accept a connection and store it in the service handler.

                                                                                            5. 它调用activate_svc_handler()钩子方法，以允许服务处理程序完成自身的初始化。

                                                                                            6. It calls the activate_svc_handler() hook method to allow the service handler to finish initializing itself.

                                                                                            侧边栏 47（第 209 页）解释了为什么ACE_Acceptor::handle_input()模板方法将服务处理程序创建与激活解耦。

                                                                                            Sidebar 47 (page 209) explains why the ACE_Acceptor::handle_input() template method decouples service handler creation from activation.

                                                                                            ACE_Acceptor::handle_input()使用模板方法模式 [ GoF ]，允许应用程序设计人员更改上述三个步骤中任意一个的行为。因此，子类可以重写make_svc_handler()、accept_svc_handler()和activate_svc_handler()的默认行为。这种设计允许进行一系列的行为修改和自定义，以支持多种用例。ACE_Acceptor ::handle_input()的三个主要变体将在下文中详细描述和说明。

                                                                                            ACE_Acceptor::handle_input() uses the Template Method pattern [GoF] to allow application designers to change the behavior of any of the three steps outlined above. The default behaviors of make_svc_handler(), accept_svc_handler(), and activate_svc_handler() can therefore be overridden by subclasses. This design allows a range of behavior modification and customization to support many use cases. The three primary variation points in ACE_Acceptor::handle_input() are described and illustrated in more detail below.

                                                                                            1.创建服务处理程序。ACE_Acceptor ::handle_input()模板方法调用make_svc_handler()工厂方法来创建一个新的服务处理程序。make_svc_handler ()的默认实现如下所示：

                                                                                            1. Service handler creation. The ACE_Acceptor::handle_input() template method calls the make_svc_handler() factory method to create a new service handler. The default implementation of make_svc_handler() is shown below:

                                                                                            1 template <class SVC_HANDLER, class PEER_ACCEPTOR> int 
2 ACE_Acceptor<SVC_HANDLER, PEER_ACCEPTOR>::make_svc_handler 
3     (SVC_HANDLER *&sh) { 
4   ACE_NEW_RETURN (sh, SVC_HANDLER, -1); 
5   sh->reactor (reactor ()); 
6   return 0; 
7}

                                                                                            第 4 行：动态分配SVC_HANDLER实例。SVC_HANDLER构造函数应将所有指针数据成员初始化为NULL ，以避免在ACE_Acceptor::handle_input()模板方法中检测到故障且必须关闭SVC_HANDLER时可能出现的微妙的运行时问题。

                                                                                            Line 4 Allocate an instance of SVC_HANDLER dynamically. The SVC_HANDLER constructor should initialize any pointer data members to NULL to avoid subtle run-time problems that can otherwise arise if failures are detected in ACE_Acceptor::handle_input() template method and the SVC_HANDLER must be closed.

                                                                                            第 5 行将新创建的服务处理程序的反应器设置为与接收器关联的同一反应器。

                                                                                            Line 5 Set the reactor of the newly created service handler to the same reactor associated with the acceptor.

                                                                                            子类可以重写make_svc_handler()函数，以任何它们喜欢的方式创建服务处理程序，例如：

                                                                                            Subclasses can override make_svc_handler() to create service handlers in any way that they like, such as:

                                                                                            • 根据某些标准（例如可用 CPU 数量、存储的配置参数、计算的历史负载平均值或当前主机工作负载）创建服务处理程序。

                                                                                            • Creating service handlers based on some criteria, such as the number of CPUs available, a stored configuration parameter, calculated historical load average, or the current host workload.

                                                                                            • 始终返回单例服务处理程序（第 247 页）或

                                                                                            • Always returning a singleton service handler (page 247) or

                                                                                            • 使用第 5 章中描述的ACE_Service_Config或ACE_DLL类，从 DLL 动态链接处理程序。

                                                                                            • Dynamically linking the handler from a DLL by using the ACE_Service_Config or ACE_DLL classes described in Chapter 5.

                                                                                            2. 建立连接。ACE_Acceptor ::handle_input()模板方法调用accept_svc_handler()钩子方法，以被动地接受来自对等连接器 的新连接。此方法的默认实现委托给PEER_ACCEPTOR::accept()方法，如下所示：

                                                                                            2. Connection establishment. The ACE_Acceptor::handle_input() template method calls the accept_svc_handler() hook method to passively accept a new connection from a peer connector. The default implementation of this method delegates to the PEER_ACCEPTOR::accept() method, as shown below:

                                                                                            template <class SVC_HANDLER, class PEER_ACCEPTOR> int 
ACE_Acceptor<SVC_HANDLER, PEER_ACCEPTOR>::accept_svc_handler 
    (SVC_HANDLER *sh) { 
  if (acceptor ().accept (sh->peer ()) == -1) 
  { sh->close (0); return -1; } 
  return 0; 
}

                                                                                            为了使此accept_svc_handler()实现能够编译，PEER_ACCEPTOR模板参数必须具有一个公共的accept()方法。ACE_SOCK_Acceptor （C++NPv1 第 3 章）满足此要求，大多数 ACE IPC 包装器外观也满足此要求。

                                                                                            For this accept_svc_handler() implementation to compile, the PEER_ACCEPTOR template parameter must have a public accept() method. ACE_SOCK_Acceptor (Chapter 3 of C++NPv1) meets this requirement, as do most ACE IPC wrapper facades.

                                                                                            子类可以重写`accept_svc_handler()`方法，以添加连接被接受之前或之后、但尚未使用之前所需的额外处理。例如，此方法可以在激活服务之前验证新连接。身份验证过程可以验证对端的主机和/或端口号、执行登录序列，或在新套接字上建立 SSL 会话。第222 页的示例部分演示了如何通过重写 ` accept_svc_handler() ` 钩子方法来实现身份验证，从而在激活服务之前执行 SSL 身份验证。但是，在这种情况下与对端进行数据交换时务必谨慎。如果通过 Reactor 回调调用`activate_svc_handler()`，则应用程序的整个事件分发循环可能会阻塞过长的时间。

                                                                                            Subclasses can override accept_svc_handler() to add extra processing required before or after the connection is accepted, but before it can be used. For example, this method can authenticate a new connection before activating the service. The authentication process could validate the peer's host and/or port number, perform a login sequence, or set up an SSL session on the new socket. The Example section on page 222 illustrates how to implement authentication by overriding the accept_svc_handler() hook method to perform SSL authentication before activating the service. Use caution, however, when performing exchanges with the peer in this situation. If activate_svc_handler() is called via a reactor callback, the application's entire event dispatching loop may block for an unacceptably long amount of time.

                                                                                            3. 服务处理程序激活。ACE_Acceptor ::handle_input() 模板方法会调用activate_svc_handler()钩子方法来激活新服务，前提是该服务已创建并已接受新的连接。此方法的默认行为如下所示：

                                                                                            3. Service handler activation. The ACE_Acceptor::handle_input() template method calls the activate_svc_handler() hook method to activate a new service after it has been created and a new connection has been accepted on its behalf. The default behavior of this method is shown below:

                                                                                             1 template <class SVC_HANDLER, class PEER_ACCEPTOR> int 
 2 ACE_Acceptor<SVC_HANDLER, PEER_ACCEPTOR>::activate_svc_handler 
 3     (SVC_HANDLER *sh) { 
 4   int result = 0; 
 5   if (ACE_BIT_ENABLED (flags_, ACE_NONBLOCK)) { 
 6     if (sh->peer ().enable (ACE_NONBLOCK) == -1) 
 7       result = -1; 
 8   } else if (sh->peer ().disable (ACE_NONBLOCK) == -1) 
 9     result = -1; 
10 
11   if (result == 0 && sh->open (this) == -1) 
12     result = -1; 
13   if (result == -1) sh->close (0); 
14   return result; 
15 }

                                                                                            第 5-9 行：服务处理程序的阻塞/非阻塞状态取决于接收者在其构造函数中存储的标志。如果接收者的标志指定为非阻塞模式，则在服务处​​理程序的对等流上启用非阻塞 I/O。否则，对等流将设置为阻塞模式。

                                                                                            Lines 5–9 The blocking/nonblocking status of a service handler is set to reflect the flags stored by the acceptor in its constructor. If the acceptor's flag_ designates nonblocking mode, we enable nonblocking I/O on the service handler's peer stream. Otherwise, the peer stream is set to blocking mode.

                                                                                            第 11-14 行：调用服务处理程序的open()钩子方法来激活该处理程序（示例见第 209 页）。如果服务激活失败，则调用服务处理程序的close()钩子方法来释放与该服务处理程序关联的所有资源。

                                                                                            Lines 11–14 The service handler's open() hook method is called to activate the handler (see page 209 for an example). If service activation fails, the service handler's close() hook method is called to release any resources associated with the service handler.

                                                                                            子类可以重写`activate_svc_handler()`方法，以其他方式激活服务，例如将其与线程池关联，或生成新的进程或线程来处理客户端发送的数据。由于 ` ACE_Acceptor::handle_input()`方法是虚方法，因此可以（尽管很少见）更改接受连接和初始化服务处理程序的步骤顺序。无论是否使用默认的`ACE_Acceptor`步骤，服务处理程序本身的功能都与用于被动连接和初始化它的步骤完全解耦。这种设计保持了模块化和关注点分离，这对于最大限度地降低服务未来维护和开发的成本至关重要。

                                                                                            Subclasses can override activate_svc_handler() to activate the service in some other way, such as associating it with a thread pool or spawning a new process or thread to process data sent by clients. Since the ACE_Acceptor::handle_input() method is virtual it's possible (though rare) to change the sequence of steps performed to accept a connection and initialize a service handler. Regardless of whether the default ACE_Acceptor steps are used or not, the functionality of the service handler itself is decoupled completely from the steps used to passively connect and initialize it. This design maintains the modularity and separation of concerns that are so important to minimize the cost of the service's future maintenance and development.

                                                                                            例子

                                                                                            Example

                                                                                            此示例是我们服务器日志守护进程的另一个变体。它使用实例化了ACE_SOCK_Acceptor的ACE_Acceptor来监听由系统服务数据库（通常位于/etc/services）中“ ace_logger ”服务条目定义的被动模式 TCP 套接字句柄。此版本的服务器采用每个连接一个线程的并发模型来同时处理多个客户端。

                                                                                            This example is another variant of our server logging daemon. It uses the ACE_Acceptor instantiated with an ACE_SOCK_Acceptor to listen on a passive-mode TCP socket handle defined by the "ace_logger" service entry in the system's services database, which is usually /etc/services. This revision of the server uses the thread-per-connection concurrency model to handle multiple clients simultaneously.

                                                                                            如图7.6所示，主线程使用 Reactor 等待来自客户端的新连接请求。当连接到达时，Acceptor 使用侧边栏 51 （第 224 页）中概述的OpenSSL [ Ope01 ] 身份验证协议，以确保客户端日志守护进程有权连接到服务器。如果客户端合法，Acceptor 会根据7.2 节示例部分动态创建一个TPC_Logging_Handler来处理该连接。TPC_Logging_Handler ::open()方法（第 214 页）会生成一个线程来处理客户端通过连接发送的日志记录。

                                                                                            As shown in Figure 7.6, the main thread uses a reactor to wait for new connection requests from clients. When a connection arrives, the acceptor uses the OpenSSL [Ope01] authentication protocol outlined in Sidebar 51 (page 224) to ensure that the client logging daemon is permitted to connect with the server. If the client is legitimate, the acceptor dynamically creates a TPC_Logging_Handler from the Example part of Section 7.2 to handle the connection. The TPC_Logging_Handler::open() method (page 214) spawns a thread to process log records sent by the client over the connection.

                                                                                            图 7.6. 每个连接一个线程的日志服务器架构

                                                                                            由于大部分代码都复用了 ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架和 OpenSSL 库，因此本示例主要扩展、实例化和使用现有功能。我们继承了ACE_Acceptor 类，并重写了其open()方法和accept_svc_handler()钩子方法，以定义其身份验证协议的服务器端。TPC_Logging_Acceptor类及其受保护的数据成员声明如下：

                                                                                            Since much of the code is reused from the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework and OpenSSL library, this example mostly extends, instantiates, and uses existing capabilities. We subclass ACE_Acceptor and override its open() method and accept_svc_handler() hook method to define the server end of its authentication protocol. The TPC_Logging_Acceptor class and its protected data members are declared as follows:

                                                                                            #include "ace/SOCK_Acceptor.h" 
#include <openssl/ssl.h> 
class TPC_Logging_Acceptor 
  : public ACE_Acceptor<TPC_Logging_Handler, ACE_SOCK_Acceptor> { 
protected: 
  // The SSL ''context'' data structure. 
  SSL_CTX *ssl_ctx_; 

  // The SSL data structure corresponding to authenticated 
  // SSL connections. 
  SSL *ssl_;

                                                                                            ssl_ctx_和ssl_数据成员通过TPC_Logging_Acceptor中的以下公共方法传递给 OpenSSL API调用。

                                                                                            The ssl_ctx_ and ssl_ data members are passed to the OpenSSL API calls made by the following public methods in TPC_Logging_Acceptor.

                                                                                            public: 
  typedef ACE_Acceptor<TPC_Logging_Handler, ACE_SOCK_Acceptor> 
          PARENT; 
  typedef ACE_SOCK_Acceptor::PEER_ADDR PEER_ADDR; 

  TPC_Logging_Acceptor (ACE_Reactor *) 
    : PARENT (r), ssl_ctx_ (0), ssl_ (0) {} 

  // Destructor frees the SSL resources. 
  virtual TPC_Logging_Acceptor (void) { 
    SSL_free (ssl_); 
    SSL_CTX_free (ssl_ctx_); 
  } 
  // Initialize the acceptor instance. 
  virtual int open 
    (const ACE_SOCK_Acceptor::PEER_ADDR &local_addr, 
    ACE_Reactor *reactor = ACE_Reactor::instance (), 
    int flags = 0, int use_select = 1, int reuse_addr = 1); 

  // <ACE_Reactor> close hook method. 
  virtual int handle_close 
    (ACE_HANDLE = ACE_INVALID_HANDLE, 
    ACE_Reactor_Mask = ACE_Event_Handler::ALL_EVENTS_MASK); 

  // Connection establishment and authentication hook method. 
  virtual int accept_svc_handler (TPC_Logging_Handler *sh); 
};

                                                                                            侧边栏 51：身份验证和加密协议概述

                                                                                            Sidebar 51: An Overview of Authentication and Encryption Protocols

                                                                                            为了防范潜在攻击或第三方发现，许多联网应用程序必须验证其对等节点的身份，并对通过网络传输的敏感数据进行加密。为了提供这些功能，人们开发了各种加密软件包（例如 OpenSSL [ Ope01 ]）和安全协议（例如传输层安全协议 (TLS) [ DA99 ]）。这些软件包和协议提供库调用，以确保两个通信应用程序之间的身份验证、数据完整性和机密性。例如，TL​​S 协议可以加密/解密通过TCP / IP网络发送/接收的数据。TLS 基于 Netscape 开发的早期协议——安全套接字层 (SSL)。

                                                                                            To protect against potential attacks or third-party discovery, many networked applications must authenticate the identities of their peers and encrypt sensitive data sent over a network. To provide these capabilities, various cryptography packages, such as OpenSSL [Ope01], and security protocols, such as Transport Layer Security (TLS) [DA99], have been developed. These packages and protocols provide library calls that ensure authentication, data integrity, and confidentiality between two communicating applications. For example, the TLS protocol can encrypt/decrypt data sent/received across a TCP/IP network. TLS is based on an earlier protocol named the Secure Sockets Layer (SSL), which was developed by Netscape.

                                                                                            本章示例中使用的 OpenSSL 工具包基于 Eric Young 和 Tim Hudson 编写的 SSLeay 库。它是开源的，目前仍在积极开发中，可在多种平台上运行，包括 ACE 支持的大多数平台，例如 Linux、FreeBSD、OpenBSD、NetBSD、Solaris、AIX、IRIX、HP-UX、OpenUNIX、DG/UX、ReliantUNIX、UnixWare、Cray T90 和 T3E、SCO Unix、Microsoft Windows 和 macOS。OpenSSL 是一个非常成功的开源软件包，其庞大的商业和非商业用户社区就是最好的证明。

                                                                                            The OpenSSL toolkit used by the examples in this chapter is based on the SSLeay library written by Eric Young and Tim Hudson. It is open source, under active development, and runs on multiple platforms, including most platforms ACE supports, such as Linux, FreeBSD, OpenBSD, NetBSD, Solaris, AIX, IRIX, HP-UX, OpenUNIX, DG/UX, ReliantUNIX, UnixWare, Cray T90 and T3E, SCO Unix, Microsoft Windows, and MacOS. OpenSSL is a highly successful open-source package, as evidenced by its extensive commercial and noncommerical user community.

                                                                                            TPC_Logging_Acceptor::open()（位于TPC_Logging_Server.cpp中）使用其基类实现初始化自身，并按如下方式建立服务器身份：

                                                                                            TPC_Logging_Acceptor::open() (in TPC_Logging_Server.cpp) initializes itself using its base class implementation and establishes the server's identity as follows:

                                                                                             1 #include "ace/OS.h" 
 2 #include "Reactor_Logging_Server_Adapter.h" 
 3 #include "TPC_Logging_Server.h" 
 4 #include "TPCLS_export.h" 
 5 
 6 #if !defined (TPC_CERTIFICATE_FILENAME) 
 7 # define TPC_CERTIFICATE_FILENAME "tpc-cert.pem" 
 8 #endif /* !TPC_CERTIFICATE_FILENAME */ 
 9 #if !defined (TPC_KEY_FILENAME) 
10 # define TPC_KEY_FILENAME "tpc-key.pem" 
11 #endif /* !TPC_KEY_FILENAME */ 
12 
13 int TPC_Logging_Acceptor::open 
14     (const ACE_SOCK_Acceptor::PEER_ADDR &local_addr, 
15            ACE_Reactor *reactor, 
16            int flags, int use_select, int reuse_addr) { 
17   if (PARENT::open (local_addr, reactor, flags, 
18                     use_select, reuse_addr) != 0) 
19     return -1; 
20   OpenSSL_add_ssl_algorithms (); 
21   ssl_ctx_ = SSL_CTX_new (SSLv3_server_method ()); 
22   if (ssl_ctx_ == 0) return -1; 
23 
24   if (SSL_CTX_use_certificate_file (ssl_ctx_, 
25                                     TPC_CERTIFICATE_FILENAME, 
26                                     SSL_FILETYPE_PEM) <= 0 
27       || SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey_file (ssl_ctx_, 
28                                       TPC_KEY_FILENAME, 
29                                       SSL_FILETYPE_PEM) <= 0 
30       || !SSL_CTX_check_private_key (ssl_ctx_)) 
31     return -1; 
32   ssl_ = SSL_new (ssl_ctx_); 
33   return ssl_ == 0 ? -1 : 0; 
34 }

                                                                                            第 6-11 行：由于我们的日志服务器没有用户界面，因此假定其服务器证书和密钥存在于一组默认文件中。但是，应用程序可以通过定义指定的预处理器宏来覆盖默认文件名。

                                                                                            Lines 6–11 Since our logging server doesn't have a user interface, its server certificate and accompanying key are assumed to exist in a default set of files. However, the application may override the default filenames by defining the specified preprocessor macros.

                                                                                            第 17-18 行使用默认的open()实现初始化ACE_Acceptor。

                                                                                            Lines 17–18 Initialize the ACE_Acceptor using the default open() implementation.

                                                                                            第 20 行初始化 OpenSSL 库。为简洁起见，我们将 ` OpenSSL_add_ssl_algorithms()`调用放在`TPC_Logging_Acceptor::open()`中。虽然每个进程可以安全地多次调用此函数，但理想情况下，每个进程应该只调用一次。然而，如果多个线程可以调用此函数，则必须同步初始化，因为此 OpenSSL 函数不是线程安全的。

                                                                                            Line 20 Initialize the OpenSSL library. For brevity, we place the OpenSSL_add_ssl_algorithms() call in TPC_Logging_Acceptor::open(). Although this function can be called safely multiple times per process, ideally this call should be made only once per process. Initialization must be synchronized if multiple threads can call the function, however, since this OpenSSL function isn't thread safe.

                                                                                            第 21-22 行设置 SSL 版本 3 连接，并创建要进行身份验证的相应 SSL 结构。

                                                                                            Lines 21–22 Set up for SSL version 3connection and create the SSL structure corresponding connections to be authenticated.

                                                                                            第 24-31 行设置用于在建立连接时识别服务器的证书和相应的私钥，然后验证私钥是否与正确的证书匹配。此代码假定证书和密钥以隐私增强邮件(PEM) 格式编码在指定的文件中。

                                                                                            Lines 24–31 Set up the certificate and accompanying private key used to identify the server when establishing connections and then verify that the private key matches the correct certificate. This code assumes that the certificate and key are encoded in Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) format within the specified files.

                                                                                            第 32-33 行初始化一个新的 SSL 数据结构，该结构在通过 OpenSSL API 建立 SSL 连接时，会在TPC_Logging_Acceptor::accept_svc_handler()钩子方法中使用，如下所示：

                                                                                            Lines 32–33 Initialize a new SSL data structure, which is used in the TPC_Logging_Acceptor::accept_svc_handler() hook method when establishing SSL connections via the OpenSSL API, as follows:

                                                                                             1 int TPC_Logging_Acceptor::accept_svc_handler 
 2     (TPC_Logging_Handler *sh) { 
 3   if (PARENT::accept_svc_handler (sh) == -1) return -1; 
 4   SSL_clear (ssl_); // Reset for new SSL connection. 
 5   SSL_set_fd 
 6     (ssl_, ACE_reinterpret_cast (int, sh->get_handle ())); 
 7 
 8   SSL_set_verify 
 9     (ssl_, 
10     SSL_VERIFY_PEER | SSL_VERIFY_FAIL_IF_NO_PEER_CERT, 
11     0); 
12   if (SSL_accept (ssl_) == -1 
13       || SSL_shutdown (ssl_) == -1) return -1; 
14   return 0; 
15 }

                                                                                            Lines 8–11 Configure the SSL data structures so that client authentication is performed and enforced when accepting an SSL connection.

                                                                                            第 12 行执行实际的 SSL 连接和协商。如果客户端身份验证失败，SSL_accept()调用将失败。

                                                                                            Line 12 Perform the actual SSL connection and negotiation. If authentication of the client fails, the SSL_accept() call will fail.

                                                                                            第 13 行：如果身份验证成功，则关闭 SSL 连接。由于我们实际上并未加密日志记录数据，因此从现在开始，我们将直接通过TCP流进行通信。如果需要数据加密，我们可以使用侧边栏 52中描述的 OpenSSL 的 ACE 封装外观。
