Since we don't actually encrypt the log record data we simply communicate via the TCP stream from here on. If data encryption were required, we could use the ACE wrapper facades for OpenSSL described in Sidebar 52.

                                                                                            通过重写open()和accept_svc_handler()钩子方法，我们为服务器日志守护进程添加了身份验证功能，而不会影响其实现的任何其他部分。这种可扩展性体现了ACE_Acceptor类设计中使用的模板方法模式的强大之处。

                                                                                            By overriding the open() and accept_svc_handler() hook methods, we added authentication to our server logging daemon without affecting any other part of its implementation. This extensibility illustrates the power of the Template Method pattern used in the ACE_Acceptor class design.

                                                                                            当我们的示例服务通过 ACE 服务配置器框架关闭时，Reactor_Logging_Server_Adapter::fini()（第 123 页）最终会调用以下handle_close()方法：

                                                                                            When our example service is shut down via the ACE Service Configurator framework, Reactor_Logging_Server_Adapter::fini() (page 123) will end up calling the following handle_close() method:

                                                                                            int TPC_Logging_Acceptor::handle_close (ACE_HANDLE h, 
                                        ACE_Reactor_Mask mask) { 
  PARENT::handle_close (h, mask); 
  delete this; 
  return 0; 
}

                                                                                            侧边栏 52：ACE 为 OpenSSL 提供的包装器外观

                                                                                            Sidebar 52: ACE Wrapper Facades for OpenSSL

                                                                                            尽管 OpenSSL API 提供了一组有用的函数，但它也存在用 C 语言编写的原生操作系统 API 常见的各种问题（参见 C++NPv1 第 2 章）。为了解决这些问题，ACE 提供了一些类，这些类使用类似于 ACE C++ Socket 包装器外观的 API 封装了 OpenSSL。例如， C++NPv1 第 3 章中描述的ACE_SOCK_Acceptor、ACE_SOCK_Connector和ACE_SOCK_Stream类都有其对应的支持 SSL 的版本：ACE_SSL_SOCK_Acceptor、ACE_SSL_SOCK_Connector和ACE_SSL_SOCK_Stream。

                                                                                            Although the OpenSSL API provides a useful set of functions, it suffers from the usual problems incurred by native OS APIs written in C (see Chapter 2 in C++NPv1). To address these problems, ACE provides classes that encapsulate OpenSSL using an API similar to the ACE C++ Socket wrapper facades. For example, the ACE_SOCK_Acceptor, ACE_SOCK_Connector, and ACE_SOCK_Stream classes described in Chapter 3 of C++NPv1 have their SSL-enabled counterparts: ACE_SSL_SOCK_Acceptor, ACE_SSL_SOCK_Connector, and ACE_SSL_SOCK_Stream.

                                                                                            ACE SSL 封装外观允许网络应用程序确保通过网络交换的数据的完整性和机密性。它们还遵循与其对应的 Socket API 相同的结构和 API，因此可以使用 C++ 参数化类型和ACE_Svc_Handler模板类轻松地对其进行整体替换。例如，要将 ACE OpenSSL 封装外观应用于我们的网络日志服务器，我们可以简单地移除所有 OpenSSL API 代码，并分别使用ACE_SSL_SOCK_Acceptor、ACE_SSL_SOCK_Connector和ACE_SSL_SOCK_Stream实例化ACE_Acceptor、ACE_Connector和ACE_Svc_Handler。

                                                                                            The ACE SSL wrapper facades allow networked applications to ensure the integrity and confidentiality of data exchanged across a network. They also follow the same structure and APIs as their Socket API counterparts, which makes it easy to replace them wholesale using C++ parameterized types and the ACE_Svc_Handler template class. For example, to apply the ACE wrapper facades for OpenSSL to our networked logging server we can simply remove all the OpenSSL API code and instantiate the ACE_Acceptor, ACE_Connector, and ACE_Svc_Handler with the ACE_SSL_SOCK_Acceptor, ACE_SSL_SOCK_Connector, and ACE_SSL_SOCK_Stream, respectively.

                                                                                            此方法调用`ACE_Acceptor::handle_close()`来关闭监听的 acceptor 套接字并将其从 Reactor 框架中注销。为避免内存泄漏，该方法随后会删除此对象，该对象是在服务初始化时动态分配的。

                                                                                            This method calls ACE_Acceptor::handle_close() to close the listening acceptor socket and unregister it from the reactor framework. To avoid memory leaks, the method then deletes this object, which was allocated dynamically when the service was initialized.

                                                                                            最后，我们创建了TPC_Logging_Server类型定义：

                                                                                            We finally create the TPC_Logging_Server type definition:

                                                                                            typedef Reactor_Logging_Server_Adapter<TPC_Logging_Acceptor> 
        TPC_Logging_Server; 

ACE_FACTORY_DEFINE (TPCLS, TPC_Logging_Server)

                                                                                            我们还使用侧边栏 32 （第 136 页）中描述的ACE _ FACTORY _ DEFINE宏来自动生成_make_TPC_Logging_Server()工厂函数，该函数在以下svc.conf文件中使用：

                                                                                            We also use the ACE_FACTORY_DEFINE macro described in Sidebar 32 (page 136) to automatically generate the _make_TPC_Logging_Server() factory function, which is used in the following svc.conf file:

                                                                                            dynamic TPC_Logging_Server Service_Object * 
TPCLS:_make_TPC_Logging_Server() "$TPC_LOGGING_SERVER_PORT"

                                                                                            该文件指示 ACE 服务配置器框架通过以下步骤配置每个连接的线程日志服务器：

                                                                                            This file directs the ACE Service Configurator framework to configure the thread-perconnection logging server via the following steps:

                                                                                            1. 它将TPCLS DLL 动态链接到进程的地址空间中。

                                                                                            2. It dynamically links the TPCLS DLL into the address space of the process.

                                                                                            3. 它使用ACE_DLL类从TPCLS DLL 符号表中提取_make_TPC_Logging_Server()工厂函数。

                                                                                            4. It uses the ACE_DLL class to extract the _make_TPC_Logging_Server() factory function from the TPCLS DLL symbol table.

                                                                                            5. 调用此函数可动态分配一个TPC_Logging_Server并返回指向它的指针。

                                                                                            6. This function is called to allocate a TPC_Logging_Server dynamically and return a pointer to it.

                                                                                            7. ACE 服务配置器框架随后通过此指针调用TPC_Logging_Server::init() ，并将TPC_LOGGING_SERVER_PORT环境变量的展开式作为其argc / argv参数传递，该环境变量指定日志服务器监听客户端连接请求的端口号。该端口号最终会传递给Reactor_Logging_Server构造函数（第 83 页）。

                                                                                            8. The ACE Service Configurator framework then calls TPC_Logging_Server::init() through this pointer, passing as its argc/argv argument an expansion of the TPC_LOGGING_SERVER_PORT environment variable that designates the port number where the logging server listens for client connection requests. The port number is ultimately passed down to the Reactor_Logging_Server constructor (page 83).

                                                                                            9. 如果init()成功，则TPC_Logging_Server指针将以名称“TPC_Logging_Server”存储在ACE_Service_Repository中。

                                                                                            10. If init() succeeds, the TPC_Logging_Server pointer is stored in the ACE_Service_Repository under the name "TPC_Logging_Server".

                                                                                            我们之前日志服务器示例中手动编写的各种*Logging_Acceptor*类已不再需要。它们的功能已被继承自ACE_Acceptor的TPC_Logging_Acceptor所取代。ACE_Acceptor基类的第一个模板参数是TPC_Logging_Handler，它派生自ACE_Svc_Handler。

                                                                                            The various *Logging_Acceptor* classes written by hand for our previous logging server examples are no longer needed. Their purpose has been subsumed by TPC_Logging_Acceptor, which inherits from ACE_Acceptor. The first template argument to the ACE_Acceptor base class is TPC_Logging_Handler, which derives from ACE_Svc_Handler.

                                                                                            在TPC_Logging_Server服务中，ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架承担了大部分基础工作，包括验证客户端连接、初始化和运行服务处理程序。由于ACE_Acceptor将接受连接、验证客户端和激活服务处理程序的功能重构为handle_input()模板方法中定义明确的步骤，因此日志服务器守护进程的源代码大幅减少。特别是，ACE_Acceptor提供了我们之前需要手动编写的所有代码。

                                                                                            In the TPC_Logging_Server service, the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework performs most of the basic work of authenticating a client connection, as well as initializing and operating a service handler. Since the ACE_Acceptor refactors the functionality of accepting connections, authenticating clients, and activating service handlers into well-defined steps in its handle_input() template method, the source code for our logging server daemon shrank considerably. In particular, ACE_Acceptor supplied all of the code we previously had to write manually to

                                                                                            • 监听并接受连接

                                                                                            • Listen for and accept connections

                                                                                            • 创建并激活新的服务处理程序

                                                                                            • Create and activate new service handlers

                                                                                            我们的每个连接一个线程的日志服务器还重用了早期解决方案中的类，这些类提供了以下功能：

                                                                                            Our thread-per-connection logging server also reused classes from earlier solutions that provided the following capabilities:

                                                                                            • 使用第 5.2 节（第 122 页）中定义的Reactor_Logging_Server_Adapter模板初始化网络监听器地址。

                                                                                            • Initialize the network listener address using the Reactor_Logging_Server_Adapter template defined in Section 5.2 (page 122).

                                                                                            • 在main()函数中动态配置日志服务器并运行 ACE Reactor 的事件循环。

                                                                                            • Dynamically configure the logging server and run the ACE Reactor's event loop in the main() function.

                                                                                            因此，我们唯一需要编写的重要代码是TPC_Logging_Handler类（第 213 页），它为每个连接生成一个线程来接收和处理 Zlog 记录；以及TPC_Logging_Acceptor::accept_svc_handler()方法（第 222 页），它实现了用于验证客户端和服务器日志守护进程身份的协议的服务器端部分。同样，由于 ACE 服务配置器框架提供的灵活性，我们只需重用第 5 章中的Configurable_Logging_Server主程序即可。

                                                                                            Therefore, the only code of any consequence we had to write was the TPC_Logging_Handler class (page 213), which spawned a thread per connection to receive and process Zlog records, and the TPC_Logging_Acceptor::accept_svc_handler() method (page 222), which implemented the server end of the protocol that authenticates the identity of the client and server logging daemons. Once again, due to the flexibility offered by the ACE Service Configurator framework, we simply reuse the Configurable_Logging_Server main program from Chapter 5.

                                                                                              7.4 ACE_Connector 类

                                                                                              7.4 The ACE_Connector Class

                                                                                              动机

                                                                                              Motivation

                                                                                              第 7.3 节重点讨论了如何将服务处理程序的功能与被动连接和初始化它们所需的步骤解耦。同样重要的是，也要将服务处理程序的功能与主动连接和初始化它们所需的步骤解耦。此外，与大量对等节点通信的网络应用程序可能需要同时主动建立多个连接，并在连接完成时进行处理。为了将这些功能整合到一个灵活、可扩展且可重用的抽象层中，ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架定义了ACE_Connector类。

                                                                                              Section 7.3 focused on how to decouple the functionality of service handlers from the steps required to passively connect and initialize them. It's equally useful to decouple the functionality of service handlers from the steps required to actively connect and initialize them. Moreover, networked applications that communicate with a large number of peers may need to actively establish many connections concurrently, handling completions as they occur. To consolidate these capabilities into a flexible, extensible, and reusable abstraction, the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework defines the ACE_Connector class.

                                                                                              等级能力

                                                                                              Class Capabilities

                                                                                              ACE_Connector是一个工厂类，它实现了 Acceptor-Connector 模式中的 Connector 角色 [ POSA2 ]。此类提供以下功能：

                                                                                              ACE_Connector is a factory class that implements the Connector role in the Acceptor-Connector pattern [POSA2]. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                              • 它将主动连接建立和服务初始化逻辑与服务处理程序在连接和初始化后执行的处理逻辑解耦。

                                                                                              • It decouples the active connection establishment and service initialization logic from the processing performed by a service handler after it's connected and initialized.

                                                                                              • 它提供了一个进程间通信（IPC）工厂，可以主动地与对等接收器建立同步或响应式连接。该IPC端点的类型可以通过ACE的多个IPC包装器外观类进行参数化，从而将底层连接机制与应用层服务初始化策略分离。

                                                                                              • It provides an IPC factory that can actively establish connections with a peer acceptor either synchronously or reactively. The type of this IPC endpoint can be parameterized with many of ACE's IPC wrapper facade classes, thereby separating lower-level connection mechanisms from application-level service initialization policies.

                                                                                              • 它可以自动执行主动连接 IPC 端点所需的步骤，以及创建和激活其关联的服务处理程序。

                                                                                              • It automates the steps necessary to connect the IPC endpoint actively as well as to create and activate its associated service handler.

                                                                                              • 由于ACE_Connector派生自ACE_Service_Object，因此它继承了第3章和第5章中分别描述的所有事件处理和动态配置功能。

                                                                                              • Since ACE_Connector derives from ACE_Service_Object it inherits all the event handling and dynamic configuration capabilities described in Chapters 3 and 5, respectively.

                                                                                              ACE_Connector的接口如图 7.7 （第 230 页）所示。该模板类由以下参数定义：

                                                                                              The interface for ACE_Connector is shown in Figure 7.7 (page 230). This template class is parameterized by:

                                                                                              图 7.7. ACE_Connector类

                                                                                              • SVC_HANDLER类提供了一个接口，用于处理对等服务中由客户端、服务器或客户端和服务器角色共同定义的服务。此参数应为ACE_Svc_Handler子类，如第 7.2 节所述。

                                                                                              • An SVC_HANDLER class, which provides an interface for processing services defined by clients, servers, or both client and server roles in peer-to-peer services. This parameter should be an ACE_Svc_Handler subclass, as described in Section 7.2.

                                                                                              • PEER_CONNECTOR类能够主动建立客户端连接。此参数通常指定为 ACE 的 IPC 包装器外观之一，例如C++NPv1 第 3 章中描述的ACE_SOCK_Connector 。

                                                                                              • A PEER_CONNECTOR class, which is able to establish client connections actively. This parameter is often specified as one of ACE's IPC wrapper facades, such as the ACE_SOCK_Connector described in Chapter 3 of C++NPv1.

                                                                                              ACE_Connector类具有灵活的接口，开发人员可以对其进行广泛的自定义。因此，我们将它的方法描述分为下一页所述的两类。

                                                                                              The ACE_Connector class has a flexible interface that can be customized extensively by developers. We therefore group the description of its methods into the two categories described on the following page.

                                                                                              1. 连接器初始化、销毁方法和访问器方法。 以下方法用于初始化、销毁和访问ACE_Connector：

                                                                                              1. Connector initialization, destruction methods, and accessor methods. The following methods are used to initialize, destroy, and access an ACE_Connector:

                                                                                              方法

                                                                                              Method

                                                                                              描述

                                                                                              Description

                                                                                              ACE_Connector() 打开()

                                                                                              ACE_Connector() open()

                                                                                              初始化连接器的方法。

                                                                                              Methods that initialize a connector.

                                                                                              ACE_Connector() 关闭()

                                                                                              ACE_Connector() close()

                                                                                              释放连接器所用资源的方法。

                                                                                              Methods that release the resources used by a connector.

                                                                                              连接器（）

                                                                                              connector()

                                                                                              返回对底层PEER_CONNECTOR 的引用。

                                                                                              Returns a reference to the underlying PEER_CONNECTOR.

                                                                                              ACE_Connector的构造函数和open()方法可以接收一个标志，该标志指示由连接器初始化的服务处理程序的 IPC 端点应以阻塞模式（默认）还是非阻塞模式（ACE_NONBLOCK）启动。这些方法还可以接收与连接器关联的 Reactor。默认情况下，它们使用单​​例ACE_Reactor ，就像ACE_Svc_Handler和ACE_Acceptor一样。

                                                                                              The ACE_Connector's constructor and open() method can be passed a flag indicating whether a service handler's IPC endpoint initialized by the connector should start in blocking (the default) or nonblocking (ACE_NONBLOCK) mode. These methods can also be passed the reactor associated with the connector. They use the singleton ACE_Reactor by default, just like the ACE_Svc_Handler and ACE_Acceptor.

                                                                                              ACE_Connector对象会在被销毁或显式调用其close()方法时关闭。ACE_Connector 不会为同步连接分配任何资源，因此如果仅用于同步连接，则无需进行任何清理。但是，对于异步连接，这些方法会释放连接器为跟踪在连接器关闭时尚未完成的挂起连接而分配的资源。每个剩余的未连接服务处理程序也会通过调用其close()钩子方法而关闭。

                                                                                              An ACE_Connector object is closed either when it's destroyed or when its close() method is called explicitly. An ACE_Connector allocates no resources for synchronous connections, so there's nothing to clean up if it's used only synchronously. For asyn-chronous connections, however, these methods release the resources a connector allocates to track pending connections that haven't completed by the time the connector is closed. Each remaining unconnected service handler is also closed by invoking its close() hook method.

                                                                                              2. 连接建立和服务处理程序初始化方法。可以使用 以下ACE_Connector方法主动建立连接并初始化其关联的服务处理程序：

                                                                                              2. Connection establishment and service handler initialization methods. The following ACE_Connector methods can be used to establish connections actively and initialize their associated service handlers:

                                                                                              方法

                                                                                              Method

                                                                                              描述

                                                                                              Description

                                                                                              连接（）

                                                                                              connect()

                                                                                              当应用程序需要将服务处理程序连接到监听对等方时，会调用此模板方法。它可以使用以下三种方法来自动执行主动连接 IPC 端点以及创建和激活其关联的服务处理程序所需的步骤。

                                                                                              This template method is called by an application when it wants to connect a service handler to a listening peer. It can use the following three methods to automate the steps necessary to actively connect an IPC endpoint, as well as to create and activate its associated service handler.

                                                                                              make_svc_handler()

                                                                                              make_svc_handler()

                                                                                              此工厂方法提供了一个服务处理程序，该处理程序将使用连接的 IPC 端点。

                                                                                              This factory method supplies a service handler that will use the connected IPC endpoint.

                                                                                              connect_svc_handler()

                                                                                              connect_svc_handler()

                                                                                              此钩子方法使用服务处理程序的 IPC 端点主动连接端点，无论是同步连接还是异步连接。

                                                                                              This hook method uses the service handler's IPC endpoint to actively connect the endpoint, either synchronously or asynchronously.

                                                                                              activate_svc_handler()

                                                                                              activate_svc_handler()

                                                                                              此钩子方法调用服务处理程序的open()钩子方法，从而允许服务处理程序在建立连接后完成自身的初始化。

                                                                                              This hook method invokes the service handler's open() hook method, which allows the service handler to finish initializing itself after the connection is established.

                                                                                              处理输出()

                                                                                              handle_output()

                                                                                              此模板方法由反应器在异步发起的连接请求完成后调用。它调用activate_svc_handler()方法以允许服务处理程序初始化自身。

                                                                                              This template method is called by a reactor after an asynchronously initiated connection request completes. It calls the activate_svc_handler() method to allow the service handler to initialize itself.

                                                                                              取消（）

                                                                                              cancel()

                                                                                              取消异步启动连接的服务处理程序。调用方（而非连接器）负责关闭服务处理程序。

                                                                                              Cancel a service handler whose connection was initiated asynchronously. The caller—not the connector—is responsible for closing the service handler.

                                                                                              联网应用程序使用connect()模板方法主动发起连接尝试，无论连接完成是同步处理还是异步处理。此方法使用以下步骤连接并初始化新的服务处理程序：

                                                                                              Networked applications use the connect() template method to initiate a connection attempt actively, regardless of whether its completion is handled synchronously or asynchronously. This method uses the following steps to connect and initialize a new service handler:

                                                                                              1. 它获取服务处理程序，可以通过使用调用者传递的处理程序，或者通过调用make_svc_handler()工厂方法来实现。

                                                                                              2. It obtains a service handler, either by using the handler passed by the caller or by invoking the make_svc_handler() factory method.

                                                                                              3. 然后，它调用 ` connect_svc_handler()`方法来建立连接。被动连接通常是即时的，而主动连接则可能需要更长时间，尤其是在广域网中。因此，可以指示`ACE_Connector`使用 ACE Reactor 框架来异步处理连接完成情况，无论连接成功还是失败。

                                                                                              4. It then calls the connect_svc_handler() method to initiate the connection. Whereas passive connection establishment is usually immediate, active connection establishment can take a longer amount of time, particularly over wide-area networks. The ACE_Connector can therefore be instructed to use the ACE Reactor framework to handle connection completions asynchronously as they occur, whether they succeed or fail.

                                                                                              5. 对于同步连接，`connect()`会调用`activate_svc_handler()`来允许服务处理程序完成初始化。对于异步连接，连接完成后，反应器会调用`ACE_Connector::handle_output()`来完成服务处理程序的初始化。图 7.8展示了异步连接的步骤。

                                                                                                图 7.8. ACE_Connector异步连接建立步骤

                                                                                                由于ACE_Connector::connect()使用了模板方法模式 [ GoF ]，应用程序设计人员可以更改上述三个步骤中的任何一个或全部的行为。

                                                                                                如图 7.7 （第 230 页）所示，ACE_Connector::connect()方法接收以下参数：

                                                                                              6. For synchronous connections, connect() calls activate_svc_handler() to allow the service handler to finish initializing itself. For asynchronous connections, the reactor calls ACE_Connector::handle_output() to finish service handler initialization after the connection completes. Figure 7.8 illustrates the steps for the asynchronous case.

                                                                                                Figure 7.8. Steps in ACE_Connector Asynchronous Connection Establishment

                                                                                                Since ACE_Connector::connect() uses the Template Method pattern [GoF], application designers can change the behavior of any or all of the three steps outlined above.

                                                                                                As shown in Figure 7.7 (page 230), the ACE_Connector::connect() method is passed the following arguments:

                                                                                              • 指向SVC_HANDLER 的指针的引用。如果该指针为NULL，则会调用make_svc_handler()工厂方法来获取一个 SVC_HANDLER。make_svc_handler ()的默认版本会动态分配一个 SVC_HANDLER。

                                                                                              • A reference to a pointer to a SVC_HANDLER. If the pointer is NULL, the make_svc_handler() factory method is called to obtain one. The default version of make_svc_handler() allocates one dynamically.

                                                                                              • 一个地址参数，其签名通过 C++ 特性与对等连接器和流类型相匹配。该地址指定对等方连接的端点。例如，对于使用ACE_SOCK_Stream的服务处理程序，它可以是包含端口号和 IP 地址的ACE_INET_Addr。对于其他进程间通信 (IPC) 机制，它可以是用于通过命名服务定位服务的名称，也可以是端口映射服务器的主机名——这取决于应用程序设计者的决定。

                                                                                              • An address argument whose signature matches the peer connector and stream types via C++ traits. The address specifies the endpoint to which the peer connects. For instance, it could be an ACE_INET_Addr containing a port number and IP address for service handlers using ACE_SOCK_Stream. For other IPC mechanisms, it could be the name used to locate a service via a naming service or it could be the hostname of a port mapping server—it's up to the application designer to decide.

                                                                                              • 引用ACE_Synch_Options对象，该对象汇总了用于确定ACE_Connector行为的选项值。

                                                                                              • A reference to an ACE_Synch_Options object that consolidates the values of options used to determine the ACE_Connector's behavior.

                                                                                              每次调用 connect()都会尝试与指定的对等方建立连接。如果connect()立即获得连接成功或失败的指示，则忽略ACE_Synch_Options参数。但是，如果它没有立即获得连接成功或失败的指示，则connect()会使用ACE_Synch_Options参数，通过两个相互独立的因素来改变完成处理：

                                                                                              Each connect() call tries to establish a connection with the designated peer. If connect() gets an immediate indication of connection success or failure, it ignores the ACE_Synch_Options parameter. If it doesn't get an immediate indication of connection success or failure, however, connect() uses its ACE_Synch_Options parameter to vary the completion processing via two orthogonal factors:

                                                                                              1. 是否使用 ACE Reactor 框架来检测连接完成情况

                                                                                              2. Whether to use the ACE Reactor framework to detect the connection completion

                                                                                              3. 连接完成需要等待多久

                                                                                              4. How long to wait for the connection to complete

                                                                                              如果使用了反应器，` connect()`方法可以同时向反应器注册`PEER_CONNECTOR`（用于检测连接完成情况）和一个定时器（用于调用者指定的时间限制），并向调用者返回 -1，同时将`errno`设置为`EWOULDBLOCK`。连接的最终成功或失败将导致 ` ACE_Connector::activate_svc_handler()`方法在连接成功时激活相应的处理程序，或在连接失败时调用服务处理程序的`close()`方法。应用程序运行反应器的事件循环，相应的调用将在反应器正常的事件循环处理过程中进行。

                                                                                              If the reactor is used, the connect() method can register both the PEER_CONNECTOR (for connect completion detection) and a timer (for the caller-specified time limit) with the reactor and returns -1 to its caller with errno set to EWOULDBLOCK. The ultimate success or failure of the connect will result in the ACE_Connector::activate_svc_handler() method's activating the handler for success or the service handler's close() method for failure. The application runs the reactor's event loop, and the appropriate call will be made during the course of the reactor's normal event loop processing.

                                                                                              如果未使用反应器，则`connect()`方法不会返回，直到连接尝试完成、失败或超时。无论连接成功还是失败，都会分别调用 ` activate_svc_handler()`方法或服务处理程序的 ` close()`方法。下表总结了基于 ` ACE_Synch_Options`值，在连接请求未立即完成的情况下， ` ACE_Connector`的行为。

                                                                                              If the reactor isn't used, the connect() method doesn't return until the connect attempt completes, fails, or times out. Its success or failure still results in a call to either the activate_svc_handler() method or the service handler's close() method, respectively. The table below summarizes the ACE_Connector's behavior, based on the ACE_Synch_Options values, if the connect request doesn't complete immediately.

                                                                                              反应堆

                                                                                              Reactor

                                                                                              暂停

                                                                                              Timeout

                                                                                              行为

                                                                                              Behavior

                                                                                              是的

                                                                                              Yes

                                                                                              0,0

                                                                                              0,0

                                                                                              返回 -1，错误号为 EWOULDBLOCK；服务处理程序通过反应堆事件循环关闭。

                                                                                              Return -1 with errno EWOULDBLOCK; service handler is closed via reactor event loop.

                                                                                              是的

                                                                                              Yes

                                                                                              时间

                                                                                              Time

                                                                                              返回 -1，错误号为 EWOULDBLOCK；等待最多指定的时间，直到使用反应堆完成。

                                                                                              Return -1 with errno EWOULDBLOCK; wait up to specified amount of time for completion using the reactor.

                                                                                              是的

                                                                                              Yes

                                                                                              无效的

                                                                                              NULL

                                                                                              返回 -1，错误号为 EWOULDBLOCK；无限期地等待反应堆完成。

                                                                                              Return -1 with errno EWOULDBLOCK; wait for completion indefinitely using the reactor.

                                                                                              不

                                                                                              No

                                                                                              0,0

                                                                                              0,0

                                                                                              直接关闭服务处理程序；返回 -1，错误号为 EWOULDBLOCK。

                                                                                              Close service handler directly; return -1 with errno EWOULDBLOCK.

                                                                                              不

                                                                                              No

                                                                                              时间

                                                                                              Time

                                                                                              在connect_svc_handler()中阻塞，直到指定的完成时间；如果仍未完成，则返回 -1 并带有errno ETIME。

                                                                                              Block in connect_svc_handler() up to specified amount of time for completion; if still not completed, return -1 with errno ETIME.

                                                                                              不

                                                                                              No

                                                                                              无效的

                                                                                              NULL

                                                                                              connect_svc_handler()函数无限期阻塞以等待完成。

                                                                                              Block in connect_svc_handler() indefinitely for completion.

                                                                                              无论连接是如何建立的，子类都可以重写默认的`make_svc_handler()`、`connect_svc_handler()`和`activate_svc_handler()`方法中的任何一个或全部。这种可扩展的模板方法模式设计允许对行为进行一系列修改和自定义，以支持多种用例。我们将在下一页描述`ACE_Connector::connect()`中的三个主要变体。

                                                                                              Regardless of how connections are established, any or all of the default make_svc_handler(), connect_svc_handler(), and activate_svc_handler() methods can be overridden by subclasses. This extensible Template Method pattern design allows a range of behavior modification and customization to support many use cases. We describe the three primary variation points in ACE_Connector::connect() on the following page.

                                                                                              1. 获取服务处理程序。 由于接收器通常由反应器的上行调用驱动，其`make_svc_handler()`工厂方法通常会创建一个新的服务处理程序。相比之下，连接器可以选择连接并初始化服务处理程序，或者选择其他方式。

                                                                                              1. Obtain a service handler. Since an acceptor is often driven by upcalls from a reactor, its make_svc_handler() factory method usually creates a new service handler. In contrast, a connector can choose to connect and initialize a service handler as either

                                                                                              • 创建调用者， 其中调用者将指向现有服务处理程序的指针传递给连接器的connect()方法。

                                                                                              • Caller created, wherein the caller passes a pointer to an existing service handler to the connector's connect() method

                                                                                              • 创建连接器， 其中调用者将NULL服务处理程序指针传递给连接器的connect()方法，从而指示make_svc_handler()工厂方法获取指向服务处理程序的指针（甚至可以完全推迟此活动，直到connect_svc_handler()方法启用连接缓存）。

                                                                                              • Connector created, wherein the caller passes a NULL service handler pointer to the connector's connect() method, thereby instructing the make_svc_handler() factory method to obtain a pointer to the service handler (or even defer this activity altogether until the connect_svc_handler() method to enable connection caching).

                                                                                              ACE_Connector::make_svc_handler()的默认实现处理这两种情况如下：

                                                                                              The default implementation of ACE_Connector::make_svc_handler() handles these two cases, as follows: 

                                                                                              template <class SVC_HANDLER, class PEER_CONNECTOR> int 
ACE_Connector<SVC_HANDLER, PEER_CONNECTOR>::make_svc_handler 
    (SVC_HANDLER *&sh) { 
  if (sh == 0) ACE_NEW_RETURN (sh, SVC_HANDLER, -1); 
  sh->reactor (reactor ()); 
  return 0; 
}

                                                                                              此方法与ACE_Acceptor::make_svc_handler() （第 219 页）类似。但是，ACE_Connector::make_svc_handler()仅在通过引用传递给它的指针为NULL时才分配新的服务处理程序，这使得客户端应用程序能够确定是由调用方还是连接器创建服务处理程序。

                                                                                              This method looks similar to ACE_Acceptor::make_svc_handler() (page 219). However, ACE_Connector::make_svc_handler() allocates a new service handler only if the pointer passed to it by reference is NULL, which enables the client application to determine if the caller or the connector should create the service handler.

                                                                                              2. 建立连接。ACE_Connector ::connect() 模板方法调用其connect_svc_handler()钩子方法来与对等接收器建立新连接。此方法的默认实现会直接转发到PEER_CONNECTOR::connect()方法来建立连接，如下所示：

                                                                                              2. Connection establishment. The ACE_Connector::connect() template method calls its connect_svc_handler() hook method to initiate a new connection with a peer acceptor. The default implementation of this method simply forwards to the PEER_CONNECTOR::connect() method to initiate the connection, as shown below: 

                                                                                              template <class SVC_HANDLER, class PEER_CONNECTOR> int 
ACE_Connector<SVC_HANDLER, PEER_CONNECTOR>::connect_svc_handler 
    (SVC_HANDLER *sh, 
     const ACE_TYPENAME PEER_CONNECTOR::PEER_ADDR &remote_addr, 
     ACE_Time_Value *timeout, 
     const ACE_TYPENAME PEER_CONNECTOR::PEER_ADDR &local_addr, 
     int reuse_addr, int flags, int perms) { 
  return connector_.connect (svc_handler->peer (), 
                             remote_addr, 
                             timeout, 
                             local_addr, 
                             reuse_addr, flags, perms); 
}

                                                                                              ACE_Connector的子类可以定义更强大的connect_svc_handler()实现。以下是一些示例：

                                                                                              More powerful implementations of connect_svc_handler() can be defined by subclasses of ACE_Connector. Here are some examples:

                                                                                              • 连接缓存。可以重写 ` connect_svc_handler()`方法来搜索已连接服务处理程序的缓存。如果没有合适的缓存处理程序，则可以创建一个新的`SVC_HANDLER`并连接。由于是否创建新的`SVC_HANDLER` 的决定是在`connect_svc_handler()`中做出的（该方法在`make_svc_handler()`之后调用），因此子类可能会将其 ` make_svc_handler()`方法定义为空操作。

                                                                                              • Connection caching. The connect_svc_handler() method can be overridden to search a cache of existing, connected service handlers. If there's no suitable cached handler, a new SVC_HANDLER can be created and connected. Since the decision to create a new SVC_HANDLER or not is made in connect_svc_handler() (which is called after make_svc_handler()), the subclass would probably define its make_svc_handler() method as a no-op.

                                                                                              • 身份验证。可以重写 ` connect_svc_handler()`方法，使其始终同步连接，并在新连接上实现身份验证协议。例如，它可以发送加密的登录密码，并与安全服务器协商访问权限。如果身份验证失败，重写的`connect_svc_handler()`方法可以关闭连接并返回 -1，以向`ACE_Connector::connect() ` 指示错误，从而避免激活服务处理程序。下面的示例部分演示了如何通过重写`connect_svc_handler()`来实现 SSL 身份验证。

                                                                                              • Authentication. The connect_svc_handler() method can be overridden to always connect synchronously and then implement an authentication protocol on the new connection. For example, it may send an encrypted login password and negotiate access rights with a secure server. If authentication fails, the overridden connect_svc_handler() method can close the connection and return -1 to indicate an error to ACE_Connector::connect() so the service handler isn't activated. The Example section below illustrates how to implement SSL authentication by overrriding connect_svc_handler().

                                                                                              3. 服务处理程序激活。ACE_Connector可以通过以下两种方式激活服务处理程序，具体取决于连接的发起方式 ：

                                                                                              3. Service handler activation. The ACE_Connector can activate service handlers in the following two ways, depending on how the connection was initiated:

                                                                                              • 如果连接是同步完成的，则在connect_svc_handler()成功返回后， ACE_Connector::connect()会激活服务处理程序。此时，connect()会调用activate_svc_handler()，以便服务处理程序完成自身初始化。

                                                                                              • If a connection is completed synchronously, the service handler is activated by ACE_Connector::connect() after connect_svc_handler() returns successfully. At this point, connect() calls activate_svc_handler() so the service handler can finish initializing itself.

                                                                                              • 如果使用 Reactor 框架异步处理连接完成，Reactor 会调用`ACE_Connector::handle_output()`来通知连接器 IPC 端点已连接。此时，`handle_output()`会调用 ` activate_svc_handler() ` 钩子方法，以便服务处理程序完成自身初始化。

                                                                                              • If a connection completion is handled asynchronously using the Reactor framework, the reactor calls ACE_Connector::handle_output() to inform the connector that the IPC endpoint is connected. At this point, handle_output() calls the activate_svc_handler() hook method so the service handler can finish initializing itself.

                                                                                              ACE_Connector::activate_svc_handler()的默认行为与ACE_Acceptor::activate_svc_handler()相同（第 221 页）。ACE_Acceptor和ACE_Connector之间的这种共性凸显了 ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架的强大功能，该框架将被动和主动连接的建立与服务处理程序的初始化和使用完全解耦。

                                                                                              The default behavior of ACE_Connector::activate_svc_handler() is identical to the ACE_Acceptor::activate_svc_handler() (page 221). This commonality between the ACE_Acceptor and ACE_Connector underscores the power of the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework, which completely decouples passive and active connection establishment from the initialization and use of a service handler.

                                                                                              例子

                                                                                              Example

                                                                                              本示例应用 ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架来实现另一个客户端日志守护进程，该守护进程扩展了6.2 节示例部分所示的守护进程。我们没有使用图 6.4（第 169 页）所示的临时Acceptor-Connector 模式实现，而是使用了本章中描述的ACE_Acceptor、ACE_Connector和ACE_Svc_Handler类。由于之前客户端日志守护进程中需要手动编写的大部分代码现在都可以作为 ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架中的可重用类使用，因此最终的实现更加简洁且更具可移植性。此外，我们的新实现也更加强大，因为它提供了一个透明的身份验证协议，以确保客户端日志守护进程能够连接到服务器日志守护进程。

                                                                                              This example applies the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework to implement another client logging daemon that extends the one shown in the Example portion of Section 6.2. Rather than using the ad hoc Acceptor-Connector pattern implementation shown in Figure 6.4 (page 169), we use the ACE_Acceptor, ACE_Connector, and ACE_Svc_Handler classes described in this chapter. The resulting implementation is more concise and portable since much of the code we had to write manually in the previous client logging daemon is available as reusable classes from the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework. Our new implementation is also more powerful since it provides an authentication protocol that's interposed transparently to ensure that the client logging daemon is permitted to connect to the server logging daemon.

                                                                                              与之前的客户端日志守护程序一样，我们的新版本使用两个线程，它们使用各种 ACE 框架类执行以下任务：

                                                                                              Like the earlier client logging daemon, our new version uses two threads, which perform the following tasks using various ACE framework classes:

                                                                                              • 输入处理—— 主线程使用单例ACE_Reactor、ACE_Acceptor和ACE_Svc_Handler被动对象，通过网络回环设备从连接到客户端应用程序的套接字读取日志记录。每条日志记录都会被放入第二个作为活动对象运行的ACE_Svc_Handler 的队列中。

                                                                                              • Input processing— The main thread uses the singleton ACE_Reactor, an ACE_Acceptor, and an ACE_Svc_Handler passive object to read log records from sockets connected to client applications via the network loopback device. Each log record is queued in a second ACE_Svc_Handler that runs as an active object.

                                                                                              • 输出处理—— 活动对象ACE_Svc_Handler在其自身的线程中运行。它从消息队列中取出消息，将消息缓冲成块，并通过TCP连接将这些块转发到服务器日志守护进程。ACE_Connector的子类用于建立（并在必要时重新建立）和验证与日志服务器的连接。

                                                                                              • Output processing— The active object ACE_Svc_Handler runs in its own thread. It dequeues messages from its message queue, buffers the messages into chunks, and forwards these chunks to the server logging daemon over a TCP connection. A subclass of ACE_Connector is used to establish (and when necessary reestablish) and authenticate connections with the logging server.

                                                                                              图 7.9展示了基于 ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架的新客户端日志守护进程的组成类。每个类的作用概述如下：

                                                                                              The classes comprising the new client logging daemon based on the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework are shown in Figure 7.9. The role of each class is outlined below:

                                                                                              图 7.9. Acceptor-Connector 客户端日志守护程序中的类

                                                                                              班级

                                                                                              Class

                                                                                              描述

                                                                                              Description

                                                                                              AC_Input_Handler

                                                                                              AC_Input_Handler

                                                                                              单例ACE_Reactor的回调目标，它接收来自客户端的日志记录，将每条记录存储在ACE_Message_Block中，并将它们传递给AC_Output_Handler进行处理。

                                                                                              A target of callbacks from the singleton ACE_Reactor that receives log records from clients, stores each in an ACE_Message_Block, and passes them to the AC_Output_Handler for processing.

                                                                                              AC_Output_Handler

                                                                                              AC_Output_Handler

                                                                                              一个在独立线程中运行的活动对象。它的put()方法将从AC_Input_Handler传递给它的消息块入队。它的svc()方法从其同步消息队列中出队消息，并将其转发到日志服务器。

                                                                                              An active object that runs in its own thread. Its put() method enqueues message blocks passed to it from the AC_Input_Handler. Its svc() method dequeues messages from its synchronized message queue and forwards them to the logging server.

                                                                                              AC_CLD_Acceptor

                                                                                              AC_CLD_Acceptor

                                                                                              一个工厂，它被动地接受来自客户端的连接，并将它们注册到单例ACE_Reactor中，以便由AC_Input_Handler进行处理。

                                                                                              AC_Client_Logging_Daemon

                                                                                              AC_Client_Logging_Daemon

                                                                                              一个将其他类集成在一起的外观类。

                                                                                              A facade class that integrates the other classes together.

                                                                                              这些类的实例之间的交互如图 7.10 （第 238 页）所示。服务运行时，有两个线程。第一个是初始程序线程，它运行反应堆事件循环。该线程执行以下操作：

                                                                                              The interactions between instances of these classes are shown in Figure 7.10 (page 238). When the service is operating, there are two threads. The first is the initial program thread and it runs the reactor event loop. This thread performs the following processing:

                                                                                              图 7.10. Acceptor-Connector 客户端日志守护进程中的交互

                                                                                              • 它通过AC_CLD_Acceptor接受新的日志客户端连接。

                                                                                              • It accepts new logging client connections via AC_CLD_Acceptor.

                                                                                              • 它接收日志记录，并通过AC_Input_Handler识别断开的日志客户端连接；日志记录被放入AC_Output_Handler消息队列中。

                                                                                              • It receives log records and identifies broken logging client connections via AC_Input_Handler; log records are enqueued on the AC_Output_Handler message queue.

                                                                                              • 它检测AC_Output_Handler中的日志服务器连接是否断开，并通过AC_CLD_Connector重新连接到服务器。

                                                                                              • It detects broken logging server connections in AC_Output_Handler and reconnects with the server via AC_CLD_Connector.

                                                                                              转发器线程在与日志服务器建立初始连接时启动，并持续运行直至服务终止。此线程运行AC_Output_Handler活动对象服务线程。

                                                                                              The forwarder thread is started when the initial connection to the logging server is made and continues to run until the service is terminated. This thread runs the AC_Output_Handler active object service thread.

                                                                                              我们首先通过包含必要的 ACE 头文件来进行实现。

                                                                                              We start our implementation by including the necessary ACE header files.

                                                                                              #include "ace/OS.h"

#include "ace/Get_Opt.h"

#include "ace/Synch.h"
