                                                                                              图 6.4中的类在AC_Client_Logging_Daemon.cpp文件中定义，如下所述。

                                                                                              The classes in Figure 6.4 are defined in the AC_Client_Logging_Daemon.cpp file and described below.

                                                                                              AC_Input_Handler 类提供以下功能：

                                                                                              AC_Input_Handler. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                              • 它接收来自客户端的日志记录。

                                                                                              • It receives log records from clients.

                                                                                              • 它将每个日志记录存储在ACE_Message_Block中。

                                                                                              • It stores each log record in an ACE_Message_Block.

                                                                                              • 它将消息块传递给AC_Output_Handler进行处理。

                                                                                              • It passes the message blocks to the AC_Output_Handler for processing.

                                                                                              AC_Input_Handler类如下所示：

                                                                                              The AC_Input_Handler class is shown below:

                                                                                              class AC_Input_Handler 
  : public ACE_Svc_Handler<ACE_SOCK_Stream, ACE_NULL_SYNCH> { 
public: 
  AC_Input_Handler (AC_Output_Handler *handler = 0) 
    : output_handler_ (handler) {} 
  virtual int open (void *); // Initialization hook method. 
  virtual int close (u_int = 0); // Shutdown hook method. 

protected: 
  // Reactor hook methods. 
  virtual int handle_input (ACE_HANDLE handle); 
  virtual int handle_close (ACE_HANDLE = ACE_INVALID_HANDLE, 
                            ACE_Reactor_Mask = 0); 

  // Pointer to the output handler. 
  AC_Output_Handler *output_handler_; 

  // Keep track of connected client handles. 
  ACE_Handle_Set connected_clients_; 
};

                                                                                              由于AC_Input_Handler不使用每个客户端的状态，因此在AC_CLD_Acceptor（第 247 页）中仅定义了一个实例来处理来自所有已连接客户端的输入。为此，我们定义了一个ACE_Handle_Set ，它是C++NPv1 第 7 章中定义的fd_set的包装外观。ACE_Handle_Set 跟踪所有已连接的客户端套接字句柄，以便在AC_Input_Handler关闭时将其从单例 Reactor 中移除。侧边栏 53（第 240 页）讨论了使用多个服务处理器与使用单个服务处理器的不同策略的优缺点。

                                                                                              Since AC_Input_Handler uses no per-client state, only a single instance is defined in AC_CLD_Acceptor (page 247) to handle input from all connected clients. We therefore define an ACE_Handle_Set, which is a wrapper facade for fd_set defined in Chapter 7 of C++NPv1. This ACE_Handle_Set keeps track of all connected client socket handles so we can remove them from the singleton reactor when the AC_Input_Handler is closed. Sidebar 53(page 240) discusses the pros and cons of different strategies for using multiple versus single service handlers.

                                                                                              由于AC_Input_Handler继承自ACE_Svc_Handler，它可以使用单例ACE_Reactor来等待通过环回 TCP 套接字连接到客户端日志守护进程的任何客户端应用程序发送的日志记录。因此，它不使用消息队列，而是使用ACE_NULL_SYNCH策略实例化ACE_Svc_Handler，以最大限度地减少同步器的使用。当日志记录到达客户端日志守护进程时，单例ACE_Reactor会分派以下AC_Input_Handler::handle_input()钩子方法：

                                                                                              Since AC_Input_Handler inherits from ACE_Svc_Handler it can use the singleton ACE_Reactor to wait for log records to arrive from any client applications connected to the client logging daemon via loopback TCP sockets. It therefore doesn't use its message queue, so it instantiates the ACE_Svc_Handler with the ACE_NULL_SYNCH strategy to minimize its synchronizer usage. When a log record arrives at the client logging daemon, the singleton ACE_Reactor dispatches the following AC_Input_Handler::handle_input() hook method:

                                                                                              int AC_Input_Handler::handle_input (ACE_HANDLE handle) { 
  ACE_Message_Block *mblk = 0; 
  Logging_Handler logging_handler (handle); 

  if (logging_handler.recv_log_record (mblk) != -1) 
    if (output_handler_->put (mblk->cont ()) != -1) { 
      mblk->cont (0); 
      mblk->release (); 
      return 0; // Success return. 
    } else mblk->release (); 
  return -1; // Error return. 
}

                                                                                              侧边栏 53：多服务处理程序与单服务处理程序

                                                                                              Sidebar 53: Multiple versus Single Service Handlers

                                                                                              第 7.3 节示例部分中的服务器日志守护进程实现会为每个已连接的客户端动态分配一个新的服务处理程序。相比之下，本示例中的客户端日志守护进程实现则对所有已连接的客户端使用同一个服务处理程序。这些方法的理由和优缺点如下：

                                                                                              The server logging daemon implementation in the Example part of Section 7.3 dynamically allocates a new service handler for each connected client. In contrast, the client logging daemon implementation in this example uses a single service handler for all connected clients. The rationale and tradeoffs for these approaches are:

                                                                                              • 如果每个服务处理程序为每个客户端维护单独的状态信息（除了连接句柄之外），那么为每个客户端分配一个服务处理程序通常是最直接的设计。

                                                                                              • If each service handler maintains separate state information for each client (in addition to the connection handle) then allocating a service handler per client is generally the most straightforward design.

                                                                                              • 如果每个服务处理器不为每个客户端维护单独的状态，那么为所有客户端分配一个服务处理器的服务器，其空间占用可能更少，性能也更快，而为每个客户端动态分配处理器则不然。随着并发连接客户端数量的增加，这些改进的效果会更加显著。

                                                                                              • If each service handler does not maintain separate state for each client, then a server that allocates one service handler for all clients can potentially use less space and perform faster than if it allocates a handler dynamically for each client. The effect of these improvements increases as the number of concurrently connected clients grows.

                                                                                              • 如果为每个客户端动态分配一个单独的服务处理器，内存管理通常会容易得多，因为 ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架类体现了这种情况下最常见的行为——服务处理器只需在其handle_close()钩子方法中调用destroy()即可。相反，如果所有客户端共享一个服务处理器，内存管理就会变得更加复杂。

                                                                                              • It's generally much easier to manage memory if a separate service handler is allocated dynamically for each client since the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework classes embody the most common behavior for this case—the service handler simply calls destroy() from its handle_close() hook method. In contrast, memory management is trickier if one service handler is shared by all the clients.

                                                                                              • 如果服务处理程序初始化可以从多个线程执行，例如在使用ACE_WFMO_Reactor的多个调度线程时，设计必须考虑可能的竞争条件，并使用适当的同步来避免连接处理不当。

                                                                                              • If service handler initialization can be performed from multiple threads, such as when using multiple dispatching threads with ACE_WFMO_Reactor, the design must take possible race conditions into account and use appropriate synchronization to avoid mishandling connections.

                                                                                              为了完整起见，本章将介绍这两种方法。但总的来说，多服务处理器方法更容易编程。因此，除非需要节省空间，否则我们建议在实践中使用这种设计。

                                                                                              For completeness, we show both approaches in this chapter. In general, however, the multiple service handler approach is much easier to program. We therefore recommend using this design in practice, unless there's a need to save space.

                                                                                              此方法使用C++NPv1 第 4 章中的Logging_Handler从套接字句柄参数中读取日志记录，将记录存储到ACE_Message_Block中，并将此消息传递给AC_Output_Handler （第 243 页），后者会将其排队并在单独的线程中进行处理。我们只将日志记录数据（由mblk->cont()引用）排队，而不将主机名（由mblk引用）排队。

                                                                                              This method uses the Logging_Handler from Chapter 4 of C++NPv1 to read a log record out of the socket handle parameter, store the record into an ACE_Message_Block, and pass this message to the AC_Output_Handler (page 243), which will queue it and service it in a separate thread. We only enqueue the log record data (which is referenced by mblk->cont()) and not the hostname (which is referenced by mblk).

                                                                                              如果客户端应用程序断开套接字连接或发生错误，handle_input()返回 -1。此值会触发单例反应器调用以下handle_close()钩子方法来关闭套接字。

                                                                                              If a client application disconnects the socket or an error occurs, handle_input() returns -1. This value triggers the singleton reactor to call the following handle_close() hook method that closes the socket.

                                                                                              int AC_Input_Handler::handle_close (ACE_HANDLE handle, 
                                    ACE_Reactor_Mask) { 
  connected_clients_.clr_bit (handle); 
  return ACE_OS::closesocket (handle); 
}

                                                                                              请注意，我们无需在handle_close() 函数中删除此对象，因为AC_Input_Handler的内存由AC_CLD_Acceptor管理（第 247 页）。handle_close ()方法还会从connected_clients_句柄集中移除指定的句柄，该句柄是在连接打开时添加到该句柄集中的。

                                                                                              Note that we needn't delete this object in handle_close() since the AC_Input_Handler's memory is managed by the AC_CLD_Acceptor (page 247). The handle_close() method also removes the specified handle from the connected_clients_ handle set, where it was added when the connection was opened.

                                                                                              当客户端应用程序向客户端日志守护程序发出连接请求时，AC_CLD_Acceptor::handle_input()将分发以下AC_Input_Handler::open()钩子方法：

                                                                                              When a connection request arrives at the client logging daemon from a client application, AC_CLD_Acceptor::handle_input() will dispatch the following AC_Input_Handler::open() hook method:

                                                                                              1 int AC_Input_Handler::open (void *) { 
2   ACE_HANDLE handle = peer ().get_handle (); 
3   if (reactor ()->register_handler 
4         (handle, this, ACE_Event_Handler::READ_MASK) == -1) 
5     return -1; 
6   connected_clients_.set_bit (handle); 
7   return 0; 
8 }

                                                                                              第 2-5 行：客户端日志守护进程为其所有日志处理程序复用同一个AC_Input_Handler对象。因此，当调用AC_CLD_Acceptor::accept_svc_handler()来接受新连接时，它会为每个连接复用AC_Input_Handler的ACE_SOCK_Stream中的句柄。我们使用三参数的ACE_Reactor::register_handler()方法（第 73 页）向单例 Reactor 注册指向此对象的指针，用于读取事件。当日志记录到达时，单例 Reactor 将分派AC_Input_Handler::handle_input() 方法（第 239 页）。

                                                                                              Lines 2–5 The client logging daemon reuses a single AC_Input_Handler object for all of its logging handlers. When AC_CLD_Acceptor::accept_svc_handler() is called to accept the new connection, it therefore reuses the handle in the AC_Input_Handler's ACE_SOCK_Stream for each connection. We use the three-parameter ACE_Reactor::register_handler() method (page 73) to register a pointer to this single object with the singleton reactor for READ events. When log records arrive, the singleton reactor will dispatch AC_Input_Handler::handle_input() (page 239).

                                                                                              回顾侧边栏 53 ，单例服务处理程序和多线程事件分发可能会引入竞态条件。如果将AC_Input_Handler类与多线程 Reactor 事件循环一起使用，我们可能会丢失某些连接，因为AC_Input_Handler对象的ACE_SOCK_Stream成员可以被多个线程修改。每个参与事件分发的线程都会执行以下操作：

                                                                                              Recall from Sidebar 53 that singleton service handlers and multithreaded event dispatching may introduce a race condition. We may lose track of some connections if the AC_Input_Handler class is used with a multithreaded reactor event loop since the AC_Input_Handler object's ACE_SOCK_Stream member can be changed by multiple threads. Each involved event dispatching thread does the following:

                                                                                              1. 调用AC_CLD_Acceptor::accept_svc_handler()方法，该方法接受一个新的套接字并将其句柄存储在AC_Input_Handler中。

                                                                                              2. Calls the AC_CLD_Acceptor::accept_svc_handler() method, which accepts a new socket and stores its handle in AC_Input_Handler

                                                                                              3. 调用AC_CLD_Acceptor::activate_svc_handler()方法，该方法又会调用上面所示的AC_Input_Handler::open() 方法。

                                                                                              4. Calls the AC_CLD_Acceptor::activate_svc_handler() method, which in turn calls AC_Input_Handler::open() shown above

                                                                                              如果线程B在线程A完成上述两个步骤之前接受了新的连接，那么线程A中的 ` AC_Input_Handler::open()`调用很可能会注册从线程B接受的套接字。如果是这样，第一个接受的套接字仍然处于打开状态，但从未向 Reactor 注册，因此会被放弃。

                                                                                              If thread B accepts a new connection before thread A completes the two steps above, it's likely that the AC_Input_Handler::open() invocation in thread A will actually register the socket accepted from thread B. If so, the first socket accepted would still be open, but never registered with the reactor and, thus, abandoned.

                                                                                              为了防止出现这种竞态条件，需要在访问AC_Input_Handler中共享的ACE_SOCK_Stream对象的代码周围进行同步。遗憾的是，同步范围包含了上述两个步骤，因此必须在它们的调用者ACE_Acceptor::handle_input()中完成。因此，如果使用多个 Reactor 事件分发线程，最终将需要重新实现handle_input函数，才能正确同步并发连接接受。因此，本节中的示例使用单个 Reactor 事件分发线程。

                                                                                              To prevent this race condition, synchronization is needed around the code that accesses the shared ACE_SOCK_Stream object in the AC_Input_Handler. Unfortunately, the synchronization scope includes the two steps listed above and so must be done from their caller, ACE_Acceptor::handle_input(). The use of multiple reactor event dispatching threads would therefore end up requiring a new implementation of handle_input to properly synchronize concurrent connection acceptance. The example in this section therefore uses a single reactor event dispatching thread.

                                                                                              第 6 行：将已连接客户端的句柄记录到connected_clients_ACE_Handle_Set中。我们跟踪已连接客户端的句柄，以便在调用AC_Input_Handler::close()时将其从反应器中移除。此方法由AC_CLD_Acceptor::handle_close()（第 247 页）或AC_Client_Logging_Daemon::fini()（第 253 页）调用，用于关闭客户端日志守护进程。

                                                                                              Line 6 Record the handle of the connected client in the connected_clients_ ACE_Handle_Set. We keep track of connected client handles so we can remove them from the reactor when AC_Input_Handler::close() is called. This method is called by AC_CLD_Acceptor::handle_close() (page 247) or AC_Client_Logging_Daemon::fini() (page 253) to shut down the client logging daemon:

                                                                                               1 int AC_Input_Handler::close (u_int) { 
 2   ACE_Message_Block *shutdown_message = 0; 
 3   ACE_NEW_RETURN 
 4     (shutdown_message, 
 5     ACE_Message_Block (0, ACE_Message_Block::MB_STOP), -1); 
 6   output_handler_->put (shutdown_message); 
 7 
 8   reactor ()->remove_handler 
 9     (connected_clients_, ACE_Event_Handler::READ_MASK); 
10   return output_handler_->wait (); 
11 }

                                                                                              第 2-6 行：向消息队列中插入一个大小为 0 的消息块，类型为MB_STOP 。当运行AC_Output_Handler::svc()（第 244 页）的转发器线程从队列中取出此shutdown_message时，它​​会将剩余的日志记录刷新到日志服务器，关闭消息队列，并退出线程。

                                                                                              Lines 2–6 Insert a 0-sized message block of type MB_STOP into the message queue. When the forwarder thread running AC_Output_Handler::svc() (page 244) dequeues this shutdown_message it will flush its remaining log records to the logging server, close the message queue, and exit the thread.

                                                                                              第 8-9 行：一次性移除connected_clients_句柄集中的所有句柄。每个被移除的句柄都会代表它生成一个向AC_Input_Handler::handle_close()发送的 Reactor 回调，该回调会关闭相应的套接字句柄。

                                                                                              Lines 8–9 Remove all handles in the connected_clients_ handle set in one operation. Each removed handle will generate a reactor callback to AC_Input_Handler::handle_close() on its behalf, where the socket handle is closed.

                                                                                              第 10 行：在AC_Input_Handler::close()返回之前，使用output_handler_的wait()方法阻塞，直到其svc()钩子方法退出。此方法会回收转发器线程的退出状态，以防止内存泄漏。

                                                                                              Line 10 Use the output_handler_'s wait() method to block until its svc() hook method exits before returning from AC_Input_Handler::close(). This method reaps the exit status of the forwarder thread to prevent memory leaks.

                                                                                              AC_Output_Handler 类提供以下功能：

                                                                                              AC_Output_Handler. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                              • 它将从AC_Input_Handler传递给它的消息块插入到其同步消息队列中。

                                                                                              • It inserts message blocks passed to it from the AC_Input_Handler into its synchronized message queue.

                                                                                              • 它作为独立线程中的活动对象运行，从其同步消息队列中取出消息块，将它们缓冲成块，并将这些块转发到日志服务器。

                                                                                              • It runs as an active object in its own thread, dequeueing message blocks from its synchronized message queue, buffering them into chunks, and forwarding the chunks to the logging server.

                                                                                              • 它向单例ACE_Reactor注册，以处理与日志服务器的断开连接并重新建立连接。

                                                                                              • It registers with the singleton ACE_Reactor to process disconnects from the logging server and reestablish connections.

                                                                                              AC_Output_Handler类如下所示：

                                                                                              The AC_Output_Handler class is shown below:

                                                                                              class AC_Output_Handler 
  : public ACE_Svc_Handler<ACE_SOCK_Stream, ACE_MT_SYNCH> { 
public: 
  enum { QUEUE_MAX = sizeof (ACE_Log_Record) * ACE_IOV_MAX }; 

  virtual int open (void *); // Initialization hook. 

  // Entry point into the <AC_Output_Handler>. 
  virtual int put (ACE_Message_Block *, ACE_Time_Value * = 0); 

protected: 
  // Pointer to connection factory for <AC_Output_Handler>. 
  AC_CLD_Connector *connector_; 

  // Handle disconnects from the logging server. 
  virtual int handle_input (ACE_HANDLE handle); 

  // Hook method forwards log records to server logging daemon. 
  virtual int svc (); 

  // Send buffered log records using a gather-write operation. 
  virtual int send (ACE_Message_Block *chunk[], size_t &count); 
}; 

#if !defined (FLUSH_TIMEOUT) 
#define FLUSH_TIMEOUT 120 /* 120 seconds == 2 minutes. */ 
#endif /* FLUSH_TIMEOUT */

                                                                                              由于AC_Output_Handler派生自ACE_Svc_Handler ，并且使用ACE_MT_SYNCH实例化其同步特性，因此它继承了ACE_SOCK_Stream、ACE_Thread_Manager和同步的ACE_Message_Queue，以及激活自身成为活动对象的能力。

                                                                                              Since AC_Output_Handler is derived from ACE_Svc_Handler and instantiates its synchronization traits with ACE_MT_SYNCH, it inherits the ACE_SOCK_Stream, ACE_Thread_Manager, and synchronized ACE_Message_Queue, as well as the ability to activate itself to become an active object.

                                                                                              AC_Input_Handler::handle_input()（第 239 页）在我们用于构建此客户端日志守护进程并发架构的半同步/半异步模式变体中扮演响应式角色。它通过以下put()方法将日志记录传递给AC_Output_Handler：

                                                                                              AC_Input_Handler::handle_input() (page 239) plays the reactive role in the variant of the Half-Sync/Half-Async pattern we use to structure the concurrency architecture of this client logging daemon. It passes log records to the AC_Output_Handler via the following put() method:

                                                                                              int AC_Output_Handler::put (ACE_Message_Block *mb, 
                            ACE_Time_Value *timeout) { 
  int result; 
  while ((result = putq (mb, timeout)) == -1) 
    if (msg_queue ()->state () != ACE_Message_Queue_Base::PULSED) 
      break; 
  return result; 
}

                                                                                              此方法只是将消息块加入到AC_Output_Handler的同步消息队列中。如果putq()调用被阻塞，并且消息队列被脉冲式更新，它会重新执行putq()调用以重试。以下两个方法解释了此类如何使用队列脉冲式更新。

                                                                                              This method simply enqueues the message block onto the AC_Output_Handler's synchronized message queue. If the putq() call is blocked and the message queue is pulsed, it simply reexecutes the putq() call to try again. The following two methods explain how this class uses queue pulsing.

                                                                                              AC_CLD_Connector工厂（第 248 页）通过调用其open()钩子方法初始化AC_Output_Handler ，如下所示：

                                                                                              The AC_CLD_Connector factory (page 248) initializes the AC_Output_Handler by calling its open() hook method shown below:

                                                                                               1 int AC_Output_Handler::open (void *connector) { 
 2   connector_ = 
 3     ACE_static_cast (AC_CLD_Connector *, connector); 
 4   int bufsiz = ACE_DEFAULT_MAX_SOCKET_BUFSIZ; 
 5   peer ().set_option (SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDBUF, 
 6                       &bufsiz, sizeof bufsiz); 
 7   if (reactor ()->register_handler 
 8        (this, ACE_Event_Handler::READ_MASK) == -1) 
 9     return -1; 
10   if (msg_queue ()->activate () 
11       == ACE_Message_Queue_Base::ACTIVATED) { 
12     msg_queue ()->high_water_mark (QUEUE_MAX); 
13     return activate (THR_SCOPE_SYSTEM); 
14   } else return 0; 
15 }

                                                                                              第 2-3 行：保存调用此方法的AC_CLD_Connector工厂的指针。如果需要重新连接服务器，将使用同一个工厂。

                                                                                              Lines 2–3 Save the pointer to the AC_CLD_Connector factory that called this method. If the connection to the server must be reconnected, the same factory will be used.

                                                                                              第 4-6 行将连接的套接字的发送缓冲区增加到最大大小，以最大限度地提高长延迟和/或高速网络的吞吐量。

                                                                                              Lines 4–6 Increase the connected socket's send buffer to its largest size to maximize throughput over long-delay and/or high-speed networks.

                                                                                              第 7-8 行将此对象注册到单例反应器中，以便在日志服务器断开连接时立即通知其handle_input()方法（第 246 页）。

                                                                                              Lines 7–8 Register this object with the singleton reactor so that its handle_input() method (page 246) will be notified immediately if the logging server disconnects.

                                                                                              第 10-13 行：每次与日志服务器建立新连接时都会调用此方法。初始连接时，消息队列处于ACTIVATED状态，因此我们将消息队列的高水位线设置为sizeof(ACE_Log_Record) x ACE_IOV_MAX，就像我们在 CLD_Handler::open() 的第 6 行（第 172 页）所做的那样。然后，我们生成一个系统作用域线程，并发运行AC_Input_Handler::svc()钩子方法。由于AC_Input_Handler::close() （第 242 页）会等待此线程退出，因此我们不将THR_DETACHED标志传递给activate()。

                                                                                              Lines 10–13 This method is called each time a new connection to the logging server is established. On the initial connection, the message queue will be in the ACTIVATED state, so we set the message queue's high watermark to sizeof(ACE_Log_Record) x ACE_IOV_MAX, just like we do on line 6 of CLD_Handler::open() (page 172). We then spawn a system-scoped thread that runs the AC_Input_Handler::svc() hook method concurrently. Since AC_Input_Handler::close() (page 242) waits for this thread to exit we don't pass the THR_DETACHED flag to activate().

                                                                                              如果消息队列未处于激活状态，则说明日志服务器连接已重新建立。在这种情况下，消息队列的高水位线已被设置，服务线程也已在执行。

                                                                                              If the message queue was not in the ACTIVATED state, however, we know the logging server connection was reestablished. In this case, the message queue's high watermark was already set and the service thread is already executing.

                                                                                              现在我们来介绍AC_Output_Handler::svc()钩子方法，该方法运行在独立的线程中，并将日志记录转发到服务器日志守护进程。如下所示，该方法通过缓冲日志记录来优化网络吞吐量，直到达到最大日志数量或经过最大时间。

                                                                                              We now show the AC_Output_Handler::svc() hook method, which runs in its own thread and forwards log records to the server logging daemon. As shown below, this method optimizes network throughput by buffering log records until a maximum number have arrived or a maximum time elapses.

                                                                                               1 int AC_Output_Handler::svc () { 
 2   ACE_Message_Block *chunk[ACE_IOV_MAX]; 
 3   size_t message_index = 0; 
 4   ACE_Time_Value time_of_last_send (ACE_OS::gettimeofday ()); 
 5   ACE_Time_Value timeout; 
 6   ACE_Sig_Action no_sigpipe ((ACE_SignalHandler) SIG_IGN); 
 7   ACE_Sig_Action original_action; 
 8   no_sigpipe.register_action (SIGPIPE, &original_action); 
 9 
10   for (;;) { 
11     if (message_index == 0) { 
12       timeout = ACE_OS::gettimeofday (); 
13       timeout += FLUSH_TIMEOUT; 
14     } 
15     ACE_Message_Block *mblk = 0; 
16     if (getq (mblk, &timeout) == -1) { 
17       if (errno == ESHUTDOWN) { 
18         if (connector_->reconnect () == -1) break; 
19         continue; 
20       } else if (errno != EWOULDBLOCK) break; 
21       else if (message_index == 0) continue; 
22     } else { 
23       if (mblk->size () == 0 
24           && mblk->msg_type () == ACE_Message_Block::MB_STOP) 
25         { mblk->release (); break; } 
26       chunk[message_index] = mblk; 
27       ++message_index; 
28     } 
29     if (message_index >= ACE_IOV_MAX 
30         || (ACE_OS::gettimeofday () - time_of_last_send 
31             >= FLUSH_TIMEOUT)) { 
32       if (send (chunk, message_index) == -1) break; 
33       time_of_last_send = ACE_OS::gettimeofday (); 
34     } 
35   } 
36 
37   if (message_index > 0) send (chunk, message_index); 
38   no_sigpipe.restore_action (SIGPIPE, original_action); 
39   return 0; 
40 }

                                                                                              我们省略了AC_Output_Handler::send() 的实现，因为它与CLD_Handler::send()（第 175 页）完全相同，后者会将日志记录发送到日志服务器，并在发送过程中连接关闭时重新连接到服务器。实际上，AC_Output_Handler::svc()与CLD_Handler::forward() （第 173 页）类似。主要区别在于，上面的第 17 行到第 20 行会检查队列是否因日志服务器断开连接而触发了脉冲。该脉冲由下面的AC_Output_Handler::handle_input()方法执行，该方法由单例 Reactor 在服务器关闭与客户端日志守护进程的连接时分派。当通过AC_Connector::reconnect()重新建立连接时，ACE_Connector类会调用AC_Output_Handler::open()（第 244 页），该方法会将消息队列的状态改回ACTIVATED。

                                                                                              We omit the AC_Output_Handler::send() implementation since it's identical to CLD_Handler::send() (page 175), which sends log records to the logging server and reconnects to the server if the connection is closed during the send. In fact, AC_Output_Handler::svc() is similar to CLD_Handler::forward() (page 173). The primary difference is that lines 17 through 20 above check to see if the queue was pulsed in response to the logging server disconnecting. The pulse is performed by the AC_Output_Handler::handle_input() method below, which is dispatched by the singleton reactor when the server closes a connection to the client logging daemon. When the connection is reestablished via AC_Connector::reconnect(), the ACE_Connector class calls AC_Output_Handler::open() (page 244), which changes the message queue's state back to ACTIVATED.

                                                                                              1 int AC_Output_Handler::handle_input (ACE_HANDLE h) { 
2   peer ().close (); 
3   reactor ()->remove_handler 
4     (h, ACE_Event_Handler::READ_MASK 
5         | ACE_Event_Handler::DONT_CALL); 
6   msg_queue ()->pulse (); 
7   return 0; 
8 }

                                                                                              第 2 行：闭合连接以释放插座手柄。

                                                                                              Line 2 Close the connection to release the socket handle.

                                                                                              第 3-5 行：由于套接字句柄已失效，因此将其从反应器中移除。由于我们已完成所有必要的清理工作，并且该对象不会被删除，因此将DONT_CALL标志传递给remove_handler()函数。当与服务器日志守护进程的连接重新建立时，将再次调用open()函数，并为该对象注册一个新的套接字。

                                                                                              Lines 3–5 Remove the socket handle from the reactor since it's no longer valid. Since we've now taken care of all required cleanup and this object is not being deleted, the DONT_CALL flag is passed to remove_handler(). When the connection to the server logging daemon is reestablished, open() will be called again, and a new socket will be registered for this object.

                                                                                              第 6 行：为了避免在转发线程可能正在尝试重新连接服务器日志守护进程时再次尝试连接，请使用pulse()方法（第 166 页）将工作转移给转发线程。如果转发线程正在等待同步消息队列（第 244 页）（因此不知道连接已关闭），它将被唤醒并立即开始重新连接。AC_Input_Handler ::handle_input()方法可以继续将消息块排队，从而确保在长时间无法重新建立连接的情况下，流控制能够正确地反向传播到客户端应用程序。

                                                                                              Line 6 To avoid trying to reconnect to the server logging daemon while the forwarder thread may be attempting the same thing, transfer the work to the forwarder thread using the pulse() method (page 166). If the forwarder thread is waiting on the synchronized message queue (page 244) (and therefore unaware that the connection is closed), it will wake up and immediately begin a reconnect. The AC_Input_Handler::handle_input() method can continue to queue message blocks, ensuring that flow control is properly back-propagated to client applications if the connection can't be reestablished for a long amount of time.

                                                                                              当运行svc()钩子方法的线程退出时，ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架会自动调用 ACE_Svc_Handler::close() 方法。此方法会清理所有动态分配的资源，例如同步消息队列及其内容，并从单例 Reactor 中移除 AC_Output_Handler 。

                                                                                              The ACE_Svc_Handler::close() method will be called automatically by the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework when the thread running the svc() hook method exits. This method cleans up all the dynamically allocated resources, such as the synchronized message queue and its contents, and removes the AC_Output_Handler from the singleton reactor.

                                                                                              AC_CLD_Acceptor。 此类提供以下功能： [1]

                                                                                              AC_CLD_Acceptor. This class provides the following capabilities: [1]

                                                                                              [1]虽然AC_CLD_Acceptor目前不对新的日志客户端执行任何身份验证，但可以在AC_CLD_Acceptor和日志客户端代码中添加此功能。这些添加内容留给读者作为练习。

                                                                                              [1] Although AC_CLD_Acceptor doesn't perform any authentication on the new logging client, this could be added to both AC_CLD_Acceptor and in the logging client code. These additions are left as an exercise for the reader.

                                                                                              • 这是一个工厂，它创建AC_Input_Handler的单个实例（第 238 页）。

                                                                                              • It's a factory that creates a single instance of the AC_Input_Handler (page 238).

                                                                                              • 它被动地接受来自客户端的连接。

                                                                                              • It passively accepts connections from clients.

                                                                                              • 它激活AC_Input_Handler的唯一实例，该实例向单例ACE_Reactor注册所有连接。

                                                                                              • It activates the single instance of AC_Input_Handler, which registers all connections with the singleton ACE_Reactor.

                                                                                              AC_CLD_Acceptor类的定义如下所示：

                                                                                              The AC_CLD_Acceptor class definition is shown below:

                                                                                              class AC_CLD_Acceptor 
  : public ACE_Acceptor<AC_Input_Handler, ACE_SOCK_Acceptor> { 
public: 
  AC_CLD_Acceptor (AC_Output_Handler *handler = 0) 
    : output_handler_ (handler), input_handler_ (handler) {} 

protected: 
  typedef ACE_Acceptor<AC_Input_Handler, ACE_SOCK_Acceptor> 
          PARENT; 

  // <ACE_Acceptor> factory method. 
  virtual int make_svc_handler (AC_Input_Handler *&sh); 

  // <ACE_Reactor> close hook method. 
  virtual int handle_close (ACE_HANDLE = ACE_INVALID_HANDLE, 
                            ACE_Reactor_Mask = 0); 

  // Pointer to the output handler. 
  AC_Output_Handler *output_handler_; 

  // Single input handler. 
  AC_Input_Handler input_handler_; 
};

                                                                                              AC_CLD_Acceptor是ACE_Acceptor的子类，因此它继承了第 7.3 节中描述的所有功能。由于我们只需要一个AC_Input_Handler实例，因此我们重写ACE_Acceptor::make_svc_handler()方法，如下所示：

                                                                                              AC_CLD_Acceptor is a subclass of ACE_Acceptor, so it inherits all the capabilities described in Section 7.3. Since we only need one instance of AC_Input_Handler we override the ACE_Acceptor::make_svc_handler() method as follows:

                                                                                              int AC_CLD_Acceptor::make_svc_handler (AC_Input_Handler *&sh) 
{ sh = &input_handler_; return 0; }

                                                                                              此方法将服务处理程序设置为input_handler_数据成员的地址，从而确保无论连接多少客户端，都只有一个AC_Input_Handler实例。

                                                                                              This method sets the service handler to the address of the input_handler_ data member, which ensures there's only one instance of AC_Input_Handler, regardless of the number of clients that connect.

                                                                                              如果在接受连接或向反应器注册句柄和事件处理程序时发生故障，则反应器会自动调用以下AC_CLD_Acceptor::handle_close()方法：

                                                                                              The following AC_CLD_Acceptor::handle_close() method is invoked by the reactor automatically if a failure occurs while accepting a connection or registering a handle and event handler with the reactor:

                                                                                              1 int AC_CLD_Acceptor::handle_close (ACE_HANDLE, 
2                                    ACE_Reactor_Mask) { 
3   PARENT::handle_close (); 
4   input_handler_.close (); 
5   return 0; 
6}

                                                                                              第 3行 调用其父级的handle_close()方法来关闭 acceptor。

                                                                                              Line 3 Call up to its parent's handle_close() method to close the acceptor.

                                                                                              第 4行 调用input_handler_的close()方法（第 242 页）来清理AC_Input_Handler的资源并关闭AC_Output_Handler的消息队列和svc()线程。

                                                                                              Line 4 Call the input_handler_'s close() method (page 242) to clean up the AC_Input_Handler's resources and shut down the AC_Output_Handler's message queue and svc() thread.

                                                                                              AC_CLD_Connector。 此类提供以下功能：

                                                                                              AC_CLD_Connector. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                              • 它会主动建立（并在必要时重新建立）与日志服务器的连接并进行身份验证。

                                                                                              • It actively establishes (and when necessary reestablishes) and authenticates connections with the logging server.

                                                                                              • 它激活一个AC_Output_Handler实例，该实例将日志记录转发到日志服务器，同时 AC_Input_Handler 接收日志记录。

                                                                                              • It activates a single instance of AC_Output_Handler, which forwards log records to the logging server concurrently with respect to the reception of log records by the AC_Input_Handler.

                                                                                              AC_CLD_Connector类的定义如下所示：

                                                                                              The AC_CLD_Connector class definition is shown below:

                                                                                              class AC_CLD_Connector 
  : public ACE_Connector<AC_Output_Handler, ACE_SOCK_Connector> { 
public: 
  typedef ACE_Connector<AC_Output_Handler, ACE_SOCK_Connector> 
          PARENT; 

  AC_CLD_Connector (AC_Output_Handler *handler = 0) 
    : handler_ (handler), ssl_ctx_ (0), ssl_ (0) {} 
  virtual AC_CLD_Connector (void) { // Frees the SSL resources. 
    SSL_free (ssl_); 
    SSL_CTX_free (ssl_ctx_); 
  } 

  // Initialize the Connector. 
  virtual int open (ACE_Reactor *r = ACE_Reactor::instance (), 
                    int flags = 0); 
  int reconnect (); // Re-establish connection to server. 

protected: 
  // Connection establishment and authentication hook method. 
  virtual int connect_svc_handler 
    (AC_Output_Handler *svc_handler, 
     const ACE_SOCK_Connector::PEER_ADDR &remote_addr, 
     ACE_Time_Value *timeout, 
     const ACE_SOCK_Connector::PEER_ADDR &local_addr, 
     int reuse_addr, int flags, int perms); 

  // Pointer to <AC_Output_Handler> we're connecting. 
  AC_Output_Handler *handler_; 

  // Address at which logging server listens for connections. 
  ACE_INET_Addr remote_addr_; 

  // The SSL "context" data structure. 
  SSL_CTX *ssl_ctx_; 

  // The SSL data structure corresponding to authenticated SSL 
  // connections. 
  SSL *ssl_; 
};

                                                                                              CLD_Connector ::open()方法的实现除了使用 OpenSSL 建立客户端身份外，还执行规范的ACE_Connector初始化。

                                                                                              The CLD_Connector::open() method implementation performs the canonical ACE_Connector initialization, in addition to using OpenSSL to establish the client's identity.

                                                                                              #if !defined (CLD_CERTIFICATE_FILENAME) 
#  define CLD_CERTIFICATE_FILENAME "cld-cert.pem" 
#endif /* !CLD_CERTIFICATE_FILENAME */ 
#if !defined (CLD_KEY_FILENAME) 
#  define CLD_KEY_FILENAME "cld-key.pem" 
#endif /* !CLD_KEY_FILENAME */ 

int AC_CLD_Connector::open (ACE_Reactor *r, int flags) { 
  if (PARENT::open (r, flags) != 0) return -1; 
  OpenSSL_add_ssl_algorithms (); 
  ssl_ctx_ = SSL_CTX_new (SSLv3_client_method ()); 
  if (ssl_ctx_ == 0) return -1; 

  if (SSL_CTX_use_certificate_file (ssl_ctx_, 
                                    CLD_CERTIFICATE_FILENAME, 
                                    SSL_FILETYPE_PEM) <= 0 
     || SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey_file (ssl_ctx_, 
                                     CLD_KEY_FILENAME, 
                                     SSL_FILETYPE_PEM) <= 0 
     || !SSL_CTX_check_private_key (ssl_ctx_)) 
    return -1; 

  ssl_ = SSL_new (ssl_ctx_); 
  if (ssl_ == 0) return -1; 
  return 0; 
}

                                                                                              此代码初始化并验证 OpenSSL 数据结构，其逻辑与TPC_Logging_Acceptor::open()的实现（第 224 页）基本相同。

                                                                                              This code initializes and validates the OpenSSL data structures using essentially the same logic as the implementation of TPC_Logging_Acceptor::open() (page 224).

                                                                                              与CLD_Connector不同，AC_CLD_Connector不需要实现connect()方法。它复用了ACE_Connector::connect()模板方法。当通过ACE_Connector建立连接时，框架会调用以下AC_CLD_Connector::connect_svc_handler()钩子方法，该方法使用 OpenSSL 实现身份验证协议，以确保客户端日志守护进程能够连接到服务器日志守护进程。同时，服务器的身份也会得到验证。服务器日志守护进程的协议部分位于TPC_Logging_Acceptor::accept_svc_handler()（第 222 页），客户端日志守护进程的协议部分如下所示：

                                                                                              Unlike CLD_Connector, AC_CLD_Connector needn't implement a connect() method. Instead, it reuses the ACE_Connector::connect() template method. When a connection is completed via ACE_Connector, the framework calls the following AC_CLD_Connector::connect_svc_handler() hook method, which uses OpenSSL to implement an authentication protocol that ensures the client logging daemon is permitted to connect with the server logging daemon. The server's identity is also verified. The server logging daemon's end of this protocol appears in TPC_Logging_Acceptor::accept_svc_handler() (page 222) and the client logging daemon's end is shown below:

                                                                                               1 int AC_CLD_Connector::connect_svc_handler 
 2     (AC_Output_Handler *svc_handler, 
 3      const ACE_SOCK_Connector::PEER_ADDR &remote_addr, 
 4      ACE_Time_Value *timeout, 
 5      const ACE_SOCK_Connector::PEER_ADDR &local_addr, 
 6      int reuse_addr, int flags, int perms) { 
 7   if (PARENT::connect_svc_handler 
 8       (svc_handler, remote_addr, timeout, 
 9       local_addr, reuse_addr, flags, perms) == -1) return -1; 
10   SSL_clear (ssl_); 
11   SSL_set_fd (ssl_, ACE_reinterpret_cast 
12                       (int, svc_handler->get_handle ())); 
13 
14   SSL_set_verify (ssl_, SSL_VERIFY_PEER, 0); 
15 
16   if (SSL_connect (ssl_) == -1 
17       || SSL_shutdown (ssl_) == -1) return -1; 
18   remote_addr_ = remote_addr; 
19   return 0; 
20 }

                                                                                              第 7-9 行使用默认的connect_svc_handler()建立TCP连接。

                                                                                              Lines 7–9 Establish the TCP connection using the default connect_svc_handler().

                                                                                              第 10-12 行重置 SSL 数据结构，以便与新的 SSL 连接一起使用。

                                                                                              Lines 10–12 Reset the SSL data structures for use with a new SSL connection.

                                                                                              第 14 行配置 SSL 数据结构，以便在建立 SSL 连接时执行和强制执行服务器身份验证。

                                                                                              Line 14 Configure the SSL data structures so that authentication of the server is performed and enforced when establishing the SSL connection.

                                                                                              第 16 行执行实际的 SSL 连接/协商。如果服务器身份验证失败，SSL_connect()调用将失败。

                                                                                              Line 16 Perform the actual SSL connection/negotiation. If authentication of the server fails, the SSL_connect() call will fail.

                                                                                              第 17 行：如果身份验证成功，则关闭 SSL 连接。由于我们实际上并未加密数据，因此从现在开始可以通过TCP流进行通信。如果还需要数据加密，请参阅侧边栏 52（第 227 页），其中介绍了如何应用 OpenSSL 的 ACE 封装外观。

                                                                                              Line 17 Shutdown the SSL connection if authentication succeeds. Since we don't actually encrypt the data we can communicate through the TCP stream from here on. If data encryption is also required, Sidebar 52 (page 227) describes how the ACE wrapper facades for OpenSSL can be applied.

                                                                                              第 18 行保存已连接服务器日志守护程序的地址，以便在需要使用下面讨论的AC_CLD_Connector::reconnect()方法重新建立连接时使用。

                                                                                              Line 18 Save the address of the connected server logging daemon in case the connection needs to be reestablished using the AC_CLD_Connector::reconnect() method discussed below.

                                                                                              通过重写open()和connect_svc_handler()钩子方法，我们可以为客户端日志守护进程添加身份验证，而不会影响其实现的任何其他部分。这种可扩展性体现了ACE_Connector类设计中使用的模板方法模式的强大功能。

                                                                                              By overriding the open() and connect_svc_handler() hook methods, we can add authentication to our client logging daemon without affecting any other part of its implementation. This extensibility illustrates the power of the Template Method pattern used in the ACE_Connector class design.

                                                                                              以下AC_CLD_Connector::reconnect()方法使用与CLD_Connector::reconnect() （第 179 页）相同的指数退避算法，以避免用连接请求淹没日志服务器：

                                                                                              The following AC_CLD_Connector::reconnect() method uses the same exponential backoff algorithm as CLD_Connector::reconnect() (page 179) to avoid swamping a logging server with connection requests:

                                                                                              int AC_CLD_Connector::reconnect () { 
  // Maximum number of times to retry connect. 
  const size_t MAX_RETRIES = 5; 
  ACE_Time_Value timeout (1); 
  size_t i; 
  for (i = 0; i < MAX_RETRIES; ++i) { 
    ACE_Synch_Options options (ACE_Synch_Options::USE_TIMEOUT, 
                               timeout); 
    if (i > 0) ACE_OS::sleep (timeout); 
    if (connect (handler_, remote_addr_, options) == 0) 
      break; 
    timeout *= 2; // Exponential backoff. 
  } 
  return i == MAX_RETRIES ? -1 : 0; 
}

                                                                                              AC_Client_Logging_Daemon。 此类是一个外观类，它集成了上述其他类，以实现新的客户端日志守护进程。其定义如下所示：

                                                                                              AC_Client_Logging_Daemon. This class is a facade that integrates the other classes described above to implement the new client logging daemon. Its definition is shown below:

                                                                                              class AC_Client_Logging_Daemon : public ACE_Service_Object { 
protected: 
  // Factory that passively connects the <AC_Input_Handler>. 
  AC_CLD_Acceptor acceptor_; 

  // Factory that actively connects the <AC_Output_Handler>. 
  AC_CLD_Connector connector_; 

  // The <AC_Output_Handler> connected by <AC_CLD_Connector>. 
  AC_Output_Handler output_handler_; 

public: 
  AC_Client_Logging_Daemon () 
    : acceptor_ (&output_handler_), 
      connector_ (&output_handler_) {} 

  // Service Configurator hook methods. 
  virtual int init (int argc, ACE_TCHAR *argv[]); 
  virtual int fini (); 
  virtual int info (ACE_TCHAR **bufferp, size_t length = 0) const; 
  virtual int suspend (); 
  virtual int resume (); 
};

                                                                                              AC_Client_Logging_Daemon继承自ACE_Service_Object 。因此，它可以通过svc.conf文件进行动态配置，该文件由第 5 章中描述的 ACE 服务配置器框架处理。当动态链接AC_Client_Logging_Daemon实例时，ACE 服务配置器框架会调用如下所示的AC_Client_Logging_Daemon::init()钩子方法：

                                                                                              AC_Client_Logging_Daemon inherits from ACE_Service_Object. It can therefore be configured dynamically via a svc.conf file that's processed by the ACE Service Configurator framework described in Chapter 5. When an instance of AC_Client_Logging_Daemon is linked dynamically, the ACE Service Configurator framework calls the AC_Client_Logging_Daemon::init() hook method shown below:

                                                                                               1 int AC_Client_Logging_Daemon::init 
 2       (int argc, ACE_TCHAR *argv[]) { 
 3   u_short cld_port = ACE_DEFAULT_SERVICE_PORT; 
 4   u_short sld_port = ACE_DEFAULT_LOGGING_SERVER_PORT; 
 5   ACE_TCHAR sld_host[MAXHOSTNAMELEN]; 
 6   ACE_OS_String::strcpy (sld_host, ACE_LOCALHOST); 
 7   ACE_Get_Opt get_opt (argc, argv, ACE_TEXT ("p:r:s:"), 0); 
 8   get_opt.long_option (ACE_TEXT ("client_port"), 'p', 
 9                        ACE_Get_Opt::ARG_REQUIRED); 
10   get_opt.long_option (ACE_TEXT ("server_port"), 'r', 
11                        ACE_Get_Opt::ARG_REQUIRED); 
12   get_opt.long_option (ACE_TEXT ("server_name"), 's', 
13                        ACE_Get_Opt::ARG_REQUIRED); 
14 
15   for (int c; (c = get_opt ()) != -1;) 
16     switch (c) { 
17     case 'p': // Client logging daemon acceptor port number. 
18       cld_port = ACE_static_cast 
19         (u_short, ACE_OS::atoi (get_opt.opt_arg ())); 
20       break; 
21     case 'r': // Server logging daemon acceptor port number. 
22       sld_port = ACE_static_cast 
23         (u_short, ACE_OS::atoi (get_opt.opt_arg ())); 
24       break; 
25     case 's': // Server logging daemon hostname. 
26       ACE_OS_String::strsncpy 
27         (sld_host, get_opt.opt_arg (), MAXHOSTNAMELEN); 
28       break; 
29     } 
30 
31   ACE_INET_Addr cld_addr (cld_port); 
32   ACE_INET_Addr sld_addr (sld_port, sld_host); 
33 
34   if (acceptor_.open (cld_addr) == -1) return -1; 
35   AC_Output_Handler *oh = &output_handler_; 
36   if (connector_.connect (oh, sld_addr) == -1) 
37   { acceptor_.close (); return -1; } 
38   return 0; 
39 }

                                                                                              第 3-6 行用于设置默认客户端日志守护进程监听端口 ( cld_port ) 和默认服务器日志守护进程端口 ( sld_port ) 及主机名 ( sld_host )。这些值可以通过传递给此方法的参数进行更改。特别是，服务器日志守护进程的主机名通常需要使用-s选项进行设置。

                                                                                              Lines 3–6 Assign the default client logging daemon listen port (cld_port) and the default server logging daemon port (sld_port) and hostname (sld_host). These can be changed by arguments passed into this method. In particular, the server logging daemon hostname will often need to be set using the -s option.

                                                                                              第 7-29 行：侧边栏 8 （第 47 页）中描述的 ACE_Get_Opt 迭代器解析svc.conf文件传递​​的选项。ACE_Get_Opt的最后一个参数 0确保选项解析从argv[0]开始，而不是默认的argv[1]。如果将任何“-p”、“-r”或“-s”选项或其对应的长选项作为参数传递给init ()函数，则会相应地修改端口号或主机名。

If any of the "-p", "-r",or"-s" options, or their long option equivalents, are passed in the argv parameter to init(), the appropriate port number or hostname is modified accordingly.

{ return acceptor_.close (); }

                                                                                              `fini ()`方法调用`AC_CLD_Acceptor`继承的`close()`方法。`close()` 方法又会调用`AC_CLD_Acceptor::handle_close()`来触发消息队列和转发线程的关闭。`fini ()`返回后，ACE 服务配置器框架会删除 ` AC_Client_Logging_Daemon`实例。此关闭过程如图 7.11所示。

The framework then calls AC_Client_Logging_Daemon::init() through this pointer, passing as its argc/argv argument the string -p followed by an expansion of the CLIENT_LOGGING_DAEMON_PORT environment variable that designates the port number where the client logging daemon listens for client application connection requests.

                                                                                              现在我们准备展示SR_Configurable_Logging_Server.cpp中的main()函数。它与用于其他服务的Configurable_Logging_Server.cpp程序类似，但需要略微不同的策略。侧边栏 11（第 55 页）讨论了事件处理程序无法控制自身生命周期时可能出现的一些问题。本章中的AC_Client_Logging_Daemon服务由 ACE 配置器框架在激活时动态分配。然而，它的 acceptor 和服务处理程序是服务中的成员对象，因此无法控制自身的生命周期。尽管我们的设计精心管理了所有处理程序的生命周期活动，但由于ACE_WFMO_Reactor 的延迟清理语义（第 107 页），在 Windows 上仍然可能出现问题。因此，我们将ACE_Reactor单例显式设置为ACE_Select_Reactor。

                                                                                              We're now ready to show the main() function, in SR_Configurable_Logging_Server.cpp. It's similar to the Configurable_Logging_Server.cpp program used for other services, but requires slightly different tactics. Sidebar 11 (page 55) discusses some problems that can arise when event handlers don't control their own life cycle. The AC_Client_Logging_Daemon service in this chapter is allocated dynamically by the ACE Configurator framework when it's activated. However, its acceptor and service handlers are member objects in the service, and therefore don't control their own life cycle. Although our design carefully manages all the handlers's life cycle activities, problems can still occur on Windows because of the ACE_WFMO_Reactor deferred cleanup semantics (page 107). We therefore explicitly set the ACE_Reactor singleton to be an ACE_Select_Reactor.

 2 #include "ace/Reactor.h" 
 3 #include "ace/Select_Reactor.h" 
 4 #include "ace/Service_Config.h"

 6 int ACE_TMAIN (int argc, ACE_TCHAR *argv[]) {

In this example, however, the reactor must persist until after the ACE_Object_Manager terminates services at shutdown time. To ensure this, we allocate the reactor dynamically. The third argument to the ACE_NEW_RETURN macro is the value to return from main() if allocation fails.

The ACE_Select_Reactor is passed as the implementation to use. This design ensures that the reactor singleton shutdown activity generated by the ACE_Object_Manager will close the reactor and free the dynamically allocated memory after the services are shut down.

                                                                                              本章中的示例阐述了许多强大的 ACE 接收器-连接器技术和策略：

                                                                                              The examples in this chapter have illustrated a number of powerful ACE Acceptor-Connector techniques and strategies:

                                                                                              • 使用单个ACE_Svc_Handler处理多个网络连接

                                                                                              • Using a single ACE_Svc_Handler to process many network connections

                                                                                              • 使用非动态服务处理器和反应器

                                                                                              • Using nondynamic service handlers with a reactor

                                                                                              • 通过脉冲方式向服务处理程序的消息队列发送消息，以与处理程序的服务线程进行通信。

                                                                                              • Pulsing a service handler's message queue to communicate with the handler's service thread

                                                                                              • 使用指数退避策略重新连接TCP套接字

                                                                                              • Reconnecting a TCP socket using an exponential backoff strategy

                                                                                              • 将单例ACE_Reactor替换为 ACE 会自动删除的实例。

                                                                                              • Replacing the singleton ACE_Reactor with one that ACE deletes automatically

                                                                                              本章客户端和服务器日志守护进程的功能显然可以使用不同的机制和协议来实现。然而，由于 ACE 框架设计高度精细，所有重新设计这些守护进程的方法都不需要重写网络代码、缓冲区管理、队列机制、并发策略或解复用技术。唯一的变化在于网络服务本身的实现。

                                                                                              The capabilities in this chapter's client and server logging daemons could clearly be implemented using different mechanisms and protocols. Due to ACE's highly refined framework design, however, none of the different ways to redesign these daemons will require rewriting the networking code, buffer management, queueing mechanisms, concurrency strategies, or demultiplexing techniques. The only changes are in the networked service implementation itself.

                                                                                                7.5 总结

                                                                                                7.5 Summary

                                                                                                ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架将服务的连接和初始化策略与其服务处理策略解耦。这种关注点分离使得每组策略能够独立演进，并促进了网络应用程序的模块化设计。ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架将连接和初始化策略封装到ACE_Acceptor和ACE_Connector类模板中，并将服务处理策略封装到ACE_Svc_Handler类模板中。

                                                                                                The ACE Acceptor-Connector framework decouples a service's connection and initialization strategies from its service handling strategy. This separation of concerns allows each set of strategies to evolve independently and promotes a modular design of networked applications. The ACE Acceptor-Connector framework factors connection and initialization strategies into the ACE_Acceptor and ACE_Connector class templates, and the service handling strategy into the ACE_Svc_Handler class template.

                                                                                                前几章中介绍的 ACE Reactor、Service Configurator 和 Task 框架主要使用类继承和虚方法作为其扩展机制。ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架也使用这些机制，主要用于配置不同的连接建立、通信、并发和服务行为策略。然而，与前几章中的框架不同，ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架中的类在网络应用程序服务中具有内在关联，因此参数化类型的使用在这里发挥着更重要的作用。为了允许并强制执行策略之间的关系，ACE_Acceptor和ACE_Connector都在其模板参数中包含一个派生自ACE_Svc_Handler的类，作为连接工厂的目标。

                                                                                                The ACE Reactor, Service Configurator, and Task frameworks described in earlier chapters use class inheritance and virtual methods as their primary extensibility mechanisms. The ACE Acceptor-Connector framework uses these mechanisms as well, primarily as the means to configure different strategies for connection establishment, communication, concurrency, and service behavior. Unlike the frameworks in previous chapters, however, classes in the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework share an inherent relationship in networked application services, so the use of parameterized types plays a more significant role here. To allow and enforce the relationships between the strategies, both ACE_Acceptor and ACE_Connector include an ACE_Svc_Handler-derived class in their template arguments to act as the target of the connection factory.

                                                                                                本章定义并阐述了网络应用服务在通信和连接方面所扮演的角色，以及面向连接的服务所使用的被动和主动连接模式。尽管《C++NPv1》第三章中描述的ACE Socket包装器外观有助于掌握与C操作系统API相关的问题，但本章阐述了ACE Acceptor-Connector框架的设计如何鼓励角色模块化分离，从而实现高度可扩展和易于维护的设计。示例展示了如何通过定义派生自ACE_Svc_Handler的类，并在继承自ACE_Svc_Handler、ACE_Task和ACE_Event_Handler的钩子和回调方法中添加特定于服务的行为，来轻松定义应用程序的服务处理程序。尽管ACE Acceptor - Connector框架封装了服务建立的最常见用例，但本章还展示了该框架如何使用模板方法模式[ GoF ]，使应用程序开发人员能够自定义每个服务建立步骤的行为，以匹配特定网络应用程序的需求、环境和资源。

                                                                                                This chapter defined and illustrated the communication and connection roles that networked application services play, as well as the passive and active connection modes that connection-oriented services use. Although the ACE Socket wrapper facades described in Chapter 3 of C++NPv1 assist with mastering the problems associated with C operating system APIs, this chapter illustrated how the design of the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework encourages modular separation of roles leading to highly extensible and maintainable designs. The examples showed how easy it is to define an application's service handlers by defining class(es) derived from ACE_Svc_Handler and adding the service-specific behavior in the hook and callback methods inherited from ACE_Svc_Handler, ACE_Task, and ACE_Event_Handler. Although the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework encapsulates the most common use-cases for service establishment, this chapter showed how the framework uses the Template Method pattern [GoF] to allow application developers to customize the behavior of each service establishment step to match the requirements, environment, and resources of specific networked applications.

                                                                                                  第八章 ACE Proactor框架

                                                                                                  Chapter 8. The ACE Proactor Framework

                                                                                                  C章概要​

                                                                                                  CHAPTER SYNOPSIS

                                                                                                  本章概述了当今主流操作系统平台上可用的异步 I/O 机制，并介绍了 ACE Proactor 框架的设计和使用。该框架实现了 Proactor 模式 [ POSA2 ]，使事件驱动型应用程序能够高效地解复用和分发由异步 I/O 操作完成触发的服务请求。本章展示了如何增强客户端日志守护进程，使其采用主动式模型，该模型 (1) 发起 I/O 操作，(2) 解复用 I/O 完成事件，以及 (3) 将这些完成事件分发给应用程序定义的完成处理程序，由这些处理程序处理异步 I/O 操作的结果。

                                                                                                  This chapter outlines the asynchronous I/O mechanisms available on today's popular OS platforms and then describes the design and use of the ACE Proactor framework. This framework implements the Proactor pattern [POSA2], which allows event-driven applications to efficiently demultiplex and dispatch service requests triggered by the completion of asynchronous I/O operations. This chapter shows how to enhance our client logging daemon to use a proactive model that (1) initiates I/O operations, (2) demultiplexes I/O completion events, and (3) dispatches those completion events to application-defined completion handlers that process the results of asynchronous I/O operations.

                                                                                                    8.1 概述

                                                                                                    8.1 Overview

                                                                                                    第三章介绍了ACE Reactor框架，它最常用于响应式I/O模型。基于此模型的应用程序会注册事件处理对象，当可以执行一个或多个所需的I/O操作（例如从套接字接收数据）且很可能立即完成时，Reactor会通知这些对象。I/O操作通常在单个线程中执行，由Reactor的事件分发循环驱动。尽管响应式I/O是一种常见的编程模型，但每个线程一次只能执行一个I/O操作。I/O操作的顺序性可能会成为瓶颈，因为在多个端点上传输大量数据的应用程序无法利用操作系统和/或多个CPU或网络接口提供的并行处理能力。

                                                                                                    Chapter 3 described the ACE Reactor framework, which is most often used with a reactive I/O model. An application based on this model registers event handler objects that are notified by a reactor when it's possible to perform one or more desired I/O operations, such as receiving data on a socket, with a high likelihood of immediate completion. I/O operations are often performed in a single thread, driven by the reactor's event dispatching loop. Although reactive I/O is a common programming model, each thread can execute only one I/O operation at a time. The sequential nature of the I/O operations can be a bottleneck since applications that transfer large amounts of data on multiple endpoints can't use the parallelism available from the OS and/or multiple CPUs or network interfaces.

                                                                                                    缓解反应式 I/O 瓶颈的一种方法是结合使用同步 I/O和多线程模型，例如第 6 章中的线程池模型或第 7 章中的每个连接一个线程模型。多线程有助于并行化应用程序的 I/O 操作，并可能提高性能。然而，在设计中添加多个线程需要适当的同步机制来避免并发风险，例如竞争条件和死锁[ Tan92 ]。这些额外的考虑因素需要具备并发和同步技术方面的专业知识。它们还会增加设计和代码的复杂性，从而增加出现隐蔽缺陷的风险。此外，由于需要分配运行时堆栈、执行上下文切换 [ SS95b ] 以及在 CPU 缓存之间移动数据 [ SKT96 ]，多线程可能会产生相当大的时间/空间开销。

                                                                                                    One way to alleviate the bottlenecks of reactive I/O is to use synchronous I/O in conjunction with a multithreading model, such as the thread pool model in Chapter 6 or the thread-per-connection model in Chapter 7. Multithreading can help parallelize an application's I/O operations and may improve performance. However, adding multiple threads to a design requires appropriate synchronization mechanisms to avoid concurrency hazards, such as race conditions and deadlocks [Tan92]. These additional considerations require expertise in concurrency and synchronization techniques. They also add complexity to both design and code, increasing the risk of subtle defects. Moreover, multithreading can incur non-trivial time/space overhead due to the resources needed to allocate run-time stacks, perform context switches [SS95b], and move data between CPU caches [SKT96].

                                                                                                    主动式 I/O模型通常是一种更具可扩展性的方式，可以缓解被动式 I/O 瓶颈，而无需引入同步 I/O 和多线程的复杂性和开销。该模型允许应用程序通过以下两个阶段执行 I/O 操作：

                                                                                                    A proactive I/O model is often a more scalable way to alleviate reactive I/O bottlenecks without introducing the complexity and overhead of synchronous I/O and multithreading. This model allows an application to execute I/O operations via the following two phases:

                                                                                                    1. 应用程序可以并行地对多个 I/O 句柄发起一个或多个异步 I/O 操作，而无需等待它们完成。

                                                                                                    2. The application can initiate one or more asynchronous I/O operations on multiple I/O handles in parallel without having to wait until they complete.

                                                                                                    3. 当每个操作完成时，操作系统会通知应用程序定义的完成处理程序，然后该处理程序会处理已完成的 I/O 操作的结果。

                                                                                                    4. As each operation completes, the OS notifies an application-defined completion handler that then processes the results from the completed I/O operation.

                                                                                                    主动式 I/O 模型的两个阶段本质上与被动式 I/O 模型的两个阶段相反，在被动式 I/O 模型中，应用程序需要响应应用程序的请求才能进行操作。

                                                                                                    The two phases of the proactive I/O model are essentially the inverse of those in the reactive I/O model, in which an application

                                                                                                    1. 使用事件解复用器来确定何时可以执行 I/O 操作，以及该操作是否可能立即完成，然后

                                                                                                    2. Uses an event demultiplexer to determine when an I/O operation is possible, and likely to complete immediately, and then

                                                                                                    3. 同步执行操作

                                                                                                    4. Performs the operation synchronously

                                                                                                    除了通过异步操作提升应用程序的可扩展性之外，主动式 I/O 模型还能带来其他优势，具体取决于平台对异步 I/O 的实现方式。例如，如果可以同时启动多个异步 I/O 操作，并且每个操作都携带扩展信息（例如文件 I/O 的文件位置），操作系统就可以优化其内部缓冲策略，避免不必要的数据复制。此外，操作系统还可以通过重新排序操作来优化文件 I/O 性能，从而最大限度地减少磁盘磁头移动和/或提高缓存命中率。

                                                                                                    In addition to improving application scalability via asynchrony, the proactive I/O model can offer other benefits, depending on the platform's implementation of asynchronous I/O. For example, if multiple asynchronous I/O operations can be initiated simultaneously and each operation carries extended information, such as file positions for file I/O, the OS can optimize its internal buffering strategy to avoid unnecessary data copies. It can also optimize file I/O performance by reordering operations to minimize disk head movement and/or increase cache hit rates.

                                                                                                    ACE Proactor 框架简化了采用主动式 I/O 模型的程序开发。在此背景下，ACE Proactor 框架负责：

                                                                                                    The ACE Proactor framework simplifies the development of programs that use the proactive I/O model. In this context, the ACE Proactor framework is responsible for

                                                                                                    • 启动异步 I/O 操作

                                                                                                    • Initiating asynchronous I/O operations

                                                                                                    • 保存每个操作的参数并将其传递给完成处理程序。

                                                                                                    • Saving each operation's arguments and relaying them to the completion handler

                                                                                                    • 等待完成事件，以表明这些操作已完成

                                                                                                    • Waiting for completion events that indicate these operations have finished

                                                                                                    • 将完成事件解复用到它们关联的完成处理程序中

                                                                                                    • Demultiplexing the completion events to their associated completion handlers and

                                                                                                    • 调度到处理程序上的钩子方法，以应用程序定义的方式处理事件。

                                                                                                    • Dispatching to hook methods on the handlers to process the events in an application-defined manner

                                                                                                    除了 I/O 相关功能外，ACE Proactor 框架还提供了与 ACE Reactor 框架在第 3.4 节中提供的相同的定时器队列机制。

                                                                                                    In addition to its I/O-related capabilities, the ACE Proactor framework offers the same timer queue mechanisms offered by the ACE Reactor framework in Section 3.4.

                                                                                                    本章介绍以下 ACE Proactor 框架类：

                                                                                                    This chapter describes the following ACE Proactor framework classes:
