                                                                                                    ACE Proactor 框架中各类之间最重要的关系如图 8.1 （第 260 页）所示。根据 Proactor 模式 [ POSA2 ]，这些类扮演以下角色：

                                                                                                    The most important relationships between the classes in the ACE Proactor framework are shown in Figure 8.1 (page 260). These classes play the following roles in accordance with the Proactor pattern [POSA2]:

                                                                                                    图 8.1. ACE Proactor 框架类

                                                                                                    • 异步 I/O 基础架构层类 执行与应用程序无关的策略，这些策略启动异步 I/O 操作，将完成事件解复用到各自的完成处理程序，然后分发关联的完成处理程序钩子方法。ACE Proactor 框架中的基础架构层类包括ACE_Asynch_Acceptor、ACE_Asynch_Connector、ACE_Asynch_Result、ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream、ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream以及ACE_Proactor的各种实现。基础架构层还使用了3.2节和3.4节中的ACE_Time_Value和 ACE 定时器队列类。

                                                                                                    • Asynchronous I/O infrastructure layer classes perform application-independent strategies that initiate asynchronous I/O operations, demultiplex completion events to their completion handlers, and then dispatch the associated completion handler hook methods.The infrastructure layer classes in the ACE Proactor framework include ACE_Asynch_Acceptor, ACE_Asynch_Connector, ACE_Asynch_Result, ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream, ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream, and various implementations of ACE_Proactor. The infrastructure layer also uses the ACE_Time_Value and ACE timer queue classes from Sections 3.2 and 3.4.

                                                                                                    • 应用层类 包含完成处理程序，这些处理程序在其钩子方法中执行应用程序定义的处理。在 ACE Proactor 框架中，这些类是ACE_Handler和/或ACE_Service_Handler的子类。

                                                                                                    • Application layer classes include completion handlers that perform application-defined processing in their hook methods. In the ACE Proactor framework, these classes are descendants of ACE_Handler and/or ACE_Service_Handler.

                                                                                                    ACE Proactor 框架的强大之处在于其基础设施类和应用类之间的关注点分离。通过将完成解复用和分发机制与应用程序定义的事件处理策略解耦，ACE Proactor 框架提供了以下优势：

                                                                                                    The power of the ACE Proactor framework comes from the separation of concerns between its infrastructure classes and application classes. By decoupling completion demultiplexing and dispatching mechanisms from application-defined event processing policies, the ACE Proactor framework provides the following benefits:

                                                                                                    • 提升可移植性。 应用程序可以在许多具有不同异步 I/O 机制的平台上利用主动式 I/O 模型。它在 Windows 上使用重叠 I/O （需要 Windows NT 4.0 及更高版本），并在实现了 POSIX.4 实时扩展标准 [ POS95 ]的平台上使用异步 I/O (AIO) 选项，这些平台包括 HP-UX、IRIX、Linux、LynxOS 和 Solaris。

                                                                                                    • Improve portability. Applications can take advantage of the proactive I/O model on many platforms that have diverse asynchronous I/O mechanisms. It uses overlapped I/O on Windows (requires Windows NT version 4.0 and higher) and the Asynchronous I/O (AIO) option of the POSIX.4 Realtime Extension standard [POS95] on platforms that implement it, including HP-UX, IRIX, Linux, LynxOS, and Solaris.

                                                                                                    • ACE Proactor 框架实现了任务完成检测、解复用和调度的自动化。 它将原生操作系统 I/O 初始化和完成解复用 API 以及定时器支持隔离到基础架构层框架类中。应用程序可以使用这些面向对象的机制来启动异步操作，而只需实现应用程序定义的完成处理程序即可。

                                                                                                    • Automates completion detection, demultiplexing, and dispatching. The ACE Proactor framework isolates native OS I/O initiation and completion demultiplexing APIs, as well as timer support, in infrastructure layer framework classes. Applications can use these object-oriented mechanisms to initiate asynchronous operations, and only need to implement application-defined completion handlers.

                                                                                                    • 支持透明扩展。如第 8.5 节 所示，ACE Proactor 框架使用桥接模式 [ GoF ] 导出具有统一、明确定义行为的接口。这种设计允许框架内部结构在无需任何应用层更改的情况下，根据操作系统提供的不同异步 I/O 实现及其缺陷进行更改和适应。

                                                                                                    • Support transparent extensibility. As shown in Section 8.5, the ACE Proactor framework uses the Bridge pattern [GoF] to export an interface with uniform, well-defined behavior. This design allows the framework internals to change and adapt to varying OS-provided asynchronous I/O implementations and shortcomings without requiring any application-layer changes.

                                                                                                    • 提高代码复用率并最大限度地减少容易出错的编程细节。 通过将异步 I/O 机制与应用程序定义的策略和行为分离，ACE Proactor 框架可以在许多不同的应用程序领域中复用。

                                                                                                    • Increase reuse and minimize error-prone programming details. By separating asynchronous I/O mechanisms from application-defined policies and behavior, the ACE Proactor framework can be reused across many diverse application domains.

                                                                                                    • 线程安全。 应用程序可以利用操作系统平台提供的 I/O 并行性，而无需复杂的应用程序级同步策略。当应用程序操作的启动和完成处理代码在单个线程中执行时，只需遵循简单的数据访问规则，例如“在 I/O 操作完成之前，不要操作已交给操作系统进行 I/O 操作的缓冲区”。

                                                                                                    • Thread safety. Applications can use I/O parallelism offered by the OS platform without needing complicated application-level synchronization strategies. When application operation initiation and completion handling code is processed in a single thread, there are only simple data access rules to follow, such as "don't manipulate a buffer that's been given to the OS for I/O before that I/O is complete."

                                                                                                    ACE Proactor 框架是一个白盒框架，因为网络应用程序事件处理程序必须继承自ACE_Handler，这与 ACE Reactor 框架类似。

                                                                                                    The ACE Proactor framework is a whitebox framework since networked application event handlers must descend from ACE_Handler, similar to the ACE Reactor framework.

                                                                                                    以下各节将阐述 ACE Proactor 框架中每个类的功能，并说明如何使用该框架为客户端日志守护进程实现异步 I/O。如果您不熟悉 POSA2 中的 Proactor 模式，我们建议您先阅读相关资料，然后再深入研究本章的详细示例。

                                                                                                    The following sections motivate and describe the capabilities of each class in the ACE Proactor framework. They also illustrate how this framework can be used to apply asynchronous I/O to our client logging daemon. If you aren't familiar with the Proactor pattern from POSA2, we recommend that you read about it first before delving into the detailed examples in this chapter.

                                                                                                      8.2 异步 I/O 工厂类

                                                                                                      8.2 The Asynchronous I/O Factory Classes

                                                                                                      动机

                                                                                                      Motivation

                                                                                                      主动式 I/O 模型通常比被动式和同步式 I/O 模型更难编程，因为

                                                                                                      The proactive I/O model is generally harder to program than reactive and synchronous I/O models because

                                                                                                      • I/O 的发起和完成是不同的活动，必须分别处理。

                                                                                                      • I/O initiation and completion are distinct activities that must be handled separately.

                                                                                                      • 可以同时启动多个 I/O 操作，这就需要更多的记录保存。

                                                                                                      • Multiple I/O operations can be initiated simultaneously, which requires more recordkeeping.

                                                                                                      • 当多个 I/O 操作同时完成时，无法保证完成顺序。

                                                                                                      • There's no guaranteed completion order when multiple I/O operations complete simultaneously.

                                                                                                      • 在多线程服务中，完成处理程序可能在与发起 I/O 操作的线程不同的线程中执行。

                                                                                                      • In a multithreaded service a completion handler may execute in a thread other than the one that initiated the I/O operation.

                                                                                                      因此，主动式 I/O 模型需要一个工厂来启动异步 I/O 操作。由于多个 I/O 操作可以同时执行并以任意顺序完成，因此主动式模型还需要在每个异步操作、其参数（例如 I/O 句柄、数据缓冲区和缓冲区大小）以及将处理操作结果的完成处理程序之间建立显式绑定。

                                                                                                      The proactive I/O model therefore requires a factory to initiate asynchronous I/O operations. Since multiple I/O operations can execute simultaneously and complete in any order, the proactive model also requires an explicit binding between each asynchronous operation, its parameters (such as the I/O handle, data buffer, and buffer size), and the completion handler that will process the results of the operation.

                                                                                                      理论上，设计用于生成异步 I/O 操作并将其绑定到完成处理程序的类应该相对简单。然而，在实践中，由于当今流行的操作系统平台上异步 I/O 的实现方式各不相同，设计变得复杂起来。以下是两个常见的例子：

                                                                                                      In theory, designing classes to generate asynchronous I/O operations and bind them to their completion handlers should be relatively straightforward. In practice, however, the design is complicated by the fact that asynchronous I/O is implemented in different ways across today's popular OS platforms. Two common examples include:

                                                                                                      • Windows 系统中的ReadFile()和WriteFile()系统函数既可以执行同步 I/O 操作，也可以发起重叠 I/O 操作。

                                                                                                      • Windows. The Windows ReadFile() and WriteFile() system functions can either perform synchronous I/O or initiate an overlapped I/O operation.

                                                                                                      • POSIX。POSIX aio_read ()和aio_write()函数分别用于启动异步读取和写入操作。这些函数与 ACE 的 IPC 包装外观类中使用的read()和write()函数（以及套接字的recv()和send()函数）不同（参见 C++NPv1 第 3 章）。

                                                                                                      • POSIX. The POSIX aio_read() and aio_write() functions initiate asynchronous read and write operations, respectively. These functions are separate from the read() and write() (and Sockets recv() and send()) functions that are used in ACE's IPC wrapper facade classes (see Chapter 3 in C++NPv1).

                                                                                                      每个平台的异步 I/O 机制都包含各自的绑定 I/O 操作及其参数（例如缓冲区指针和传输大小）的机制。例如，POSIX AIO 提供了一个 AIO 控制块 ( aiocb )，而 Windows 则提供了OVERLAPPED结构以及一个用于 I/O 完成端口的完成键参数。侧边栏 54讨论了操作系统异步 I/O 机制面临的其他挑战。

                                                                                                      Each platform's asynchronous I/O facility also includes its own mechanism for binding an I/O operation with its parameters, such as buffer pointer and transfer size. For example, POSIX AIO provides an AIO control block (aiocb), whereas Windows provides the OVERLAPPED structure and a completion key argument to the I/O completion port facility. Sidebar 54 discusses other challenges with OS asynchronous I/O mechanisms.

                                                                                                      侧边栏 54：异步 I/O 可移植性问题

                                                                                                      Sidebar 54: Asynchronous I/O Portability Issues

                                                                                                      与大多数现代操作系统都支持的同步 I/O 和响应式 I/O 不同，异步 I/O 并不普遍。ACE 支持的以下操作系统平台提供异步 I/O 机制：

                                                                                                      Unlike synchronous I/O and reactive I/O, which are available on most modern operating systems, asynchronous I/O is not ubiquitous. The following OS platforms supported by ACE provide asynchronous I/O mechanisms:

                                                                                                      • 支持重叠 I/O 和 I/O 完成端口的Windows 平台[ Ric97 ]。重叠 I/O 是 Windows 上一种高效且可扩展的 I/O 机制 [ Sol98 ]。Windows 通过 I/O 完成端口和事件句柄执行完成事件解复用。I/O 完成端口是由 Windows 内核管理的队列，用于缓冲 I/O 完成事件。

                                                                                                      • Windows platforms that support both overlapped I/O and I/O completion ports [Ric97]. Overlapped I/O is an efficient and scalable I/O mechanism on Windows [Sol98]. Windows performs completion event demultiplexing via I/O completion ports and event handles. An I/O completion port is a queue managed by the Windows kernel to buffer I/O completion events.

                                                                                                      • 实现了 POSIX.4 AIO 规范 [ POS95 ] 的POSIX 平台。该规范最初是为磁盘文件 I/O [ Gal95 ] 设计的，但也可用于网络 I/O，只是效果参差不齐。应用程序线程可以通过aio_suspend()等待完成事件，也可以接收实时信号通知，但将实时信号集成到事件驱动型应用程序中比较棘手。总的来说，POSIX.4 AIO 需要格外注意才能正确高效地编写主动式模型。尽管 UNIX 的 I/O 系统函数通常在不同的 IPC 机制之间具有互换性，但在某些平台上，POSIX AIO 与其他 IPC 机制（例如 Socket API）的集成仍有待改进。例如，Socket API 中的connect()和accept()等函数并未与 POSIX AIO 模型集成，而且某些 AIO 实现无法在所有情况下处理对同一句柄的多个未完成操作。

                                                                                                      • POSIX platforms that implement the POSIX.4 AIO specification [POS95]. This specification was originally designed for disk file I/O [Gal95], but can also be used for network I/O with varying degress of success. An application thread can wait for completion events via aio_suspend() or be notified by real-time signals, which are tricky to integrate into an event-driven application. In general, POSIX.4 AIO requires extra care to program the proactive model correctly and efficiently. Despite UNIX's usual interchangeability of I/O system functions across IPC mechanisms, integration of the POSIX AIO facility with other IPC mechanisms, such as the Socket API, leaves much to be desired on some platforms. For example, Socket API functions such as connect() and accept() are not integrated with the POSIX AIO model, and some AIO implementations can't handle multiple outstanding operations on a handle under all conditions.

                                                                                                      异步 I/O 的性能特征也可能差异很大。例如，一些操作系统通过为每个异步 I/O 操作创建一个线程来实现 POSIX AIO 功能。虽然这种实现方式符合规范，但与应用程序自行创建线程相比，它并没有带来任何性能提升。事实上，这种实现方式甚至可能会降低 I/O 密集型应用程序的性能！希望操作系统对异步 I/O 的实现能够尽快改进，从而使这种强大的机制得到更广泛的应用。

                                                                                                      Asynchronous I/O performance characteristics can also vary widely. For example, some operating systems implement the POSIX AIO functions by spawning a thread for each asynchronous I/O operation. Although this is a compliant implementation, it provides no performance gain relative to an application spawning the thread itself. In fact, this implementation can actually degrade the performance of I/O-intensive applications rather than improve it! Hopefully, OS asynchronous I/O implementations will soon improve, allowing wider use of this powerful mechanism.

                                                                                                      上文讨论的所有异步 I/O 机制都使用 I/O 句柄来引用要执行 I/O 操作的 IPC 通道或文件。ACE Proactor 框架定义了一组类，用于在各种 IPC 机制上启动异步 I/O。这些类增强了可移植性，降低了复杂性，并避免了重新引入 C++NPv1 中已解决的与 I/O 句柄相关的问题。本书将重点介绍网络应用程序中最常用的两个类：ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream和ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream。

                                                                                                      All the asynchronous I/O mechanisms discussed above use an I/O handle to refer to the IPC channel or file on which to perform the I/O. The ACE Proactor framework defines a set of classes that initiate asynchronous I/O on various IPC mechanisms. These classes enhance portability, minimize complexity, and avoid reintroducing the I/O handle-related problems mastered in C++NPv1. This book examines the two most popular classes for networked applications, ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream and ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream.

                                                                                                      等级能力

                                                                                                      Class Capabilities

                                                                                                      ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream和ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream是工厂类，分别使应用程序能够发起可移植的异步读取和写入操作。这些类提供以下功能：

                                                                                                      ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream and ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream are factory classes that enable applications to initiate portable asynchronous read() and write() operations, respectively. These classes provide the following capabilities:

                                                                                                      • 它们可以在面向流的 IPC 机制（例如TCP套接字）上发起异步 I/O 操作。

                                                                                                      • They can initiate asynchronous I/O operations on a stream-oriented IPC mechanism, such as a TCP socket.

                                                                                                      • 它们绑定 I/O 句柄、ACE_Handler对象和ACE_Proactor ，以正确、高效地处理 I/O 完成事件。

                                                                                                      • They bind an I/O handle, an ACE_Handler object, and an ACE_Proactor to process I/O completion events correctly and efficiently.

                                                                                                      • 它们创建一个对象，该对象通过 ACE Proactor 框架将操作参数传递给其完成处理程序。

                                                                                                      • They create an object that carries an operation's parameters through the ACE Proactor framework to its completion handler.

                                                                                                      • 它们源自ACE_Asynch_Operation，该接口提供初始化对象和请求取消未完成的 I/O 操作的接口。

                                                                                                      • They derive from ACE_Asynch_Operation, which provides the interface to initialize the object and to request cancellation of outstanding I/O operations.

                                                                                                      ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream和ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream定义了嵌套的Result类，用于表示操作与其参数之间的绑定关系。ACE Proactor 框架将常见的面向结果的行为抽象到ACE_Asynch_Result类中，嵌套的Result类均继承自该类。这组类共同提供了一个具有以下功能的完成处理程序：

                                                                                                      ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream and ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream define nested Result classes to represent the binding between an operation and its parameters. The ACE Proactor framework abstracts common results-oriented behavior into the ACE_Asynch_Result class from which the nested Result classes derive. Together, this set of classes provides a completion handler with the following capabilities:

                                                                                                      • 它可以获取 I/O 操作的原始参数，例如请求的传输字节数和内存地址。

                                                                                                      • It can obtain the original parameters for an I/O operation, such as the requested transfer byte count and the memory address.

                                                                                                      • 它可以决定相关操作的成败。

                                                                                                      • It can determine the success or failure of the associated operation.

                                                                                                      • 可以传递一个异步完成令牌（ACT） [ POSA2 ]，它提供了一种方法来扩展操作发起者和完成处理程序之间通信的信息量和信息类型。

                                                                                                      • It can be passed an asynchronous completion token (ACT) [POSA2] that provides a method to extend the amount and type of information communicated between the operation initiator and the completion handler.

                                                                                                      图 8.2 （第 264 页）展示了ACE_Asynch_Result、ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream、ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream及其嵌套的Result类的接口。下表列出了ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream中的关键方法：

The following table lists the key methods in ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream:

                                                                                                      open ()方法将异步 I/O 工厂对象绑定到

                                                                                                      The open() methods bind the asynchronous I/O factory object to

                                                                                                      • 用于启动 I/O 操作的句柄

                                                                                                      • The handle that's used to initiate I/O operations

                                                                                                      • ACE_Proactor对象将检测并解复用这些 I/O 操作的完成事件

                                                                                                      • The ACE_Proactor object that will detect and demultiplex completion events for those I/O operations

                                                                                                      • ACE_Handler对象将处理由 proactor 分发的 I/O 完成操作

                                                                                                      • The ACE_Handler object that will handle proactor-dispatched I/O completions

                                                                                                      act参数是一个异步完成令牌，它将与通过 I/O 工厂对象发出的每个 I/O 操作关联。操作完成后，可以使用ACE_Asynch_Result中的act()方法来检索act参数。然而，此功能仅适用于 Windows，因此本书不介绍其用法。

                                                                                                      The act parameter is an asynchronous completion token that will be associated with each I/O operation issued via the I/O factory object. When the operation completes, the act parameter can be retrieved using the act() method in ACE_Asynch_Result. This feature is specific to Windows, however, so we don't show its use in this book.

                                                                                                      read ()和write()方法分别使用ACE_Message_Block来接收和发送消息，从而提供以下好处：

                                                                                                      The read() and write() methods use an ACE_Message_Block to receive into and send from, respectively, thereby providing the following benefits:

                                                                                                      • 简化缓冲区管理。 由于异步 I/O 的启动和完成由不同的类处理，因此每个 I/O 操作都必须关联缓冲区地址、可用空间和已用空间等信息。重用ACE_Message_Block可以高效且可移植地满足这些需求。

                                                                                                      • Simplified buffer management. Since asynchronous I/O initiation and completion are handled in separate classes, information concerning buffer addresses, available space, and used space must be associated with each I/O operation. Reusing ACE_Message_Block addresses these needs portably and efficiently.

                                                                                                      • 自动传输计数更新。`write ()`方法从消息块的读取指针开始传输字节，即从消息中读取字节。相反，` read()`方法从消息块的写入指针开始向其中写入字节，即向消息中写入新字节。I/O 操作成功完成后，消息块的读取指针和写入指针会更新，以反映成功传输的字节数。因此，应用程序无需调整消息缓冲区指针或大小，因为 ACE Proactor 框架会自动处理这些操作。侧边栏 55（第 275 页）进一步描述了 ACE Proactor 框架如何管理`ACE_Message_Block`指针。

                                                                                                      • Automatic transfer count udpate. The write() method starts transferring bytes from the message block's read pointer, that is, it reads bytes out of the message. Conversely, the read() method starts reading into the message block beginning at its write pointer, that is, it writes new bytes into the message. After successful completion of an I/O operation, the message block's read and write pointers are updated to reflect the number of bytes transferred successfully. Applications therefore needn't adjust message buffer pointers or sizes since the ACE Proactor framework handles this automatically. Sidebar 55 (page 275) further describes how the ACE Proactor framework manages ACE_Message_Block pointers.

                                                                                                      • 与其他 ACE 框架轻松集成。ACE_Message_Block提供了一种便捷的 机制，用于获取或转发数据，以便在 ACE Task 框架（第 6 章）、ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架（第 7 章）和 ACE Streams 框架（第 9 章）中进行进一步处理。

                                                                                                      • Easy integration with other ACE frameworks. The ACE_Message_Block provides a convenient mechanism to obtain or forward data for further processing in the ACE Task framework (Chapter 6), ACE Acceptor-Connector framework (Chapter 7), and the ACE Streams framework (Chapter 9).

                                                                                                      与C++NPv1 中描述的ACE_SOCK_Stream等 ACE IPC 封装外观不同，ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream和ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream不封装任何底层 IPC 机制。相反，它们定义了用于启动异步 I/O 操作的接口。这种设计带来了以下优点：

                                                                                                      In contrast to the ACE IPC wrapper facades, such as ACE_SOCK_Stream described in C++NPv1, ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream and ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream don't encapsulate any underlying IPC mechanisms. Instead, they define the interface for initiating asynchronous I/O operations. This design yields the following benefits:

                                                                                                      • 它允许在 ACE Proactor 框架中重用 ACE 的 IPC 包装器外观类，例如ACE_SOCK_Stream和ACE_SPIPE_Stream，从而避免重新创建一组只能在 Proactor 框架中使用的并行 IPC 类。

                                                                                                      • It allows reuse of ACE's IPC wrapper facade classes, such as ACE_SOCK_Stream and ACE_SPIPE_Stream, in the ACE Proactor framework and avoids recreating a parallel set of IPC classes usable only in the Proactor framework.

                                                                                                      • 它通过仅公开所需的 I/O 操作发起程序来强制执行 I/O 句柄的滥用结构。

                                                                                                      • It imposes a structure to avoid misuse of I/O handles by exposing only the desired I/O operation initiators.

                                                                                                      • 它通过将 I/O 句柄交给异步操作工厂，简化了同步和异步 I/O 对同一 IPC 类的使用。

                                                                                                      • It facilitates use of the same IPC classes for synchronous and asynchronous I/O by giving the I/O handle to the asynchronous operation factory.

                                                                                                      因此，使用 ACE 编写的网络应用程序可以采用同步、响应式和主动式 I/O 的任意组合。如果需要，可以在编译时或运行时决定使用哪种 I/O 机制。实际上，甚至可以将决定推迟到 IPC 对象设置完成后再进行！例如，应用程序可以在建立套接字连接后决定使用哪种机制 [ HPS97 ]。

                                                                                                      Therefore, networked applications written with ACE can use any combination of synchronous, reactive, and proactive I/O. The decision concerning which I/O mechanism to use can be made at compile time or run time if desired. In fact, the decision can be deferred until after the IPC object is set up! For example, an application may decide which mechanism to use after establishing a socket connection [HPS97].

                                                                                                      ACE Proactor 框架还包含用于启动数据报 I/O 操作（ACE_Asynch_Read_Dgram和ACE_Asynch_Write_Dgram）以及文件 I/O 操作（ACE_Asynch_Read_File、ACE_Asynch_Write_File和ACE_Asynch_Transmit_File ）的工厂类。这些类的设计和功能与本章所述类似。详情请参阅 ACE 在线文档：http://ace.ece.uci.edu/Doxygen/或http://www.riverace.com/docs/ 。

                                                                                                      The ACE Proactor framework also contains factory classes for initiating datagram I/O operations (ACE_Asynch_Read_Dgram and ACE_Asynch_Write_Dgram) and file I/O operations (ACE_Asynch_Read_File, ACE_Asynch_Write_File, and ACE_Asynch_Transmit_File). The designs and capabilities of these classes are similar to those described in this chapter. Please consult the online ACE documentation at http://ace.ece.uci.edu/Doxygen/ or http://www.riverace.com/docs/ for details.

                                                                                                      例子

                                                                                                      Example

                                                                                                      本章使用 ACE Proactor 框架重新实现了第 7 章中的客户端日志守护进程服务。虽然主动式客户端日志守护进程服务中使用的类与 Acceptor-Connector 版本中的类类似，但主动式版本使用单个应用程序线程来启动和处理所有 I/O 操作的完成情况。

                                                                                                      This chapter reimplements the client logging daemon service from Chapter 7 using the ACE Proactor framework. Although the classes used in the proactive client logging daemon service are similar to those in the Acceptor-Connector version, the proactive version uses a single application thread to initiate and handle completions for all its I/O operations.

                                                                                                      图 8.3展示了基于 ACE Proactor 框架的客户端日志守护进程的组成类。每个类的作用概述如下：

                                                                                                      The classes comprising the client logging daemon based on the ACE Proactor framework are shown in Figure 8.3. The role of each class is outlined below:

                                                                                                      这些类的实例之间的交互如图 8.4 （第 268 页）所示。本例将首先介绍AIO_Output_Handler类，并在本章后续章节中介绍其他类。

                                                                                                      The interactions between instances of these classes are shown in Figure 8.4 (page 268). We'll start describing the AIO_Output_Handler class in this example and present the other classes in subsequent sections in this chapter.

                                                                                                      图 8.4. 主动客户端日志记录守护程序中的交互

                                                                                                      本示例的源代码位于AIO_Client_Logging_Daemon.cpp文件中。AIO_Output_Handler类将日志记录转发到服务器日志守护进程。以下是其类定义的部分内容：

                                                                                                      The source code for this example is in the AIO_Client_Logging_Daemon.cpp file. The AIO_Output_Handler class forwards log records to a server logging daemon. A portion of its class definition follows:

                                                                                                      class AIO_Output_Handler 
  : public ACE_Task<ACE_NULL_SYNCH>, 
    public ACE_Service_Handler {

                                                                                                      AIO_Output_Handler继承自ACE_Task，以重用其ACE_Message_Queue。由于此服务中的所有工作都在同一个应用程序线程中完成，因此该队列是非同步的。由于AIO_Output_Handler派生自ACE_Service_Handler，因此它可以处理完成事件（详见8.3 节），并作为AIO_CLD_Connector异步连接工厂的目标（详见8.4 节）。

                                                                                                      AIO_Output_Handler inherits from ACE_Task to reuse its ACE_Message_Queue. This queue is unsynchronized since all work in this service occurs in one application thread. Since AIO_Output_Handler derives from ACE_Service_Handler, it can process completion events (described in Section 8.3) and act as the target of the AIO_CLD_Connector asynchronous connection factory (described in Section 8.4).

                                                                                                      public: 
  AIO_Output_Handler (): can_write_ (0) {} 

  virtual AIO_Output_Handler (); 

  // Entry point into the <AIO_Output_Handler>. 
  virtual int put (ACE_Message_Block *, ACE_Time_Value * = 0); 

  // Hook method called when server connection is established. 
  virtual void open (ACE_HANDLE new_handle, 
                     ACE_Message_Block &message_block); 

protected: 
  ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream reader_; // Detects connection loss. 
  ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream writer_; // Sends records to server. 
  int can_write_; // Safe to begin sending a log record? 

  // Initiate the send of a log record. 
  void start_write (ACE_Message_Block *mblk = 0); 
}; 

typedef ACE_Unmanaged_Singleton<AIO_Output_Handler, 
                                ACE_Null_Mutex> 
        OUTPUT_HANDLER;

                                                                                                      AIO_Output_Handler包含一个ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream，用于检测服务器连接何时关闭。它还包含一个ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream，用于启动异步write()操作，将日志记录发送到服务器日志守护程序。

                                                                                                      AIO_Output_Handler contains an ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream to detect when the server connection closes. It also contains an ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream to initiate asynchronous write() operations that send log records to the server logging daemon.

                                                                                                      由于与服务器日志守护进程之间只有一个TCP连接，我们使用单个AIO_Output_Handler将日志记录转发到服务器日志守护进程。因此，我们将OUTPUT_HANDLER定义为ACE_Unmanaged_Singleton（第 194 页）。之所以将其定义为非托管的，是为了确保我们能够控制其生命周期，因为此服务可能在程序结束前停止并断开连接。同步特性类为ACE_Null_Mutex ，因为对该单例的所有访问都发生在同一个线程中。

                                                                                                      Since there's one TCP connection to the server logging daemon, we use a single AIO_Output_Handler to forward log records to the server logging daemon. We therefore define OUTPUT_HANDLER as an ACE_Unmanaged_Singleton (page 194). It's unmanaged to ensure that we control its life cycle since this service may be stopped and unlinked before the end of the program. The synchronization traits class is ACE_Null_Mutex because all access to the singleton occurs in one thread.

                                                                                                      当服务器日志守护进程连接建立后，ACE Proactor 框架会调用以下open() hook 方法：

                                                                                                      When the server logging daemon connection is established, the following open() hook method is dispatched by the ACE Proactor framework:

                                                                                                       1 void AIO_Output_Handler::open 
 2     (ACE_HANDLE new_handle, ACE_Message_Block &) { 
 3   ACE_SOCK_Stream temp_peer (new_handle); 
 4   int bufsiz = ACE_DEFAULT_MAX_SOCKET_BUFSIZ; 
 5   temp_peer.set_option (SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDBUF, 
 6                         &bufsiz, sizeof bufsiz); 
 7 
 8   reader_.open (*this, new_handle, 0, proactor ()); 
 9   writer_.open (*this, new_handle, 0, proactor ()); 
10 
11   ACE_Message_Block *mb; 
12   ACE_NEW (mb, ACE_Message_Block (1)); 
13   reader_.read (*mb, 1); 
14   ACE_Sig_Action no_sigpipe ((ACE_SignalHandler) SIG_IGN); 
15   no_sigpipe.register_action (SIGPIPE, 0); 
16   can_write_ = 1; 
17   start_write (0); 
18 }

                                                                                                      第 3-6 行：将新套接字的发送缓冲区增大到最大值，以在长延迟和/或高速网络上最大化吞吐量。我们使用一个临时的ACE_SOCK_Stream对象以类型安全的方式设置缓冲区。

                                                                                                      Lines 3–6 Increase the new socket's send buffer to its largest size to maximize throughput over long-delay and/or high-speed networks. We use a temporary ACE_SOCK_Stream object to set the buffer in a type-safe manner.

                                                                                                      第 8-9 行初始化reader_和writer_对象。它们分别指定此对象作为完成处理程序、用于发出操作的新套接字句柄，以及用于打开连接的同一个ACE_Proactor 。由于未使用完成键 ( ACT ) 功能，因此第三个参数为 0。初始化完成后， reader_和writer_用于启动异步 I/O 操作。

                                                                                                      Lines 8–9 Initialize the reader_ and writer_ objects. Each specifies this object as the completion handler, the new socket handle to issue operations on, and the same ACE_Proactor used to open the connection. The completion key (ACT) facility isn't used, so the third argument is 0. After initialization, the reader_ and writer_ are used to initiate asynchronous I/O operations.

                                                                                                      第 11-13 行：7.4 节示例部分的客户端日志守护进程在反应器中注册了用于输入事件的服务器套接字。在主动模型中，我们发起一个异步的read() 操作，读取一个字节。如果此操作最终完成，则要么是服务器发送了数据（这违反了协议），要么是服务器关闭了其套接字端点。

                                                                                                      Lines 11–13 The client logging daemon in the Example part of Section 7.4 registered the server socket for input events in a reactor. In the proactive model, we initiate an asynchronous read() for one byte. If this operation ever completes, either the server sent data (which violates the protocol) or the server closed its socket endpoint.

                                                                                                      第 14-15 行与其他依赖READ事件来检测已关闭套接字的示例一样，忽略SIGPIPE信号，这样异步write()操作就不会在连接关闭时中止程序。

                                                                                                      Lines 14–15 As in other examples that rely on a READ event to detect a closed socket, ignore the SIGPIPE signal so that asynchronous write() operations won't abort the program if the connection is closed.

                                                                                                      第 16-17 行为了避免在存在部分写入的情况下交错日志记录，我们每次只传输一条日志记录。`can_write_`标志指示是否可以安全地开始写入新的日志记录。由于此连接是新打开的，现在可以安全地写入，因此我们设置该标志，然后调用以下 ` start_write()`方法来启动异步写入操作：

                                                                                                      Lines 16–17 To avoid interleaving log records in the presence of partial writes, we only transmit one log record at a time. The can_write_ flag indicates whether it's safe to start writing a new log record or not. Since this connection is newly opened, it's now safe to write, so we set the flag and then call the following start_write() method to initiate an asynchronous write() operation:

                                                                                                       1 void AIO_Output_Handler::start_write 
 2     (ACE_Message_Block *mblk) { 
 3   if (mblk == 0) { 
 4     ACE_Time_Value nonblock (0); 
 5     getq (mblk, &nonblock); 
 6   } 
 7   if (mblk != 0) { 
 8     can_write_ = 0; 
 9     if (writer_.write (*mblk, mblk->length ()) == -1) 
10       ungetq (mblk); 
11   } 
12 }

                                                                                                      第 1-6 行start_write ()方法可以接受以下两个参数之一进行调用

                                                                                                      Lines 1–6 The start_write() method can be called with one of two arguments

                                                                                                      • 空指针，表示队列中的第一条消息应该出队并发送。

                                                                                                      • A NULL pointer, which indicates that the first message in the queue should be dequeued and sent

                                                                                                      • 一个非空的 ACE_Message_Block，表示立即开始写入

                                                                                                      • A non-NULL ACE_Message_Block, which indicates to start writing immediately

                                                                                                      第 7-11 行：如果没有可供发送的日志记录，则直接返回，不做任何操作。否则，我们将can_write_重置为 0，以防止在当前消息块发送完毕之前发送其他消息块。writer_对象会发起一个异步write()操作来发送消息块。如果write()操作失败，则将消息块放回队列，并假定套接字已关闭。重连策略（第 293 页）会在连接重新建立后立即触发异步write()操作。

                                                                                                      Lines 7–11 If there's no log record available for sending, we return without doing anything. Otherwise, we reset can_write_ to 0 to prevent further message blocks from being sent until the current one is finished. The writer_ object initiates an asynchronous write() operation to send the message block. If the write() initiation fails, the message block is put back on the queue with the assumption that the socket is closed. The reconnection strategy (page 293) will trigger an asynchronous write() as soon as the connection is reestablished.

                                                                                                      当从日志客户端接收到日志记录时，会使用从ACE_Task重新实现的以下put()方法将其传递给AIO_Output_Handler：

                                                                                                      When log records are received from logging clients, they are passed to the AIO_Output_Handler using the following put() method reimplemented from ACE_Task:

                                                                                                      int AIO_Output_Handler::put (ACE_Message_Block *mb, 
                             ACE_Time_Value *timeout) { 
  if (can_write_) { start_write (mb); return 0; } 
  return putq (mb, timeout); 
}

                                                                                                      如果没有正在进行的write()操作，则调用start_write()立即开始发送指定的ACE_Message_Block。如果现在无法开始write()操作，则将消息排队稍后发送。

                                                                                                      If there's no write() operation in progress, call start_write() to immediately initiate sending of the specified ACE_Message_Block. If a write() can't be started now, we queue the message for later.

                                                                                                        8.3 ACE_Handler 类

                                                                                                        8.3 The ACE_Handler Class

                                                                                                        动机

                                                                                                        Motivation

                                                                                                        主动式 I/O 模型和被动式 I/O 模型的主要区别在于，主动式 I/O 的启动和完成是两个独立的步骤，分别独立执行。此外，这两个步骤可能在不同的线程中执行。使用不同的类来处理启动和完成过程可以避免两者之间不必要的耦合。第 8.2 节介绍了用于启动异步 I/O 操作的ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream和ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream类；本节重点介绍 I/O 完成的处理。

                                                                                                        A chief differentiator between the proactive and reactive I/O models is that proactive I/O initiation and completion are distinct steps that occur separately. Moreover, these two steps may occur in different threads of control. Using separate classes for the initiation and completion processing avoids unnecessarily coupling the two. Section 8.2 described the ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream and ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream classes used to initiate asynchronous I/O operations; this section focuses on I/O completion handling.

                                                                                                        完成事件表明先前启动的 I/O 操作已完成。为了正确高效地处理 I/O 操作的结果，完成处理程序除了需要知道操作结果之外，还必须知道为 I/O 操作指定的所有参数。这些信息包括：

                                                                                                        Completion events signify that a previously initiated I/O operation has finished. To process the result of the I/O operation correctly and efficiently, a completion handler must know all of the arguments specified for the I/O operation, in addition to the result. Together, this information includes

                                                                                                        • 发起了何种类型的行动

                                                                                                        • What type of operation was initiated

                                                                                                        • 无论手术是否成功完成

                                                                                                        • Whether or not the operation completed successfully

                                                                                                        • 操作失败时，会显示错误代码。

                                                                                                        • The error code, if the operation failed

                                                                                                        • 用于标识通信端点的 I/O 句柄

                                                                                                        • The I/O handle that identifies the communication endpoint

                                                                                                        • 传输的内存地址

                                                                                                        • The memory address for the transfer

                                                                                                        • 请求的字节数和实际传输的字节数

                                                                                                        • The requested and actual number of bytes transferred

                                                                                                        异步 I/O 完成处理需要的信息比 ACE Reactor 框架中的回调方法所能获取的信息更多。因此， 3.3 节中介绍的ACE_Event_Handler类不适用于 ACE Proactor 框架。由于完成处理也依赖于底层操作系统平台提供的异步 I/O 机制，因此它也存在8.2 节中讨论的相同可移植性问题。在每个应用程序中解决这些问题既繁琐又耗时，这也是 ACE Proactor 框架提供ACE_Handler类的原因。

                                                                                                        Asynchronous I/O completion processing requires more information than is available to callback methods in the ACE Reactor framework. The ACE_Event_Handler class presented in Section 3.3 is therefore not suitable for use in the ACE Proactor framework. Since completion handling also depends on the asynchronous I/O mechanism offered by the underlying OS platform, it has the same portability issues discussed in Section 8.2. Addressing these issues in each application is unnecessarily tedious and costly, which is why the ACE Proactor framework provides the ACE_Handler class.

                                                                                                        等级能力

                                                                                                        Class Capabilities

                                                                                                        ACE_Handler是 ACE Proactor 框架中所有异步完成处理程序的基类。此类提供以下功能：

                                                                                                        ACE_Handler is the base class of all asynchronous completion handlers in the ACE Proactor framework. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                                        • 它提供钩子方法来处理 ACE 中定义的所有异步 I/O 操作的完成情况，包括连接建立和 IPC 流上的 I/O 操作。

                                                                                                        • It provides hook methods to handle completion of all asynchronous I/O operations defined in ACE, including connection establishment and I/O operations on an IPC stream.

                                                                                                        • 它提供了一个钩子方法来处理计时器到期。

                                                                                                        • It provides a hook method to handle timer expiration.

                                                                                                        ACE_Handler的接口如图 8.5 （第 272 页）所示，其主要方法如下表所示：

                                                                                                        当使用ACE_Proactor调度的定时器超时时，会调用 `handle_time_out()` 方法。其` tv`参数是定时器预定超时的绝对时间。实际时间可能因活动级别和已分发的处理程序延迟而有所不同。请注意，此行为与传递给`ACE_Event_Handler::handle_timeout()` （第 49 页）的 ` ACE_Time_Value`略有不同，后者是 ACE Proactor 框架分发定时器事件钩子方法的实际时间。

                                                                                                        The handle_time_out() method is called when a timer scheduled with an ACE_Proactor expires. Its tv argument is the absolute time of day that the timer was scheduled to expire. The actual time may be different depending on activity level and dispatched handler delays. Note that this behavior is slightly different than the ACE_Time_Value passed to ACE_Event_Handler::handle_timeout() (page 49), which is the actual time of day the timer event hook method was dispatched by the ACE proactor framework.
