                                                                                                        例子

                                                                                                        Example

                                                                                                        之前所有的日志守护进程，包括客户端和服务端，都使用C++NPv1 第 4 章中开发的Logging_Handler类来接收来自日志客户端的日志记录。Logging_Handler ::recv_log_record()方法使用同步输入操作来接收日志记录。同步输入操作的编程相对简单，因为接收线程运行时栈的活动记录可以用来存储簿记信息和数据片段。

                                                                                                        All previous logging daemons, both client and server, have used the Logging_Handler class developed in Chapter 4 of C++NPv1 to receive log records from logging clients. The Logging_Handler::recv_log_record() method uses synchronous input operations to receive a log record. Synchronous input operations are relatively straightforward to program since the activation record of the receiving thread's run-time stack can be used to store bookkeeping information and data fragments.

                                                                                                        相比之下，异步输入处理的编程难度更大，因为簿记细节和数据片段必须显式管理，而不是在运行时堆栈上隐式管理。在本例中，新的AIO_Input_Handler类通过发起异步read()操作从日志客户端接收日志记录，并将数据片段组装成日志记录，然后转发给服务器日志守护进程。此类使用主动式 I/O 模型和异步输入操作，通过单个控制线程实现所有日志客户端的最大并发性。

                                                                                                        In contrast, asynchronous input handling is harder to program since the bookkeeping details and data fragments must be managed explicitly, rather than implicitly on the run-time stack. In this example, the new AIO_Input_Handler class receives log records from logging clients by initiating asynchronous read() operations and assembling the data fragments into log records that are then forwarded to the server logging daemon. This class uses the proactive I/O model and asynchronous input operations to achieve maximum concurrency across all logging clients using a single thread of control.

                                                                                                        如图 8.3（第 267 页）所示， AIO_Input_Handler类是ACE_Handler的子类（第 8.4 节讨论了ACE_Service_Handler，它派生自ACE_Handler），定义如下：

                                                                                                        As shown in Figure 8.3 (page 267), the AIO_Input_Handler class is a descendant of ACE_Handler (Section 8.4 discusses ACE_Service_Handler, which derives from ACE_Handler) and is defined as follows:

                                                                                                        class AIO_Input_Handler : public ACE_Service_Handler { 
public: 
  AIO_Input_Handler (AIO_CLD_Acceptor *acc = 0) 
    : acceptor_ (acc), mblk_ (0) {} 

  virtual AIO_Input_Handler (); 

  // Called by <ACE_Asynch_Acceptor> when a client connects. 
  virtual void open (ACE_HANDLE new_handle, 
                     ACE_Message_Block &message_block); 

protected: 
  enum { LOG_HEADER_SIZE = 8 };   // Length of CDR header. 
  AIO_CLD_Acceptor *acceptor_;    // Our creator. 
  ACE_Message_Block *mblk_;       // Block to receive log record. 
  ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream reader_; // Asynchronous read() factory. 

  // Handle input from logging clients. 
  virtual void handle_read_stream 
    (const ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream::Result &result); 
};

                                                                                                        日志客户端以 CDR 格式发送每条日志记录，开头是一个固定长度的头部（C++NPv1 的 4.4.2 节详细介绍了 CDR 编组和日志记录格式）。头部包含一个ACE_CDR::Boolean来指示字节顺序，以及一个ACE_CDR::ULong来存储头部之后有效载荷的长度。根据 CDR 编码和对齐规则，我们知道有效载荷的长度为 8 字节，因此我们将LOG_HEADER_SIZE枚举值定义为 8。

                                                                                                        The logging client sends each log record in CDR format, starting with a fixed-length header (Section 4.4.2 in C++NPv1 presents complete details on the CDR marshaling and log record format). The header has an ACE_CDR::Boolean to indicate the byte order and an ACE_CDR::ULong holding the length of the payload following the header. From CDR encoding and alignment rules, we know this to be 8 bytes, so we define the LOG_HEADER_SIZE enumerator as 8.

                                                                                                        当日志客户端连接到客户端日志守护进程时， ACE Proactor 框架会分发以下open() hook 方法：

                                                                                                        When a logging client connects to the client logging daemon, the following open() hook method is dispatched by the ACE Proactor framework:

                                                                                                        void AIO_Input_Handler::open 
    (ACE_HANDLE new_handle, ACE_Message_Block &) { 
  reader_.open (*this, new_handle, 0, proactor ()); 
  ACE_NEW_NORETURN 
    (mblk_, ACE_Message_Block (ACE_DEFAULT_CDR_BUFSIZE)); 
  ACE_CDR::mb_align (mblk_); 
  reader_.read (*mblk_, LOG_HEADER_SIZE); 
}

                                                                                                        此方法分配一个ACE_Message_Block来接收来自客户端的日志记录头。与仅分配足够容纳记录头的空间不同，该消息块的大小通常足以容纳整个记录。此外，它还可以根据需要调整大小。该块的写指针已正确对齐以进行 CDR 反序列化，然后传递给异步read()操作以接收记录头。

                                                                                                        This method allocates an ACE_Message_Block to receive the log record header from the client. Rather than simply allocating just enough for the header, the message will be large enough for the entire record in many cases. Moreover, it can be resized when needed. The block's write pointer is aligned correctly for CDR demarshaling, and then passed to an asynchronous read() operation that's initiated to receive the header.

                                                                                                        当read()操作完成时，ACE Proactor 框架会调用以下完成处理方法：

                                                                                                        When the read() operation completes, the following completion handler method is invoked by the ACE Proactor framework:

                                                                                                         1 void AIO_Input_Handler::handle_read_stream 
 2     (const ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream::Result &result) { 
 3   if (!result.success () || result.bytes_transferred () == 0) 
 4     delete this; 
 5   else if (result.bytes_transferred() < result.bytes_to_read()) 
 6     reader_.read (*mblk_, result.bytes_to_read () -
 7                           result.bytes_transferred ()); 
 8   else if (mblk_->length () == LOG_HEADER_SIZE) { 
 9     ACE_InputCDR cdr (mblk_); 
10 
11     ACE_CDR::Boolean byte_order; 
12     cdr >> ACE_InputCDR::to_boolean (byte_order); 
13     cdr.reset_byte_order (byte_order); 
14 
15     ACE_CDR::ULong length; 
16     cdr >> length; 
17 
18     mblk_->size (length + LOG_HEADER_SIZE); 
19     reader_.read (*mblk_, length); 
20   } 
21   else { 
22     if (OUTPUT_HANDLER::instance ()->put (mblk_) == -1) 
23       mblk_->release (); 
24 
25     ACE_NEW_NORETURN 
26       (mblk_, ACE_Message_Block (ACE_DEFAULT_CDR_BUFSIZE)); 
27     ACE_CDR::mb_align (mblk_); 
28     reader_.read (*mblk_, LOG_HEADER_SIZE); 
29   } 
30 }

                                                                                                        第 3-4 行：如果read()失败或对等日志客户端关闭了连接，则删除此对象。AIO_Input_Handler的析构函数会释放资源以防止内存泄漏。

                                                                                                        Lines 3–4 Delete this object if read() failed or if the peer logging client closed the connection. AIO_Input_Handler's destructor releases resources to prevent leaks.

                                                                                                        第 5-7 行：如果接收到的字节数少于请求的字节数，则启动另一个异步read()操作来接收剩余的字节数。请求向消息块添加更多数据时，无需调整任何指针。侧边栏 55描述了 ACE Proactor 框架如何自动管理ACE_Message_Block指针。

                                                                                                        Lines 5–7 If fewer bytes were received than requested, initiate another asynchronous read() operation to receive the remaining bytes. We needn't adjust any pointers when requesting that more data be added to the message block. Sidebar 55 describes how the ACE Proactor framework manages ACE_Message_Block pointers automatically.

                                                                                                        第 8-19 行：如果所有请求的数据都已接收，且其大小与日志记录头部的大小相同，则我们接收到的是头部，而非有效载荷。此测试是安全的，因为日志记录的数据部分始终大于头部。然后，我们使用ACE_InputCDR类对头部进行反序列化，从而得到记录中的有效载荷字节数。mblk_的大小将被调整以容纳剩余数据，并启动异步read()操作来接收有效载荷。此方法将在完成后再次被调用，如有必要，将继续启动异步read()操作，直到接收到完整的记录或发生错误为止。

                                                                                                        Lines 8–19 If all requested data was received, and it's the size of a log record header, we received the header, not payload. This test is safe since the data portion of a log record is always larger than the header. We then use the ACE_InputCDR class to demarshal the header, yielding the number of payload bytes in the record. mblk_ is resized to accomodate the remaining data and an asynchronous read() is initiated to receive the payload. This method will be called again upon completion and, if necessary, will continue initiating asynchronous read() operations until the complete record is received or an error occurs.

                                                                                                        第 22-23 行：当接收到完整的日志记录时，会通过AIO_Output_Handler::put()方法（第 270 页）转发该记录。转发日志记录后，AIO_Output_Handler会释放消息块。但是，如果无法转发该记录，则会立即释放消息块，丢弃该日志记录。

                                                                                                        Lines 22–23 When the complete log record is received, it's forwarded via the AIO_Output_Handler::put() method (page 270). After forwarding the log record, AIO_Output_Handler will release the message block. If the record can't be forwarded, however, the message is released immediately, discarding the log record.

                                                                                                        第 25-28 行为下一个日志记录分配一个新的ACE_Message_Block对象，并启动异步read()操作以接收其标头。

                                                                                                        Lines 25–28 Allocate a new ACE_Message_Block object for the next log record and initiate an asynchronous read() operation to receive its header.

                                                                                                        侧边栏 55：ACE_Message_Block 指针的管理方式

                                                                                                        Sidebar 55: How ACE_Message_Block Pointers are Managed

                                                                                                        发起异步读取或写入操作时，请求必须指定一个ACE_Message_Block来接收或提供数据。ACE Proactor 框架的完成处理机制会更新ACE_Message_Block指针，以反映读取或写入的数据量，具体如下：

                                                                                                        When initiating an asynchronous read() or write() operation, the request must specify an ACE_Message_Block to either receive or supply the data. The ACE Proactor framework's completion handling mechanism updates the ACE_Message_Block pointers to reflect the amount of data read or written as follows:

                                                                                                        手术

                                                                                                        Operation

                                                                                                        指针用法

                                                                                                        Pointer Usage

                                                                                                        读

                                                                                                        Read

                                                                                                        初始读取缓冲区指针是消息的wr_ptr()。读取完成后，wr_ptr 的值会递增读取的字节数。

                                                                                                        The initial read buffer pointer is the message's wr_ptr(). At completion, the wr_ptr is advanced by the number of bytes read.

                                                                                                        写

                                                                                                        Write

                                                                                                        初始写入缓冲区指针是消息的rd_ptr()。写入完成后，rd_ptr指针会前进写入的字节数。

                                                                                                        The initial write buffer pointer is the message's rd_ptr(). At completion, the rd_ptr is advanced by the number of bytes written.

                                                                                                        使用写指针进行读取操作，使用读指针进行写入操作，这似乎有悖常理。因此，可以这样理解：读取数据时，数据会被写入消息块；同样地，写入数据时，数据会从消息块中读取。操作完成后， ACE_Message_Block中更新后的数据长度，读取操作的数据长度会更长（因为写指针已移动），而写入操作的数据长度会更短（因为读指针已移动）。

                                                                                                        It may seem counterintuitive to use the write pointer for reads and the read pointer for writes. It may therefore help to consider that when reading data, it's being written into the message block. Similarly, when writing data, it's being read from the message block. Upon completion, the updated length of data in the ACE_Message_Block is larger for reads (because the write pointer has advanced) and smaller for writes (because the read pointer has advanced).

                                                                                                        AIO_Output_Handler ::start_write()方法（第 269 页）启动异步write()操作，将日志记录发送到服务器日志守护进程。write ()操作完成后，ACE Proactor 框架会调用以下方法。

                                                                                                        The AIO_Output_Handler::start_write() method (page 269) initiates an asynchronous write() operation to send a log record to the server logging daemon. When a write() completes, the following method is called by the ACE Proactor framework.

                                                                                                         1 void AIO_Output_Handler::handle_write_stream 
 2        (const ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream::Result &result) { 
 3   ACE_Message_Block &mblk = result.message_block (); 
 4   if (!result.success ()) { 
 5     mblk.rd_ptr (mblk.base ()); 
 6     ungetq (&mblk); 
 7   } 
 8   else { 
 9     can_write_ = handle () == result.handle (); 
10     if (mblk.length () == 0) { 
11       mblk.release (); 
12       if (can_write_) start_write (); 
13     } 
14     else if (can_write_) start_write (&mblk); 
15     else { mblk.rd_ptr (mblk.base ()); ungetq (&mblk); } 
16   } 
17 }

                                                                                                        第 4-7 行：如果write()操作失败，则将消息块的rd_ptr()重置为块的开头。我们假设如果write()失败，套接字将关闭，稍后会重新连接，届时消息块将从头开始重新发送。

                                                                                                        Lines 4–7 If the write() operation failed, reset the message block's rd_ptr() to the beginning of the block. We assume that if a write() fails, the socket is closed and will be reconnected later, at which point the message block will be resent from the beginning.

                                                                                                        第 9 行：仅当套接字未关闭时才重新启用can_write_ 。如果在异步write()操作排队或进行中时套接字关闭，则无法保证操作系统会按给定顺序交付完成操作。因此，我们会检查句柄，当套接字关闭操作被处理时，句柄会被设置为ACE_INVALID_HANDLE 。

                                                                                                        Line 9 Re-enable can_write_ only if the socket hasn't been closed. If the socket closes while asynchronous write() operations are queued or in progress, there is no guarantee that the OS will deliver the completions in a given order. Thus, we check the handle, which is set to ACE_INVALID_HANDLE when the socket close is handled.

                                                                                                        第 10-13 行：如果整个数据块已写入完毕，则释放它。如果可以再次调用 write() ，则执行该操作。

                                                                                                        Lines 10–13 If the entire block has been written, release it. If another write() is possible, initiate it.

                                                                                                        第 14 行write ()操作成功，但只发送了部分消息。如果套接字仍然连接，则发起异步write()操作以发送剩余的消息。

                                                                                                        Line 14 The write() succeeded, but only part of the message was sent. If the socket is still connected, initiate an asynchronous write() to send the rest of the message.

                                                                                                        第 15 行消息块已部分写入，但套接字已断开连接，因此将消息的rd_ptr()倒回到块的开头，并将其放回消息队列中以便稍后重新发送。

                                                                                                        Line 15 The message block was partially written, but the socket has been disconnected, so rewind the message's rd_ptr() to the beginning of the block and put it back on the message queue to be resent later.

                                                                                                        如果write()操作失败，我们不会尝试清理套接字，因为此时套接字上还有一个未完成的read()操作，可以检测到这个问题。当服务器日志守护进程关闭套接字时，在AIO_Output_Handler::open() （第 268 页）中启动的异步read()操作就会完成。完成后，ACE Proactor 框架会调用以下方法：

                                                                                                        If a write() operation fails, we don't try to clean up the socket since it has an outstanding read() operation to detect this problem. When the server logging daemon closes the socket, the asynchronous read() operation started in AIO_Output_Handler::open() (page 268) completes. Upon completion, the following method is called by the ACE Proactor framework:

                                                                                                        1 void AIO_Output_Handler::handle_read_stream 
2        (const ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream::Result &result) { 
3   result.message_block ().release (); 
4   writer_.cancel (); 
5   ACE_OS::closesocket (result.handle ()); 
6   handle (ACE_INVALID_HANDLE); 
7   can_write_ = 0; 
8   CLD_CONNECTOR::instance ()->reconnect (); 
9 }

                                                                                                        第 3-5 行释放为read()操作分配的ACE_Message_Block，取消任何未完成的write()操作，并关闭套接字。

                                                                                                        Lines 3–5 Release the ACE_Message_Block that was allocated for the read() operation, cancel any outstanding write() operations, and close the socket.

                                                                                                        第 6-8 行：由于连接已关闭，请将句柄设置为ACE_INVALID_HANDLE ，并重置can_write_标志，以防止在重新建立服务器连接之前启动任何日志记录传输（重新连接机制在第 293 页有详细说明）。第 8.4 节讨论了如何在 ACE Proactor 框架中被动和主动地建立连接。

                                                                                                        Lines 6–8 Since the connection is now closed, set the handle to ACE_INVALID_HANDLE and reset the can_write_ flag to prevent any log record transmissions from being initiated until after we reestablish the server connection (the reconnection mechanism is explained on page 293). Section 8.4 discusses how to passively and actively establish connections in the ACE Proactor framework.

                                                                                                        图 8.6显示了从日志客户端接收日志记录并将其转发到服务器日志守护程序时发生的事件顺序。

                                                                                                        Figure 8.6 shows the sequence of events that occur when receiving a log record from a logging client and forwarding it to the server logging daemon.

                                                                                                        图 8.6. 转发日志记录的事件顺序

                                                                                                          8.4 主动式接收器连接器类

                                                                                                          8.4 The Proactive Acceptor-Connector Classes

                                                                                                          动机

                                                                                                          Motivation

                                                                                                          TCP / IP连接的建立是一个两步过程：

                                                                                                          TCP/IP connection establishment is a two-step process:

                                                                                                          1. 该应用程序要么将监听套接字绑定到端口并进行监听，要么获知有监听应用程序并发起主动连接请求。

                                                                                                          2. The application either binds a listening socket to a port and listens, or learns of a listening application and initiates an active connection request.

                                                                                                          3. 连接操作在操作系统介导的TCP协议交换建立新连接后完成。

                                                                                                          4. The connect operation completes after OS-mediated TCP protocol exchanges open the new connection.

                                                                                                          这种两步过程通常使用响应式或同步 I/O 模型来实现，如 C++NPv1 第 3 章和本书第 7 章所示。然而，TCP 连接建立的初始化/完成协议非常适合主动式模型。因此，受益于异步 I/O 的网络应用程序也可以受益于异步连接建立功能。

                                                                                                          This two-step process is often performed using either a reactive or synchronous I/O model, as shown in Chapter 3 of C++NPv1 and in Chapter 7 of this book. However, the initiate/complete protocol of TCP connection establishment lends itself well to the proactive model. Networked applications that benefit from asynchronous I/O can therefore also benefit from asynchronous connection establishment capabilities.

                                                                                                          操作系统对异步连接建立的支持各不相同。例如，Windows 支持异步连接建立，而 POSIX.4 AIO 则不支持。但是，即使操作系统不支持异步连接建立，也可以使用其他操作系统机制（例如多线程）来模拟异步连接建立（第 283 页的侧边栏 57讨论了 ACE Proactor 框架对 POSIX 的模拟）。由于为每个项目或平台重新设计和重写代码来封装或模拟异步连接建立既繁琐又容易出错，因此 ACE Proactor 框架提供了ACE_Asynch_Acceptor、ACE_Asynch_Connector和ACE_Service_Handler类。

                                                                                                          OS support for asynchronous connection establishment varies. For example, Windows supports asynchronous connection establishment, whereas POSIX.4 AIO does not. It's possible, however, to emulate asynchronous connection establishment where it doesn't exist by using other OS mechanisms, such as multithreading (Sidebar 57 on page 283 discusses the ACE Proactor framework's emulation for POSIX). Since redesigning and rewriting code to encapsulate or emulate asynchronous connection establishment for each project or platform is tedious and error prone, the ACE Proactor framework provides the ACE_Asynch_Acceptor, ACE_Asynch_Connector, and ACE_Service_Handler classes.

                                                                                                          等级能力

                                                                                                          Class Capabilities

                                                                                                          ACE_Asynch_Acceptor是 Acceptor-Connector 模式 [ POSA2 ]中 Acceptor 角色的另一种实现。此类提供以下功能：

                                                                                                          ACE_Asynch_Acceptor is another implementation of the acceptor role in the Acceptor-Connector pattern [POSA2]. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                                          • 它启动异步被动连接建立。

                                                                                                          • It initiates asynchronous passive connection establishment.

                                                                                                          • 它充当工厂的角色，为每个接受的连接创建一个新的服务处理程序。

                                                                                                          • It acts as a factory, creating a new service handler for each accepted connection.

                                                                                                          • 它可以取消之前发起的异步accept()操作。

                                                                                                          • It can cancel a previously initiated asynchronous accept() operation.

                                                                                                          • 它提供了一个钩子方法，用于在建立新连接时获取对等方的地址。

                                                                                                          • It provides a hook method to obtain the peer's address when the new connection is established.

                                                                                                          • 它提供了一个钩子方法，用于在初始化新服务处理程序之前验证对等方。

                                                                                                          • It provides a hook method to validate the peer before initializing the new service handler.

                                                                                                          ACE_Asynch_Connector在 ACE Proactor 框架的 Acceptor-Connector 模式实现中扮演连接器的角色。此类提供以下功能：

                                                                                                          ACE_Asynch_Connector plays the connector role in the ACE Proactor framework's implementation of the Acceptor-Connector pattern. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                                          • 它启动异步主动连接建立。

                                                                                                          • It initiates asynchronous active connection establishment.

                                                                                                          • 它就像一个工厂，为每个完成的连接创建一个新的服务处理程序。

                                                                                                          • It acts as a factory, creating a new service handler for each completed connection.

                                                                                                          • 它可以取消之前发起的异步connect()操作。

                                                                                                          • It can cancel a previously initiated asynchronous connect() operation.

                                                                                                          • 它提供了一个钩子方法，用于在建立新连接时获取对等方的地址。

                                                                                                          • It provides a hook method to obtain the peer's address when the new connection is established.

                                                                                                          • 它提供了一个钩子方法，用于在初始化新服务处理程序之前验证对等方。

                                                                                                          • It provides a hook method to validate the peer before initializing the new service handler.

                                                                                                          与第 7 章中描述的 ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架不同，这两个类仅用于建立TCP / IP连接。如8.2 节所述，ACE Proactor 框架侧重于封装操作，而非 I/O 句柄，而这两个类封装的正是用于建立TCP / IP连接的操作。无连接 IPC 机制（例如UDP和文件 I/O）无需建立连接，因此可以直接与 ACE Proactor 框架的 I/O 工厂类一起使用。

                                                                                                          Unlike the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework described in Chapter 7, these two classes only establish TCP/IP connections. As discussed in Section 8.2, the ACE Proactor framework focuses on encapsulating operations, not I/O handles, and these classes encapsulate operations to establish TCP/IP connections. Connectionless IPC mechanisms (for example, UDP and file I/O) don't require a connection setup, so they can be used directly with the ACE Proactor framework's I/O factory classes.

                                                                                                          与ACE_Acceptor和ACE_Connector类似，ACE_Asynch_Acceptor和ACE_Asynch_Connector也是模板类工厂，它们可以创建服务处理程序，以便在新连接上执行服务。ACE_Asynch_Acceptor和ACE_Asynch_Connector的模板参数都是工厂生成的服务类，称为ACE_Service_Handler 。该类作为ACE_Asynch_Acceptor和ACE_Asynch_Connector连接完成事件的目标。

                                                                                                          Similar to ACE_Acceptor and ACE_Connector, ACE_Asynch_Acceptor and ACE_Asynch_Connector are template class factories that can create a service handler to execute a service on the new connection. The template parameter for both ACE_Asynch_Acceptor and ACE_Asynch_Connector is the service class the factory generates, known as ACE_Service_Handler. This class acts as the target of connection completions from ACE_Asynch_Acceptor and ACE_Asynch_Connector.

                                                                                                          ACE_Service_Handler提供以下功能：

                                                                                                          ACE_Service_Handler provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                                          • 它为初始化和实现网络应用程序服务提供了基础，充当ACE_Asynch_Connector和ACE_Asynch_Acceptor连接工厂的目标。

                                                                                                          • It provides the basis for initializing and implementing a networked application service, acting as the target of the ACE_Asynch_Connector and ACE_Asynch_Acceptor connection factories.

                                                                                                          • 它会接收已连接对等方的地址，这在 Windows 系统上非常重要，因为异步连接完成后，该地址将不可用。

                                                                                                          • It receives the connected peer's address, which is important on Windows since this address isn't available after an asynchronous connection completes.

                                                                                                          • 它继承了处理异步完成事件的能力，因为它派生自ACE_Handler。

                                                                                                          • It inherits the ability to handle asynchronous completion events since it derives from ACE_Handler.

                                                                                                          侧边栏 56 （第 280 页）讨论了决定不为 ACE Proactor 框架重用ACE_Svc_Handler的理由。

                                                                                                          Sidebar 56 (page 280) discusses the rationale behind the decision to not reuse ACE_Svc_Handler for the ACE Proactor framework.

                                                                                                          图 8.7 （第 281 页）展示了主动式 Acceptor-Connector 机制中三个类的接口。下表概述了ACE_Asynch_Acceptor类中的关键方法：

                                                                                                          The interfaces for all three of the classes in the Proactive Acceptor-Connector mechanism are shown in Figure 8.7 (page 281). The following table outlines the key methods in the ACE_Asynch_Acceptor class:

                                                                                                          图 8.7. 主动式接收器、连接器和服务处理程序类

                                                                                                          方法

                                                                                                          Method

                                                                                                          描述

                                                                                                          Description

                                                                                                          打开（）

                                                                                                          open()

                                                                                                          初始化并发出一个或多个异步accept()操作。

                                                                                                          Initialize and issue one or more asynchronous accept() operations.

                                                                                                          侧边栏 56：ACE_Service—uscoreHandler 与 ACE_Svc_Handler 的比较

                                                                                                          Sidebar 56: ACE_Service—uscoreHandler versus ACE_Svc_Handler

                                                                                                          ACE_Service_Handler类的作用类似于 ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架中ACE_Svc_Handler类（详见7.2 节）。虽然 ACE Proactor 框架可以重用ACE_Svc_Handler作为ACE_Asynch_Acceptor和ACE_Asynch_Connector的目标，但出于以下原因，我们选择使用一个单独的类：

                                                                                                          The ACE_Service_Handler class plays a role analogous to that of the ACE Acceptor-Connector framework's ACE_Svc_Handler class covered in Section 7.2. Although the ACE Proactor framework could have reused ACE_Svc_Handler as the target of ACE_Asynch_Acceptor and ACE_Asynch_Connector, a separate class was chosen for the following reasons:

                                                                                                          • 使用主动连接建立的网络应用程序通常也会使用主动 I/O。因此，异步连接完成的目标应该是一个能够与 ACE Proactor 框架其他部分无缝协作的类。

                                                                                                          • Networked applications that use proactive connection establishment also often use proactive I/O. The target of asynchronous connection completions should therefore be a class that can participate seamlessly with the rest of the ACE Proactor framework.

                                                                                                          • ACE_Svc_Handler封装了一个 IPC 对象。ACE Proactor 框架内部使用 I/O 句柄，因此额外的 IPC 对象可能会造成混淆。

                                                                                                          • ACE_Svc_Handler encapsulates an IPC object. The ACE Proactor framework uses I/O handles internally, so the additional IPC object could be confusing.

                                                                                                          • ACE_Svc_Handler是专为与 ACE Reactor 框架配合使用而设计的，因为它源自ACE_Event_Handler。ACE在其框架中保持分离，以避免不必要的耦合并方便使用 ACE 工具包的子集。

                                                                                                          • ACE_Svc_Handler is designed for use with the ACE Reactor framework since it descends from ACE_Event_Handler. ACE maintains separation in its frameworks to avoid unnecessary coupling and faciliate ACE toolkit subsets.

                                                                                                          对于ACE_Service_Handler可以利用 ACE Task 框架的用例，一种常见的设计是将 ACE_Task 作为基类添加到继承自ACE_Service_Handler 的服务类中。ACE_Svc_Handler也可以使用，因为它继承自ACE_Task，但使用ACE_Task更为常见。事实上， AIO_Output_Handler类（第 266 页）就展示了这种用例。

                                                                                                          For use cases in which an ACE_Service_Handler benefits by using the ACE Task framework, a common design is to add ACE_Task as a base class to the service class derived from ACE_Service_Handler. ACE_Svc_Handler can also be used since it's derived from ACE_Task, but use of ACE_Task is more common. In fact, this use case is illustrated in the AIO_Output_Handler class (page 266).

                                                                                                          open ()方法初始化监听的TCP套接字，并启动一个或多个异步accept()操作。如果reissue_accept参数为 1（默认值），则会根据需要自动启动新的accept()操作。

                                                                                                          The open() method initializes the listening TCP socket and initiates one or more asynchronous accept() operations. If the argument for reissue_accept is 1 (the default), a new accept() operation will automatically be started as needed.

                                                                                                          ACE_Asynch_Acceptor实现了ACE_Handler::handle_accept()方法（参见第 272 页图 8.5），用于处理每个accept()完成情况，如下所示。

                                                                                                          ACE_Asynch_Acceptor implements the ACE_Handler::handle_accept() method (Figure 8.5 on page 272) to process each accept() completion as follows

                                                                                                          • 收集代表新连接的每个端点的ACE_INET_Addr 。

                                                                                                          • Collect the ACE_INET_Addr representing each endpoint of the new connection.

                                                                                                          • 如果open()函数的validate_new_connection参数值为 1，则调用validate_connection()方法，并将已连接对等方的地址作为参数传递。如果validate_connection()返回 -1，则连接中止。

                                                                                                          • If the validate_new_connection parameter to open() was 1, invoke the validate_connection() method, passing the connected peer's address. If validate_connection() returns -1, the connection is aborted.

                                                                                                          • 调用`make_handler() ` 钩子方法来获取新连接的服务处理程序。默认实现使用 ` new`运算符动态分配新的处理程序。

                                                                                                          • Call the make_handler() hook method to obtain the service handler for the new connection. The default implementation uses operator new to allocate a new handler dynamically.

                                                                                                          • 设置新处理程序的ACE_Proactor指针。

                                                                                                          • Set the new handler's ACE_Proactor pointer.

                                                                                                          • 如果open() 的pass_address参数为 1，则使用本地地址和对等地址调用ACE_Service_Handler::addresses()方法。

                                                                                                          • If the pass_address parameter to open() was 1, call the ACE_Service_Handler::addresses() method with both the local and peer addresses.

                                                                                                          • 设置新连接的 I/O 句柄并调用新服务处理程序的open()方法。

                                                                                                          • Set the new connection's I/O handle and call the new service handler's open() method.

                                                                                                          ACE_Asynch_Connector类提供的方法与ACE_Asynch_Acceptor类中的方法类似，如下表所示：

                                                                                                          The ACE_Asynch_Connector class provides methods that are similar to those in ACE_Asynch_Acceptor and are outlined in the following table:

                                                                                                          open()方法接受的参数比ACE_Asynch_Acceptor::open()少。特别是，由于每次connect()操作的寻址信息可能不同，因此寻址信息是在connect()方法的参数中指定的。

                                                                                                          The open() method accepts fewer arguments than ACE_Asynch_Acceptor::open(). In particular, since addressing information can be different on each connect() operation, it's specified in parameters to the connect() method.

                                                                                                          ACE_Asynch_Connector实现了ACE_Handler::handle_connect() 函数（参见第 272 页图 8.5 ）来处理每个连接完成事件。处理步骤与上文所述的ACE_Asynch_Acceptor相同。

                                                                                                          ACE_Asynch_Connector implements ACE_Handler::handle_connect() (Figure 8.5 on page 272) to process each connection completion. The processing steps are the same as for ACE_Asynch_Acceptor, above.

                                                                                                          ACE Proactor 框架中的每个网络应用程序服务类都派生自ACE_Service_Handler。其关键方法如下表所示：

                                                                                                          Each networked application service class in the ACE Proactor framework derives from ACE_Service_Handler. Its key methods are shown in the following table:

                                                                                                          方法

                                                                                                          Method

                                                                                                          描述

                                                                                                          Description

                                                                                                          打开（）

                                                                                                          open()

                                                                                                          建立新连接后，调用钩子方法初始化服务

                                                                                                          Hook method called to initialize the service after establishing a new connection

                                                                                                          addresses()

                                                                                                          addresses()

                                                                                                          用于捕获服务连接的本地和远程地址的钩子方法

                                                                                                          Hook method to capture the local and remote addresses for the service connection

                                                                                                          如上所述，ACE_Asynch_Acceptor和ACE_Asynch_Connector都会为每个新建立的连接调用ACE_Service_Handler::open()钩子方法。handle参数是已连接套接字的句柄。如果ACE_Asynch_Acceptor::open()的bytes_to_read参数大于 0，则ACE_Message_Block参数可能包含来自对端的数据。由于此 Windows 特有的功能通常用于非 IP 协议（​​例如 X.25），因此我们在此不做讨论。ACE Proactor 框架会管理 ACE_Message_Block ，因此服务无需关心它。

                                                                                                          As mentioned above, ACE_Asynch_Acceptor and ACE_Asynch_Connector both call the ACE_Service_Handler::open() hook method for each new connection established. The handle argument is the handle for the connected socket. The ACE_Message_Block argument may contain data from the peer if the bytes_to_read parameter to ACE_Asynch_Acceptor::open() was greater than 0. Since this Windows-specific facility is often used with non-IP protocols (e.g., X.25), we don't discuss its use here. The ACE Proactor framework manages the ACE_Message_Block, so the service need not be concerned with it.

                                                                                                          如果服务处理程序需要新连接的本地地址或对等地址，则必须实现 ` addresses() ` 钩子方法，以便在连接建立时捕获这些地址。如果异步连接工厂的`pass_address`参数为 1，ACE Proactor 框架会调用此方法。此方法在 Windows 上尤为重要，因为在使用异步连接建立时，无法通过其他方式获取连接地址。

                                                                                                          If the service handler requires either the local or peer addresses on the new connection, it must implement the addresses() hook method to capture them when the connection is established. The ACE Proactor framework calls this method if the pass_address argument to the asynchronous connection factory was 1. This method is more significant on Windows because the connection addresses cannot be obtained any other way when asynchronous connection establishment is used.

                                                                                                          侧边栏 57：在 POSIX 上模拟异步连接

                                                                                                          Sidebar 57: Emulating Asynchronous Connections on POSIX

                                                                                                          Windows 本身具备异步连接套接字的能力。相比之下，POSIX.4 AIO 机制主要用于磁盘 I/O，因此不包含任何异步TCP / IP连接建立功能。为了在所有支持异步 I/O 的平台上提供统一的功能，ACE 会在需要时模拟异步连接建立过程。

                                                                                                          Windows has native capability for asynchronously connecting sockets. In contrast, the POSIX.4 AIO facility was designed primarily for use with disk I/O, so it doesn't include any capability for asynchronous TCP/IP connection establishment. To provide uniform capability across all asynchronous I/O-enabled platforms, ACE emulates asynchronous connection establishment where needed.

                                                                                                          为了模拟异步连接建立， ACE_Asynch_Acceptor和ACE_Asynch_Connector以非阻塞模式发起主动和被动连接请求。如果连接没有立即完成（被动连接总是如此），套接字句柄会被注册到框架私有管理的ACE_Select_Reactor实例中。一个由 ACE Proactor 框架生成的线程（应用程序无法访问）会运行该私有反应器的事件循环。连接请求完成后，框架通过反应器回调重新获得控制权并发布完成事件。原始应用程序线程会根据情况在ACE_Asynch_Acceptor或ACE_Asynch_Connector类中接收到该完成事件。

                                                                                                          To emulate asynchronous connection establishment, active and passive connection requests are begun in nonblocking mode by the ACE_Asynch_Acceptor and ACE_Asynch_Connector. If the connection doesn't complete immediately (which is always the case for passive connections), the socket handle is registered with an instance of ACE_Select_Reactor managed privately by the framework. An ACE Proactor framework-spawned thread (unseen by the application) runs the private reactor's event loop. When the connection request completes, the framework regains control via a reactor callback and posts the completion event. The original application thread receives the completion event back in the ACE_Asynch_Acceptor or ACE_Asynch_Connector class, as appropriate.

                                                                                                          例子

                                                                                                          Example

                                                                                                          与第6章和第7章中的客户端日志守护程序一样，主动实现中的类被分为单独的输入和输出角色，如下所述。

                                                                                                          As with the client logging daemons in Chapters 6 and 7, the classes in the proactive implementation are separated into separate input and output roles that are explained below.

                                                                                                          输入角色。主动客户端日志守护进程的输入角色由AIO_CLD_Acceptor和AIO_Input_Handler类 执行。AIO_Input_Handler已在第 273 页描述，因此这里我们重点介绍AIO_CLD_Acceptor，它派生自ACE_Asynch_Acceptor，如图8.3 （第 267 页）所示。AIO_CLD_Acceptor 的类定义如下所示：

                                                                                                          Input role. The input role of the proactive client logging daemon is performed by the AIO_CLD_Acceptor and AIO_Input_Handler classes. AIO_Input_Handler was described on page 273, so here we focus on AIO_CLD_Acceptor, which derives from ACE_Asynch_Acceptor as shown in Figure 8.3 (page 267). The class definition for AIO_CLD_Acceptor is shown below:

                                                                                                          class AIO_CLD_Acceptor 
  : public ACE_Asynch_Acceptor<AIO_Input_Handler> { 
public: 
  // Cancel accept and close all clients. 
  void close (void); 

  // Remove handler from client set. 
  void remove (AIO_Input_Handler *ih) 
  { clients_.remove (ih); } 

protected: 
  // Service handler factory method. 
  virtual AIO_Input_Handler *make_handler (void); 

  // Set of all connected clients. 
  ACE_Unbounded_Set<AIO_Input_Handler *> clients_; 
};

                                                                                                          由于 ACE Proactor 框架仅跟踪活动的 I/O 操作，因此它不像 ACE Reactor 框架那样维护已注册的处理程序集。因此，应用程序必须在必要时查找并清理处理程序。在本章的示例中，AIO_Input_Handler对象是动态分配的，并且在服务关闭时必须能够立即访问。为了满足此要求，AIO_CLD_Acceptor::clients_成员是一个ACE_Unbounded_Set，其中包含指向所有活动的AIO_Input_Handler对象的指针。当日志客户端连接到此服务器时，ACE_Asynch_Acceptor::handle_accept()会调用以下工厂方法：

                                                                                                          Since the ACE Proactor framework only keeps track of active I/O operations, it doesn't maintain a set of registered handlers like the ACE Reactor framework does. Applications must therefore locate and clean up handlers when necessary. In this chapter's example, the AIO_Input_Handler objects are allocated dynamically, and they must be readily accessible when the service shuts down. To satisfy this requirement, the AIO_CLD_Acceptor::clients_ member is an ACE_Unbounded_Set that holds pointers to all active AIO_Input_Handler objects. When a logging client connects to this server, ACE_Asynch_Acceptor::handle_accept() calls the following factory method:

                                                                                                          AIO_Input_Handler * AIO_CLD_Acceptor::make_handler (void) { 
  AIO_Input_Handler *ih; 
  ACE_NEW_RETURN (ih, AIO_Input_Handler (this), 0); 
  if (clients_.insert (ih) == -1) { delete ih; return 0; } 
  return ih; 
}

                                                                                                          AIO_CLD_Acceptor重新实现了make_handler()工厂方法，该方法跟踪clients_中每个已分配服务处理程序的指针。如果由于某种原因无法插入新的处理程序指针，则会将其删除；返回 0 将强制 ACE Proactor 框架关闭新接受的连接。

                                                                                                          AIO_CLD_Acceptor reimplements the make_handler() factory method that keeps track of each allocated service handler's pointer in clients_. If the new handler's pointer can't be inserted for some reason, it's deleted; returning 0 will force the ACE Proactor framework to close the newly accepted connection.

                                                                                                          `make_handler () ` 钩子方法将其对象指针传递给每个动态分配的`AIO_Input_Handler` 对象（第 273 页）。当`AIO_Input_Handler`检测到`read()`操作失败（很可能是因为日志客户端关闭了连接）时，其 ` handle_read_stream()`方法（第 274 页）会直接删除自身。`AIO_Input_Handler`析构函数会清理所有占用的资源，并调用 ` AIO_CLD_Acceptor::remove()`方法（第 283 页）从`clients_`集合中移除自身，如下所示：

                                                                                                          The make_handler() hook method passes its object pointer to each dynamically allocated AIO_Input_Handler (page 273). When AIO_Input_Handler detects a failed read() (most likely because the logging client closed the connection), its handle_read_stream() method (page 274) simply deletes itself. The AIO_Input_Handler destructor cleans up all held resources, and calls the AIO_CLD_Acceptor::remove() method (page 283) to remove itself from the clients_ set, as shown below:

                                                                                                          AIO_Input_Handler::AIO_Input_Handler () { 
  reader_.cancel (); 
  ACE_OS::closesocket (handle ()); 
  if (mblk_ != 0) mblk_->release (); 
  mblk_ = 0; 
  acceptor_->remove (this); 
}

                                                                                                          当此服务在AIO_Client_Logging_Daemon::svc()方法（第 295 页）中关闭时，所有剩余的AIO_Input_Handler连接和对象都会通过调用下面的close()方法进行清理：

                                                                                                          When this service shuts down in the AIO_Client_Logging_Daemon::svc() method (page 295), all the remaining AIO_Input_Handler connections and objects are cleaned up by calling the close() method below:

                                                                                                          void AIO_CLD_Acceptor::close (void) { 
  ACE_Unbounded_Set_Iterator<AIO_Input_Handler *> 
    iter (clients_.begin ()); 
  AIO_Input_Handler **ih; 
  while (iter.next (ih)) delete *ih; 
}

                                                                                                          该方法简单地遍历所有活动的AIO_Input_Handler对象，并删除每个对象。

                                                                                                          This method simply iterates through all of the active AIO_Input_Handler objects, deleting each one.

                                                                                                          输出角色。主动式客户端日志守护进程的输出角色由AIO_CLD_Connector和AIO_Output_Handler类 执行。客户端日志守护进程使用AIO_CLD_Connector来

                                                                                                          Output role. The output role of the proactive client logging daemon is performed by the AIO_CLD_Connector and AIO_Output_Handler classes. The client logging daemon uses the AIO_CLD_Connector to

                                                                                                          • 建立（并在必要时重新建立）与服务器日志守护进程的 TCP 连接

                                                                                                          • Establish (and, when necessary, reestablish) a TCP connection to a server logging daemon

                                                                                                          • 使用服务器日志守护程序实现 SSL 身份验证的连接器部分（服务器日志守护程序的 SSL 身份验证在第 224 页中显示）。

                                                                                                          • Implement the connector half of the SSL authentication with the server logging daemon (the server logging daemon's SSL authentication is shown on page 224)

                                                                                                          然后，它使用AIO_Output_Handler将来自已连接日志客户端的日志记录异步转发到服务器日志守护程序。

                                                                                                          It then uses the AIO_Output_Handler to asychronously forward log records from connected logging clients to the server logging daemon.

                                                                                                          以下是AIO_CLD_Connector类的部分定义：

                                                                                                          Part of the AIO_CLD_Connector class definition is below:

                                                                                                          class AIO_CLD_Connector 
  : public ACE_Asynch_Connector<AIO_Output_Handler> { 
public: 
  enum { INITIAL_RETRY_DELAY = 3, MAX_RETRY_DELAY = 60 }; 

  // Constructor. 
  AIO_CLD_Connector () 
    : retry_delay_ (INITIAL_RETRY_DELAY), ssl_ctx_ (0), ssl_ (0) 
  { open (); } 

  // Hook method to detect failure and validate peer before 
  // opening handler. 
  virtual int validate_connection 
    (const ACE_Asynch_Connect::Result &result, 
     const ACE_INET_Addr &remote, const ACE_INET_Addr &local); 

protected: 
  // Template method to create a new handler 
  virtual AIO_Output_Handler *make_handler (void) 
  { return OUTPUT_HANDLER::instance (); } 

  // Address at which logging server listens for connections. 
  ACE_INET_Addr remote_addr_; 

  // Seconds to wait before trying the next connect 
  int retry_delay_; 

  // The SSL "context" data structure. 
  SSL_CTX *ssl_ctx_; 

  // The SSL data structure corresponding to authenticated 
  // SSL connections. 
  SSL *ssl_; 
}; 

typedef ACE_Unmanaged_Singleton<AIO_CLD_Connector, ACE_Null_Mutex> 
        CLD_CONNECTOR;

                                                                                                          AIO_CLD_Connector类以非托管单例的形式通过CLD_CONNECTOR typedef访问（参见第 194 页的侧边栏 45 ） 。实例化AIO_CLD_Connector时，其构造函数会调用ACE_Asynch_Connector::open()方法。默认情况下，每次connect()尝试完成后都会调用validate_connection()方法（第 293 页） 。

                                                                                                          The AIO_CLD_Connector class is accessed as an unmanaged singleton (see Sidebar 45 on page 194) via the CLD_CONNECTOR typedef. When AIO_CLD_Connector is instantiated, its constructor calls the ACE_Asynch_Connector::open() method. By default, the validate_connection() method (page 293) will be called on completion of each connect() attempt.

                                                                                                            8.5 ACE_Proactor 类

                                                                                                            8.5 The ACE_Proactor Class

                                                                                                            动机

                                                                                                            Motivation

                                                                                                            异步 I/O 操作分两步处理：启动和完成。由于涉及多个步骤和类，因此必须有一种方法来解复用完成事件，并高效地将每个完成事件与已完成的操作以及将处理结果的完成处理程序关联起来。操作系统异步 I/O 机制的多样性在这里发挥的作用比在响应式 I/O 模型中更为重要，因为

                                                                                                            Asynchronous I/O operations are handled in two steps: initiation and completion. Since multiple steps and classes are involved, there must be a way to demultiplex the completion events and efficiently associate each completion event with the operation that completed and the completion handler that will process the result. The diversity of OS asynchronous I/O facilities plays a deeper role here than in the reactive I/O model because

                                                                                                            • 不同平台接收完成通知的方式各不相同。例如，Windows 使用 I/O 完成端口或事件，而 POSIX.4 AIO 则使用实时信号或aio_suspend()系统函数来等待完成。

                                                                                                            • Platforms have different ways to receive completion notifications. For example, Windows uses I/O completion ports or events, whereas POSIX.4 AIO uses real-time signals or the aio_suspend() system function to wait for a completion.

                                                                                                            • 不同的平台使用不同的数据结构来维护异步 I/O 操作的状态信息。例如，Windows 使用OVERLAPPED结构，而 POSIX.4 AIO 使用struct aiocb。

                                                                                                            • Platforms use different data structures to maintain state information for asynchronous I/O operations. For example, Windows uses the OVERLAPPED structure, whereas POSIX.4 AIO uses struct aiocb.

                                                                                                            因此，关于平台特定机制和数据结构的知识链从启动操作贯穿到分发，最终到达完成处理。除了复杂且难以持续重复实现之外，主动式 I/O 设计也容易紧密耦合。为了解决这些问题，并提供可移植且灵活的完成事件解复用和分发机制，ACE Proactor 框架定义了ACE_Proactor类。

                                                                                                            Thus, the chain of knowledge concerning platform-specific mechanisms and data structures runs from initiation operations through dispatching and into completion handling. In addition to being complicated and hard to reimplement continually, it's easy to tightly couple proactive I/O designs. To resolve these issues and provide a portable and flexible completion event demultiplexing and dispatching facility, the ACE Proactor framework defines the ACE_Proactor class.

                                                                                                            等级能力

                                                                                                            Class Capabilities

                                                                                                            ACE_Proactor实现了外观模式 [ GoF ]，定义了一个接口，应用程序可以通过该接口以可移植且灵活的方式访问 ACE Proactor 框架的各种功能。此类提供以下功能：

                                                                                                            ACE_Proactor implements the Facade pattern [GoF] to define an interface that applications can use to access the various ACE Proactor framework features portably and flexibly. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                                            • 它将事件循环处理集中在一个主动式应用程序中。

                                                                                                            • It centralizes event loop processing in a proactive application.

                                                                                                            • 它将定时器到期事件分发给与其关联的ACE_Handler对象。

                                                                                                            • It dispatches timer expirations to their associated ACE_Handler objects.

                                                                                                            • 它将完成事件解复用到完成处理程序，并在完成处理程序上分发适当的钩子方法，然后执行应用程序定义的处理以响应完成事件。

                                                                                                            • It demultiplexes completion events to completion handlers and dispatches the appropriate hook methods on completion handlers that then perform application-defined processing in response to the completion events.

                                                                                                            • 它可以将执行完成事件检测、解复用和分派的线程与发起异步操作的线程解耦。

                                                                                                            • It can decouple the thread(s) performing completion event detection, demultiplexing, and dispatching from thread(s) initiating asynchronous operations.

                                                                                                            • 它负责协调发起 I/O 操作的类和特定于平台的异步 I/O 实现细节。

                                                                                                            • It mediates between classes that initiate I/O operations and platform-specific asynchronous I/O implementation details.

                                                                                                            ACE_Proactor的接口如图 8.8 （第 288 页）所示。该类具有丰富的接口，导出了 ACE Proactor 框架中的所有功能。因此，我们将其方法描述分为以下四个类别。

                                                                                                            The interface for ACE_Proactor is shown in Figure 8.8 (page 288). This class has a rich interface that exports all the features in the ACE Proactor framework. We therefore group its method descriptions into the four categories described below.

                                                                                                            ACE Proactor 事件循环与 ACE Reactor 框架提供的事件循环是相互独立的。要在同一应用程序中同时使用 ACE Reactor 和 ACE Proactor 事件循环，并保持其在所有异步 I/O 平台上的可移植性，这两个事件循环必须在不同的线程中执行。然而，ACE_Proactor的 Windows 实现可以将其 I/O 完成端口句柄注册到ACE_WFMO_Reactor实例，从而将这两个事件循环机制绑定在一起，允许它们在同一个线程中使用。侧边栏 58（第 290 页）介绍了如何实现这一点。

                                                                                                            The ACE Proactor event loop is separate from that provided by the ACE Reactor framework. To use both ACE Reactor and ACE Proactor event loops in the same application and remain portable across all asynchronous I/O platforms, the two event loops must be executed in separate threads. However, the Windows implementation of ACE_Proactor can register its I/O completion port handle with an ACE_WFMO_Reactor instance to tie the two event loop mechanisms together, allowing them to both be used in one thread. Sidebar 58 (page 290) describes how to do this.

                                                                                                            4. I/O 操作辅助方法。ACE_Proactor 类能够访问平台异步 I/O 实现的细节，这些细节对于操作的启动和完成事件处理非常有用。将ACE_Proactor作为平台特定知识的中心中介，可以避免 ACE Proactor框架中各类之间的耦合。具体而言，ACE Proactor 框架采用了桥接模式 [GoF]。

                                                                                                            4. I/O operation facilitator methods. The ACE_Proactor class has visibility into the platform's asynchronous I/O implementation details that are useful for operation initiation and completion event processing. Making ACE_Proactor the central mediator of platform-specific knowledge prevents coupling between the classes in the ACE Proactor framework. In particular, the ACE Proactor framework uses the Bridge pattern [GoF].
