All work dependent on platform-specific mechanisms is forwarded to the Proactor implementation class for handling. We briefly describe the platform-specific ACE Proactor framework implementations below.

                                                                                                            ACE_WIN32_Proactor 类

                                                                                                            The ACE_WIN32_Proactor Class

                                                                                                            ACE_WIN32_Proactor是ACE_Proactor在 Windows 上的实现。此类适用于 Windows NT 4.0 及更新的 Windows 平台，例如 Windows 2000 和 Windows XP。但是，它不适用于 Windows 95、98、Me 或 CE，因为这些平台不支持异步 I/O。

                                                                                                            ACE_WIN32_Proactor is the ACE_Proactor implementation on Windows. This class works on Windows NT 4.0 and newer Windows platforms, such as Windows 2000 and Windows XP. It doesn't work on Windows 95, 98, Me, or CE, however, since these platforms don't support asynchronous I/O.

                                                                                                            实现概述。ACE_WIN32_Proactor 使用I/O 完成端口进行完成事件检测。初始化异步操作工厂（例如ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream或ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream）时，I/O 句柄与 Proactor 的 I/O 完成端口关联。在本实现中，Windows 的GetQueuedCompletionStatus()函数控制事件循环的节奏。

                                                                                                            Implementation overview. ACE_WIN32_Proactor uses an I/O completion port for completion event detection. When initializing an asynchronous operation factory, such as ACE_Asynch_Read_Stream or ACE_Asynch_Write_Stream, the I/O handle is associated with the Proactor's I/O completion port. In this implementation, the Windows GetQueuedCompletionStatus() function paces the event loop.

                                                                                                            侧边栏 58：在 Windows 上集成 Proactor 和 Reactor 事件

                                                                                                            Sidebar 58: Integrating Proactor and Reactor Events on Windows

                                                                                                            ACE Reactor 和 ACE Proactor 事件循环需要不同的事件检测和解复用机制。因此，它们通常在不同的线程中执行。然而，在 Windows 系统上，ACE 提供了一种将这两种事件循环机制集成起来的方法，使它们可以由单个线程驱动。使用单个事件循环线程的优势在于，它可以简化应用程序定义的事件处理程序和完成处理程序，因为它们可能不再需要同步器来防止竞争条件。

                                                                                                            The ACE Reactor and ACE Proactor event loops require different event detection and demultiplexing mechanisms. As a result, they are often executed in separate threads. On Windows, however, ACE provides a way to integrate the two event loop mechanisms so they can both be driven by a single thread. The advantage of using a single event-loop thread is that it can simplify application-defined event handlers and completion handlers, since they may no longer require synchronizers to prevent race conditions.

                                                                                                            ACE_Proactor的Windows 实现使用 I/O 完成端口来检测完成事件。当一个或多个异步操作完成时，Windows 会向相应的 I/O 完成端口句柄发出信号。因此，该句柄可以注册到ACE_WFMO_Reactor的实例中（参见第 4 章）。通过这种机制，ACE_WFMO_Reactor将 I/O 完成端口的“已发出信号”事件分发给 ACE_Proactor ， ACE_Proactor 再将完成事件分发给 ACE_Proactor 并返回到反应器的事件循环。

                                                                                                            The ACE_Proactor Windows implementation uses an I/O completion port to detect completion events. When one or more asynchronous operations complete, Windows signals the corresponding I/O completion port handle. This handle can therefore be registered with an instance of ACE_WFMO_Reactor (Chapter 4). Using this scheme, the ACE_WFMO_Reactor dispatches the I/O completion port's "signaled" event to the ACE_Proactor, which in turn dispatches completion events and returns to the reactor's event loop.

                                                                                                            要使用上述方案，应用程序必须使用一组特定的非默认选项实例化一个ACE_Proactor对象。以下代码片段展示了如何实现这一点，并且应该在程序启动时立即执行：

                                                                                                            To use the scheme outlined above, an application must instantiate an ACE_Proactor with a particular set of nondefault options. The following code fragment shows how to accomplish this, and should be executed immediately at program startup: 

                                                                                                            1 ACE_Proactor::close_singleton (); 
2 ACE_WIN32_Proactor *impl = new ACE_WIN32_Proactor (0, 1); 
3 ACE_Proactor::instance (new ACE_Proactor (impl, 1), 1); 
4 ACE_Reactor::instance ()->register_handler 
5   (impl, impl->get_handle ()); 
// ... Other registration and initiation code omitted. 
6 ACE_Reactor::instance ()->run_reactor_event_loop (); 
7 ACE_Reactor::instance ()->remove_handler 
8   (impl->get_handle (), ACE_Event_Handler::DONT_CALL);

                                                                                                            第 1 行关闭现有的 proactor 单例。

                                                                                                            Line 1 Close the existing proactor singleton.

                                                                                                            第 2 行创建了一个 Windows 特有的 proactor 实现。第二个参数指定此 proactor 将与 reactor 一起使用。

                                                                                                            Line 2 Creates a Windows-specific proactor implementation. The second argument specifies that this proactor will be used with a reactor.

                                                                                                            第 3 行：为启用反应堆的实现创建一个新的ACE_Proactor 对象，并将其设置为单例。ACE_Proactor的第二个参数表示在ACE_Proactor关闭时删除该实现。instance ()的第二个参数表示在 ACE_Proactor 关闭时删除该ACE_Proactor对象。

                                                                                                            Line 3 Create a new ACE_Proactor for the reactor-enabled implementation and make it the singleton. The second argument to ACE_Proactor says to delete the implementation when the ACE_Proactor is closed. The second argument to instance() says to delete the ACE_Proactor object when it's closed.

                                                                                                            第 4-6 行向反应器注册 I/O 完成端口句柄并运行反应器事件循环。

                                                                                                            Lines 4–6 Register the I/O completion port handle with the reactor and run the reactor event loop.

                                                                                                            第 7-8 行：事件循环结束后，从反应堆中移除反应堆的 I/O 完成端口。

                                                                                                            Lines 7–8 After the event loop ends, remove the proactor's I/O completion port from the reactor.

                                                                                                            所有为ACE_WIN32_Proactor定义的Result类都派生自 Windows OVERLAPPED结构。根据执行的操作，每个 Result 类都会添加额外的信息。当GetQueuedCompletionStatus()返回指向已完成操作的OVERLAPPED结构的指针时，ACE_WIN32_Proactor会将其转换为指向Result对象的指针。这种设计使得 I/O 操作完成后，能够高效地将完成信息分派给正确的、派生自ACE_Handler的完成处理程序。POSA2中 Proactor 模式的实现部分阐述了如何使用 Windows 异步机制和异步完成令牌模式来实现 Proactor。

                                                                                                            All the Result classes defined for use with the ACE_WIN32_Proactor are derived from the Windows OVERLAPPED structure. Additional information is added to each depending on the operation being performed. When GetQueuedCompletionStatus() returns a pointer to the completed operation's OVERLAPPED structure, the ACE_WIN32_Proactor converts it to a pointer to a Result object. This design allows completions to be dispatched efficiently to the correct ACE_Handler-derived completion handler when I/O operations complete. The Implementation section of the Proactor pattern in POSA2 illustrates how to implement a proactor using the Windows asynchrony mechanisms and the Asynchronous Completion Token pattern.

                                                                                                            并发性考虑因素。多个线程可以同时执行ACE_WIN32_Proactor 的事件循环。由于所有事件的注册和分发都由 I/O 完成端口机制处理，而不是由ACE_WIN32_Proactor本身处理，因此无需像ACE_WFMO_Reactor实现（第 106 页）那样同步对注册相关数据结构的访问。

                                                                                                            Concurrency considerations. Multiple threads can execute the event loop of an ACE_WIN32_Proactor simultaneously. Since all event registration and dispatching is handled by the I/O completion port mechanism, and not by the ACE_WIN32_Proactor itself, there's no need to synchronize access to registration-related data structures, as in the ACE_WFMO_Reactor implementation (page 106).

                                                                                                            定时器队列的过期管理由ACE_WIN32_Proactor管理的独立线程处理。当定时器过期时，超时机制使用PostQueuedCompletionStatus()函数向 Proactor 的 I/O 完成端口发布完成状态。这种设计将定时器机制与常规的完成分发机制完美地集成在一起。此外，由于所有完成检测线程都只等待完成事件，无需担心因预定的定时器过期而被唤醒，因此它确保只有一个线程会被唤醒来分发定时器。

                                                                                                            The timer queue expiry management is handled in a separate thread that's managed by the ACE_WIN32_Proactor. When a timer expires, the timeout mechanism uses the PostQueuedCompletionStatus() function to post a completion to the proactor's I/O completion port. This design cleanly integrates the timer mechanism with the normal completion dispatching mechanism. It also ensures that only one thread is awakened to dispatch the timer since all completion-detection threads wait only for completion events and needn't worry about waking up for a scheduled timer expiration.

                                                                                                            ACE_POSIX_Proactor 类

                                                                                                            The ACE_POSIX_Proactor Class

                                                                                                            在 POSIX 系统上，ACE Proactor 实现提供了多种机制来启动 I/O 操作并检测其完成情况。此外，Sun 的 Solaris 操作系统环境提供了其专有的异步 I/O 版本。在 Solaris 2.6 及更高版本中，Sun 特有的异步 I/O 函数的性能显著高于 Solaris 的 POSIX.4 AIO 实现。为了充分利用这种性能提升，ACE 还将此机制封装在一组独立的类中。

                                                                                                            The ACE Proactor implementations on POSIX systems present multiple mechanisms for initiating I/O operations and detecting their completions. Moreover, Sun's Solaris Operating Environment offers its own proprietary version of asynchronous I/O. On Solaris 2.6 and above, the performance of the Sun-specific asynchronous I/O functions is significantly higher than that of Solaris's POSIX.4 AIO implementation. To take advantage of this performance improvement, ACE also encapsulates this mechanism in a separate set of classes.

                                                                                                            实现概述。POSIX 异步 I/O 的实现使用控制块（struct aiocb）来标识每个异步 I/O 请求及其控制信息。每个aiocb一次只能关联一个 I/O 请求。Sun 特有的异步 I/O 使用名为aio_result_t的附加结构。

                                                                                                            Implementation overview. The POSIX implementations of asynchronous I/O use a control block (struct aiocb) to identify each asynchronous I/O request and its controlling information. Each aiocb can be associated with only one I/O request at a time. The Sun-specific asynchronous I/O uses an additional structure named aio_result_t.

                                                                                                            尽管封装的 POSIX 异步 I/O 机制支持read()和write()操作，但它们不支持任何TCP / IP连接相关的操作。为了支持ACE_Asynch_Acceptor和ACE_Asynch_Connector的功能，需要使用单独的线程来执行连接相关的操作。这种异步连接模拟在侧边栏 57（第 283 页）中有详细描述。

                                                                                                            Although the encapsulated POSIX asynchronous I/O mechanisms support read() and write() operations, they don't support any TCP/IP connection-related operations. To support the functions of ACE_Asynch_Acceptor, and ACE_Asynch_Connector,a separate thread is used to perform connection-related operations. This asynchronous connection emulation is described in Sidebar 57 (page 283).

                                                                                                            下表描述了ACE_POSIX_Proactor实现的三种变体：

                                                                                                            The three variants of the ACE_POSIX_Proactor implementation are described in the following table:

                                                                                                            ACE Proactor 变体

                                                                                                            ACE Proactor Variant

                                                                                                            描述

                                                                                                            Description

                                                                                                            ACE_POSIX_AIOCB_Proactor

                                                                                                            ACE_POSIX_AIOCB_Proactor

                                                                                                            此实现维护一个并行的aiocb结构体和Result对象列表。每个未完成的操作都由这两个列表中的一个条目表示。aio_suspend ()函数会暂停事件循环，直到一个或多个异步 I/O 操作完成。

                                                                                                            This implementation maintains a parallel list of aiocb structures and Result objects. Each outstanding operation is represented by an entry in each list. The aio_suspend() function suspends the event loop until one or more asynchronous I/O operations complete.

                                                                                                            ACE_POSIX_SIG_Proactor

                                                                                                            ACE_POSIX_SIG_Proactor

                                                                                                            此实现源自ACE_POSIX_AIOCB_Proactor，但使用 POSIX 实时信号来检测异步 I/O 完成。事件循环使用sigtimedwait()和sigwaitinfo()函数来控制循环节奏并检索已完成操作的信息。每个使用此 Proactor 启动的异步 I/O 操作都有一个与其aiocb关联的唯一值，该值通过记录其完成的信号进行传递。这种设计使得定位aiocb及其并行Result对象以及分发正确的完成处理程序变得容易。

                                                                                                            This implementation is derived from ACE_POSIX_AIOCB_Proactor, but uses POSIX real-time signals to detect asynchronous I/O completion. The event loop uses the sigtimedwait() and sigwaitinfo() functions to pace the loop and retrieve information about completed operations. Each asynchyronous I/O operation started using this proactor has a unique value associated with its aiocb that's communicated with the signal noting its completion. This design makes it easy to locate the aiocb and its parallel Result object, and dispatch the correct completion handler.

                                                                                                            ACE_SUN_Proactor

                                                                                                            ACE_SUN_Proactor

                                                                                                            此实现也基于ACE_POSIX_AIOCB_Proactor，但它使用 Sun 特有的异步 I/O 机制，而不是 POSIX.4 AIO 机制。此实现的工作方式与ACE_POSIX_AIOCB_Proactor非常相似，但它使用 Sun 特有的aiowait()函数来检测 I/O 完成情况。

                                                                                                            This implementation is also based on ACE_POSIX_AIOCB_Proactor, but it uses the Sun-specific asynchronous I/O facility instead of the POSIX.4 AIO facility. This implementation works much like ACE_POSIX_AIOCB_Proactor, but uses the Sun-specific aiowait() function to detect I/O completions.

                                                                                                            并发性注意事项。ACE_POSIX_SIG_Proactor是POSIX.4 AIO 平台上的默认 Proactor 实现。其完成事件解复用机制使用sigtimedwait()函数。每个ACE_POSIX_SIG_Proactor实例都可以指定要与sigtimedwait()一起使用的信号集。因此，要在不同的ACE_POSIX_SIG_Proactor实例中使用不同优先级的多个线程，每个实例都应该使用不同的信号或信号集。

                                                                                                            Concurrency considerations. The ACE_POSIX_SIG_Proactor is the default proactor implementation on POSIX.4 AIO-enabled platforms. Its completion event demultiplexing mechanism uses the sigtimedwait() function. Each ACE_POSIX_SIG_Proactor instance can specify the set of signals to use with sigtimedwait().To use multiple threads at different priorities with different ACE_POSIX_SIG_Proactor instances, therefore, each instance should use a different signal, or set of signals.

                                                                                                            某些平台的限制和特性会直接影响可使用的ACE_POSIX_Proactor实现。例如，在 Linux 系统上，线程实际上是克隆的进程。由于信号无法跨进程传递，而异步 I/O 操作和 Proactor 定时器超时都是通过线程实现的，因此ACE_POSIX_SIG_Proactor在 Linux 系统上无法正常工作。所以，ACE_POSIX_AIOCB_Proactor是 Linux 系统上的默认 Proactor 实现。ACE_POSIX_AIOCB_Proactor中使用的aio_suspend ()解复用机制是线程安全的，因此多个线程可以同时运行其事件循环。

                                                                                                            Limitations and characteristics of some platforms directly affect which ACE_POSIX_Proactor implementation can be used. On Linux, for instance, threads are actually cloned processes. Since signals can't be sent across processes, and asynchronous I/O operations and Proactor timer expirations are both implemented using threads, the ACE_POSIX_SIG_Proactor doesn't work well on Linux. Thus, ACE_POSIX_AIOCB_Proactor is the default proactor implementation on Linux. The aio_suspend() demultiplexing mechanism used in ACE_POSIX_AIOCB_Proactor is thread safe, so multiple threads can run its event loop simultaneously.

                                                                                                            Example

                                                                                                            在讨论AIO_Output_Handler::handle_read_stream()方法时（第 276 页）提到了AIO_CLD_Connector的重连机制。重连机制通过以下AIO_CLD_Connector::reconnect()方法启动：

                                                                                                            The AIO_CLD_Connector reconnection mechanism was mentioned in the discussion of the AIO_Output_Handler::handle_read_stream() method (page 276). The reconnection mechanism is initiated using the AIO_CLD_Connector::reconnect() method below:

                                                                                                            int reconnect (void) { return connect (remote_addr_); }

                                                                                                            此方法仅向服务器日志守护进程发起一个新的异步连接请求。为了避免在例如没有服务器日志守护进程监听时持续发起连接尝试，我们使用了指数退避策略。我们使用以下`validate_connection()`钩子方法将应用程序定义的行为插入到`ACE_Asynch_Connector`的连接完成处理中。此方法会了解每个异步连接请求的处理结果，并在连接失败时设置一个定时器来重试连接。如果连接成功，此方法将执行与服务器日志守护进程的 SSL 身份验证。

                                                                                                            This method simply initiates a new asynchronous connection request to the server logging daemon. An exponential backoff strategy is used to avoid continually initiating connection attempts when, for example, there's no server logging daemon listening. We use the following validate_connection() hook method to insert application-defined behavior into ACE_Asynch_Connector's connection completion handling. This method learns the disposition of each asynchronous connection request and schedules a timer to retry the connect if it failed. If the connect succeeded, this method executes the SSL authentication with the server logging daemon.

 2       (const ACE_Asynch_Connect::Result &result, 
 3        const ACE_INET_Addr &remote, const ACE_INET_Addr &) { 
 4   remote_addr_ = remote; 
 5   if (!result.success ()) { 
 6     ACE_Time_Value delay (retry_delay_); 
 7     retry_delay_ *= 2; 
 8     if (retry_delay_ > MAX_RETRY_DELAY) 
 9       retry_delay_ = MAX_RETRY_DELAY; 
10     proactor ()->schedule_timer (*this, 0, delay); 
11     return -1; 
12   } 
13   retry_delay_ = INITIAL_RETRY_DELAY; 
14 
15   if (ssl_ctx_ == 0) { 
16     OpenSSL_add_ssl_algorithms ();

18     if (ssl_ctx_ == 0) return -1; 
19 
20     if (SSL_CTX_use_certificate_file (ssl_ctx_,

23        || SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey_file (ssl_ctx_, 
24                                        CLD_KEY_FILENAME,

26        || !SSL_CTX_check_private_key (ssl_ctx_)) { 
27       SSL_CTX_free (ssl_ctx_);

29       return -1; 
30     } 
31     ssl_ = SSL_new (ssl_ctx_); 
32     if (ssl_ == 0) {

34       return -1; 
35     } 
36   } 
37 
38   SSL_clear (ssl_); 
39   SSL_set_fd

41 
42   SSL_set_verify (ssl_, SSL_VERIFY_PEER, 0); 
43

45       || SSL_shutdown (ssl_) == -1) return -1;

                                                                                                            第 15-46 行`validate_connection()`的其余部分与`TPC_Logging_Acceptor::open()` （第 224 页）类似，因此此处不再赘述。如果 SSL 身份验证失败，`validate_connection()`将返回 -1，导致`ACE_Asynch_Connector`在为其打开服务处理程序之前关闭新连接。请注意，第 43 行和第 44 行的 SSL 函数调用是同步的，因此在这些调用进行期间，Proactor 事件循环不会处理完成事件。与 Reactor 框架一样，开发人员必须注意回调方法中的这种延迟。

If the SSL authentication fails, validate_connection() returns -1, causing ACE_Asynch_Connector to close the new connection before opening a service handler for it. Note that the SSL function calls on lines 43and 44 are synchronous, and therefore the proactor event loop is not processing completion events while these calls are being made. As with the Reactor framework, developers must be aware of this type of delay in a callback method.

                                                                                                            void AIO_CLD_Connector::handle_time_out (const ACE_Time_Value &, 
                                         const void *) 
{ connect (remote_addr_); }

                                                                                                            此方法只是启动另一个异步connect()尝试，无论成功还是失败，都会触发对validate_connection()的另一个调用。

                                                                                                            AIO 客户端日志守护进程服务由以下AIO_Client_Logging_Daemon类表示：

                                                                                                            The AIO client logging daemon service is represented by the following AIO_Client_Logging_Daemon class:

                                                                                                            class AIO_Client_Logging_Daemon: public ACE_Task<ACE_NULL_SYNCH> { 
protected: 
  ACE_INET_Addr cld_addr_; // Our listener address. 
  ACE_INET_Addr sld_addr_; // The logging server's address. 

  // Factory that passively connects the <AIO_Input_Handler>. 
  AIO_CLD_Acceptor acceptor_; 

public: 
  // Service Configurator hook methods. 
  virtual int init (int argc, ACE_TCHAR *argv[]); 
  virtual int fini (); 
  virtual int svc (void); 
};

                                                                                                            此类与AC_Client_Logging_Daemon类（第 251 页）类似。主要区别在于，AIO_Client_Logging_Daemon会创建一个新线程来运行服务所依赖的 proactor 事件循环，而AC_Client_Logging_Daemon则依赖于主程序线程来运行单例 reactor 的事件循环。为了便于激活此线程，AIO_Client_Logging_Daemon继承自ACE_Task而不是ACE_Service_Config。

                                                                                                            This class is similar to the AC_Client_Logging_Daemon class (page 251). The primary difference is that AIO_Client_Logging_Daemon spawns a new thread to run the proactor event loop that the service depends on, whereas AC_Client_Logging_Daemon relies on the main program thread to run the singleton reactor's event loop. To activate this thread easily, AIO_Client_Logging_Daemon derives from ACE_Task rather than ACE_Service_Config.

                                                                                                            我们为 Proactor 事件循环启动一个新线程，因为我们仍然依赖于 Reactor 事件循环来进行服务重配置活动，如第 5 章所述。如果我们的服务仅针对 Windows 设计，我们可以将 Proactor 和 Reactor 事件循环集成在一起，如侧边栏 58（第 290 页）所述。然而，此客户端日志守护程序实现可移植到所有支持 AIO 的 ACE 平台。在我们的AIO_Client_Logging_Daemon::init()方法处理完参数列表并生成地址后，它会调用ACE_Task::activate()来生成一个运行以下svc()方法的线程：

                                                                                                            We start a new thread for the proactor event loop because we do still rely on the reactor event loop for service reconfiguration activity as described in Chapter 5. If our service was designed solely for Windows, we could integrate the proactor and reactor event loops, as described in Sidebar 58 (page 290). However, this client logging daemon implementation is portable to all AIO-enabled ACE platforms. After our AIO_Client_Logging_Daemon::init() method processes the argument list and forms addresses, it then calls ACE_Task::activate() to spawn a thread running the following svc() method:

                                                                                                            1   int AIO_Client_Logging_Daemon::svc (void) { 
2   if (acceptor_.open (cld_addr_) == -1) return -1; 
3   if (CLD_CONNECTOR::instance ()->connect (sld_addr_) == 0) 
4     ACE_Proactor::instance ()->proactor_run_event_loop (); 
5   acceptor_.close (); 
6   CLD_CONNECTOR::close (); 
7   OUTPUT_HANDLER::close (); 
8   return 0; 
9 }

The proactor event loop is terminated when the service is shut down via the following fini() method:

                                                                                                            int AIO_Client_Logging_Daemon::fini () { 
  ACE_Proactor::instance ()->proactor_end_event_loop (); 
  wait (); 
  return 0; 
}

                                                                                                            该方法调用ACE_Proactor::proactor_end_event_loop() ，结束svc()方法中的事件循环。然后，它调用ACE_Task::wait()等待svc()方法完成并退出其线程。

                                                                                                            This method calls ACE_Proactor::proactor_end_event_loop() which ends the event loop in the svc() method. It then calls ACE_Task::wait() to wait for the svc() method to complete and exit its thread.

                                                                                                            第 5-7 行关闭所有打开的连接和单例对象，并退出svc()线程。

  "-p $CLIENT_LOGGING_DAEMON_PORT"

                                                                                                              8.6 总结

                                                                                                              8.6 Summary

                                                                                                              本章探讨了主动式 I/O 的概念，并概述了主动式模型与被动式模型的区别。此外，本章还展示了如何利用主动式 I/O 模型克服被动式 I/O 模型的性能限制，同时避免使用多线程同步 I/O 所带来的某些弊端。然而，主动式 I/O 模型也面临着一些挑战：

                                                                                                              This chapter explored the concept of proactive I/O and outlined how the proactive model differs from the reactive model. It also showed how the proactive I/O model can be used to overcome the performance limitations of the reactive I/O model without incurring certain liabilities associated with the use of multithreaded synchronous I/O. However, the proactive I/O model presents several challenges:

                                                                                                              • 设计挑战。 该模型的多步骤特性增加了异步操作的启动 I/O 机制与操作完成处理之间过度耦合的可能性。

                                                                                                              • Design challenges. The multistep nature of this model increases the likelihood of overly coupling the I/O mechanisms that initiate asynchronous operations with the processing of the completions of operations.

                                                                                                              • 可移植性挑战。 当今的计算平台提供的异步 I/O 标准和实现方式差异很大。

                                                                                                              • Portability challenges. There are highly divergent standards and implementations for asynchronous I/O offered by today's computing platforms.

                                                                                                              Proactor 模式 [ POSA2 ] 定义了一系列角色和关系，旨在简化使用主动 I/O 的应用程序。ACE Proactor 框架在支持异步 I/O 的各种操作系统上实现了 Proactor 模式。ACE Proactor 框架提供了一组类，简化了网络应用程序在所有支持异步 I/O 的平台上使用异步 I/O 功能的过程。本章讨论了框架中的每个类，涵盖了它们的动机和功能。本章展示了一个客户端日志守护进程的实现，该守护进程在其所有网络操作中都使用了主动 I/O 模型。此版本的客户端日志守护进程可在所有提供异步 I/O 机制的 ACE 平台上兼容运行。

                                                                                                              The Proactor pattern [POSA2] defines a set of roles and relationships to help simplify applications that use proactive I/O. The ACE Proactor framework implements the Proactor pattern across a range of operating systems that support asynchronous I/O. The ACE Proactor framework provides a set of classes that simplify networked application use of asynchronous I/O capabilities across all platforms that offer it. This chapter discussed each class in the framework, covering their motivations and capabilities. It showed an implementation of the client logging daemon that uses the proactive I/O model for all of its network operations. This version of the client logging daemon works portably on all ACE platforms that offer asynchronous I/O mechanisms.

                                                                                                                第九章 ACE Streams框架

                                                                                                                Chapter 9. The ACE Streams Framework

                                                                                                                C章概要​

                                                                                                                CHAPTER SYNOPSIS

                                                                                                                本章介绍 ACE Streams 框架的设计和使用。该框架实现了管道和过滤器模式 [ POSA1 ]，这是一种架构模式，为处理数据流的系统提供了一种结构。我们将演示如何使用 ACE Streams 框架开发一个实用程序，该程序用于格式化和打印由日志服务器存储的日志记录文件。

                                                                                                                This chapter describes the design and use of the ACE Streams framework. This framework implements the Pipes and Filters pattern [POSA1], which is an architectural pattern that provides a structure for systems that process streams of data. We illustrate how the ACE Streams framework can be used to develop a utility program that formats and prints files of log records stored by our logging servers.

                                                                                                                  9.1 概述

                                                                                                                  9.1 Overview

                                                                                                                  管道和过滤器架构模式是组织分层/模块化应用程序的常用方法[ SG96 ]。该模式定义了一种处理数据流的架构，其中每个处理步骤都封装在某种类型的过滤器组件中。数据通过通信机制在相邻过滤器之间传递，该机制可以是连接本地或远程进程的进程间通信 (IPC) 通道，也可以是指向同一进程内对象的简单指针。每个过滤器都可以在将数据传递给下一个过滤器之前添加、修改或删除数据。过滤器通常是无状态的，在这种情况下，流经过滤器的数据会被转换并传递给下一个过滤器，而不会被存储。

                                                                                                                  The Pipes and Filters architectural pattern is a common way of organizing layered/modular applications [SG96]. This pattern defines an architecture for processing a stream of data in which each processing step is encapsulated in some type of filter component. Data is passed between adjacent filters via a communication mechanism, which can range from IPC channels connecting local or remote processes to simple pointers that reference objects within the same process. Each filter can add, modify, or remove data before passing it along to the next filter. Filters are often stateless, in which case data passing through the filter are transformed and passed along to the next filter without being stored.

                                                                                                                  管道和过滤器模式的常见示例包括

                                                                                                                  Common examples of the Pipes and Filters pattern include

                                                                                                                  • UNIX shell 使用的UNIX 管道 IPC 机制 [ Ste92 ] 用于创建单向管道

                                                                                                                  • The UNIX pipe IPC mechanism [Ste92] used by UNIX shells to create unidirectional pipelines

                                                                                                                  • System V STREAMS [ Rit84 ] 提供了一个将双向协议集成到 UNIX 内核中的框架。

                                                                                                                  • System V STREAMS [Rit84], which provides a framework for integrating bidirectional protocols into the UNIX kernel

                                                                                                                  ACE Streams 框架基于管道和过滤器模式。该框架简化了可通过双向处理模块进行通信的分层/模块化应用程序的开发。本章将介绍 ACE Streams 框架中的以下类：

                                                                                                                  The ACE Streams framework is based on the Pipes and Filters pattern. This framework simplifies the development of layered/modular applications that can communicate via bidirectional processing modules. This chapter describes the following classes in the ACE Streams framework:

                                                                                                                  ACE 级

                                                                                                                  ACE Class

                                                                                                                  描述

                                                                                                                  Description

                                                                                                                  ACE_Task

                                                                                                                  ACE_Task

                                                                                                                  一个由应用程序定义的功能组成的统一单元，它使用消息来传递请求、响应、数据和控制信息，并且可以按顺序或并发对消息进行排队和处理。

                                                                                                                  A cohesive unit of application-defined functionality that uses messages to communicate requests, responses, data, and control information and can queue and process messages sequentially or concurrently.

                                                                                                                  ACE模块

                                                                                                                  ACE_Module

                                                                                                                  应用程序中包含两个ACE_Task对象（一个用于“读取”，一个用于“写入”）的独立双向处理层

                                                                                                                  A distinct bidirectional processing layer in an application that contains two ACE_Task objects—one for "reading" and one for "writing"

                                                                                                                  ACE_Stream

                                                                                                                  ACE_Stream

                                                                                                                  包含一个有序的互连ACE_Module对象列表，可用于配置和执行分层应用程序定义服务。

                                                                                                                  Contains an ordered list of interconnected ACE_Module objects that can be used to configure and execute layered application-defined services

                                                                                                                  ACE Streams 框架中类之间最重要的关系如图 9.1所示。这些类根据管道和过滤器模式 [ POSA1 ] 扮演以下角色：

                                                                                                                  The most important relationships between classes in the ACE Streams framework are shown in Figure 9.1. These classes play the following roles in accordance with the Pipes and Filters pattern [POSA1]:

                                                                                                                  图 9.1. ACE Streams 框架类

                                                                                                                  • 过滤器类是数据流中的处理单元，用于丰富、提炼或转换输入数据。ACE Streams 框架中的过滤器类由ACE_Task 的子类实现。

                                                                                                                  • Filter classes are the processing units in a stream that enrich, refine, or transform input data. The filter classes in the ACE Streams framework are implemented by subclasses of ACE_Task.

                                                                                                                  • 管道类表示过滤器之间的互连。ACE Streams 框架中的管道类由ACE_Module对象 提供，这些对象包含相互连接的ACE_Task对象，这些对象链接在一起以创建完整的双向ACE_Stream。相邻互连任务中的应用程序定义方法通过交换数据和控制消息块进行协作。

                                                                                                                  • Pipe classes denote the interconnections between the filters. The pipe classes in the ACE Streams framework are provided by ACE_Module objects that contain interconnected ACE_Task objects linked together to create a complete bidirectional ACE_Stream. Application-defined methods in adjacent interconnected tasks collaborate by exchanging data and control message blocks.

                                                                                                                  ACE Streams框架具有以下优势：

                                                                                                                  The ACE Streams framework provides the following benefits:

                                                                                                                  • 增强了重用性和灵活性。 任何ACE_Task都可以插入任何ACE_Module，任何ACE_Module也可以插入任何ACE_Stream。这种灵活性使得多个应用程序能够系统地重用现有模块和任务，所有这些都可以动态配置。

                                                                                                                  • Enhanced reuse and flexibility. Any ACE_Task can be plugged into any ACE_Module and any ACE_Module can be plugged into any ACE_Stream. This flexibility enables multiple applications to systematically reuse existing modules and tasks, all of which can be configured dynamically.

                                                                                                                  • 透明、渐进式演进。 应用程序功能可以通过添加、删除和更改模块和任务以可控的方式实现。这种演进应用程序设计和功能的能力在敏捷开发流程（例如极限编程 (XP)）中尤为有用 [ Bec00 ]。

                                                                                                                  • Transparent, incremental evolution. Application functionality can be implemented in a controlled manner by adding, removing, and changing modules and tasks. This ability to evolve an application's design and functionality is particularly useful in agile development processes, such as Extreme Programming (XP) [Bec00].

                                                                                                                  • 宏观性能调优。应用程序可以通过选择性地省略不必要的服务功能或重新配置ACE_Task和ACE_Module对象 的组合，来适应不同的部署场景和运行时环境，从而提供上下文最优的服务功能。

                                                                                                                  • Macro-level performance tuning. Applications can adapt to varying deployment scenarios and run-time environments by selectively omitting unnecessary service functionality or reconfiguring a mixture of ACE_Task and ACE_Module objects to provide contextually optimal service functionality.

                                                                                                                  • 固有的模块化特性。ACE Streams 框架所强制执行的结构促进了公认的强内聚和最小耦合的设计实践。模块化设计有助于降低每一层的复杂性，并改进网络应用程序和服务的整体实现。基于高度模块化的设计，测试和文档编写也更加容易，从而简化了应用程序的维护和系统化复用。

                                                                                                                  • Inherent modularity. The structure enforced by the ACE Streams framework promotes well-accepted design practices of strong cohesion and minimal coupling. Modular designs help to reduce the complexity of each layer and improve the overall implementation of networked applications and services. Testing and documentation are also more easily accomplished when based on a highly modular design, making application maintenance and systematic reuse easier, as well.

                                                                                                                  • 易于学习。ACE Streams 框架包含一个直观的类结构，该结构基于 System V STREAMS框架的模式和设计，如侧边栏 59中所述。然而，即使是没有接触过 System V STREAMS 的开发人员也能快速掌握管道和过滤器模式的结构，然后以此模式为基础学习 ACE Streams 框架的其他类。

                                                                                                                  • Easy to learn. The ACE Streams framework contains an intuitive class structure based on the patterns and design of the System V STREAMS framework, as discussed in Sidebar 59. However, even developers who haven't been exposed to System V STREAMS can quickly grasp the structure of the Pipes and Filters pattern and then use that pattern as a basis for learning the rest of the ACE Streams framework classes.

                                                                                                                  ACE_Task类已在第 6 章中介绍。因此，本章主要着重介绍ACE_Module和ACE_Stream类提供的功能。不过，我们也会演示如何使用 ACE Streams 框架中的所有类来开发一个实用程序，该程序可以格式化并打印日志服务器存储的日志记录。如果您不熟悉 POSA1 中的管道和过滤器模式，我们建议您先阅读相关内容，然后再深入研究本章中的详细示例。

                                                                                                                  The ACE_Task class was described in Chapter 6. This chapter therefore focuses largely on describing the capabilities provided by the ACE_Module and ACE_Stream classes. However, we illustrate how all the classes in the ACE Streams framework can be used to develop a utility program that formats and prints log records stored by our logging servers. If you aren't familiar with the Pipes and Filters pattern from POSA1, we recommend that you read about it first before delving into the detailed examples in this chapter.

                                                                                                                  侧边栏 59：ACE 流与系统 V 流的关系

                                                                                                                  Sidebar 59: ACE Streams Relationship to System V STREAMS

                                                                                                                  ACE Streams 框架的类名和设计与 System V STREAMS中的类似组件相对应[ Rit84 , Rag93 ]。然而，这两个框架中用于支持可扩展性和并发性的技术却截然不同。例如，System V STREAMS 通过指向 C 函数的指针表来添加应用程序定义的功能，而 ACE Streams 框架则通过继承 ACE_Task 类来实现，从而提供了更高的类型安全性和可扩展性。ACE Streams 框架还利用 ACE Task 框架来增强 System V STREAMS中使用的基于协程的并发机制。这些 ACE 增强功能通过降低死锁的可能性并简化 ACE_Stream 中ACE_Task活动对象之间的流程控制，使得在共享内存多处理平台上更有效地利用多个 CPU [ SS95b ] 。

                                                                                                                  The class names and design of the ACE Streams framework correspond to similar componentry in System V STREAMS [Rit84, Rag93]. The techniques used to support extensibility and concurrency in these two frameworks differ significantly, however. For example, application-defined functionality is added in System V STREAMS via tables of pointers to C functions, whereas in the ACE Streams framework it's added by subclassing from ACE_Task, which provides greater type safety and extensibility. The ACE Streams framework also uses the ACE Task framework to enhance the coroutine-based concurrency mechanisms used in System V STREAMS. These ACE enhancements enable more effective use of multiple CPUs on shared memory multiprocessing platforms [SS95b] by reducing the likelihood of deadlock and simplifying flow control between ACE_Task active objects in an ACE_Stream.

                                                                                                                    9.2 ACE_Module 类

                                                                                                                    9.2 The ACE_Module Class

                                                                                                                    动机

                                                                                                                    Motivation

                                                                                                                    许多网络应用可以建模为一系列有序的处理层，这些处理层在层次结构上相互关联，并在相邻层之间交换消息。例如，内核级 [ Rit84 , Rag93 ] 和用户级 [ SS95b , HJE95 ] 协议栈、呼叫中心管理器 [ SS94 ] 以及其他类型的网络应用都可以受益于基于分层/模块化服务架构的消息传递设计。正如第 2.1.4 节所述，每一层都可以处理服务或网络应用的独立部分（例如输入或输出、事件分析、事件过滤或服务处理）。

                                                                                                                    Many networked applications can be modeled as an ordered series of processing layers that are related hierarchically and that exchange messages between adjacent layers. For example, kernel-level [Rit84, Rag93] and user-level [SS95b, HJE95] protocol stacks, call center managers [SS94], and other families of networked applications can benefit from a message-passing design based on a layered/modular service architecture. As discussed in Section 2.1.4, each layer can handle a self-contained portion (such as input or output, event analysis, event filtering, or service processing) of a service or networked application.

                                                                                                                    ACE_Task类提供了一个可重用的组件，可以轻松地将处理过程拆分成多个阶段并在阶段间传递数据。然而，由于ACE_Task对象是相互独立的，因此需要额外的结构来将它们组织成双向的“读写器”对，以便作为一个整体进行组装和管理。在多个项目中重新开发这种结构既繁琐又没有必要，因为该结构本质上与应用程序无关。为了避免这种重复的开发工作，ACE Streams 框架定义了ACE_Module类。

                                                                                                                    The ACE_Task class provides a reuseable component that can easily be used to separate processing into stages and pass data between them. Since ACE_Task objects are independent, however, additional structure is required to order ACE_Task objects into bidirectional "reader-writer" pairs that can be assembled and managed as a unit. Redeveloping this structure in multiple projects is tedious and unnecessary because the structure is fundamentally application independent. To avoid this redundant development effort, therefore, the ACE Streams framework defines the ACE_Module class.

                                                                                                                    等级能力

                                                                                                                    Class Capabilities

                                                                                                                    ACE_Module定义了一个独立的应用程序自定义功能层。此类提供以下功能：

                                                                                                                    ACE_Module defines a distinct layer of application-defined functionality. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                                                    • 每个ACE_Module都是一个双向的应用定义处理层，包含一对源自ACE_Task 的读取器和写入器任务。使用ACE_Module可以轻松表达分层设计，从而简化开发、训练和演进。

                                                                                                                    • Each ACE_Module is a bidirectional application-defined processing layer containing a pair of reader and writer tasks that derive from ACE_Task. Layered designs can be expressed easily using ACE_Module, which simplifies development, training, and evolution.

                                                                                                                    • ACE 服务配置器框架支持动态构建ACE_Module对象，这些对象可在运行时配置为ACE_Stream。因此，基于ACE_Module的分层设计具有高度可扩展性。

                                                                                                                    • The ACE Service Configurator framework supports dynamic construction of ACE_Module objects that can be configured into an ACE_Stream at run time. Layered designs based on ACE_Module are therefore highly extensible.

                                                                                                                    • ACE_Module中包含的读取器和写入器ACE_Task对象通过公共钩子方法传递消息与相邻的ACE_Task对象协作，从而促进松耦合并简化重新配置。

                                                                                                                    • The reader and writer ACE_Task objects contained in an ACE_Module collaborate with adjacent ACE_Task objects by passing messages via a public hook method, which promotes loose coupling and simplifies reconfiguration.

                                                                                                                    • ACE_Module中组成对象可以独立地进行更改和替换，从而降低维护和增强成本。

                                                                                                                    • The objects composed into an ACE_Module can be varied and replaced independently, which lowers maintenance and enhancement costs.

                                                                                                                    ACE_Module的接口如图 9.2所示，其主要方法如下表所示：

                                                                                                                    第 6.3 节中描述的ACE_Task类提供了一个面向对象的处理抽象，可以针对任何特定的应用领域进行专门化，例如网络协议栈 [ SW95 ] 或客户服务呼叫中心管理 [ SS94 ]。ACE_Task的消息传递和排队机制提供了一种直接的方法，可以将一个领域的工作划分为不同的步骤，并在这些步骤之间高效地双向移动工作和数据。许多领域都具有用于读取和写入数据的对称处理步骤。例如，协议处理通常涉及用于验证和应用安全转换（例如加密）的对称任务。ACE_Module提供了一种统一且灵活的组合机制，将这些应用程序定义的ACE_Task对象的实例关联起来。

                                                                                                                    The ACE_Task class described in Section 6.3 provides an object-oriented processing abstraction that can be specialized to target any particular application domain, such as network protocol stacks [SW95] or customer care call center management [SS94]. The ACE_Task message passing and queueing mechanism provides a straightforward way to divide a domain's work into distinct steps and move work and data between them efficiently and bidirectionally. Many domains have symmetric processing steps for data being read and written. For example, protocol processing often involves symmetric tasks for verifying and applying security transforms, such as encryption. An ACE_Module provides a uniform and flexible composition mechanism that relates instances of these application-defined ACE_Task objects into

                                                                                                                    • 一个“读取器”端，用于处理发送到上游ACE_Module层的消息。

                                                                                                                    • A "reader" side to process messages sent upstream to the ACE_Module layer

                                                                                                                    • 一个“写入端”，用于处理向下游发送到ACE_Module层的消息。

                                                                                                                    • A "writer" side to process messages sent downstream to the ACE_Module layer

                                                                                                                    构成双向模块的两个任务被称为同级任务。例如，在加密示例中，读取任务会验证并解密接收到的数据，而其同级写入任务则会在写入数据之前对其进行加密。ACE_Module由这两个任务各一个组成，并相应地配置到数据流中。

                                                                                                                    The two tasks that comprise a bidirectional module are referred to as siblings. In the encryption example, for instance, the reader task would verify and decrypt received data while its sibling writer task would encrypt data before it's written. An ACE_Module would be composed from one of each of these tasks, and configured into the stream appropriately.

                                                                                                                    如果某个层只在一个方向上处理数据，则可以将不活跃的同级任务指定为空指针，这将触发ACE_Module安装一个ACE_Thru_Task，该任务会将所有消息转发到下一个模块的任务，而不对其进行任何修改。即使重新排列、添加或删除层，这种设计也能保持分层结构。

                                                                                                                    In cases where a layer actively processes data in only one direction, the inactive sibling task can be specified as a NULL pointer, which triggers the ACE_Module to install an ACE_Thru_Task that simply forwards all messages to the next module's task without modifying them. This design maintains the layering even when layers are rearranged, added, or removed.

                                                                                                                    例子

                                                                                                                    Example

                                                                                                                    本示例开发了一个名为display_logfile的实用程序，它读取日志服务器存储的日志记录，格式化信息，并以人类可读的格式打印出来。如 C++NPv1 第 90 页所示，日志记录中的大多数字段都以 CDR 编码的二进制格式存储，这种格式虽然简洁，但不易被人类理解。为了实现display_logfile程序，我们实现了以下继承自ACE_Module 的类：

                                                                                                                    This example develops a utility program called display_logfile, which reads log records stored by our logging servers, formats the information, and prints it in a human-readable format. As shown on page 90 in C++NPv1, most fields in a log record are stored in a CDR-encoded binary format, which is concise but not easily understood by humans. To implement the display_logfile program, we implement the following classes derived from ACE_Module:

                                                                                                                    • Logrec Reader 是一个模块，它将日志文件中的日志记录转换为规范格式，然后通过ACE_Stream传递给其他模块并由其处理。

                                                                                                                    • Logrec Reader is a module that converts the log records in a logfile into a canonical format that's then passed to, and processed by, other modules in an ACE_Stream.

                                                                                                                    • Logrec Formatter 是一个模块，它决定如何格式化日志记录中的字段，例如将它们从二进制转换为ASCII。

                                                                                                                    • Logrec Formatter is a module that determines how the fields in the log record will be formatted, for example by converting them from binary to ASCII.

                                                                                                                    • Logrec Separator 是一个模块，用于在复合日志记录消息中，在现有消息块之间插入包含分隔符字符串的消息块。

                                                                                                                    • Logrec Separator is a module that inserts message blocks containing a separator string between the existing message blocks in a composite log record message.

                                                                                                                    • Logrec Writer 是一个模块，它将格式化的日志记录消息打印到标准输出，然后可以将其重定向到文件、打印机或控制台。

                                                                                                                    • Logrec Writer is a module that prints formatted log record messages to the standard output, where they can be redirected to a file, printer, or console.

                                                                                                                    图 9.3展示了构成display_logfile程序的ACE_Stream中各模块的结构。该程序采用生产者/消费者并发模型，其中Logrec_Reader和Logrec_Writer作为活动对象分别运行，负责生产和消费消息。图 9.3还展示了由Logrec Reader模块创建并由ACE_Stream中的其他过滤器模块操作的复合ACE_Message_Block的结构。

                                                                                                                    Figure 9.3 illustrates the structure of the modules in the ACE_Stream that comprise the display_logfile program. This program uses a producer/consumer concurrency model, where the Logrec_Reader and the Logrec_Writer run as active objects that produce and consume messages, respectively. Figure 9.3 also illustrates the structure of the composite ACE_Message_Block created by the Logrec Reader module and manipulated by the other filter modules in the ACE_Stream.

                                                                                                                    图 9.3.显示日志文件程序的ACE_Stream结构

                                                                                                                    在下面的示例中，我们继承自ACE_Task和ACE_Module，创建了Logrec Reader、Logrec Formatter、Logrec Separator和Logrec Writer模块。以下Logrec_Module模板和 LOGREC MODULE 宏用于简化以下许多示例：

                                                                                                                    In the example below, we inherit from ACE_Task and ACE_Module to create the Logrec Reader, Logrec Formatter, Logrec Separator, and Logrec Writer modules. The following Logrec_Module template and LOGREC MODULE macro are used to simplify many of the examples below:

                                                                                                                    template <class TASK> 
class Logrec_Module : public ACE_Module<ACE_MT_SYNCH> { 
public: 
  Logrec_Module (const ACE_TCHAR *name) 
    : ACE_Module<ACE_MT_SYNCH> 
                    (name, 
                     &task_, // Initialize writer-side task. 
                     0,      // Ignore reader-side task. 
                     0, 
                     ACE_Module<ACE_MT_SYNCH>::M_DELETE_READER) {} 
private: 
  TASK task_; 
}; 
#define LOGREC_MODULE(NAME) \ 
  typedef Logrec_Module<NAME> NAME##_Module

                                                                                                                    由于消息流是单向的（从Logrec Reader到Logrec Writer ），我们在ACE_Module构造函数中仅初始化写入端任务。通过将NULL指针传递给读取端任务参数，ACE_Module构造函数将创建一个ACE_Thru_Task实例，该实例会转发所有消息而不对其进行修改。M_DELETE_READER标志指示ACE_Module析构函数仅删除读取端任务，而不删除写入端任务。

                                                                                                                    Since the flow of messages is unidirectional (from Logrec Reader to Logrec Writer)we initialize only the writer-side task in the ACE_Module constructor. By passing a NULL pointer to the reader-side task parameter, the ACE_Module constructor will create an instance of ACE_Thru_Task that forwards all messages along without modifying them. The M_DELETE_READER flag instructs the ACE_Module destructor to only delete the reader-side task and not the writer-side task.

                                                                                                                    Logrec_Reader_Module。 此模块包含Logrec_Reader任务类的一个实例，该实例执行以下操作：

                                                                                                                    Logrec_Reader_Module. This module contains an instance of the Logrec_Reader task class that performs the following activities:

                                                                                                                    1. 它打开指定的日志文件。

                                                                                                                    2. It opens the designated logfile.

                                                                                                                    3. 它将Logrec_Reader实例激活为活动对象。

                                                                                                                    4. It activates the Logrec_Reader instance to be an active object.

                                                                                                                    5. 它将日志文件中的日志记录转换为一组链式消息块，每个消息块都包含反序列化日志记录中的一个字段，然后由ACE_Stream中的后续模块进行处理。

                                                                                                                    6. It converts the log records in the logfile into a set of chained message blocks, each containing a field from the demarshaled log record, which is then processed by subsequent modules in an ACE_Stream.

                                                                                                                    Logrec_Reader类如下所示：

                                                                                                                    The Logrec_Reader class is shown below:

                                                                                                                    class Logrec_Reader : public ACE_Task<ACE_MT_SYNCH> { 
private: 
  ACE_TString filename_; // Name of logfile. 
  ACE_FILE_IO logfile_;  // File containing log records. 
public: 
  enum {MB_CLIENT = ACE_Message_Block::MB_USER, 
        MB_TYPE, MB_PID, MB_TIME, MB_TEXT}; 
  Logrec_Reader (const ACE_TString &file): filename_ (file) {} 
  // ... Other methods shown below ... 
};

                                                                                                                    我们定义了五个枚举器来识别日志记录中的字段。我们不将字段指示符存储在数据本身中，而是使用ACE_Message_Block类型成员来指示字段类型。ACE_Message_Block定义了两个类型值范围：normal和priority，每个范围包含若干值。它还定义了第三个范围，用于用户自定义的消息类型。我们将MB_CLIENT初始化为ACE_Message_Block::MB_USER的值，这是第一个保证不会与 ACE 内部定义的其他值冲突的用户自定义消息类型值。

                                                                                                                    We define five enumerators to identify the fields in a log record. Rather than store the field indicator in the data itself, we use the ACE_Message_Block type member to indicate the field type. ACE_Message_Block defines two ranges of type valuesnormal and prioritywith a number of values in each range. It also defines a third range for user-defined message types. We initialize MB_CLIENT to the value of ACE_Message_Block::MB_USER, which is the first user-defined message type value guaranteed not to conflict with other values defined within ACE itself.

                                                                                                                    Logrec_Reader ::open() hook 方法打开指定的日志文件并将任务转换为活动对象，如下所示。

                                                                                                                    The Logrec_Reader::open() hook method opens the designated logfile and converts the task into an active object, as shown below.

                                                                                                                    virtual int open (void *) { 
  ACE_FILE_Addr name (filename_.c_str ()); 
  ACE_FILE_Connector con; 
  if (con.connect (logfile_, name) == -1) return -1; 
  return activate (); 
}

                                                                                                                    Logrec_Reader::svc()在活动对象线程中运行。它从日志文件中读取日志记录，对每条记录进行反序列化，并将其存储在一个复合消息块中，然后将每个复合消息块向上传递，供其他模块进一步处理。日志文件以一系列日志记录的形式写入，每条记录包含：

                                                                                                                    Logrec_Reader::svc() runs in the active object thread. It reads log records from the logfile, demarshals and stores each one in a composite message block, and passes each composite message block up the stream for further processing by other modules. The logfile is written as a series of log records, each consisting of:

                                                                                                                    • 包含发送日志记录的客户端名称的字符串

                                                                                                                    • A string containing the name of the client that sent the log record

                                                                                                                    • 一个 CDR 编码的ACE_Log_Record（有关该记录的封送代码，请参见 C++NPv1 第 79 页）

                                                                                                                    • A CDR-encoded ACE_Log_Record (see page 79 of C++NPv1 for the marshaling code of the record)

                                                                                                                    每条日志记录都紧随前一条记录之后，没有记录间标记。如下所示，` Logrec_Reader::svc()` 函数以大块数据读取文件内容，并将其反序列化为数据流。一个for循环读取文件内容直至到达文件末尾(EOF) 。另一个内部for循环从数据块中反序列化出日志记录。

                                                                                                                    Each log record follows the previous one with no inter-record marker. As shown below, Logrec_Reader::svc() reads the file contents in large chunks and demarshals them as a stream of data. A for loop reads the file contents until EOF is reached. An inner for loop demarshals log records from the data chunks.

                                                                                                                     1  virtual int svc () { 
 2    const size_t FILE_READ_SIZE = 8 * 1024; 
 3    ACE_Message_Block mblk (FILE_READ_SIZE); 
 4 
 5    for (;; mblk.crunch ()) { 
 6      ssize_t bytes_read = logfile_.recv (mblk.wr_ptr (), 
 7                                          mblk.space ()); 
 8      if (bytes_read <= 0) break; 
 9      mblk.wr_ptr (ACE_static_cast (size_t, bytes_read)); 
10      for (;;) { 
11        size_t name_len = ACE_OS_String::strnlen 
12                            (mblk.rd_ptr (), mblk.length ()); 
13        if (name_len == mblk.length ()) break; 
14 
15        char *name_p = mblk.rd_ptr (); 
16        ACE_Message_Block *rec = 0, *head = 0, *temp = 0; 
17        ACE_NEW_RETURN 
18          (head, ACE_Message_Block (name_len, MB_CLIENT), 0); 
19        head->copy (name_p, name_len); 
20        mblk.rd_ptr (name_len + 1);   // Skip nul also 
21 
22        size_t need = mblk.length () + ACE_CDR::MAX_ALIGNMENT; 
23        ACE_NEW_RETURN (rec, ACE_Message_Block (need), 0); 
24        ACE_CDR::mb_align (rec); 
25        rec->copy (mblk.rd_ptr (), mblk.length ()); 
26 
27        ACE_InputCDR cdr (rec); rec->release (); 
28        ACE_CDR::Boolean byte_order; 
29        if (!cdr.read_boolean (byte_order)) { 
30          head->release (); mblk.rd_ptr (name_p); break; 
31        } 
32        cdr.reset_byte_order (byte_order); 
33 
34        ACE_CDR::ULong length; 
35        if (!cdr.read_ulong (length)) { 
36          head->release (); mblk.rd_ptr (name_p); break; 
37        } 
38        if (length > cdr.length ()) { 
39          head->release (); mblk.rd_ptr (name_p); break; 
40        } 
41        ACE_NEW_RETURN 
42          (temp, ACE_Message_Block (length, MB_TEXT), 0); 
43        ACE_NEW_RETURN 
44          (temp, 
45           ACE_Message_Block (2 * sizeof (ACE_CDR::Long), 
46                              MB_TIME, temp), 0); 
47        ACE_NEW_RETURN 
48          (temp, 
49           ACE_Message_Block (sizeof (ACE_CDR::Long), 
50                              MB_PID, temp), 0); 
51        ACE_NEW_RETURN 
52          (temp, 
53           ACE_Message_Block (sizeof (ACE_CDR::Long), 
54                              MB_TYPE, temp), 0); 
55        head->cont (temp); 
56        // Extract the type... 
57        ACE_CDR::Long *lp = ACE_reinterpret_cast 
58                          (ACE_CDR::Long *, temp->wr_ptr ()); 
59        cdr >> *lp; 
60        temp->wr_ptr (sizeof (ACE_CDR::Long)); 
61        temp = temp->cont (); 
62        // Extract the PID... 
63        lp = ACE_reinterpret_cast 
64            (ACE_CDR::Long *, temp->wr_ptr ()); 
65        cdr >> *lp; 
66        temp->wr_ptr (sizeof (ACE_CDR::Long)); 
67        temp = temp->cont (); 
68        // Extract the timestamp... 
69        lp = ACE_reinterpret_cast 
70          (ACE_CDR::Long *, temp->wr_ptr ()); 
71        cdr >> *lp; ++lp; cdr >> *lp; 
72        temp->wr_ptr (2 * sizeof (ACE_CDR::Long)); 
73        temp = temp->cont (); 
74        // Extract the text length, then the text message 
75        ACE_CDR::ULong text_len; 
76        cdr >> text_len; 
77        cdr.read_char_array (temp->wr_ptr (), text_len); 
78        temp->wr_ptr (text_len); 
79 
80        if (put_next (head) == -1) break; 
81        mblk.rd_ptr (mblk.length () - cdr.length ()); 
82      } 
83    } 
84 
85    ACE_Message_Block *stop = 0; 
86    ACE_NEW_RETURN 
87      (stop, 
88       ACE_Message_Block (0, ACE_Message_Block::MB_STOP), 0); 
89    put_next (stop); 
90    return 0; 
91  }

                                                                                                                    第 59 行开始循环，将文件内容读取到ACE_Message_Block中，并使用space()方法获取块中的可用空间。块的写入指针会更新以反映添加的数据。for 循环的最后一个子句使用ACE_Message_Block ::crunch()方法将mblk中的所有数据移到块数据缓冲区的开头，以便有空间追加更多数据。

                                                                                                                    Lines 59 Begin the loop that reads the file's contents into an ACE_Message_Block, using the space() method to find out how much free space is available in the block. The block's write pointer is updated to reflect the added data. The final clause in the for loop uses the ACE_Message_Block::crunch() method to shift any data in mblk to the beginning of the block's data buffer so there's room to append more data.

                                                                                                                    第 1020 行开始日志记录反序列化循环。我们使用 ` ACE_OS_String::strnlen()`方法来查找主机名字符串的长度，但只会检查`mblk`中剩余的字符。如果`mblk`中没有包含完整的名称，则跳出循环从文件中读取更多数据。如果名称存在，我们会记住名称起始位置的指针（` name_p`），以便在需要获取更多数据时重新开始反序列化。分配头 `ACE_Message_Block`来保存名称；它将成为沿流向上传递的消息块链中的第一个块。

                                                                                                                    Lines 1020 Begin the log record demarshaling loop. We use the ACE_OS_String::strnlen() method to find the length of the hostname string, but will only look through the characters remaining in mblk.Ifmblk doesn't contain the whole name, we break out of the loop to read more data from the file. If the name is there, we remember the pointer where the name starts (name_p) in case we need to get more data and restart the demarshaling. The head ACE_Message_Block is allocated to hold the name; it will become the first block in the message block chain that's passed up the stream.

                                                                                                                    第 2225 行，mblk读取指针现在位于 CDR 编码的ACE_Log_Record的开头。回顾 C++NPv1 第 4 章，ACE 的 CDR 类要从中反序列化数据的缓冲区必须正确对齐。mblk 读取指针的当前对齐方式未知，并且很可能没有正确对齐。因此，我们分配一个新的ACE_Message_Block，其大小足以容纳mblk中的剩余数据，以及 CDR 对齐所需的任何字节。调用ACE_CDR::mb_align()对齐新块的写入指针后，我们复制文件数据的剩余部分。

                                                                                                                    Lines 2225 The mblk read pointer is now at the start of the CDR-encoded ACE_Log_Record. Recall from Chapter 4 of C++NPv1 that a buffer from which ACE's CDR classes will demarshal data must be properly aligned. The current alignment of the mblk read pointer is unknown, and not likely to be properly aligned. We therefore allocate a new ACE_Message_Block large enough to hold the remaining data in mblk, plus any needed bytes for CDR alignment. After calling ACE_CDR::mb_align() to align the new block's write pointer, we copy the remainder of the file data.

                                                                                                                    第2732 行：创建一个ACE_InputCDR对象，用于从rec 对象中反序列化日志记录内容。由于ACE_InputCDR构造函数会增加rec 对象的引用计数，因此我们调用rec->release()来释放对它的引用，以防止内存泄漏。反序列化的第一个项是字节顺序指示符。它用于重置cdr 对象的字节顺序，以便正确反序列化剩余数据。

                                                                                                                    Lines 2732 Create an ACE_InputCDR object to demarshal the log record contents from rec. Since the ACE_InputCDR constructor increments the reference count on rec, we call rec->release() to release our reference to it, preventing a memory leak. The first item demarshaled is the byte order indicator. It's used to reset the byte order of cdr so the remaining data can be demarshaled properly.

                                                                                                                    第 3439 行：为序列化的ACE_Log_Record写入的头部包含一个长度字段，用于指定序列化日志记录中的字节数。该值将被反序列化，并与cdr对象中剩余的字节数进行比较。如果缺少所需的字节数，则释放客户端名称块（head），将mblk读取指针重置为在下一次反序列化过程中从主机名重新开始，并跳出记录反序列化循环以从文件中读取更多数据。

                                                                                                                    Lines 3439 The header written for the marshaled ACE_Log_Record contains a length field designating the number of bytes in the marshaled log record. That value is demarshaled and compared to the number of bytes remaining in the cdr object. If not all of the needed bytes are present, release the client name block (head), reset the mblk read pointer to restart at the host name on the next demarshaling pass, and break out of the record-demarshaling loop to read more data from the file.

                                                                                                                    第 4155 行：为所有剩余的日志记录字段分配消息块。每个消息块都具有正确的块类型，以便在后续模块中正确识别。它们按相反的顺序分配，以便于提供延续指针。因此，当最后一个消息块分配完毕时，它将成为链中头节点之后的第一个消息块，并通过其延续指针连接。

                                                                                                                    Lines 4155 Allocate message blocks for all of the remaining log record fields. Each has the correct block type for proper identification in modules further down the stream. They're allocated in reverse order to make it easier to supply the cont pointer. When the last one is allocated, therefore, it's the first block in the chain after head and is connected via its continuation pointer.

                                                                                                                    Lines 6373 The same technique is used to demarshal the process ID and timestamp.
