                                                                                                                    侧边栏 60：与 ACE Streams 框架相关的 ACE_Task 方法

                                                                                                                    Sidebar 60: ACE_Task Methods Related to ACE Streams Framework

                                                                                                                    第 6.3 节中描述的ACE_Task还包含以下方法，这些方法可以与 ACE Streams 框架结合使用：

                                                                                                                    The ACE_Task described in Section 6.3 also contains the following methods that can be used in conjunction with the ACE Streams framework:

                                                                                                                    方法

                                                                                                                    Method

                                                                                                                    描述

                                                                                                                    Description

                                                                                                                    模块（）

                                                                                                                    module()

                                                                                                                    如果存在任务所在的模块，则返回指向该模块的指针，否则返回 0。

                                                                                                                    Returns a pointer to the task's module if there is one, else 0

                                                                                                                    下一个（）

                                                                                                                    next()

                                                                                                                    如果流中存在下一个任务，则返回指向该任务的指针，否则返回 0。

                                                                                                                    Returns a pointer to the next task in a stream if there is one, else 0

                                                                                                                    兄弟（）

                                                                                                                    sibling()

                                                                                                                    返回指向模块中任务同级节点的指针

                                                                                                                    Returns a pointer to a task's sibling in a module

                                                                                                                    put_next()

                                                                                                                    put_next()

                                                                                                                    将消息块传递给流中的相邻任务。

                                                                                                                    Passes a message block to the adjacent task in a stream

                                                                                                                    可以放置()

                                                                                                                    can_put()

                                                                                                                    如果消息块可以通过put_next()入队而不会因流内流控制而阻塞，则返回 1，否则返回 0。

                                                                                                                    Returns 1 if a message block can be enqueued via put_next() without blocking due to intrastream flow control, else 0

                                                                                                                    回复（）

                                                                                                                    reply()

                                                                                                                    将消息块传递给同级任务在流中的相邻任务，这使得任务能够反转流中消息的传递方向。

                                                                                                                    Passes a message block to the sibling task's adjacent task of a stream, which enables a task to reverse the direction of a message in a stream

                                                                                                                    属于ACE_Module 的 ACE_Task可以使用put_next ()将消息块转发到相邻模块。此方法会跟随模块的next()指针找到正确的任务，然后调用其put()钩子方法，并将消息块传递给它。put ()方法会借用调用put_next()的任务的线程。如果任务作为活动对象运行，其put()方法可以将消息放入任务的消息队列，并允许其svc()钩子方法在处理流中的其他任务时并发地处理该消息。侧边栏 62（第 317 页）概述了 ACE Streams 框架支持的并发模型。

                                                                                                                    An ACE_Task that's part of an ACE_Module can use put_next() to forward a message block to an adjacent module. This method follows the module's next() pointer to the right task, then calls its put() hook method, passing it the message block. The put() method borrows the thread from the task that invoked put_next(). If a task runs as an active object, its put() method can enqueue the message on the task's message queue and allow its svc() hook method to handle the message concurrently with respect to other processing in a stream. Sidebar 62 (page 317) outlines the concurrency models supported by the ACE Streams framework.

                                                                                                                    由于日志文件名会传递给Logrec_Reader_Module构造函数，因此我们不能使用LOGREC_MODULE宏（第303 页）。相反，我们需要显式定义该类，如下所示：

                                                                                                                    Since the name of the logfile is passed to the Logrec_Reader_Module constructor, we can't use the LOGREC_MODULE macro (page 303). Instead, we define the class explicitly, as shown below:

                                                                                                                    class Logrec_Reader_Module : public ACE_Module<ACE_MT_SYNCH> { 
public: 
  Logrec_Reader_Module (const ACE_TString &filename) 
    : ACE_Module<ACE_MT_SYNCH> 
                    (ACE_TEXT ("Logrec Reader"), 
                     &task_, // Initialize writer-side. 
                     0,      // Ignore reader-side. 
                     0, 
                     ACE_Module<ACE_MT_SYNCH>::M_DELETE_READER), 
      task_ (filename) {} 

private: 
  // Converts the logfile into chains of message blocks. 
  Logrec_Reader task_; 
};

                                                                                                                    Logrec_Formatter_Module。 该模块包含一个Logrec_Formatter任务，用于确定日志记录字段的格式，如下所示：

                                                                                                                    Logrec_Formatter_Module. This module contains a Logrec_Formatter task that determines how the log record fields will be formatted, as shown below:

                                                                                                                    class Logrec_Formatter : public ACE_Task<ACE_MT_SYNCH> { 
private: 
  typedef void (*FORMATTER[5])(ACE_Message_Block *); 
  static FORMATTER format_; // Array of format static methods. 

public:

                                                                                                                    流的模块和任务的同步特性由包含它们的ACE_Stream设置。由于上面定义的模块和任务使用了ACE_MT_SYNCH，因此Logrec_Formatter也继承自ACE_Task<ACE_MT_SYNCH>。然而，它以被动对象的形式运行，因为Logrec_Formatter从不调用activate()，并且它的put()方法会借用调用者的线程来格式化消息，如下所示：

                                                                                                                    The synchronization trait for a stream's modules and tasks is set by the ACE_Stream that contains them. Since the modules and tasks defined above use ACE_MT_SYNCH, Logrec_Formatter also derives from ACE_Task<ACE_MT_SYNCH>. It runs as a passive object, however, since Logrec_Formatter never calls activate() and its put() method borrows the thread of its caller to format messages, as shown below:

                                                                                                                    virtual int put (ACE_Message_Block *mblk, ACE_Time_Value *) { 
  if (mblk->msg_type () == Logrec_Reader::MB_CLIENT) 
    for (ACE_Message_Block *temp = mblk; 
         temp != 0; 
         temp = temp->cont ()) { 
      int mb_type = 
        temp->msg_type () - ACE_Message_Block::MB_USER; 
      (*format_[mb_type])(temp); 
    } 
  return put_next (mblk); 
}

                                                                                                                    ` put()`方法用于确定转发到此模块的`ACE_Message_Block`的消息类型。如果消息类型为`Logrec_Reader::MB_CLIENT`，则它是包含日志记录字段的一组链式块中的第一个。在这种情况下，该方法会遍历记录字段，并调用相应的静态方法将这些字段转换为人类可读的格式。所有字段格式化完成后，消息块将被传递给流中的下一个模块。如果转发的块不是 ` Logrec_Reader ::MB_CLIENT`类型，则假定它是`MB_STOP`块，并直接转发到流中的下一个模块。

                                                                                                                    The put() method determines the message type of the ACE_Message_Block forwarded to this module. If the message type is Logrec_Reader::MB_CLIENT, then it's the first in a set of chained blocks containing log record fields. In this case, the method iterates through the record fields invoking the appropriate static methods to convert the fields into a human-readable format. After all the fields are formatted, the message block is passed along to the next module in the stream. If the forwarded block is not of type Logrec_Reader::MB_CLIENT, it's assumed to be the MB_STOP block and is simply forwarded to the next module in the stream.

                                                                                                                    以下静态方法用于格式化其对应类型的字段。我们首先来看format_client()：

                                                                                                                    The following static methods format their corresponding type of field. We start with format_client():

                                                                                                                    static void format_client (ACE_Message_Block *) { return; }

                                                                                                                    MB_CLIENT数据块包含一个已知长度的文本字符串。由于无需进一步格式化，` format_client()` 函数直接返回。请注意，该文本为 ASCII 字符。任何将文本转换为宽字符格式或通过查找 IP 地址来验证名称所需的处理都可以在此处添加，而不会影响数据流的其余部分。

                                                                                                                    The MB_CLIENT block has a known-length text string in it. Since this needs no further formatting, format_client() simply returns. Note that the text is in ASCII. Any processing required to translate to a wide-character format or verify the name by looking up its IP address could be added here without disturbing the rest of the stream.

                                                                                                                    我们使用以下format_long()方法将日志记录的类型和进程 ID 转换为 ASCII 表示形式：

                                                                                                                    We use the following format_long() method to convert the log record's type and process id into an ASCII representation:

                                                                                                                    static void format_long (ACE_Message_Block *mblk) { 
  ACE_CDR::Long type = * (ACE_CDR::Long *)mblk->rd_ptr (); 
  mblk->size (11); // Max size in ASCII of 32-bit word. 
  mblk->reset (); 
  mblk->wr_ptr ((size_t) sprintf (mblk->wr_ptr (), "%d", type)); 
}

                                                                                                                    `size ()`方法调用确保消息块中有足够的空间来容纳值的文本表示，并在必要时重新分配空间。`reset ()`方法调用将消息块的读写指针重置到其内存缓冲区的起始位置，以便调用标准的 C 语言 ` sprintf()`函数进行实际的格式化。`sprintf ()`函数返回用于格式化值的字符数，不包括字符串终止符NUL。由于消息块包含特定数量的字符，因此在更新消息块的写指针时，我们不将NUL字符计入新的长度。

                                                                                                                    The size() method call ensures that there's enough space in the message block to hold the textual representation of the value, reallocating space if necessary. The reset() method call resets the message block's read and write pointers to the start of its memory buffer in preparation for the call to the standard C sprintf() function that does the actual formatting. The sprintf() function returns the number of characters used to format the value, not including the string-terminating NUL character. Since message blocks contain a specific count, we don't include the NUL character in the new length when updating the message block's write pointer.

                                                                                                                    format_time ()方法比较复杂，因为它将时间值的秒和微秒转换为 ASCII 字符串，如下所示：

                                                                                                                    The format_time() method is more complicated since it converts the seconds and microseconds of the time value into an ASCII string, as follows:

                                                                                                                    static void format_time (ACE_Message_Block *mblk) { 
  ACE_CDR::Long secs = * (ACE_CDR::Long *)mblk->rd_ptr (); 
  mblk->rd_ptr (sizeof (ACE_CDR::Long)); 
  ACE_CDR::Long usecs = * (ACE_CDR::Long *)mblk->rd_ptr (); 
  char timestamp[26]; // Max size of ctime_r() string. 
  time_t time_secs (secs); 
  ACE_OS::ctime_r (&time_secs, timestamp, sizeof timestamp); 
  mblk->size (26); // Max size of ctime_r() string. 
  mblk->reset (); 
  timestamp[19] = '\0'; // NUL-terminate after the time. 
  timestamp[24] = '\0'; // NUL-terminate after the date. 
  size_t fmt_len (sprintf (mblk->wr_ptr (), 
                           "%s.%03d %s", 
                           timestamp + 4, 
                           usecs / 1000, 
                           timestamp + 20)); 
  mblk->wr_ptr (fmt_len); 
}

                                                                                                                    最终的format_string()方法与format_client()方法完全相同，因为它也接收一个已知长度的字符串。同样，如果需要对字符串进行一些处理，也可以很容易地在这里添加这些处理步骤。

                                                                                                                    The final format_string() method is identical to format_client() since it also receives a known-length string. Again, if the string required some manipulation, this processing could easily be added here.

                                                                                                                      static void format_string (ACE_Message_Block *) { return; } 
};

                                                                                                                    我们按如下方式初始化指向格式化方法的指针数组：

                                                                                                                    We initialize the array of pointers to formatting methods as follows:

                                                                                                                    Logrec_Formatter::FORMATTER Logrec_Formatter::format_ = { 
  format_client, format_long, 
  format_long, format_time, format_string 
};

                                                                                                                    我们使用指向静态方法的指针，而不是指向非静态方法的指针，因为没有必要访问Logrec_Formatter 的状态。

                                                                                                                    We use pointers to static methods rather than pointers to nonstatic methods since there's no need to access Logrec_Formatter state.

                                                                                                                    接下来，我们使用Logrec_Formatter类实例化 LOGREC_MODULE宏，以创建Logrec_Formatter_Module：

                                                                                                                    We next instantiate the LOGREC_MODULE macro with the Logrec_Formatter class to create the Logrec_Formatter_Module:

                                                                                                                    LOGREC_MODULE (Logrec_Formatter);

                                                                                                                    Logrec_Separator_Module。 此模块包含一个Logrec_Separator对象，用于在复合日志记录消息中现有消息块之间插入消息块，每个新消息块都包含分隔符字符串。

                                                                                                                    Logrec_Separator_Module. This module contains a Logrec_Separator object that inserts message blocks between the existing message blocks in a composite log record message, each new message block contains the separator string.

                                                                                                                    class Logrec_Separator : public ACE_Task<ACE_MT_SYNCH> { 
private: 
  ACE_Lock_Adapter<ACE_Thread_Mutex> lock_strategy_; 
public:

                                                                                                                    这个类是一个被动对象，因此Logrec_Separator::put()会借用其调用者的线程来插入分隔符：

                                                                                                                    This class is a passive object, so Logrec_Separator::put() borrows the thread of its caller to insert the separators:

                                                                                                                     1  virtual int put (ACE_Message_Block *mblk, 
 2                   ACE_Time_Value *) { 
 3    if (mblk->msg_type () == Logrec_Reader::MB_CLIENT) { 
 4      ACE_Message_Block *separator = 0; 
 5      ACE_NEW_RETURN 
 6        (separator, 
 7         ACE_Message_Block (ACE_OS_String::strlen ("|") + 1, 
 8                            ACE_Message_Block::MB_DATA, 
 9                            0, 0, 0, &lock_strategy_), -1); 
10      separator->copy ("|"); 
11 
12      ACE_Message_Block *dup = 0; 
13      for (ACE_Message_Block *temp = mblk; temp != 0; ) { 
14        dup = separator->duplicate (); 
15        dup->cont (temp->cont ()); 
16        temp->cont (dup); 
17        temp = dup->cont (); 
18      } 
19      ACE_Message_Block *nl = 0; 
20      ACE_NEW_RETURN (nl, ACE_Message_Block (2), 0); 
21      nl->copy ("\n"); 
22      dup->cont (nl); 
23      separator->release (); 
24    } 
25 
26    return put_next (mblk); 
27  }

                                                                                                                    第 3 行：如果数据块的类型为MB_STOP，则将其转发到下一个流模块。由于Logrec_Separator是一个被动对象，因此在完成操​​作后无需执行任何操作。

                                                                                                                    Line 3 If the block's type is MB_STOP, it's forwarded to the next stream module. Since Logrec_Separator is a passive object, it needn't take any action when it's done.

                                                                                                                    第 410 行创建了一个消息块来保存分隔符字符串，该字符串设置为“|”（更灵活的实现方式是将分隔符字符串作为类构造函数的参数）。稍后，我们将使用 ` ACE_Message_Block::duplicate()`方法，该方法返回消息的“浅”副本，该副本仅将其引用计数加一，但实际上并不复制数据本身。第 61 行的侧边栏解释了我们如何以及为何使用`ACE_Lock_Adapter<ACE_Thread_Mutex>`锁定策略配置分隔符 `ACE_Message_Block`。

                                                                                                                    Lines 410 Create a message block to hold the separator string, which is set to "|" (a more flexible implementation could make the separator string a parameter to the class constructor). Later in this method, we'll use the ACE_Message_Block::duplicate() method, which returns a "shallow" copy of the message that simply increments its reference count by one, but doesn't actually make a copy of the data itself. Sidebar 61 explains how and why we configured the separator ACE_Message_Block with an ACE_Lock_Adapter<ACE_Thread_Mutex> locking strategy.

                                                                                                                    第 1218 行循环遍历消息块列表，在每个原始消息块之间插入一个包含分隔符字符串的分隔符副本。

                                                                                                                    Lines 1218 Loop through the list of message blocks to insert a duplicate of separator that contains the separator string between each of the original message blocks.

                                                                                                                    第 1922 行插入分隔符后，会附加一个包含换行符的最后一个块，以便在最终写入标准输出时能够清晰地格式化输出。

                                                                                                                    Lines 1922 After the separators are inserted, a final block containing a newline is appended to format the output cleanly when it's eventually written to the standard output.

                                                                                                                    第 2326 行：从中复制了所有分隔符块的块被释放，修改后的复合消息被传递到流中的下一个模块。

                                                                                                                    Lines 2326 The block from which all the separator blocks were duplicated is released, and the revised composite message is passed along to the next module in the stream.

                                                                                                                    侧边栏 61：序列化 ACE_Message_Block 引用计数

                                                                                                                    Sidebar 61: Serializing ACE_Message_Block Reference Counts

                                                                                                                    如果消息块的浅拷贝在不同线程中创建和/或释放，则对引用计数和共享数据的访问可能存在竞争条件。因此，对这些数据的访问必须串行化。由于涉及多个消息块，因此应用了外部锁定策略。因此，消息块可以与ACE_Lock_Adapter的实例关联。Logrec_Separator ::put()（第 311 页）从多个线程访问消息块，因此ACE_Lock_Adapter使用ACE_Thread_Mutex进行参数化。此锁定策略串行化对消息块的duplicate()和release()方法的调用，以避免不同线程并发创建和释放消息块时出现竞争条件。尽管Logrec_Separator::put()在将消息块转发到下一个模块之前会调用separator->release()，但我们采取此预防措施是因为插入到流中的后续模块可能会使用多个线程处理这些块。

                                                                                                                    If shallow copies of a message block are created and/or released in different threads there's a potential race condition on access to the reference count and shared data. Access to these data must therefore be serialized. Since there are multiple message blocks involved, an external locking strategy is applied. Hence, a message block can be associated with an instance of ACE_Lock_Adapter. Logrec_Separator::put() (page 311) accesses message blocks from multiple threads, so the ACE_Lock_Adapter is parameterized with an ACE_Thread_Mutex. This locking strategy serializes calls to the message block's duplicate() and release() methods to avoid race conditions when a message block is created and released concurrently by different threads. Although Logrec_Separator::put() calls separator->release() before forwarding the message block to the next module, we take this precaution because a subsequent module inserted in the stream may process the blocks using multiple threads.

                                                                                                                    现在我们使用Logrec_Separator类实例化LOGREC_MODULE宏来创建Logrec_Separator_Module：

                                                                                                                    We now instantiate the LOGREC_MODULE macro with the Logrec_Separator class to create the Logrec_Separator_Module:

                                                                                                                    LOGREC_MODULE (Logrec_Separator);

                                                                                                                    Logrec_Writer_Module。 该模块包含一个Logrec_Writer任务，该任务执行以下操作：

                                                                                                                    Logrec_Writer_Module. This module contains a Logrec_Writer task that performs the following activities:

                                                                                                                    • 它将Logrec_Writer实例激活为活动对象。

                                                                                                                    • It activates the Logrec_Writer instance to be an active object.

                                                                                                                    • 它接收相邻模块传递的格式化日志记录消息，并将其打印到其标准输出。

                                                                                                                    • It receives formatted log record messages passed by an adjacent module and prints them to its standard output.

                                                                                                                    Logrec_Writer类如下所示：

                                                                                                                    The Logrec_Writer class is shown below:

                                                                                                                    class Logrec_Writer : public ACE_Task<ACE_MT_SYNCH> { 
public: 
  // Initialization hook method. 
  virtual int open (void *) { return activate (); }

                                                                                                                    open ()钩子方法将Logrec_Writer转换为活动对象。该类中的其他两个方法利用了其ACE_Task子类使用ACE_MT_SYNCH特性类实例化这一事实。例如，Logrec_Writer::put()将消息入队到其同步消息队列中：

                                                                                                                    The open() hook method converts Logrec_Writer into an active object. The other two methods in this class leverage the fact that its ACE_Task subclass is instantiated with the ACE_MT_SYNCH traits class. For example, Logrec_Writer::put() enqueues messages in its synchronized message queue:

                                                                                                                    virtual int put (ACE_Message_Block *mblk, ACE_Time_Value *to) 
{ return putq (mblk, to); }

                                                                                                                    同样，Logrec_Writer::svc()在其活动对象线程中运行，从其消息队列中取出消息并将其写入标准输出：

                                                                                                                    Likewise, Logrec_Writer::svc() runs in its active object thread, dequeueing messages from its message queue and writing them to standard output:

                                                                                                                      virtual int svc () { 
    int stop = 0; 
    for (ACE_Message_Block *mb; !stop && getq (mb) != -1; ) { 
      if (mb->msg_type () == ACE_Message_Block::MB_STOP) 
        stop = 1; 
      else ACE::write_n (ACE_STDOUT, mb); 

      put_next (mb); 
    } 
    return 0; 
  } 
};

                                                                                                                    当收到MB_STOP块时，该方法会跳出处理循环并返回，从而结束线程。ACE ::write_n()方法使用高效的收集-写入操作，打印出所有其他通过其cont()指针链接的消息块。所有消息块都会转发到流中的下一个模块。默认情况下，ACE Streams 框架会释放所有从流“末尾”转发出去的消息块，如ACE_Stream_Tail部分（第 314 页）所述。

                                                                                                                    When a MB_STOP block is received, the method will break out of the processing loop and return, ending the thread. The ACE::write_n() method prints out all other message blocks chained through their cont() pointers using an efficient gather-write operation. All the message blocks are forwarded to the next module in the stream. By default, the ACE Streams framework releases all message blocks that are forwarded "off the end" of the stream, as discussed in the coverage of ACE_Stream_Tail (page 314).

                                                                                                                    最后，我们使用 Logrec_Writer类实例化LOGREC_MODULE宏来创建Logrec_Writer_Module：

                                                                                                                    Finally, we instantiate the LOGREC_MODULE macro with the Logrec_Writer class to create the Logrec_Writer_Module:

                                                                                                                    LOGREC_MODULE (Logrec_Writer);

                                                                                                                    The Example portion of Section 9.3 illustrates how all the modules shown above can be configured in an ACE_Stream to create the complete display_logfile program.

                                                                                                                      9.3 ACE_Stream 类

                                                                                                                      9.3 The ACE_Stream Class

                                                                                                                      动机

                                                                                                                      Motivation

                                                                                                                      第 9.2 节中描述的ACE_Module类可用于将网络应用程序分解为一系列相互连接、功能不同的层。每个模块实现应用程序定义的不同功能层，例如日志记录的读取器、格式化器、分隔符和写入器。ACE_Module提供了在模块内同级任务之间以及模块之间传递消息的方法。但是，它不提供按特定顺序连接或重新排列模块的功能。为了使开发人员能够将一系列层次相关的模块层构建并管理为一个单一对象，ACE Streams 框架定义了ACE_Stream类。

                                                                                                                      The ACE_Module class described in Section 9.2 can be used to decompose a networked application into a series of interconnected, functionally distinct layers. Each module implements a different layer of application-defined functionality, such as a reader, formatter, separator, and writer of log records. ACE_Module provides methods to transfer messages between sibling tasks within a module, as well as between modules. It does not, however, provide a facility to connect or rearrange modules in a particular order. To enable developers to build and manage a series of hierarchically related module layers as a single object, the ACE Streams framework defines the ACE_Stream class.

                                                                                                                      等级能力

                                                                                                                      Class Capabilities

                                                                                                                      ACE_Stream实现了管道和过滤器模式 [ POSA1 ]，使开发人员能够通过自定义可重用的、与应用程序无关的框架类来配置和执行分层相关的服务。此类提供以下功能：

                                                                                                                      ACE_Stream implements the Pipes and Filters pattern [POSA1] to enable developers to configure and execute hierarchically related services by customizing reusable application-independent framework classes. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                                                      • 它提供了动态添加、替换和删除ACE_Module对象的方法，以形成各种流配置。

                                                                                                                      • It provides methods to dynamically add, replace, and remove ACE_Module objects to form various stream configurations.

                                                                                                                      • 它提供了向ACE_Stream发送/接收消息的方法。

                                                                                                                      • It provides methods to send/receive messages to/from an ACE_Stream.

                                                                                                                      • 它提供了一种将两个ACE_Stream流连接在一起的机制。

                                                                                                                      • It provides a mechanism to connect two ACE_Stream streams together.

                                                                                                                      • 它提供了一种关闭流中的所有模块并等待它们全部停止的方法。

                                                                                                                      • It provides a way to shut down all modules in a stream and wait for them all to stop.

                                                                                                                      ACE_Stream的接口如图 9.4所示。由于此类导出了 ACE Streams 框架的许多特性，我们将其方法描述分为以下三个类别。

                                                                                                                      The interface for ACE_Stream is shown in Figure 9.4. Since this class exports many features of the ACE Streams framework, we group its method descriptions into the three categories described below.

                                                                                                                      图 9.4. ACE_Stream类

                                                                                                                      1. 流的初始化和销毁​​方法。 以下方法用于初始化和销毁​​ ACE_Stream：

                                                                                                                      1. Stream initialization and destruction methods. The following methods initialize and destroy an ACE_Stream:

                                                                                                                      方法

                                                                                                                      Method

                                                                                                                      描述

                                                                                                                      Description

                                                                                                                      ACE_Stream() 打开()

                                                                                                                      ACE_Stream() open()

                                                                                                                      初始化一个流。

                                                                                                                      Initialize a stream.

                                                                                                                      ACE_Stream() 关闭()

                                                                                                                      ACE_Stream() close()

                                                                                                                      通过释放流的资源并弹出（销毁）每个模块来销毁流。

                                                                                                                      等待（）

                                                                                                                      默认情况下， ACE 初始化时会在ACE_Stream中安装两个由 ACE 创建的ACE_Module对象，一个位于流的头部，另一个位于流的尾部。头部模块在其读取端和写入端都包含ACE_Stream_Head对象。同样，尾部模块在其读取端和写入端都包含ACE_Stream_Tail对象。这两个类负责解释预定义的控制消息和数据消息块，这些消息和消息块可以在运行时在ACE_Stream中循环。ACE_Message_Block 类将这些消息块的类型定义为枚举器，其所有值均小于MB_USER。

                                                                                                                      By default, two ACE-created ACE_Module objects are installed in an ACE_Stream when it's initialized, one at the head of the stream and the other at the tail. The head module contains ACE_Stream_Head objects in both its reader and writer sides. Likewise, the tail module contains ACE_Stream_Tail objects in both sides. These two classes interpret predefined control messages and data message blocks that can be circulated through an ACE_Stream at run time. The ACE_Message_Block class defines the types of these message blocks as enumerators whose values are all less than MB_USER.

                                                                                                                      ACE_Stream_Head可以对应用程序和ACE_Stream实例之间的消息进行排队。当消息传递到顶层模块的写入端ACE_Stream_Head时，它会被转发到流中的下一个模块。当消息传递到顶层模块的读取端ACE_Stream_Head时，它会被放入任务的消息队列中（除非其类型为MB_FLUSH，在这种情况下，消息队列将被关闭）。

                                                                                                                      ACE_Stream_Head can queue messages between an application and an instance of ACE_Stream. When a message is passed to the top module's writer-side ACE_Stream_Head, it's forwarded to the next module in the stream. When a message is passed to the top module's reader-side ACE_Stream_Head, it's queued on the task's message queue (unless its type is MB_FLUSH, in which case the message queue is shut down).

                                                                                                                      为了防止消息到达流末尾而未处理时发生资源泄漏，ACE_Stream_Tail::put()会在作为写入器时释放接收到的消息。这种行为使得Logrec_Writer模块（第 313 页）能够将其消息块传递给下一个任务。下一个任务很可能是一个ACE_Stream_Tail任务。但是，如果程序在该流的该位置添加了另一个模块，该模块仍会按预期工作。

                                                                                                                      To prevent resource leaks when messages reach the end of a stream without being processed, ACE_Stream_Tail::put() releases messages that it receives when acting as writer. This behavior allows the Logrec_Writer module (page 313) to pass its message blocks through to the next task. Most likely, the next task is an ACE_Stream_Tail.If the program is extended to add another module at that point in the stream, however, the module will continue to work as expected.

                                                                                                                      2. 流配置方法。 以下方法用于将ACE_Module对象推送到 ACE_Stream 或从ACE_Stream中弹出：

                                                                                                                      2. Stream configuration methods. The following methods push and pop ACE_Module objects onto and off of an ACE_Stream:

                                                                                                                      方法

                                                                                                                      Method

                                                                                                                      描述

                                                                                                                      Description

                                                                                                                      推（）

                                                                                                                      push()

                                                                                                                      在流头部正下方添加一个新模块。

                                                                                                                      Add a new module to the stream right below the stream head.

                                                                                                                      流行音乐（）

                                                                                                                      pop()

                                                                                                                      拆下流头正下方的模块并将其关闭。

                                                                                                                      Remove the module right below the stream head and close it down.

                                                                                                                      顶部（）

                                                                                                                      top()

                                                                                                                      返回指向流头正下方模块的指针。

                                                                                                                      Return a pointer to the module right below the stream head.

                                                                                                                      插入（）

                                                                                                                      insert()

                                                                                                                      在指定模块下方插入一个新模块。

                                                                                                                      Insert a new module below the designated module.

                                                                                                                      代替（）

                                                                                                                      replace()

                                                                                                                      用新模块替换指定的模块。

                                                                                                                      Replace the designated module with a new module.

                                                                                                                      消除（）

                                                                                                                      remove()

                                                                                                                      从流中移除指定的模块并将其关闭。

                                                                                                                      Remove the designated module from a stream and close it down.

                                                                                                                      ` push ()`和`pop()`方法允许应用程序在运行时通过在流的顶部插入或移除ACE_Module实例来配置流。当模块被推送到流中时，会自动调用该模块的写入端和读取端任务的 ` open()`钩子方法。同样，当模块从流中弹出时，会自动调用其写入端和读取端任务的` close()`钩子方法。

                                                                                                                      The push() and pop() methods allow applications to configure a stream at run time by inserting or removing an instance of ACE_Module at the top of a stream. When a module is pushed onto a stream, the open() hook methods of the module's writer- and reader-side tasks are called automatically. Likewise, when a module is popped from a stream the close() hook methods of its writer- and reader-side tasks are invoked.

                                                                                                                      由于完整的数据流由一系列相互连接的独立模块组成，因此在数据流的任何位置插入、删除和替换模块通常都很有用。为了支持这些操作，数据流中定义了ACE_Module对象，并且可以使用insert()、replace()和remove()方法来操作数据流中的模块。ACE_Module对象可以组合成几乎任意的配置，以满足应用程序的需求并提高模块的重用性。

                                                                                                                      Since a complete stream is represented as an interconnected series of independent modules, it's often useful to insert, remove, and replace modules at any point in a stream. To support these operations, therefore, ACE_Module objects are named in the stream, and the insert(), replace() and remove() methods can manipulate a stream's modules. ACE_Module objects can be composed in essentially arbitrary configurations that satisfy application requirements and enhance module reuse.

                                                                                                                      3. 流通信方法。 以下方法用于在ACE_Stream上发送和接收消息：

                                                                                                                      3. Stream communication methods. The following methods are used to send and receive messages on an ACE_Stream:

                                                                                                                      方法

                                                                                                                      Method

                                                                                                                      描述

                                                                                                                      Description

                                                                                                                      得到（）

                                                                                                                      get()

                                                                                                                      接收存储在流头部的下一条消息。

                                                                                                                      Receive the next message that's stored at the stream head.

                                                                                                                      放（）

                                                                                                                      put()

                                                                                                                      从流头下方的模块开始，向流中发送消息。

                                                                                                                      Send a message down a stream, starting at the module that's below the stream head.

                                                                                                                      get ()和put()方法允许应用程序向ACE_Stream对象发送和接收消息。与在ACE_Message_Queue中插入消息块类似，可以通过传递以下类型的ACE_Time_Value值来修改这些方法的阻塞行为：

                                                                                                                      The get() and put() methods allow applications to send and receive messages on an ACE_Stream object. Similar to inserting message blocks in an ACE_Message_Queue, the blocking behavior of these methods can be modified by passing the following types of ACE_Time_Value values:

                                                                                                                      价值

                                                                                                                      Value

                                                                                                                      行为

                                                                                                                      Behavior

                                                                                                                      空 ACE_Time_Value指针

                                                                                                                      NULL ACE_Time_Value pointer

                                                                                                                      表示get()或put()应该无限期地等待，也就是说，它会阻塞直到方法完成。

                                                                                                                      Indicates that get() or put() should wait indefinitely, that is, it will block until the method completes.

                                                                                                                      指向非空 ACE_Time_Value 的指针，其sec()和usec()方法均返回 0。

                                                                                                                      Non-NULL ACE_Time_Value pointer whose sec() and usec() methods return 0

                                                                                                                      表示get()或put()应该执行非阻塞操作，也就是说，如果该方法没有立即成功，则返回 -1 并将errno设置为EWOULDBLOCK。

                                                                                                                      Indicates that get() or put() should perform a nonblocking operation, that is, if the method doesn't succeed immediately, return -1 and set errno to EWOULDBLOCK.

                                                                                                                      一个非空的 ACE_Time_Value指针，其sec()或usec()方法返回值大于 0。

                                                                                                                      A non-NULL ACE_Time_Value pointer whose sec() or usec() method returns > 0

                                                                                                                      表示get()或put()应该等到指定时间，如果该方法在此时间之前未完成，则返回 -1，并将errno设置为EWOULDBLOCK 。

                                                                                                                      Indicates that get() or put() should wait until the absolute time of day, returning -1 with errno set to EWOULDBLOCK if the method does not complete by this time.

                                                                                                                      当消息块到达 ACE_Stream 时，它们可以通过调用一系列相互连接的ACE_Task对象的put_next()方法来传递，如侧边栏 60 （第 308 页）所述。消息块可以来自各种来源，例如应用程序线程、反应器或 Proactor，或者 ACE 定时器队列调度器。侧边栏 62概述了 ACE Streams 框架支持的并发模型。

                                                                                                                      When message blocks arrive at an ACE_Stream they can pass through a series of interconnected ACE_Task objects by calling their put_next() methods, as discussed in Sidebar 60 (page 308). Message blocks can originate from various sources, such as an application thread, a reactor or proactor, or an ACE timer queue dispatcher. Sidebar 62 outlines the concurrency models supported by the ACE Streams framework.

                                                                                                                      侧边栏 62：ACE Streams 框架并发模型

                                                                                                                      Sidebar 62: ACE Streams Framework Concurrency Models

                                                                                                                      C++NPv1 的 5.6 节描述了两种典型的并发架构类型：基于任务的架构和基于消息的架构[ SS93 ]，ACE Streams 框架支持这两种架构。例如，` put()`方法可以将消息入队，并将消息处理延迟到其任务的 ` svc()`方法，该方法在单独的线程中并发执行。下面所示的基于任务的架构就体现了这种方法：

                                                                                                                      Section 5.6 of C++NPv1 describes the two canonical types of concurrency architectures, task-based and message-based [SS93], which are supported by the ACE Streams framework. For example, a put() method may enqueue a message and defer handling to its task's svc() method that executes concurrently in a separate thread. This approach is illustrated by the task-based architecture shown below:

                                                                                                                      相反，` put()`方法可以从调用者那里借用线程控制权来立即处理消息。上图所示的基于消息的架构就体现了这种方法。如 [ SS95b ]中所述，流的并发架构对性能和编程便捷性有着显著的影响。

                                                                                                                      Conversely, a put() method can borrow the thread of control from its caller to handle a message immediately. This approach is illustrated by the message-based architecture shown in the figure above. A stream's concurrency architecture has a significant impact on performance and ease of programming, as described in [SS95b].

                                                                                                                      例子

                                                                                                                      Example

                                                                                                                      最后，我们将展示如何使用包含第 9.2 节中介绍的模块的ACE_Stream对象来配置display_logfile程序。下面的程序创建一个ACE_Stream，然后将所有模块推送到该流中。

                                                                                                                      We conclude by showing how to configure the display_logfile program with an ACE_Stream object that contains the modules presented in Section 9.2. The program below creates an ACE_Stream and then pushes all of the modules onto the stream.

                                                                                                                      int ACE_TMAIN (int argc, ACE_TCHAR *argv[]) { 
  if (argc != 2) ACE_ERROR_RETURN 
                  ((LM_ERROR, "usage: %s logfile\n", argv[0]), 1); 
  ACE_TString logfile (argv[1]); 
  ACE_Stream<ACE_MT_SYNCH> stream; 
  if (stream.push 
      (new Logrec_Writer_Module (ACE_TEXT ("Writer"))) != -1 
      && stream.push 
      (new Logrec_Separator_Module (ACE_TEXT ("Separator"))) != -1 
      && stream.push 
      (new Logrec_Formatter_Module (ACE_TEXT ("Formatter"))) != -1 
      && stream.push 
      (new Logrec_Reader_Module (logfile)) != -1) 
    return ACE_Thread_Manager::instance ()->wait () == 0 ? 0 : 1; 
  return 1; 
}

                                                                                                                      当每个模块被推送到流中时，ACE Streams 框架会调用其写入端任务的 open() 钩子方法，该方法会初始化任务。Logrec_Writer_Module和 Logrec_Reader_Module的open ( )钩子方法会将它们的写入任务转换为活动对象。主线程实际上并不参与处理过程。在所有模块成功推送到流之后，它只需等待其他线程在处理完日志文件后退出其活动对象即可。

                                                                                                                      As each module is pushed onto the stream, the ACE Streams framework calls the open() hook method on its writer-side task, which initializes the task. The Logrec_Writer_Module and Logrec_Reader_Module's open() hook methods convert their writer tasks into active objects. The main thread doesn't actually take part in the processing. After pushing all the modules onto the stream successfully, it simply waits for the other threads to exit from their active objects when they're done processing the logfile.

                                                                                                                      上一页的 main() 函数在程序启动和处理日志文件时动态分配了多个模块。为了节省空间，我们从 main() 函数中省略了大部分错误处理逻辑。虽然该程序不太可能在启动时耗尽堆内存，但一个设计良好的生产应用程序应该检查错误并进行适当的处​​理。

                                                                                                                      The main() function on the previous page allocates a number of modules dynamically at program startup and while processing the logfile. We omit most of the error handling logic from the main() function to save space. Although it's unlikely that this program would exhaust the heap at startup time, a well-designed production application should check for errors and handle them appropriately.

                                                                                                                      使用 ACE Streams 框架实现display_logfile程序，可以实现应用程序功能的透明、增量式演进。例如，可以轻松地实现和配置Logrec Sorter模块，该模块可以更改日志记录中字段的显示顺序。同样，ACE Streams 框架降低了display_logfile程序中每个模块层的复杂性，从而简化了其实现、测试和维护。

                                                                                                                      Implementing the display_logfile program with the ACE Streams framework enables the transparent, incremental evolution of application functionality. For example, it's straightforward to implement and configure a Logrec Sorter module that changes the order in which the fields in the log record are displayed. Likewise, the ACE Streams framework reduces the complexity of each module layer in the display_logfile program, thereby simplifying its implementation, testing, and maintenance.

                                                                                                                        9.4 总结

                                                                                                                        9.4 Summary

                                                                                                                        ACE Streams 框架是管道和过滤器模式的一种实现，它采用了面向对象的设计技术、ACE Task 框架和 C++ 语言特性。ACE Streams 框架使得在不修改应用程序无关的框架类的情况下，轻松地将新增或修改的功能集成到ACE_Stream中。例如，将新的服务层集成到ACE_Stream中需要以下步骤：

                                                                                                                        The ACE Streams framework is an implementation of the Pipes and Filters pattern that employs object-oriented design techniques, the ACE Task framework, and C++ language features. The ACE Streams framework makes it easy to incorporate new or modified functionality into an ACE_Stream without modifying the application-independent framework classes. For example, incorporating a new layer of service functionality into an ACE_Stream involves the following steps:

                                                                                                                        1. 继承ACE_Task接口，并在ACE_Task子类中重写open()、close()、put()和svc()方法，以实现应用程序定义的功能。

                                                                                                                        2. Inheriting from the ACE_Task interface and overriding the open(), close(), put(), and svc() methods in the ACE_Task subclass to implement application-defined functionality.

                                                                                                                        3. 分配一个新的ACE_Module，其中包含一个或两个应用程序定义的ACE_Task实例，一个用于读取端，一个用于写入端。

                                                                                                                        4. Allocating a new ACE_Module that contains one or two instances of the application-defined ACE_Tasks, one for the reader-side and one for the writer-side.

                                                                                                                        5. 将ACE_Module插入到ACE_Stream对象中。可以将多个ACE_Module插入到ACE_Stream中，以形成一系列有序的、层次相关的处理能力。

                                                                                                                        6. Inserting the ACE_Module into an ACE_Stream object. Multiple ACE_Modules can be inserted into an ACE_Stream to form an ordered series of hierarchically related processing capabilities.

                                                                                                                        ACE Streams 框架使开发人员能够创建易于扩展、调优、维护和配置的分层模块化网络应用程序。此外，ACE Task、Service Configurator 和 Streams 框架之间的协同作用，支持各种设计和配置，这些设计和配置可以扩展和修改，以适应无数的设计场景、运行时环境和操作系统平台。

                                                                                                                        The ACE Streams framework enables developers to create layered, modular networked applications that are easily extended, tuned, maintained and configured. Moreover, the synergy between the ACE Task, Service Configurator, and Streams frameworks allows a wide range of designs and configurations that can be extended and modified to suit countless design situations, run-time environments, and OS platforms.

                                                                                                                          词汇表

                                                                                                                          Glossary

                                                                                                                          接收器-连接器模式
                                                                                                                          Acceptor-Connector Pattern

                                                                                                                          一种设计模式，它将网络系统中协作对等服务的连接和初始化与它们连接和初始化后执行的处理解耦。

                                                                                                                          A design pattern that decouples the connection and initialization of cooperating peer services in a networked system from the processing they perform once connected and initialized.





                                                                                                                          主动连接建立
                                                                                                                          Active Connection Establishment

                                                                                                                          对等应用程序所扮演的连接角色，即发起与远程对等方的连接（与被动连接建立进行比较）。

                                                                                                                          The connection role played by a peer application that initiates a connection to a remote peer (compare with Passive Connection Establishment).





                                                                                                                          活动对象
                                                                                                                          Active Object

                                                                                                                          实现了主动对象模式的对象。这类对象通常在与调用者线程分离的线程中执行服务请求（与被动对象进行比较）。

                                                                                                                          An object that implements the Active Object pattern. Such objects generally execute service requests in a thread separate from the caller's (compare with Passive Object).





                                                                                                                          活动对象模式
                                                                                                                          Active Object Pattern

                                                                                                                          一种设计模式，它将方法执行与方法调用解耦，以增强并发性并简化对驻留在其自身控制线程中的对象的同步访问。

                                                                                                                          A design pattern that decouples method execution from method invocation in order to enhance concurrency and simplify synchronized access to objects that reside in their own threads of control.





                                                                                                                          建筑模式
                                                                                                                          Architectural Pattern

                                                                                                                          一种表达软件系统基本结构组织模式的模式。它提供了一组预定义的子系统，明确了它们的职责，并包含了组织它们之间关系的规则和指南。

                                                                                                                          A pattern that expresses a fundamental structural organization schema for software systems. It provides a set of predefined subsystems, specifies their responsibilities, and includes rules and guidelines for organizing the relationships between them.





                                                                                                                          方面
                                                                                                                          Aspects

                                                                                                                          程序的某些属性，例如内存管理、同步或容错能力，会跨越模块边界。

                                                                                                                          A property of a program, such as memory management, synchronization, or fault tolerance, that cross-cuts module boundaries.





                                                                                                                          异步完成令牌（ACT）
                                                                                                                          Asynchronous Completion Token (ACT)

                                                                                                                          开发者提供的与异步操作关联的值。它用于将与操作相关的信息传递给操作的完成处理程序。

                                                                                                                          A developer-supplied value associated with an asynchronous operation. It is used to communicate information related to the operation to the operation's completion handler.





                                                                                                                          异步 I/O
                                                                                                                          Asynchronous I/O

                                                                                                                          一种用于发送或接收数据的机制，其中启动了 I/O 操作，但调用者不会阻塞等待操作完成。

                                                                                                                          A mechanism for sending or receiving data in which an I/O operation is initiated but the caller does not block waiting for the operation to complete.





                                                                                                                          屏障同步
                                                                                                                          Barrier Synchronization

                                                                                                                          线程同步机制允许一组指定的线程在各自达到特定状态（例如完成某个集体操作或任务）时同步执行进度。屏障代表执行路径上的一个特定点。每个到达屏障点的线程都会等待其他线程也到达该点。当集合中的所有线程都到达屏障点时，屏障将被“释放”，所有线程同时继续执行。

                                                                                                                          A thread synchronization mechanism that allows a designated group of threads to synchronize their progress when each attains a certain state, such as completion of some collective operation or task. A barrier represents a specific point in the execution path. Each thread that reaches the barrier point waits for the other threads to also reach that point. When all threads in the set reach the barrier, the barrier is "dropped" and all threads simultaneously continue execution.





                                                                                                                          有界缓冲区
                                                                                                                          Bounded Buffer

                                                                                                                          一个有限大小的缓冲区，允许两个（或多个）线程并发共享该缓冲区，其中至少一个线程向缓冲区插入项目，至少一个线程从缓冲区中删除项目。

                                                                                                                          A finite-sized buffer that allows two (or more) threads to share the buffer concurrently, with at least one thread inserting items into the buffer and at least one thread removing items from the buffer.





                                                                                                                          桥接模式
                                                                                                                          Bridge Pattern

                                                                                                                          一种设计模式，它将抽象与其实现解耦，使两者可以独立变化。

                                                                                                                          A design pattern that decouples an abstraction from its implementation so that the two can vary independently.





                                                                                                                          繁忙等待
                                                                                                                          Busy Wait

                                                                                                                          线程使用的一种技术是通过执行紧密循环并在每次迭代中轮询锁是否可用来等待锁，这与通过睡眠并允许其他线程运行来等待锁被释放的方式形成对比。

                                                                                                                          A technique used by a thread to wait for a lock by executing a tight loop and polling to see if the lock is available on each iteration, in contrast to waiting for the lock to be released by sleeping and allowing other threads to run.





                                                                                                                          缓存亲和性
                                                                                                                          Cache Affinity

                                                                                                                          一种线程调度优化，优先将线程调度到它最近运行过的 CPU 上，以最大限度地提高其状态出现在 CPU 指令缓存和数据缓存中的概率。

                                                                                                                          A thread scheduling optimization that gives preference to dispatching a thread on the CPU on which it most recently ran to maximize the probability of its state being present in the CPU's instruction and data caches.





                                                                                                                          打回来
                                                                                                                          Callback

                                                                                                                          向调度器注册的对象，当特定事件发生时，调度器会回调对象上的方法。

                                                                                                                          An object registered with a dispatcher, which calls back to a method on the object when a particular event occurs.





                                                                                                                          搭配
                                                                                                                          Collocation

                                                                                                                          将对象定位到单个进程或主机中，通常是为了提高简单性或性能（与分布式比较）。

                                                                                                                          The locating of objects into a single process or host, often done to improve simplicity or performance (compare with Distribution).





                                                                                                                          通用数据表示法 (CDR)
                                                                                                                          Common Data Representation (CDR)

                                                                                                                          CORBA 定义的用于序列化和反序列化数据的标准格式。它使用双规范的“接收方优先”表示法，只有当发送方的字节顺序与接收方的字节顺序不同时才会产生开销。

                                                                                                                          The standard format defined by CORBA to marshal and demarshal data. It uses a bicanonical "receiver makes right" representation that only incurs overhead if the byte order of the sender differs from the byte order of the receiver.





                                                                                                                          通用中间件服务
                                                                                                                          Common Middleware Services

                                                                                                                          这一层中间件定义了与领域无关的服务，例如事件通知、日志记录、多媒体流、持久性、安全性、全局时间同步、实时调度和分布式资源管理、容错、并发控制和可恢复事务，这些服务用于在整个分布式系统中分配、调度和协调各种资源。

                                                                                                                          This layer of middleware defines domain-independent services, such as event notifications, logging, multimedia streaming, persistence, security, global time synchronization, real-time scheduling and distributed resource management, fault tolerance, concurrency control, and recoverable transactions, that allocate, schedule, and coordinate various resources throughout a distributed system.





                                                                                                                          完成处理程序
                                                                                                                          Completion Handler

                                                                                                                          一个接口包含一个或多个钩子方法的对象，这些钩子方法旨在处理完成事件。

                                                                                                                          An object whose interface contains one or more hook methods designed to process completion events.





                                                                                                                          成分
                                                                                                                          Component

                                                                                                                          组件是软件系统中封装的一部分，用于实现特定的服务或一组服务。组件具有一个或多个接口，用于访问其提供的服务。组件是构建系统结构的基本单元。在编程语言层面，组件可以表示为模块、类、对象或一组相关函数。未实现其接口所有元素的组件称为抽象组件。

                                                                                                                          An encapsulated part of a software system that implements a specific service or set of services. A component has one or more interfaces that provide access to its services. Components serve as building blocks for the structure of a system. On a programming language level, components may be represented as modules, classes, objects, or a set of related functions. A component that does not implement all the elements of its interface is called an abstract component.





                                                                                                                          组件配置器模式
                                                                                                                          Component Configurator Pattern

                                                                                                                          一种设计模式，允许应用程序在运行时链接和取消链接其组件实现，而无需静态地修改、重新编译或重新链接应用程序。

                                                                                                                          A design pattern that allows an application to link and unlink its component implementations at run time without having to modify, recompile, or relink the application statically.





                                                                                                                          并发性
                                                                                                                          Concurrency

                                                                                                                          对象、组件或系统执行“逻辑上同时”的操作的能力（与并行性比较）。

                                                                                                                          The ability of an object, component, or system to execute operations that are "logically simultaneous" (compare with Parallelism).





                                                                                                                          条件变量
                                                                                                                          Condition Variable

                                                                                                                          线程间协作时会使用一种同步机制，使线程暂时挂起，直到涉及线程间共享数据的条件表达式达到预期状态。条件变量始终与互斥锁配合使用，线程必须在计算条件表达式之前获取互斥锁。如果条件表达式为假，线程会原子地挂起自身并释放互斥锁，以便其他线程可以修改共享数据。当协作线程修改此数据时，它可以通知条件变量，条件变量会原子地恢复之前挂起的线程并重新获取互斥锁。

                                                                                                                          A synchronization mechanism used by collaborating threads to suspend themselves temporarily until condition expressions involving data shared between the threads attain desired states. A condition variable is always used in conjunction with a mutex, which the thread must acquire before evaluating the condition expression. If the condition expression is false the thread atomically suspends itself on the condition variable and releases the mutex, so that other threads can change the shared data. When a cooperating thread changes this data, it can notify the condition variable, which atomically resumes a thread that had previously suspended on the condition variable and acquires its mutex again.





                                                                                                                          容器
                                                                                                                          Container

                                                                                                                          容器是存储元素集合的数据结构的通用名称。列表、集合和关联数组都是容器的例子。此外，组件模型（例如 EJB 和 ActiveX 控件）也定义了容器，这些容器提供了一个运行时环境，使组件免受底层基础架构（例如操作系统）细节的影响。

                                                                                                                          A common name for data structures that hold a collection of elements. Examples of containers are lists, sets, and associative arrays. In addition, component models, such as EJB and ActiveX Controls, define containers that provide a run-time environment that shields components from the details of their underlying infrastructure, such as an operating system.





                                                                                                                          关键部分
